destinations.name: Africa
destinations.description: Discover breathtaking sightseeing, world-class stays, and seamless guided itineraries across Africa.
destinations.climate: Many people hold the misconception that Africa is a culturally homogenous continent. However, one of the most fascinating truths about Africa is its remarkable ethnic and linguistic diversity. The continent is home to over 3,000 tribes, such as the Zulu, Bantu, Berber, and Maasai. These communities collectively speak more than 2,000 languages, including Arabic in the north, Zulu in the south, and French across many West African nations like Mali, Senegal, and Benin. This cultural richness is what makes exploring Africa an unforgettable experience through our carefully crafted Africa tour packages.
tips: Namibia’s Namib is Earth’s oldest desert
Africa’s iconic Baobab is called the Tree of Life
The Congo is the world’s deepest and second-largest river

packages.title: Experience the Spiritual Essence of India with the Ayodhya Tour Package
packages.description: Varanasi, also known as Kashi or Benares, stands as one of the oldest living cities in the world and holds immense religious significance for Hindus. Ayodhya, on the other hand, is deeply revered as the birthplace of Lord Rama. Explore these sacred destinations with our dedicated Ayodhya tour package.
highlights: Ram Janmabhoomi Temple & Kanak Bhawan Darshan
Scenic boat ride on Sarayu River & Evening Ganga Aarti in Varanasi
Nageshwarnath Temple, Treta ke Thakur & Sita ki Rasoi

itinerary.title: Arrival in Lucknow & Transfer to Ayodhya
itinerary.description: On arrival at Lucknow Airport, meet your TripByGenie tour executive who assists with your transfer to Ayodhya (2.5 hrs). Check into your hotel. In the evening, witness the divine Aarti at Sarayu Ghat.

itinerary.title: Sacred Ayodhya Darshan & Ram Janmabhoomi
itinerary.description: Begin your spiritual morning with holy darshan at the magnificent Ram Janmabhoomi Temple. Continue to Kanak Bhawan, Nageshwarnath Temple, Treta ke Thakur, and Sita ki Rasoi.

itinerary.title: Ayodhya to Varanasi & Evening Ghat Aarti
itinerary.description: Post breakfast, drive to Varanasi, the city of light and Shiva. In the evening, experience the world-famous spiritual Ganga Aarti by private boat at Dashashwamedh Ghat.

itinerary.title: Kashi Vishwanath Temple & Departure from Varanasi
itinerary.description: Early morning darshan at the sacred Kashi Vishwanath Jyotirlinga and Sankat Mochan Temple. Transfer to Varanasi Airport or Railway Station with cherished blessings.

package_itineraries.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Sunset Shikara on Dal Lake
package_itineraries.description: Meet and greet at Srinagar Airport by our representative. Transfer to your luxury houseboat. Evening relaxing 1-hour shikara ride on Dal Lake passing floating gardens and lotus blossoms.
package_itineraries.activities: Airport pickup, Houseboat check-in, Dal Lake Shikara ride

package_itineraries.title: Mughal Gardens & Historic Srinagar Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Visit the world-renowned Mughal terraced gardens: Nishat Bagh (Garden of Pleasure) and Shalimar Bagh (Abode of Love), followed by Chashme Shahi and Shankaracharya Hill temple.
package_itineraries.activities: Sightseeing of Mughal Gardens, Old Srinagar heritage walk

package_itineraries.title: Gulmarg Meadow of Flowers & Gondola Ride
package_itineraries.description: Scenic drive to Gulmarg. Board the famous Gulmarg Gondola up to Kongdoori Phase 1 (elev. 10,000 ft). Enjoy snow views and optional skiing or snowmobiling.
package_itineraries.activities: Gondola ride, snow play, alpine photography

package_itineraries.title: Pahalgam Valley of Shepherds & Lidder River
package_itineraries.description: Drive along saffron fields of Pampore to reach Pahalgam. Visit scenic Betaab Valley where Bollywood movies were filmed, and stroll beside the turquoise Lidder river.
package_itineraries.activities: Saffron field stop, Betaab Valley, Lidder river walk

package_itineraries.title: Aru Valley & Kashmiri Handicrafts Shopping
package_itineraries.description: Explore the unspoiled alpine meadows of Aru Valley. Return to Srinagar for an afternoon visiting authentic Pashmina shawl looms and walnut woodcarving workshops.
package_itineraries.activities: Aru Valley exploration, artisan craft workshops, Wazwan feast

package_itineraries.title: Departure with Cherished Himalayan Memories
package_itineraries.description: After a leisurely breakfast overlooking the water, transfer to Srinagar International Airport for your flight home with unforgettable memories.

package_itineraries.title: Arrival in Male & Seaplane Transfer to Paradise Island
package_itineraries.description: Land at Velana International Airport and board your scenic seaplane flight over sparkling atolls. Check in to your luxury Beach Villa. Welcome tropical cocktail & dinner.
package_itineraries.activities: Seaplane transfer, resort welcome, beach sunset walk

package_itineraries.title: House Reef Snorkeling & Sunset Dolphin Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Swim in warm crystal waters alongside sea turtles and colorful reef fish. In the late afternoon, embark on a traditional Maldivian Dhoni cruise to spot playful spinner dolphins.
package_itineraries.activities: Guided reef snorkeling, sunset dolphin cruise

package_itineraries.title: Water Villa Check-In & Overwater Spa Therapy
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to your iconic Overwater Villa with glass floor panels and direct sea stairs. Enjoy an afternoon couple signature aromatherapeutic massage at the overwater spa.
package_itineraries.activities: Water villa transition, couple spa ritual, private sundeck relaxing

package_itineraries.title: Kayak Safari & Candlelight Beach Dinner
package_itineraries.description: Paddle transparent kayaks across calm lagoons. In the evening, enjoy a private 5-course romantic candlelight dinner on the secluded beach under starlit skies.
package_itineraries.activities: Clear kayak safari, private candlelight dinner

package_itineraries.title: Farewell Maldives & Seaplane Return
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast over the lagoon before your seaplane return transfer to Male for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Bali
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Bali, you’ll be greeted at the airport and transferred to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to unwind, enjoy the surroundings, or explore nearby attractions at your leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Celuk Village – Mas Village – Elephant Cave – Kintamani – Ubud Village Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start the day at Celuk Village, renowned for its intricate gold and silver jewellery crafted by local artisans. Continue to Mas Village, where skilled craftsmen create elaborate wooden carvings. Visit the historic Elephant Cave (Goa Gajah), an important Hindu archaeological site. The journey then leads to Tirta Empul Temple, where holy spring water is believed to hold purifying powers. Later, admire the volcanic beauty of Mount Batur and Lake Batur in Kintamani. Before heading back, explore Ubud Market for traditional Balinese crafts and souvenirs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tanjung Benoa Beach
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a fun-filled day at Tanjung Benoa Beach, a hub for exciting water sports like parasailing, jet skiing, and banana boat rides. In the afternoon, relax with a rejuvenating spa session that will leave you refreshed and re-energized. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Bali
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your return flight, carrying with you the memories of a splendid Bali experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Dubai – Miracle Garden - Dhow Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Dubai and check into your hotel. Start your trip with Miracle Garden, spread over 72,000 sq. meters with over 150 million flowers. In the evening, enjoy a Dhow Cruise with dinner and entertainment. Return to the hotel for rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Burj Khalifa – Dubai Creek – Dubai Mall - Jumeirah Beach
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Burj Khalifa and explore its observation decks. Continue to Dubai Creek for a boat ride, then enjoy retail therapy at Dubai Mall. End the day at Jumeirah Beach.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Desert Safari
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day in the desert, enjoying dune bashing, camel rides, and sand skiing. Watch live shows, taste delicious BBQ dinner, and rest under the desert stars before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Sharjah - Al Corniche Beach - Sharjah Natural History Museum and Desert Park
package_itineraries.description: Head to Sharjah and check into your hotel. Visit Al Corniche Beach, followed by the Sharjah Natural History Museum and Desert Park, where you can also interact with farm animals.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Mleiha Archaeological Centre - Sharjah Aquarium - Al Noor Island
package_itineraries.description: Begin with Mleiha Archaeological Centre to explore history and nature. Visit Sharjah Aquarium, home to 250 species of marine life. End your day at Al Noor Island, featuring a Butterfly House, café, playground, and modern art.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Sharjah
package_itineraries.description: Check out from the hotel and transfer to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Zurich – Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zurich and travel to Lucerne. Explore the Old Town, Chapel Bridge, and Lion Monument, or enjoy a boat ride on Lake Lucerne. Overnight in Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Lucerne – Mount Titlis
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Engelberg and ride the Rotair cable car to Mount Titlis , where snow awaits year-round. Admire panoramic alpine views before returning to Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Lucerne – Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: Board a train to Interlaken. Spend the day exploring or trying adventure activities like paragliding. Evening strolls along Interlaken’s streets are highly recommended.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Jungfraujoch Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Jungfraujoch , the “Top of Europe,” and explore the Ice Palace and Sphinx Observatory. Return to Interlaken in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Interlaken – Bern City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Adventure seekers may try bungee jumping or a helicopter ride. Later, take a train to Bern for a city tour featuring the Rose Garden, Clock Tower, and Bern Cathedral before returning to Interlaken.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Interlaken – Zurich
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Zurich. Visit the Rhine Falls and explore Zurich’s vibrant old streets, markets, and museums.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Zurich Airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Kochi
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Kochi and check in to your hotel. Begin sightseeing with a visit to Mattancherry Palace, Hill Palace Museum, Paradesi Synagogue, St. Francis Church, and the famous Chinese fishing nets. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kochi to Alleppey
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Alleppey, known for its backwaters, lagoons, and beaches. Check in to your hotel and enjoy lunch. Stroll along Alleppey Beach in the evening before returning for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Alleppey to Kumarakom
package_itineraries.description: Post breakfast, drive to Kumarakom and board a houseboat at 12:30 PM. Cruise along Vembanad Lake while enjoying local cuisine prepared onboard. Relax amidst the serene surroundings and spend the night on the houseboat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Kochi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from the houseboat and drive to Kochi Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Delhi – Shimla
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Delhi airport, where you’ll be assisted with your transfer to Shimla. The scenic 8-hour drive showcases the majestic Shivalik mountain ranges. After checking into the hotel, explore the nearby surroundings or rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Shimla City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out for local sightseeing. Visit Christ Church, Viceregal Lodge, Shri Hanuman Temple, Kali Bari Temple, Annadale Ground, and Green Valley. Spend the evening at Mall Road, enjoying shopping and dining before returning to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Shimla – Manali
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Manali. The 8-hour journey offers spectacular landscapes, mountain valleys, and lush forests. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel and spend the night in Manali.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Manali
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore Manali’s major attractions including the Hadimba Devi Temple, Tibetan monasteries, and the hot springs of Vashisht Kund. Later, browse through the local markets for handicrafts before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Snow Point Excursion
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head for an excursion to the nearby snow points—Kothi, Gulaba, Marhi, and the iconic Rohtang Pass. Later, enjoy Solang Valley, famous for adventure sports and breathtaking landscapes. Return to Manali for an overnight stay

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Manali – Chandigarh
package_itineraries.description: Leave Manali after breakfast and travel to Chandigarh, known for its urban planning and modern architecture. Visit Rock Garden, Rose Garden, and Sukhna Lake. Stay overnight in Chandigarh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Chandigarh – Delhi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and return to Delhi. Proceed to the airport or railway station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Hanoi and begin a city tour featuring the Temple of Literature , Ba Dinh Square , and the Old Quarter by cyclo, including a visit to Ngoc Son Temple . Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi - Tam Coc - Hoa Lu - Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Head to Ninh Binh for a boat trip through the Tam Coc caves and a visit to the ancient capital Hoa Lu . See temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le. Lunch included. Return to Hanoi for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi to Halong
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Halong Bay , a UNESCO Natural World Heritage site. Cruise among limestone cliffs, visit caves, and enjoy swimming or kayaking. Dinner and overnight on board.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Halong – Hanoi – Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Cruise back to Halong Wharf, passing by Cock-Fighting Rock, Sail Island, and other famous islets. Return to Hanoi and fly to Saigon . Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Saigon – Mekong Delta – Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Mekong Delta with boat trips, island visits, local factory stops, honey tea tasting, and a horse-cart ride. Visit Vinh Trang Pagoda before returning to Saigon. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Cu Chi Tunnels , a wartime relic. In the evening, explore Saigon’s shopping spots such as Ben Thanh Market, Saigon Square, or Diamond Plaza. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast at the hotel before your airport transfer.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in London
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Heathrow, transfer to your hotel, and check in. Spend the day at leisure near your hotel. Overnight in London.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: London City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Visit UNESCO sites like the Tower of London, Westminster Palace, Greenwich, and Royal Botanical Gardens. Other stops include Buckingham Palace, London Eye, London Bridge, British Museum, St. Paul’s Cathedral, Big Ben, Hyde Park, Natural History Museum, Trafalgar Square, Kensington Palace, Borough Market, and London Aquarium.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: London to Paris
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Paris on the Eurostar (approx. 2.5 hours). On arrival, transfer to your hotel and explore nearby areas in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Paris City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Discover the Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame, Arc de Triomphe, Luxembourg Gardens, Pantheon, and Palace of Versailles. The guided tour offers audio in multiple languages and includes lunch.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Disneyland Paris
package_itineraries.description: Travel 32 km outside Paris to Disneyland, with rides, shows, and shopping. Return to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Paris
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Goa
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival, our representatives will welcome you and escort you to your hotel. After check-in, freshen up and take some time to relax. Spend the remainder of the day exploring romantic local attractions before returning for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: South Goa
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, head out to experience the peaceful charm of South Goa. Visit the revered Shree Mangueshi Temple and the iconic churches of Old Goa. End your day at Dona Paula, where you can indulge in sunbathing or adventurous water activities like jet skiing, kayaking, and scuba diving.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: North Goa
package_itineraries.description: Post breakfast, embark on a North Goa tour filled with scenic beaches and lively vibes. Enjoy dolphin watching and explore the historic Aguada Fort, a magnificent 17th-century Portuguese structure. Return to your hotel and unwind.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Goa
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at leisure, soak in your last moments in Goa, and then check out from the hotel. Proceed to the airport or railway station for your return journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Jammu
package_itineraries.description: Upon arriving at Jammu Airport, you will be greeted by your tour representative, who will assist you on your drive to Katra. The journey takes about one and a half hours and is filled with stunning mountain views. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the surroundings. Overnight stay in Katra.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Katra – Vaishno Devi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out for a spiritual journey to the Vaishno Devi Temple, a revered 700-year-old shrine devoted to Maa Shakti. After completing your darshan, return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Katra.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Katra – Pahalgam
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive to Pahalgam, a tranquil hill station adorned with verdant meadows and glistening rivers. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy exploring the charming surroundings. Spend the night in Pahalgam.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Pahalgam – Gulmarg
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, explore local attractions in Pahalgam, such as Mamaleshwar Temple, Chandanwari, Wadiy e Hajan, and the sacred Amarnath Cave Temple. Later, proceed to Gulmarg, known for its scenic gondola rides and alpine beauty. Visit Strawberry Valley, Afarwat, and Drung Waterfall before retiring for the night in Gulmarg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Gulmarg – Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Srinagar, the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir. Visit Shalimar Bagh, Nishat Garden, Pari Mahal, the Tulip Garden, Hari Parbat, and Dal Lake. Enjoy a serene houseboat stay overnight in Srinagar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore the places you missed yesterday. Take a boat ride across Dal Lake, visit the Floating Gardens, Lal Chowk, and Sinthan Top, or simply unwind amid the natural beauty. Overnight stay in Srinagar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a relaxed day. You can visit Sri Shankaracharya Temple, go shopping for souvenirs, or simply relax in your houseboat with a warm cup of Kashmiri kahwa. Stay overnight in Srinagar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Depart Srinagar
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed to the airport to board your flight home, carrying wonderful memories of your Kashmir journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arriving in Harare
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Harare International Airport, you'll be greeted by our tour representatives just outside the baggage hall. After a satisfying lunch, embark on a half-day excursion to Chinoyi Cave, which is situated 120km from here. In the evening, savour a delightful dinner at a local restaurant before heading back to Harare for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Harare to Hwange
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. After checking out, head to Harare Airport for a flight to Victoria Falls. Upon arrival at Victoria Falls Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and transfer you to Hwange Safari Lodge in a luxurious bus. Check in at the lodge and savour a delicious lunch. In the afternoon, the group will convene for tea before embarking on a three-hour game drive. As the sun sets, return to your lodge for a delightful dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Delight in Safari Adventures
package_itineraries.description: Today, our expert guide will lead you on a thrilling safari drive into the National Park. Pause for a delightful American breakfast. The morning is yours to unwind by the pool and relish in some leisurely fun. Lunch will be served around midday, and in the afternoon, the entire group will gather for a tea session before embarking on another exciting safari drive. Return to the lodge for a delectable dinner and enjoy an overnight stay at Hwange.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Victoria Falls
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a hearty American breakfast, followed by a visit to the stunning Victoria Falls. Return to the hotel for lunch, and then explore the world-renowned "Mighty Victoria Falls," one of the most magnificent waterfalls globally. In the evening, return to the hotel and savour a delicious dinner. You can spend the night at Victoria Falls for a restful stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Zambezi River
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. Next, we'll visit the Crocodile Farm and Crocodile Leather Factory for an interesting tour. Return to the hotel and indulge in a delightful lunch. In the afternoon, the group will embark on a Sunset Cruise along the majestic Zambezi River. Take a break and savour your dinner back at the hotel. You can then relax and enjoy your overnight stay at Victoria Falls.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Time to Leave
package_itineraries.description: Once you've had your breakfast, make your way to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Casablanca
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Casablanca's Mohamed V airport, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred to your hotel. Check in at the hotel and spend the night in Casablanca. Have a splendid dinner at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Casablanca to Rabat - Discovering the Capitals
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a captivating journey as we delve into the vibrant cities of Morocco. We begin the day with a comprehensive city tour of Casablanca, the nation's economic hub. From the comfort of your coach, you'll witness the enchanting Medina, Mohammed V square, the bustling United Nations square, the lively Central Market, the charming Habbous quarter, the Royal Palace, and the affluent Anfa residential area. Admire the grandeur of the iconic Hassan II Mosque from the outside, and take in the picturesque Ain Diab Cornice, lined with inviting swimming pools and exquisite gastronomic restaurants. In the afternoon, our voyage continues as we set forth to Rabat, Morocco's administrative capital. Here, we'll explore the "Imperial Garden City," known for its significant landmarks. Stroll through the Oudayas garden, stand in awe of the magnificent Hassan Tower and Mausoleum, and witness the formidable ramparts and walls of the Mechouar surrounding the Royal Palace. As the day draws to a close, we'll reach our hotel in Rabat for a seamless check-in. Rest and rejuvenate as you prepare for the adventures that lie ahead. Overnight stay at the hotel in Rabat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rabat to Meknes and Fes
package_itineraries.description: Today, we journey to Meknes, often referred to as the "Moroccan Versailles," founded by Moulay Ismail in the late 17th century, during the time of Louis XIV. Our exploration includes a visit to the renowned Bab El Mansour, widely regarded as one of Morocco's most exquisite gateways. We also have the option to explore Meknes or the holy city of Moulay Idriss, which gazes upon the ancient ruins of Volubilis. Our journey continues to Fes, where you'll settle into your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Fes
package_itineraries.description: Today, we dedicate the entire day to exploring Fes, the oldest of Morocco's Imperial Cities, renowned for its profound spiritual and educational influence on Moroccan culture. We'll delve into the medieval Medina, where you'll be captivated by its historical charm. Wander through the renowned souks, where skilled artisans continue to craft in the timeless oriental tradition. Enjoy a leisurely lunch. In the afternoon, our sightseeing adventure continues. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Fes.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Fes to Marrakech
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with an early breakfast, and then set out for Marrakech. Along the way, you'll pass through some charming places. First, you'll visit Immouzer du Kandar, a picturesque Berber village. Afterward, your journey takes you to Ifrane, a delightful ski resort known for its beauty. Then, you'll continue to Azrou, another Berber village famous for its wood carving and carpet weaving cooperative. As the day progresses, you'll make your way to Marrakech. You'll arrive in the late afternoon and check in to your hotel. Enjoy an overnight stay in the heart of Marrakech.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Marrakech - City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Today is all about discovering the charms of Marrakech, the second-oldest Imperial City and the renowned "Pearl of the South." Established by the Almoravides in the late 11th century, Marrakech is nestled in a verdant oasis at the base of the snow-capped Atlas Mountains. Your day will include visits to iconic landmarks like the Saadian Tombs, Menara Gardens, Koutoubia Mosque, and the magnificent Bahia Palace. After a leisurely lunch, your journey continues with a stroll through the bustling souks and a visit to the famous Jemaa El Fna square. You'll spend the night at your Marrakech hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Marrakech to Casablanca
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning, whether it's exploring the vibrant souks or unwinding by your hotel's poolside. Lunch in Marrakech at your own pace. Later, journey to Casablanca for an overnight stay at your hotel. Breakfast and Dinner included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Farewell Casablanca
package_itineraries.description: As the morning arrives, have your breakfast and get ready to bid adieu to your hotel and make your way to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Casablanca
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Casablanca's Mohamed V airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your driver and transferred to your hotel. After checking in, you'll spend the night at the hotel in Casablanca. Dinner will be provided.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Casablanca - City Discovery - Rabat
package_itineraries.description: Today, we embark on a brief exploration of Casablanca, the thriving business hub of the kingdom. From our comfortable coach, we'll catch glimpses of the Medina, Mohammed V Square, United Nations Place, the charming Habbous quarter, the Royal Palace, and the Anfa residential area. Not to be missed is the grand Hassan II Mosque. After this delightful experience, we set our course for Rabat. Upon arrival, we'll check into our hotel and settle in for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rabat - City Exploration - Tangier
package_itineraries.description: Explore Morocco's administrative capital today. Discover the "Imperial Garden City" with its prominent landmarks, including the Oudayas garden, Hassan Tower, and its Mausoleum. You can choose to have lunch at a local restaurant in Rabat. Afterward, we'll continue our journey to Tangier, passing through Larache and Asilah. Check-in at the hotel in Tangier for a comfortable overnight stay. Breakfast and Dinner will be included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Tangier - Chefchaouen - Fes
package_itineraries.description: Today, we will embark on a captivating journey through the legendary city of Tangier. Our first stop is Cape Spartel, where the sparkling Mediterranean Sea gracefully merges with the vast Atlantic Ocean. Take some free time to relish the breathtaking views from the furthest Northwestern tip of Africa. Next, we head to the enchanting city of Chefchaouen, known for its charming streets adorned in shades of white and blue. There, we'll enjoy a delightful lunch at a local restaurant. In the late afternoon, we make our way to the historic city of Fes, where we'll check in at our hotel. Rest and refresh for the night ahead. You'll spend the night at our comfortable hotel in Fes. Breakfast and Dinner included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Fes – Exploring the City
package_itineraries.description: Today is all about immersing yourself in the rich history of Fez, the oldest of Morocco's Imperial Cities, celebrated for its significant influence on Moroccan culture. Begin with a visit to the ancient Medina. Stroll through the bustling souks, where artisans continue their age-old craft in the traditional oriental way. Later, journey to Meknes, often dubbed the "Moroccan Versailles," and take in the sights, including Bab El Mansour. Return to your hotel and enjoy an overnight stay in Fes with breakfast and dinner included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Fes to Erfoud via Midelt
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with an early breakfast, and then set off for Merzouga, passing through Erfoud and the charming Berber village of Immouzer du Kandar. Your journey will take you through Ifrane, a picturesque ski resort, and Azrou, a Berber village renowned for its skilled artisans specialising in wood carving and carpet weaving. Take your time for lunch at a serene Kasbah in Midelt. Afterward, continue your adventure through the breathtaking Ziz canyons, offering magnificent views of the Atlas Mountains. You'll finally reach Erfoud and check in at your hotel. Enjoy your overnight stay in Erfoud, with both breakfast and dinner included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Erfoud to Ouarzazate via Tinghir
package_itineraries.description: Today, we'll journey to Ouarzazate through Tinghir, where you'll find the Todra Gorges, renowned for being both the highest and narrowest in the region, just 15 km from Tinghir. The road along the Todra Gorges offers stunning views of palm tree-covered riverbanks. Next, we'll continue our drive to Ouarzazate via Boumalne, Kelaa M'Gouna, and Skoura. Upon arriving in Ouarzazate, you'll have the opportunity to explore its main Kasbahs. Afterward, we'll check in at the hotel, where you'll spend the night. Breakfast and dinner are included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Ouarzazate to Marrakech
package_itineraries.description: Today, we will embark on a journey to the famous Ait Benhadou Kasbah, located just 30 kilometers from Ouarzazate. This stunning fortress is a true gem of southern Morocco and has served as the backdrop for numerous films, including the iconic "Lawrence of Arabia." Aït Benhaddou: This fortified village, now home to only five families, holds UNESCO recognition as a global cultural treasure. Its ancient beauty is a testament to Morocco's rich history. After our exploration, we set out on a scenic route towards Marrakech, taking us through winding mountain roads and the Tizin Tichka Pass, the highest mountain pass in Morocco. Upon arrival, we'll check into our hotel for a comfortable overnight stay. Breakfast and dinner included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Marrakech - City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Today, embark on a full-day city tour of Marrakech, the second oldest Imperial City and often referred to as the "Pearl of the South." Founded by the Almoravides in the late 11th century, Marrakesh is a vibrant city surrounded by the snow-capped Atlas Mountains and lush oases. Your journey includes visits to renowned attractions such as the Bahia Palace, Menara Gardens, an external view of the Koutoubia Mosque, and an opportunity for a leisurely lunch. Later, immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of the souks and the famous Jemaa El Fna square. Tonight, rest comfortably at your Marrakech hotel. Optional: In the evening, you have the choice to enjoy dinner at the local restaurant "Chez Ali" with captivating folkloric performances and a spectacular Fantasia show or savour the delights of an Arab palace with mesmerising belly dancing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Marrakech to Essaouira
package_itineraries.description: This morning, we'll journey to Essaouira, a city with a rich history that echoes the times when Spain, Portugal, and England vied for control of its coast. This charming coastal town showcases a blend of Moorish and Portuguese architecture, featuring a picturesque Portuguese harbour. Essaouira is renowned for its skilled artisans working with thuja wood, a vibrant silver market, an inspiring art gallery, and its bustling harbour and islands. Fun fact: Orson Welles filmed his masterpiece, Othello, right here in Essaouira. During your visit, explore the impressive Skala ramparts, admire the seaside port, and wander through the captivating Medina. You'll spend the night at a cozy hotel in Essaouira, with both breakfast and dinner provided. Enjoy your stay in this enchanting coastal town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Essaouira – Safi - El Jadida - Casablanca
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before embarking on your journey to Safi, one of Africa's oldest ports beyond Gibraltar. You'll explore the remnants of the Portuguese Sea Castle and can shop for exquisite pottery on Pottery's Hill. Next, you'll head to Oualidia, a charming seaside resort famous for its oyster farming, where you can choose to have a leisurely lunch. In the afternoon, you'll continue your adventure to the picturesque beach resort of El Jadida, formerly known as “Mazagan” during the Portuguese era, for a brief visit. Afterward, you'll make your way to Casablanca, where you'll check in at the hotel for a restful night. Your stay in Casablanca includes breakfast and dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Leaving Casablanca
package_itineraries.description: Today, after having a delicious breakfast, it's time to say goodbye to your hotel and head to Mohamed V Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Casablanca
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Mohamed V Airport, you'll be warmly welcomed and transferred to your hotel in Casablanca. After checking in, you'll spend the night at the hotel in Casablanca. Dinner included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Casablanca – Rabat - Fes
package_itineraries.description: Today, we start with a delightful tour of Casablanca, the bustling business hub of the kingdom. From the comfort of your coach, you'll take in the sights of the Medina, Mohammed V square, United Nations square, the Central Market, the Habbous quarter, the Royal Palace, the residential area of Anfa, and catch a glimpse of the splendid Hassan II Mosque and the picturesque Ain Diab Corniche, adorned with swimming pools and gourmet restaurants. We then continue to Rabat, where you'll have a leisurely lunch. In Rabat, often referred to as the "Imperial Garden City," we explore its key landmarks, such as the Oudayas garden, Hassan Tower, and Mausoleum. You'll also have a chance to admire the ramparts and walls of the Mechouar, which encircle the Royal Palace. Afterward, we make our way to the enchanting city of Fes. You'll check in at the hotel and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in Fes. Breakfast and Dinner are included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Fes - Exploring the Ancient City
package_itineraries.description: Today is dedicated to exploring the enchanting city of Fes, the oldest of Morocco's Imperial Cities, renowned for its significant contributions to Moroccan culture in the realms of spirituality and education. You'll embark on a journey through the medieval Medina, where you'll visit the Bouanania medersa and the Nejjarine fountain. Take time to wander through the renowned souks, where skilled artisans carry on age-old oriental traditions. Lunch will be at your leisure. In the afternoon, we'll explore the modern part of the city, "Fes Jdid," and the Mellah. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Fes. (Breakfast and Dinner included)

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Fes to Erfoud
package_itineraries.description: After an early morning start and breakfast, we set off for Erfoud, passing through some remarkable places. Our journey takes us through Immouzer du Kandar, a charming Berber village, then onto Ifrane, a picturesque ski resort, and Azrou, another Berber village famous for its handicraft cooperative, offering wood carving and carpet weaving. You'll have a leisurely lunch break in Midelt. Then, we continue our adventure through the breathtaking Ziz canyons, a route that showcases the stunning Atlas scenery. Finally, we arrive in Erfoud and check in at our hotel. Spend the night in Erfoud. (Breakfast and Dinner included) Optional: Experience a sunrise like no other with a 4X4 jeep excursion to Erg Chebbi, where you can witness the sun rising over the sandy dunes of Merzouga.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Erfoud to Tineghir, then Ouarzazate
package_itineraries.description: Today, we'll set off for Tineghir with plenty of opportunities to capture the stunning and one-of-a-kind scenery with your camera. You'll have a leisurely lunch in Tineghir. Afterward, we'll journey on to Ouarzazate via the Todra Canyon and the Dadès Valley, also known as "the Valley of Roses" and famous for its myriad Kasbahs. You'll check in at your Ouarzazate hotel for the night. Enjoy your overnight stay in Ouarzazate.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Ouarzazate to Marrakech
package_itineraries.description: Today, we embark on a city tour of Ouarzazate, taking in its main attractions. Our first stop is the mesmerising Kasbah Taourirt, a former Glaoui residence. This splendid kasbah, located on the outskirts of the town, is often regarded as one of Morocco's most beautiful. Its intricate architecture includes luxurious apartments, traditional clay houses, and ornate crenelated towers adorned with exquisite geometric patterns. Some parts of this fortified village are accessible to the public. Continuing our journey, we make our way to the Ait Benhadou Kasbah, located around 30 kilometers from Ouarzazate. This remarkable fortress is renowned for its dramatic appearance and has served as a backdrop for numerous famous films, including "Lawrence of Arabia." Aït Benhaddou is a UNESCO-listed fortified village, boasting crenelated towers and buildings adorned with stunning geometric designs, making it one of the most picturesque villages of its kind in Morocco. Efforts are ongoing to restore and repopulate this historic village, currently home to only five families. After exploring these cultural treasures, we set off for Marrakech, traversing the Tizin Tichka Pass, the highest pass in Morocco's mountains. This scenic route offers breathtaking views of the Atlas Mountains and the charming village of Taddert. You'll have the option to enjoy lunch either in Benhaddou or in Marrakech. Upon arrival in Marrakech, we will check in at our hotel and spend the night in this vibrant city. (Breakfast and Dinner included)

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Marrakech – City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Today, we will embark on a city tour of Marrakech, the second oldest Imperial City, often referred to as the "Pearl of the South." Founded by the Almoravides in the late 11th century, Marrakesh is nestled in a picturesque oasis, cradled at the base of the snow-capped Atlas Mountains. In the morning, our journey begins with a visit to the Menara Gardens, a serene retreat. We'll also pass by the majestic Koutoubia Mosque, admiring its exterior beauty. Our next stop takes us to the renowned Bahia Palace and the intriguing Saadian tombs. Lunch is a leisurely affair, allowing you to explore the local cuisine at your own pace. In the afternoon, we delve into the vibrant souks (markets) that Marrakech is famous for. Our journey culminates at the iconic Jemaa El Fna Place. This bustling square is the heart of Medina life, brimming with activity both day and night. By day, it serves as a bustling marketplace, where vendors offer fresh orange juice, nuts, and dried fruits. However, real magic happens at dusk. At 5:00 PM, the square transforms into a hub of entertainment and culinary delights. Food stalls spring to life, dishing up a wide array of vegetables, fish, and meats. As the evening unfolds, the square becomes a stage for performers of all kinds, including snake charmers, singers, musicians, storytellers, and acrobats. Healers and fakirs offer their remedies and cures. The crowd is a mix of locals and tourists, offering a glimpse into the unchanged Medina life, much like medieval times. Don't forget to bring some loose change to Jemaa El Fna, as the performers appreciate a token of your gratitude, in addition to applause. Enjoy a restful night at your Marrakech hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Leaving Marrakech
package_itineraries.description: Today, after having your breakfast, it's time to check out of your hotel and make your way to Menara Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Mahe - Praslin
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at the Mahe International Airport, our tour managers will welcome you and help you transfer to the ship terminal to board your ship to Praslin. Check into your hotel in Praslin and spend the rest of the day exploring places around your resort. Spend the night in Praslin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Praslin - Vallee-De-Mai
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to the Vallee-De-Mai Nature Reserve. This is a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for the coco de mer palm tree, the seeds of which are believed to be the largest in the world. The nature reserve is also home to unique wildlife species, including the Seychelles tree frog, the Seychelles chameleon, the Seychelles black parrot, and the bronze gecko. Return to your resort in the evening to enjoy a candlelight dinner beside the beach.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Praslin - Mahe
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to the Praslin Ship Terminal to board your ferry to Mahe. Check into your hotel and spend the evening at leisure. Spend the night in Mahe.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Mahe Island Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After a delicious breakfast, head out for a full-day tour of the island. Some iconic attractions include Anse Royale Beach, Anse Major, Victoria Botanical Gardens, Morne Blanc Trail, Takamaka Rum Distillery, and Beau Vallon Beach. Don’t miss the Jardin du Roi Spice Garden, where you can admire the different medicinal and herbal plants and fruits. Spend the night in Mahe.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Depart Mahe
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, bid adieu to Seychelles and catch your flight to return home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival on Mahe Island
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Mahe Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and take you to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to relax and enjoy. Have a peaceful overnight stay on Mahe Island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Mahe Island - Full-Day Mahe Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Today, you'll enjoy a comprehensive tour of Mahe. Explore court buildings, museums, the post office, and the clock tower. Stroll down Albert Street, where you'll find a vibrant market with stalls brimming with fresh fruits, vegetables, fish, herbs, and spices. Next, take a scenic drive through the Sans Soucis mountain pass and visit the historic Missions Lodge. Afterward, take a break for lunch (not included). Then, continue your journey to the southern tip of the island, where you'll discover the colonial plantation known as "Jardin du Roi."

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Mahe - Reef Safari
package_itineraries.description: On your third day, you'll embark on a reef safari aboard a catamaran. This adventure will take you to the heart of the harbour, where you can feed the fish and observe intriguing underwater creatures while swimming. Afterward, it's time for a well-deserved break! You'll enjoy a delicious buffet lunch served in the traditional Creole style on board. Later, if you're a fan of marine life, you can choose to go for a swim or relax on the beach of Cerf Island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mahe to Praslin to La Digue
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel. Afterward, visit Vallee-de-Mai, the natural habitat of the giant Coco-de-Mer nut. Then, we'll take you to the renowned Anse Lazio Beach. Following that, enjoy a 30-minute ferry ride to La Digue. Our guide will assist you in transitioning from an ox-cart to L’Union Estate, where you can explore the copra sheds. Your tour of La Digue will continue an open-sided truck with a canopy, known as a 'camion.' Finally, we'll head to one of the world's most stunning beaches, "Anse Source d'Argent."

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Mahe
package_itineraries.description: Today is all yours to enjoy as you wish. Take your time exploring this beautiful island on your own and return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Mahe - Homeward Journey
package_itineraries.description: Have your breakfast and make your way to the airport for your flight back home. Safe Travel!

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Mahe to Praslin
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Mahe International Airport, our representatives will assist you with customs procedures. Your tour guide will then take you to the Mahe ferry terminal, where you'll board a ferry to Praslin. Upon arriving in Praslin, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Relax and enjoy your overnight stay on Praslin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Praslin - Vallee-De-Mai
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. Prepare for an exciting full-day tour to explore Vallee-De-Mai, a world-famous Heritage Site. Next, head to Anse Lazio, a stunning beach in this beautiful city. Keep in mind that Vallee-De-Mai is also a habitat for some of the world's rarest birds. Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Praslin to Mahe
package_itineraries.description: After you've had your breakfast, head to the Praslin ferry terminal to catch a ferry to Mahe. Once you arrive at the Mahe ferry terminal, you'll be taken to the hotel for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mahe Island - Full-Day Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying breakfast at your hotel, contact your tour representative for the day's itinerary. They'll guide you on a comprehensive tour of Mahe Island. Explore the island's historical gems, including the court buildings, post office, museum, and the iconic clock tower. Stroll along Albert Street, where you'll encounter a vibrant market offering an array of fresh fish, tropical fruits, vegetables, and a variety of herbs and spices. As you traverse the Sans Soucis mountain pass, take your time to capture some memorable photos at the historic Mission Lodge. Afterward, break for lunch (at your expense) before continuing your journey to the meticulously preserved colonial plantation known as "Jardin du Roi."

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Mahe - Departure
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a swift breakfast at the hotel, then head over to Mahe Airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cape Town
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Cape Town International Airport, one of our representatives will be there to greet you and provide a private transfer to your hotel. After checking in, the remainder of the day is yours to relax and enjoy at your own pace. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Cape Town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cape Town Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Today, we begin our day with a city tour that includes a visit to Table Mountain. Our journey takes us past several noteworthy landmarks, offering a glimpse into the rich history of Cape Town. We'll drive by the Houses of Parliament, District Six, Green Market Square, the South African National Museum, Clifton, and Sea Point. As we head towards the city centre, you'll catch sight of famous sites like the Castle of Good Hope, constructed in 1666 by the Dutch East India Company, and City Hall, an elegant baroque building located at the Grand Parade. Continuing along Adderley Street, we'll come across St. George's Cathedral, which serves as the Anglican Diocese of the Nobel Peace Laureate, Archbishop Desmond Tutu. Our route will also lead us past the Company Gardens and the Malay Quarter, known as the Bo-Kaap. This area earned its name, which means "Above Cape," due to its location against the slopes of Table Mountain. In the early 18th century, Cape Town saw the arrival of thousands of slaves from Java, Ceylon, and other Far Eastern regions. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Cape Town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cape Peninsula Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After your breakfast, get ready for a full-day tour of the stunning Cape Peninsula. Don't forget your camera, as we're heading to Cape Point, located at the southwest tip of the Cape Peninsula, offering some of the most breathtaking views in the world. On our way back to Cape Town, we'll pass by notable landmarks like the University of Cape Town, Rhodes Memorial, and the Groote Schuur Hospital. You'll also have the option to embark on a half-hour cruise to "Seal Island." We'll make a stop at Chapmans Peak to observe the charming Jackass Penguin Colony at Boulders, and then continue our journey to Cape Point and the Cape of Good Hope. Our day will include a visit to the picturesque Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. After a day of exploration, you'll return to your hotel in Cape Town for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cape Town to Knysna
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, embark on a private transfer to Knysna. In the evening, enjoy a scenic sunset cruise on the Knysna Lagoon aboard the John Benn. After the cruise, return to the hotel, and the rest of the evening is yours to relax and enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at the hotel in Knysna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Knysna – Full-Day Trip to Oudtshoorn
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, embark on a full-day excursion to Oudtshoorn, where you'll explore the mesmerising Cango Caves, visit an ostrich farm, and experience the Cango Wildlife Ranch. Return to the hotel in the evening and enjoy the rest of your night at your leisure. Spend the night at the Knysna hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Knysna to Kwantu Game Reserve
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, complete the hotel check-out and make your way to Kwantu Game Reserve. You'll have a late lunch at the lodge. In the afternoon, delight in a game drive within the reserve and then return to the lodge for dinner. Your overnight stay will be at the Lodge in Kwantu Game Reserve.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Kwantu Game Reserve
package_itineraries.description: Savour a complete day of game drives, beginning early in the morning. This allows you to witness wildlife in their natural surroundings as they go about their daily routines. Spend the night at the Lodge in Kwantu Game Reserve.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Kwantu Game Reserve to Port Elizabeth
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a dawn game drive through the reserve. After the game drive, head back to the lodge for breakfast. Then, it's time to check out from the lodge and continue to Port Elizabeth via a private transfer. Along the way, you have the option to stop at the Bloukrans Bridge for an adrenaline-pumping bungee jumping experience (optional) or proceed to the Tsitsikamma Forest for a thrilling zip line adventure (this is optional). Upon reaching Port Elizabeth, check in at the hotel, and the rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at the hotel in Port Elizabeth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Port Elizabeth to Johannesburg and Sun City
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast today, you'll be taken to Port Elizabeth airport for your flight to Johannesburg. Please note that the flight cost is not included in the package. Upon landing in Johannesburg, you'll continue with a private transfer to Sun City. Upon reaching Sun City, check in at the hotel. The rest of the day is yours to explore the resort at your leisure. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Sun City - A Relaxing Day
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a delightful breakfast. Today is a day for relaxation and leisure. You can enjoy endless entertainment at the Valley of the Waves, with exciting options like concerts, sporting events, and more. Spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Sun City to Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying breakfast this morning, it's time to check out of the hotel. You'll embark on a private transfer to the Gold Reef Tour in Johannesburg, where you can explore fascinating historical gold mining attractions (this is optional). Following the tour, you'll be taken to the hotel for check-in. Enjoy your overnight stay in Johannesburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Leaving Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel. Make use of the complimentary shuttle service provided by Emperor's Palace to reach JNB Airport for your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cape Town
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Cape Town International Airport, a friendly representative will greet you and accompany you to your hotel. You'll have the remainder of the day to leisurely explore the city at your own pace. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Cape Town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cape Town - Exploring the City
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before embarking on a half-day tour of Cape Town. If the weather is on our side, we'll ascend Table Mountain. We'll also take you on a scenic drive past iconic landmarks like The Castle of Good Hope, Company Gardens, Parliament Buildings, City Hall, the Slave Lodge, and the charming Malay Quarter. You'll spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cape Town - Peninsula Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a full day exploring the picturesque Cape Peninsula. We'll make a stop at Hout Bay Harbour, take a cruise to Seal Island, and, weather permitting, drive along the breathtaking Chapmans Peak Drive. Our journey continues to Cape Point National Park, where we'll take a funicular tour. Afterward, we'll visit Simons Town, the charming Boulders Beach Penguin Colony, and the lush Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. You'll spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cape Town to Knysna
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel, and then complete the check-out process. You'll embark on a journey to Knysna via the N2 road. Once you arrive, you'll check in at your hotel. The remainder of the day is yours to relax and enjoy at your own pace. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Knysna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Knysna - Oudtshoorn - Knysna
package_itineraries.description: Today, we will journey over the picturesque Outeniqua Mountain Pass to reach Oudtshoorn, renowned as the feather capital of the world. Our day includes a visit to the fascinating Cango Caves and the captivating Cango Wildlife Ranch. You'll also get the chance to explore an Ostrich Farm Tour. After our adventures, we will be returning to our hotel in Knysna for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Knysna to Sun City via Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: We'll arrange a transfer to George Airport for your flight to Johannesburg, though please note that the flight cost is not included (we recommend a departure around 10:00 AM). Upon landing at O.R. Tambo International Airport, a Thompsons Africa representative will be there to greet you and transfer you to Sun City. Check in at the hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Enjoying Sun City
package_itineraries.description: Today is your day to relax and unwind. There are no scheduled tours, and you won't have a vehicle or guide at your disposal. If you're interested in exploring, there's an option to go on a safari in the Pilanesberg National Park, but you'll need to arrange and pay for it directly with the suppliers. After your day of leisure, you'll spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Sun City to Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: You'll be driven to your chosen hotel in Johannesburg, where you can enjoy a leisurely day. Rest for the night at your Johannesburg hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Leaving Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: This morning, it's time to check out and make your way to O.R. Tambo International Airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Livingstone - Afternoon Zambezi River Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Livingstone Airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. In the afternoon, enjoy a relaxing sunset cruise on the Zambezi River. Spend the night at your hotel in Livingstone.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Livingstone – Victoria Falls Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore the majestic Victoria Falls on a guided tour. Please note that this tour excludes transfers, as the falls are within walking distance of the hotel. Spend the night at the hotel in Livingstone.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leaving Livingstone
package_itineraries.description: We'll arrange for your transfer from the Avani Victoria Falls Hotel to Livingstone Airport. Enjoy breakfast before you go.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cape Town
package_itineraries.description: Touch down at Cape Town International Airport, where a friendly representative will greet you and take you to your hotel. Enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure to explore the city on your own. Spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cape Town – Half-Day City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and then set off for a half-day Cape Town City tour. If the weather allows, you'll visit Table Mountain. Drive past the Castle of Good Hope, accompanied by a Driver Guide, and see the Parliament Buildings, City Hall, and the Slave Lodge. Explore the Malay Quarter and pay a visit to the Diamond Cutters. Wrap up your tour with a visit to the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront for some shopping before returning to your hotel. Spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cape Town - Full-Day Cape Peninsula Tour
package_itineraries.description: On this full-day tour, we'll make several stops to explore the beauty of the Cape Peninsula. Our first stop is at Hout Bay Harbour, where we'll enjoy a Seal Island Cruise. If it's open, we'll take the picturesque Chapmans Peak Drive. We'll also visit the Cape Point National Park, where you can take an optional Funicular Tour. Next, we'll head to Simons Town to see the charming Boulders Beach Penguin Colony. The tour also includes a visit to the Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Cape Town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cape Town to Knysna
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast, and then set off on a private transfer to Knysna. You'll follow Route 62, a scenic route, to reach Knysna. In the evening, enjoy a picturesque sunset cruise on the Knysna Lagoon aboard the John Benn. Afterward, return to your hotel, and the rest of the evening is yours to relax and unwind. You'll spend the night at your Knysna hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Knysna - Full Day Oudtshoorn Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying your breakfast, embark on a full-day excursion to Oudtshoorn, where you'll visit the remarkable Cango Caves, an ostrich farm, and the Cango Wildlife Ranch. After the day's adventures, return to your hotel. The evening is yours to relax and enjoy at your leisure. You'll spend the night at the Knysna hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: George to Johannesburg to Sun City
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast today, we'll arrange for your transfer to George Airport for your flight to Johannesburg. Please note that the flight cost is not included in the tour price, and we suggest a flight departing around 09:00. Upon your arrival in Johannesburg, a private transfer will take you to Sun City. After checking in at the hotel, the rest of the day is yours to explore the resort at your own pace. Enjoy an overnight stay at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Sun City – A Day of Relaxation
package_itineraries.description: Today is a day for relaxation and leisure. You have the opportunity to indulge in endless entertainment at the Valley of the Waves. Enjoy thrilling entertainment choices, live concerts, sporting events, and much more. Spend the night at the hotel in Sun City. (Breakfast included)

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Sun City to Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast, then check out of the hotel. You'll continue your journey with a private transfer to Johannesburg for a Half Day Gold Reef Tour, featuring fascinating historical gold mining attractions. After the tour, you'll be taken to the hotel for check-in. Enjoy an overnight stay in Johannesburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Depart Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: This morning you need to check out from the hotel take the complimentary shuttle from Emperor's Palace to JNB Airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: As you land at OR Tambo International Airport, a welcoming representative will greet you. They will then escort you to your awaiting vehicle, which will transport you to your chosen game lodge in Kruger National Park or nearby hotels. Enjoy the remainder of the day at your own pace. You'll spend the night at the lodge.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kruger National Park
package_itineraries.description: Start with a hearty breakfast. A full day of game drives awaits those staying outside the Kruger National Park. For clients inside the park, enjoy early morning and afternoon game drives. Spend the night at the lodge.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Depart Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast you will be collected and transferred back to OR Tambo International Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cape Town
package_itineraries.description: When you land at Cape Town International Airport, a friendly representative will be there to greet you and take you to your hotel. After your transfer, the rest of the day is yours to explore at your own pace. You'll spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cape Town - Morning City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today, we set out for a half-day city tour of Cape Town. If the weather allows, we'll visit Table Mountain. We'll drive past the Castle of Good Hope, the Company Gardens, the Parliament Buildings, the City Hall, and the Slave Lodge. We'll also pass by the vibrant Malay Quarter and make a stop to visit the Diamond Cutters. Our tour concludes at the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, where you can enjoy some shopping before returning to your hotel. Spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cape Town – Full-Day Cape Peninsula Tour
package_itineraries.description: On this full-day Cape Peninsula tour, we have an exciting itinerary for you: We'll start with a stop at Hout Bay Harbour, where you can enjoy a Seal Island Cruise. If Chapmans Peak Drive is open, we'll take you on a scenic drive along this stunning route. For lunch, you're free to choose your own meal (at your own expense). Next, we'll visit the beautiful Cape Point National Park and take a Funicular Tour. Then, we're off to see Simons Town and the charming Boulders Beach Penguin Colony. Finally, we'll explore the enchanting Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. You'll spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cape Town to Sun City (Flight Not Included)
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast and then check out of the hotel. You'll be taken to Cape Town International Airport for your flight to Johannesburg. When you arrive at O.R. Tambo International Airport in Johannesburg, you'll be met and taken to your hotel. In the late afternoon, you'll check in and have the rest of the day to explore the extensive resort. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Sun City - Free Day
package_itineraries.description: Today is a day for you to enjoy yourself, exploring the resort's activities and amenities. You'll spend the night at the Sun City hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Sun City to Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast at your hotel, then check out and head to your hotel in Johannesburg. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy as you please. You'll stay overnight at your Johannesburg hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Johannesburg to Victoria Falls, Zambia (Flight Not Included)
package_itineraries.description: Leave your hotel and head to O.R. Tambo International for your flight to Victoria Falls, Zambia. Upon arriving in Zambia, a Thompsons Africa representative will meet you and take you to your hotel. Check in, and then enjoy the rest of the day at your own pace. You can choose from optional tours for an extra cost. Spend the night at the hotel in Zambia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Victoria Falls, Zambia
package_itineraries.description: Today, you'll join a guided group tour to explore the spectacular Victoria Falls. Afterward, you have the afternoon free to relax or choose from optional activities available at an extra cost: Take a 15-minute helicopter flight for $189.00 per person. Enjoy Elephant Interactions for $80.00 per person. Choose for a full-day Chobe Tour in Botswana, which includes lunch, for $170.00 per person. In the evening, unwind at your hotel and spend a leisurely night in Zambia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Victoria Falls, Zambia to Nairobi (Flight Not Included)
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, we'll take you to Livingstone Airport for your flight to Nairobi. After arriving in Nairobi, we'll arrange your transfer to the hotel. The rest of the day is free for you to enjoy at your leisure. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Nairobi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Nairobi to Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: After having breakfast, the rest of the day is yours to enjoy leisurely activities at the resort. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Masai Mara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Nairobi to Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a whole day exploring the beauty of Masai Mara with morning and afternoon game drives. Rest for the night at the hotel in Masai Mara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Masai Mara to Nairobi
package_itineraries.description: We will head back to Nairobi today and should arrive by the afternoon. After reaching Nairobi, check in at your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to relax and enjoy yourself. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Nairobi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Nairobi - Explore the City
package_itineraries.description: Take a mini van for a tour of the city. Afterward, return to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at your own pace. Spend the night at your Nairobi hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Leaving Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: This morning, you'll be taken to Nairobi Airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cape Town
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Cape Town International Airport, you will be warmly greeted by a representative and taken to your hotel. Enjoy a comfortable transfer in a 2-seater sedan with a driver. The remainder of the day is yours to explore at your own pace. Spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cape Town - Half-Day City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast before embarking on a half-day city tour of Cape Town. If the weather allows, you'll have the opportunity to visit Table Mountain, a true natural wonder. On the way, you'll also pass by notable landmarks such as the Castle of Good Hope, Company Gardens, Parliament Buildings, City Hall, the Slave Lodge, and the charming Malay Quarter. The tour will include a visit to Diamond Cutters, where you can witness the art of crafting exquisite gems. After the tour, you'll have the option to return to your hotel or be dropped off at the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, a vibrant hub of activities and dining. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cape Town - Cape Peninsula Tour
package_itineraries.description: Full Day Cape Peninsula Tour with Stops at Hout Bay Harbour, Optional Seal Island Cruise (Weather Permitting), Chapman's Peak Drive (if open), Lunch (on your own), Visit to Cape Point National Park (with Funicular Tour included), Stop at Simon's Town and Boulders Beach Penguin Colony, and a Visit to Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. Rest for the night at your Cape Town hotel. It's a full day of adventure and exploration on the Cape Peninsula. We begin our day with a stop at Hout Bay Harbour, where you can choose to go on a Seal Island Cruise (subject to weather conditions). Following that, we may take a scenic drive along Chapman's Peak Drive, provided it's open for travel. Lunch arrangements are at your discretion. Then, we'll visit Cape Point National Park, where a Funicular Tour is included. Our next destination is Simon's Town, home to the charming Boulders Beach Penguin Colony, which is also included in your tour. Finally, our day culminates at the Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Cape Town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cape Town - George
package_itineraries.description: Following your morning meal, set out on a private transfer to Knysna, travelling along the N2. During the journey, you'll have the chance to enjoy the George John Benn Cruise within the Featherbed Nature Reserve. Upon your arrival in George, check in at your hotel, and the remainder of the day is yours to spend at your leisure. You'll spend the night at your hotel in George.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Knysna - Full-Day Oudtshoorn Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, embark on a day trip to Oudtshoorn, where you'll explore the Cango Caves, visit an ostrich farm, and discover the Cango Wildlife Ranch. Return to your hotel, and the rest of the evening is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at your Knysna hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: George to Johannesburg to Sun City (Flight Not Included)
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying your breakfast this morning, y you will be chauffeured to George Airport for your flight to Johannesburg. Please keep in mind that the flight cost is not included in the package (We recommend a flight around 09:00). Upon your arrival in Johannesburg, a private transfer will be arranged to take you to Sun City. You'll check in at the hotel, and the rest of the day is yours to explore the resort at your own pace. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Sun City - A Day of Relaxation
package_itineraries.description: Today, you have the entire day to unwind and enjoy the delightful offerings of Sun City. You can indulge in endless enjoyment at the Valley of the Waves, where thrilling entertainment, concerts, sports events, and more await. There are no optional activities today. In the evening, you will spend the night at the lodge in Pilanesberg National Park, where you can look forward to memorable game drives. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Sun City to Pilanesberg National Park
package_itineraries.description: Today, we'll travel from Sun City to Pilanesberg National Park. In the afternoon, we'll set out for a thrilling game drive in Pilanesberg National Park. Afterward, enjoy a delicious Western-style dinner at the lodge. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Pilanesberg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Pilanesberg National Park
package_itineraries.description: Savour a leisurely day at the Game Reserve. Start with a morning game drive and enjoy a delicious lunch. In the afternoon, embark on another game drive in the beautiful Pilanesberg National Park. Then, relish a delectable Western-style dinner at the lodge. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Pilanesberg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Pilanesberg National Park to Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast and check out of the hotel. You'll then continue your journey with a private transfer to Johannesburg, where you will be dropped off at your hotel. Enjoy an overnight stay in Johannesburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Johannesburg - Gold Reef City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a visit to Gold Reef City for a captivating half-day tour. Dive into the rich heritage of this site and discover the art of gold pouring. After the tour, our team will take you back to your hotel for a comfortable drop-off. Enjoy your overnight stay in Johannesburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Leaving Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: Today, it's time to check out of your accommodation and make your way to O.R. Tambo International Airport for your journey back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cape Town
package_itineraries.description: You'll land at Cape Town International Airport, where a friendly representative will greet you. They'll ensure your smooth transfer to your hotel. Afterward, the day is yours to explore at your own pace. Take a leisurely stroll around the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, known for its excellent restaurants and vibrant nightlife. It's one of Cape Town's most popular tourist destinations, nestled in a bustling harbor surrounded by pubs, eateries, craft markets, theaters, and more. With Robben Island and Table Mountain as its neighbors, this picturesque spot in the heart of Cape Town's harbor offers stunning views of the sea and mountains. You'll spend the night at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cape Town City Tour and Table Mountain
package_itineraries.description: After a delightful breakfast, embark on a half-day Cape Town city tour, including tickets for a visit to Table Mountain (weather permitting). Ascend to the summit of the iconic Table Mountain via a cable car, where you'll be treated to panoramic views of the city and the surrounding landscapes of this southernmost tip of Africa. Explore the country's oldest building, The Castle, and nearby, the well-preserved Company Gardens, both of which are steeped in captivating history. As you continue your drive, you'll pass by significant landmarks such as the Parliament Buildings, City Hall, and the Slave Lodge, each reflecting a rich historical tapestry through their unique architectural styles. Wander up the cobbled streets to the Malay Quarter, where the charming Bo-Kaap homes, adorned with vibrant, ice-cream-like colors, will captivate your senses. Witness the craftsmanship of a skilled diamond cutter as he transforms raw stones into every girl's dream gem. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Relax and soak in the beauty of Cape Town. Spend the night at your hotel in this enchanting city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Full-Day Peninsula Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely cruise along the stunning stretch of coastline known as Millionaire's Paradise, starting from Clifton and continuing to Camps Bay, all the way to the exclusive beach haven of Llandudno. Our journey takes us to the delightful working harbour of Hout Bay, where you'll embark on a close encounter with the resident seals on Seal Island. Next, we'll wind our way along the renowned Chapman's Peak Drive, hugging the cliffs and relishing the breathtaking ocean views.
