package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, embark on a full-day excursion to Oudtshoorn, where you'll explore the mesmerising Cango Caves, visit an ostrich farm, and experience the Cango Wildlife Ranch. Return to the hotel in the evening and enjoy the rest of your night at your leisure. Spend the night at the Knysna hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Knysna to Kwantu Game Reserve
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, complete the hotel check-out and make your way to Kwantu Game Reserve. You'll have a late lunch at the lodge. In the afternoon, delight in a game drive within the reserve and then return to the lodge for dinner. Your overnight stay will be at the Lodge in Kwantu Game Reserve.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Kwantu Game Reserve
package_itineraries.description: Savour a complete day of game drives, beginning early in the morning. This allows you to witness wildlife in their natural surroundings as they go about their daily routines. Spend the night at the Lodge in Kwantu Game Reserve.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Kwantu Game Reserve to Port Elizabeth
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a dawn game drive through the reserve. After the game drive, head back to the lodge for breakfast. Then, it's time to check out from the lodge and continue to Port Elizabeth via a private transfer. Along the way, you have the option to stop at the Bloukrans Bridge for an adrenaline-pumping bungee jumping experience (optional) or proceed to the Tsitsikamma Forest for a thrilling zip line adventure (this is optional). Upon reaching Port Elizabeth, check in at the hotel, and the rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at the hotel in Port Elizabeth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Port Elizabeth to Johannesburg and Sun City
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast today, you'll be taken to Port Elizabeth airport for your flight to Johannesburg. Please note that the flight cost is not included in the package. Upon landing in Johannesburg, you'll continue with a private transfer to Sun City. Upon reaching Sun City, check in at the hotel. The rest of the day is yours to explore the resort at your leisure. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Sun City - A Relaxing Day
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a delightful breakfast. Today is a day for relaxation and leisure. You can enjoy endless entertainment at the Valley of the Waves, with exciting options like concerts, sporting events, and more. Spend the night at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Sun City to Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying breakfast this morning, it's time to check out of the hotel. You'll embark on a private transfer to the Gold Reef Tour in Johannesburg, where you can explore fascinating historical gold mining attractions (this is optional). Following the tour, you'll be taken to the hotel for check-in. Enjoy your overnight stay in Johannesburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Leaving Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel. Make use of the complimentary shuttle service provided by Emperor's Palace to reach JNB Airport for your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arriving in Harare
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Harare International Airport, you'll be greeted by our tour representatives just outside the baggage hall. After a satisfying lunch, embark on a half-day excursion to Chinoyi Cave, which is situated 120km from here. In the evening, savour a delightful dinner at a local restaurant before heading back to Harare for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Harare to Hwange
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. After checking out, head to Harare Airport for a flight to Victoria Falls. Upon arrival at Victoria Falls Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and transfer you to Hwange Safari Lodge in a luxurious bus. Check in at the lodge and savour a delicious lunch. In the afternoon, the group will convene for tea before embarking on a three-hour game drive. As the sun sets, return to your lodge for a delightful dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Delight in Safari Adventures
package_itineraries.description: Today, our expert guide will lead you on a thrilling safari drive into the National Park. Pause for a delightful American breakfast. The morning is yours to unwind by the pool and relish in some leisurely fun. Lunch will be served around midday, and in the afternoon, the entire group will gather for a tea session before embarking on another exciting safari drive. Return to the lodge for a delectable dinner and enjoy an overnight stay at Hwange.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Victoria Falls
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a hearty American breakfast, followed by a visit to the stunning Victoria Falls. Return to the hotel for lunch, and then explore the world-renowned "Mighty Victoria Falls," one of the most magnificent waterfalls globally. In the evening, return to the hotel and savour a delicious dinner. You can spend the night at Victoria Falls for a restful stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Zambezi River
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel. Next, we'll visit the Crocodile Farm and Crocodile Leather Factory for an interesting tour. Return to the hotel and indulge in a delightful lunch. In the afternoon, the group will embark on a Sunset Cruise along the majestic Zambezi River. Take a break and savour your dinner back at the hotel. You can then relax and enjoy your overnight stay at Victoria Falls.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Time to Leave
package_itineraries.description: Once you've had your breakfast, make your way to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at JKI Airport - Transfer to Nairobi Hotel
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at JKI Airport in Nairobi, you will be warmly greeted by our representatives. They will assist you in transferring to your Nairobi Hotel, where you will spend the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Nairobi to Masai Mara Game Reserve
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying a hearty breakfast at your hotel, it's time to set out on an exciting adventure. Our first stop is the renowned Masai Mara Game Reserve, one of Nairobi's most famous attractions. Along the way, we'll pass through the breathtaking Great Rift Valley, providing ample opportunities for stunning photographs. As we continue our journey towards Masai Mara, we'll break for a delicious lunch. Once we arrive at the reserve, get ready for an incredible experience. Here, you'll have the chance to witness the most magnificent scenes in the animal kingdom – from the commanding roar of a lion to the incredible agility of a cheetah during a hunt. Keep your camera ready for moments like an elephant expressing its frustration. Prepare to be captivated by a multitude of fascinating events as you explore the Masai Mara Game Reserve.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: Prepare for another thrilling safari adventure as you embark on a journey to spot wild animals. The early morning and evening are prime times for observing these magnificent creatures in their natural habitat. During the midday, you can enjoy a game viewing drive in pursuit of the famous "big five" – the leopard, lion, rhino, and elephant.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Lake Nakuru National Park
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast and be sure to listen to the instructions provided by your safari driver to help you navigate into Lake Nakuru National Park. Once you're all set, head over to Lake Nakuru Lodge where you can enjoy a leisurely lunch. The real adventure begins in the afternoon as you embark on a thrilling game viewing drive within the boundaries of Lake Nakuru National Park.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Lake Nakuru to Nairobi
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Then, it's time to check out from the hotel and make your way to Nairobi. Our friendly representatives will accompany you to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for your departure. Safe travel!

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at JKI Airport
package_itineraries.description: Check into Your Nairobi Hotel Upon your arrival at JKI Airport, our friendly representatives will assist you in transferring to your Nairobi hotel, where you'll spend the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Nairobi to Masai Mara Game
package_itineraries.description: Reserve Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Today, you'll embark on an exciting journey to the renowned Masai Mara Game Reserve, promising loads of fun and adventure. Along the way, we'll make a stop at the Eastern Great Rift Valley for some excellent photo opportunities to capture the stunning landscape. Upon arriving at the Masai Mara, we'll settle in for a delicious lunch at the hotel. After a rejuvenating break, your expert tour guide will lead you on an unforgettable safari experience. Get ready to witness some of the most incredible wildlife in their natural habitat. As you explore the reserve, keep an eye out for mesmerising moments, like the mighty lion's roar, the majestic wildebeest, or the elephants trumpeting in all their grandeur. The Masai Mara promises a wealth of exciting animal encounters and breathtaking scenes.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: On the following morning, our tour representatives will take you on an exciting safari adventure to seek out the majestic wildlife. Typically, the early mornings and evenings offer the prime opportunity to observe the hunting activities of the big cats, such as cheetahs, leopards, and lions. Moreover, you can revel in the breathtaking views of the sunrise and sunset in this incredible destination. Afterward, take a short break to recharge. To ensure an unforgettable wildlife experience, we will guide you on a quest to spot the "big five" animals, which include elephants, buffaloes, lions, rhinos, and leopards.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Masai Mara to Lake Nakuru National Park
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Seek the guidance of our skilled safari driver as you journey to Lake Nakuru National Park. Here, you'll spend the morning exploring the park's unique wildlife. Upon arrival at Lake Nakuru Lodge, enjoy a delicious lunch to refuel for your adventure. Afterward, embark on an exciting game drive within Lake Nakuru National Park. Keep your eyes peeled for some of nature's rare gems, such as the white rhino, black rhino, elusive leopard, and other fascinating wildlife.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Lake Nakuru to Lake Naivasha
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying breakfast at your hotel, we'll make our way to the enchanting Lake Naivasha. Our first stop is the Lake Naivasha Spa Lodge, nestled on the serene southern shores of Lake Naivasha. This charming lodge boasts 21 cozy cottages, each with four rooms, and 84 comfortable rooms that provide breathtaking panoramic views of the lake valley. Our adventure continues as we head to Crescent Island, a unique and picturesque destination. Here, you'll have the opportunity to observe a variety of wildlife, often found taking shelter in their caves. It's a truly captivating experience!

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Lake Naivasha to Nairobi – Time to Say Goodbye
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast, and then it's time to check out of the hotel. We'll arrange a comfortable transfer to Nairobi for you. Our friendly representatives will ensure you reach Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in time for your departure. Safe travel!

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cape Town
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Cape Town International Airport, you will be warmly greeted by a representative and taken to your hotel. Enjoy a comfortable transfer in a 2-seater sedan with a driver. The remainder of the day is yours to explore at your own pace. Spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cape Town - Half-Day City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a delightful breakfast before embarking on a half-day city tour of Cape Town. If the weather allows, you'll have the opportunity to visit Table Mountain, a true natural wonder. On the way, you'll also pass by notable landmarks such as the Castle of Good Hope, Company Gardens, Parliament Buildings, City Hall, the Slave Lodge, and the charming Malay Quarter. The tour will include a visit to Diamond Cutters, where you can witness the art of crafting exquisite gems. After the tour, you'll have the option to return to your hotel or be dropped off at the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront, a vibrant hub of activities and dining. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cape Town - Cape Peninsula Tour
package_itineraries.description: Full Day Cape Peninsula Tour with Stops at Hout Bay Harbour, Optional Seal Island Cruise (Weather Permitting), Chapman's Peak Drive (if open), Lunch (on your own), Visit to Cape Point National Park (with Funicular Tour included), Stop at Simon's Town and Boulders Beach Penguin Colony, and a Visit to Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. Rest for the night at your Cape Town hotel. It's a full day of adventure and exploration on the Cape Peninsula. We begin our day with a stop at Hout Bay Harbour, where you can choose to go on a Seal Island Cruise (subject to weather conditions). Following that, we may take a scenic drive along Chapman's Peak Drive, provided it's open for travel. Lunch arrangements are at your discretion. Then, we'll visit Cape Point National Park, where a Funicular Tour is included. Our next destination is Simon's Town, home to the charming Boulders Beach Penguin Colony, which is also included in your tour. Finally, our day culminates at the Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. You'll spend the night at your hotel in Cape Town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cape Town - George
package_itineraries.description: Following your morning meal, set out on a private transfer to Knysna, travelling along the N2. During the journey, you'll have the chance to enjoy the George John Benn Cruise within the Featherbed Nature Reserve. Upon your arrival in George, check in at your hotel, and the remainder of the day is yours to spend at your leisure. You'll spend the night at your hotel in George.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Knysna - Full-Day Oudtshoorn Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, embark on a day trip to Oudtshoorn, where you'll explore the Cango Caves, visit an ostrich farm, and discover the Cango Wildlife Ranch. Return to your hotel, and the rest of the evening is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Spend the night at your Knysna hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: George to Johannesburg to Sun City (Flight Not Included)
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying your breakfast this morning, y you will be chauffeured to George Airport for your flight to Johannesburg. Please keep in mind that the flight cost is not included in the package (We recommend a flight around 09:00). Upon your arrival in Johannesburg, a private transfer will be arranged to take you to Sun City. You'll check in at the hotel, and the rest of the day is yours to explore the resort at your own pace. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Sun City - A Day of Relaxation
package_itineraries.description: Today, you have the entire day to unwind and enjoy the delightful offerings of Sun City. You can indulge in endless enjoyment at the Valley of the Waves, where thrilling entertainment, concerts, sports events, and more await. There are no optional activities today. In the evening, you will spend the night at the lodge in Pilanesberg National Park, where you can look forward to memorable game drives. Enjoy your overnight stay at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Sun City to Pilanesberg National Park
package_itineraries.description: Today, we'll travel from Sun City to Pilanesberg National Park. In the afternoon, we'll set out for a thrilling game drive in Pilanesberg National Park. Afterward, enjoy a delicious Western-style dinner at the lodge. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Pilanesberg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Pilanesberg National Park
package_itineraries.description: Savour a leisurely day at the Game Reserve. Start with a morning game drive and enjoy a delicious lunch. In the afternoon, embark on another game drive in the beautiful Pilanesberg National Park. Then, relish a delectable Western-style dinner at the lodge. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Pilanesberg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Pilanesberg National Park to Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast and check out of the hotel. You'll then continue your journey with a private transfer to Johannesburg, where you will be dropped off at your hotel. Enjoy an overnight stay in Johannesburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Johannesburg - Gold Reef City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a visit to Gold Reef City for a captivating half-day tour. Dive into the rich heritage of this site and discover the art of gold pouring. After the tour, our team will take you back to your hotel for a comfortable drop-off. Enjoy your overnight stay in Johannesburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Leaving Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: Today, it's time to check out of your accommodation and make your way to O.R. Tambo International Airport for your journey back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Nairobi
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi, your dedicated team will be there to assist you with immigration and customs procedures. Afterward, they will transfer you to your hotel. You will spend the night at your hotel in Nairobi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Nairobi to Tree Hotel
package_itineraries.description: After a delightful breakfast, we will depart from Nairobi in the morning, heading to Nyeri. Nyeri is a charming town nestled in the heart of Kenya's coffee-growing and dairy farming region, formerly known as the White Highlands. Following a scrumptious lunch at the base hotel, our adventure takes us to a tree hotel. Here, you'll witness a fascinating spectacle in the evening as a parade of animals emerges from the forest and gathers at the floodlit water hole and salt lick. They engage in playful scuffles and jostles for prime viewing spots. If you decide to stay up, you might witness the impressive displays of strength by elephants, although even they are cautious about challenging the rhinos, keeping a respectful distance. At Mountain Lodge, we head directly to the lodge for lunch. You'll enjoy your meals and spend the night at the Tree Hotel. Don't forget to pack an overnight bag for your transfer to the Ark later in the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tree Hotel to Nakuru or Naivasha
package_itineraries.description: Today, we set off for Nyahururu, where Thompson's Falls await at an impressive altitude of 7,738 feet. These falls were named after the Scottish explorer Joseph Thompson, who made the first European discovery in 1884. We then make our way down into the stunning Rift Valley, arriving at Lake Nakuru National Park in time for lunch at one of the local hotels. After lunch, an exciting afternoon game drive is on the agenda. The park is teeming with wildlife, and the birdwatching here is truly exceptional. You might even find yourself becoming a bird enthusiast, thanks to the breathtaking variety of bird species. Lake Nakuru is famous for its magnificent flocks of lesser and greater flamingos, which turn the lake's shores into a spectacular stretch of pink. This park is renowned for its birdlife, with over 400 species, including white pelicans, plovers, egrets, and marabou storks. It's also one of the rare places in Africa where you can spot the white rhino and the elusive Rothschild giraffe. Tonight, we'll enjoy our meals and spend the night at a comfortable lodge or camp in Nakuru or Naivasha.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Nakuru/Naivasha to Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, embark on a scenic drive through the stunning Great Rift Valley to reach the renowned Masai Mara National Reserve. This vast reserve is a part of the Serengeti plains, famous for the incredible wildebeest migration and home to the Big Five: Lions, Elephants, Leopards, Buffaloes, and Rhinos. After arriving at your lodge or camp, enjoy a relaxing lunch before setting out for an exciting afternoon game drive. The Masai Mara Game Reserve is a true wilderness wonderland, where you can easily spot a diverse array of large mammals. Some of the park's permanent residents include Maasai Giraffes, Buffaloes, Elands, and numerous plains game like Impalas, Zebras, Topis, as well as both Thomson's and Grant's Gazelles. You'll wrap up the day with a delightful meal and spend the night at your lodge or camp in the heart of the Mara. This includes Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a morning safari to spot the diverse wildlife that calls this reserve home. With a bit of luck, you might witness a live hunt unfold before your very eyes. After a delicious lunch at your lodge, embark on another thrilling game drive, where you have the chance to encounter the renowned 'Big 5' animals. You'll enjoy your meals and spend the night at a lodge or camp in the Mara. This includes Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Masai Mara to Nairobi
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your morning meal and complete the check-out process. We'll then embark on a pleasant drive back to Nairobi, ensuring we arrive in time for lunch. You can choose your preferred lunch spot. Afterward, we'll transfer you to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for your onward flight. Enjoy breakfast, check out, and begin your journey back to Nairobi, where you'll arrive in time for lunch. You can choose your own lunch option. Afterwards, we'll arrange your transfer to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for your next flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Casablanca
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Casablanca's Mohamed V airport, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred to your hotel. Check in at the hotel and spend the night in Casablanca. Have a splendid dinner at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Casablanca to Rabat - Discovering the Capitals
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a captivating journey as we delve into the vibrant cities of Morocco. We begin the day with a comprehensive city tour of Casablanca, the nation's economic hub. From the comfort of your coach, you'll witness the enchanting Medina, Mohammed V square, the bustling United Nations square, the lively Central Market, the charming Habbous quarter, the Royal Palace, and the affluent Anfa residential area. Admire the grandeur of the iconic Hassan II Mosque from the outside, and take in the picturesque Ain Diab Cornice, lined with inviting swimming pools and exquisite gastronomic restaurants. In the afternoon, our voyage continues as we set forth to Rabat, Morocco's administrative capital. Here, we'll explore the "Imperial Garden City," known for its significant landmarks. Stroll through the Oudayas garden, stand in awe of the magnificent Hassan Tower and Mausoleum, and witness the formidable ramparts and walls of the Mechouar surrounding the Royal Palace. As the day draws to a close, we'll reach our hotel in Rabat for a seamless check-in. Rest and rejuvenate as you prepare for the adventures that lie ahead. Overnight stay at the hotel in Rabat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rabat to Meknes and Fes
package_itineraries.description: Today, we journey to Meknes, often referred to as the "Moroccan Versailles," founded by Moulay Ismail in the late 17th century, during the time of Louis XIV. Our exploration includes a visit to the renowned Bab El Mansour, widely regarded as one of Morocco's most exquisite gateways. We also have the option to explore Meknes or the holy city of Moulay Idriss, which gazes upon the ancient ruins of Volubilis. Our journey continues to Fes, where you'll settle into your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Fes
package_itineraries.description: Today, we dedicate the entire day to exploring Fes, the oldest of Morocco's Imperial Cities, renowned for its profound spiritual and educational influence on Moroccan culture. We'll delve into the medieval Medina, where you'll be captivated by its historical charm. Wander through the renowned souks, where skilled artisans continue to craft in the timeless oriental tradition. Enjoy a leisurely lunch. In the afternoon, our sightseeing adventure continues. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Fes.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Fes to Marrakech
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with an early breakfast, and then set out for Marrakech. Along the way, you'll pass through some charming places. First, you'll visit Immouzer du Kandar, a picturesque Berber village. Afterward, your journey takes you to Ifrane, a delightful ski resort known for its beauty. Then, you'll continue to Azrou, another Berber village famous for its wood carving and carpet weaving cooperative. As the day progresses, you'll make your way to Marrakech. You'll arrive in the late afternoon and check in to your hotel. Enjoy an overnight stay in the heart of Marrakech.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Marrakech - City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Today is all about discovering the charms of Marrakech, the second-oldest Imperial City and the renowned "Pearl of the South." Established by the Almoravides in the late 11th century, Marrakech is nestled in a verdant oasis at the base of the snow-capped Atlas Mountains. Your day will include visits to iconic landmarks like the Saadian Tombs, Menara Gardens, Koutoubia Mosque, and the magnificent Bahia Palace. After a leisurely lunch, your journey continues with a stroll through the bustling souks and a visit to the famous Jemaa El Fna square. You'll spend the night at your Marrakech hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Marrakech to Casablanca
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning, whether it's exploring the vibrant souks or unwinding by your hotel's poolside. Lunch in Marrakech at your own pace. Later, journey to Casablanca for an overnight stay at your hotel. Breakfast and Dinner included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Farewell Casablanca
package_itineraries.description: As the morning arrives, have your breakfast and get ready to bid adieu to your hotel and make your way to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Arusha – Lake Manyara
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our team will be there to assist you with all necessary airport procedures. Our experienced tour guide will then drive you to the captivating Lake Manyara National Park. Upon reaching your hotel, you'll check-in and enjoy a satisfying lunch. Take in the breathtaking views that stretch out across the lake and its surroundings. Later in the afternoon, our guide will lead you on a thrilling game drive within the park. The evening is yours to relax and unwind. You'll enjoy a delicious dinner and spend the night at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Lake Manyara to Serengeti
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Today, you'll embark on an exciting journey as you cross the Ngorongoro Massif en route to the renowned Serengeti National Park. Once you arrive, our tour representative will guide you on an exhilarating game drive within the park. After your morning adventure, return to the hotel for a well-deserved lunch. Then, prepare for another thrilling game drive in the Serengeti. As the day draws to a close, head back to the hotel for a delicious dinner and a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Serengeti
package_itineraries.description: On the third day, you'll embark on a full-day safari adventure in the Serengeti, complete with a picnic lunch. Your morning will be dedicated to observing the wildlife along the riverbanks and in the branches of trees. During the afternoon, you'll have the opportunity to spot wildebeests as they roam the area. Take some time to explore the rocky outcrops where cheetahs seek shade and rest. Later in the evening, return to the hotel for a delicious dinner and a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Serengeti to Ngorongoro
package_itineraries.description: After having breakfast at the hotel, we'll make our way to Ngorongoro. Here, we'll have a lovely picnic lunch at Olduvai Gorge, and you can explore the museum located there. This museum holds the remnants of some of humanity's earliest fossils. We recommend spending at least two nights in Ngorongoro. In the evening, we'll return to the lodge to enjoy a delicious dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Ngorongoro
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying a hearty breakfast in the morning, our tour guide will accompany you on an exciting 6-hour game-viewing adventure within the Ngorongoro Crater. You'll have the chance to spot an array of wildlife during this expedition, and your picnic lunch will be served right there in the crater. Following your visit, return to the lodge for a well-deserved dinner. Ngorongoro is renowned as one of Africa's premier game-viewing destinations, and it's often referred to as the "8th wonder of the world." Ngorongoro Crater is a natural marvel, boasting the title of the world's largest unbroken caldera, with its impressive 610-meter depth and expansive 260 square kilometers of area. This unique landscape encapsulates the essence of East African beauty and wildlife. The panoramic grandeur and breathtaking views make Ngorongoro Crater a true wonder of the world. Your overnight stay will be in the Ngorongoro region, allowing you to soak in the magic of this remarkable place.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Ngorongoro to Tarangire
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel. Afterward, we'll make our way to Tarangire National Park, where you'll have the opportunity to explore all the wonderful attractions it has to offer. Return to the hotel for a delicious lunch. In the evening, embark on an exciting game drive. Tarangire National Park is a haven for bird enthusiasts, boasting a wide array of bird species and fascinating wildlife. Enjoy a tranquil overnight stay at Tarangire, surrounded by the beauty of nature.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Tarangire to Arusha
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a swift breakfast and head to Arusha. Relish a delicious lunch, and then we'll whisk you away to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cape Town - Oudtshoorn
package_itineraries.description: Your journey commences as you arrive in Cape Town and embark on a scenic drive through the Winelands, passing Paarl and Worcester along the way. As you meander through the picturesque Breede River Valley, characterised by its lush vineyards and bountiful fruit orchards, you'll soon find yourself in the enchanting region known as 'The Little Karoo.' Your route leads you to the coastal town of Mossel Bay, nestled along the Garden Route in South Africa's Western Cape Province. Mossel Bay is renowned for its expansive Santos Beach and the iconic 19th-century Cape St. Blaize Lighthouse, offering breathtaking bay views. While here, make sure to explore the Bartolomeu Dias Museum Complex, which houses the Maritime Museum, the Shell Museum, and delightful botanical gardens. Don't miss the Post Office Tree, a majestic milkwood tree within the complex that has served as a mail collection point since the 1500s. Your first day's journey concludes with an overnight stay at a hotel in Oudtshoorn.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Oudtshoorn to Knysna
package_itineraries.description: Today, we explore the captivating Cango Caves, renowned for their stunning stalactite and stalagmite formations. Afterwards, we head to the Cango Wildlife Ranch, offering an optional opportunity to get up close with the world's fastest animal, the cheetah (additional cost applies). In the afternoon, we delve into the fascinating world of ostrich farming, discovering how these magnificent birds are raised. You may even have the chance to take a ride on one of these remarkable creatures. Our journey then takes us over the picturesque Outeniqua Mountains to George, known as 'the Gateway to the Garden Route,' and the scenic lakes of Wilderness, en route to the beautiful destination of Knysna. You'll spend the night at Knysna hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Knysna - John Benn Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a delightful morning cruise aboard the John Benn, sailing on the scenic Knysna Lagoon. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. You'll spend the night at your Knysna hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Leaving Knysna
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a healthy breakfast. Today, we'll pick you up from your hotel and take you to George Airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nairobi
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at the airport, our friendly representatives will assist you in completing all necessary government procedures. Afterward, you'll be transferred to your hotel, where you can enjoy a relaxing day at your own pace.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Nairobi to Masai Mara (5 hours and 30 minutes)
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying your breakfast at the hotel, we'll set out for the remarkable Masai Mara National Reserve, passing through Narak Town. Upon arrival, we'll check into the hotel for a delicious lunch. Following a brief rest, we'll embark on an exciting game drive in this renowned reserve, an extension of Tanzania's Serengeti National Park. As the day comes to a close, we'll head back to the hotel for a delightful dinner, and you'll spend the night there.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Masai Mara
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast, and then gather with our tour guide for an exciting morning game drive. Afterward, head back to the camp for a relaxing lunch break. In the evening, return to your hotel for a delicious dinner and a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Masai Mara to Lake Nakuru (5 Hours and 30 Minutes)
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying your breakfast at the hotel, we'll set off for the picturesque Lake Nakuru National Park, where breathtaking scenery awaits. You'll have your lunch at the hotel and then head to the national park for a brief visit to experience its natural beauty. Later in the day, return to the hotel for a delicious dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Lake Nakuru to Aberdares (4 Hours)
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast, and then it's off to Aberdares to explore some of the area's top tourist attractions. After your visit, return to the hotel to check out, and enjoy a leisurely lunch. Following that, embark on more sightseeing adventures before transferring to the lodge using the lodge's transportation. In the evening, savour a delicious dinner at the lodge and settle in for a peaceful overnight stay. Keep an eye out for the various animals that frequent the waterhole and its surroundings.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Aberdares to Mount Kenya (1 Hour 30 Minutes)
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a quick breakfast at the hotel, and then meet with your tour guide to discuss the day's plan. We'll make our way to the picturesque White Highlands and the stunning Mount Kenya Region. Upon arrival, check-in at the club. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Take in the breathtaking surroundings and relish the tranquility. As evening approaches, it's time for a delicious dinner where you can indulge in your favourite dishes at the club.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Mount Kenya to Nairobi
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast, and then make your way to Nairobi. Treat yourself to lunch at the renowned "Carnivore" restaurant or "Haandi/Haveli" if you prefer vegetarian options. After your meal, head to the airport for your flight departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Casablanca
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Casablanca's Mohamed V airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your driver and transferred to your hotel. After checking in, you'll spend the night at the hotel in Casablanca. Dinner will be provided.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Casablanca - City Discovery - Rabat
package_itineraries.description: Today, we embark on a brief exploration of Casablanca, the thriving business hub of the kingdom. From our comfortable coach, we'll catch glimpses of the Medina, Mohammed V Square, United Nations Place, the charming Habbous quarter, the Royal Palace, and the Anfa residential area. Not to be missed is the grand Hassan II Mosque. After this delightful experience, we set our course for Rabat. Upon arrival, we'll check into our hotel and settle in for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rabat - City Exploration - Tangier
package_itineraries.description: Explore Morocco's administrative capital today. Discover the "Imperial Garden City" with its prominent landmarks, including the Oudayas garden, Hassan Tower, and its Mausoleum. You can choose to have lunch at a local restaurant in Rabat. Afterward, we'll continue our journey to Tangier, passing through Larache and Asilah. Check-in at the hotel in Tangier for a comfortable overnight stay. Breakfast and Dinner will be included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Tangier - Chefchaouen - Fes
package_itineraries.description: Today, we will embark on a captivating journey through the legendary city of Tangier. Our first stop is Cape Spartel, where the sparkling Mediterranean Sea gracefully merges with the vast Atlantic Ocean. Take some free time to relish the breathtaking views from the furthest Northwestern tip of Africa. Next, we head to the enchanting city of Chefchaouen, known for its charming streets adorned in shades of white and blue. There, we'll enjoy a delightful lunch at a local restaurant. In the late afternoon, we make our way to the historic city of Fes, where we'll check in at our hotel. Rest and refresh for the night ahead. You'll spend the night at our comfortable hotel in Fes. Breakfast and Dinner included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Fes – Exploring the City
package_itineraries.description: Today is all about immersing yourself in the rich history of Fez, the oldest of Morocco's Imperial Cities, celebrated for its significant influence on Moroccan culture. Begin with a visit to the ancient Medina. Stroll through the bustling souks, where artisans continue their age-old craft in the traditional oriental way. Later, journey to Meknes, often dubbed the "Moroccan Versailles," and take in the sights, including Bab El Mansour. Return to your hotel and enjoy an overnight stay in Fes with breakfast and dinner included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Fes to Erfoud via Midelt
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with an early breakfast, and then set off for Merzouga, passing through Erfoud and the charming Berber village of Immouzer du Kandar. Your journey will take you through Ifrane, a picturesque ski resort, and Azrou, a Berber village renowned for its skilled artisans specialising in wood carving and carpet weaving. Take your time for lunch at a serene Kasbah in Midelt. Afterward, continue your adventure through the breathtaking Ziz canyons, offering magnificent views of the Atlas Mountains. You'll finally reach Erfoud and check in at your hotel. Enjoy your overnight stay in Erfoud, with both breakfast and dinner included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Erfoud to Ouarzazate via Tinghir
package_itineraries.description: Today, we'll journey to Ouarzazate through Tinghir, where you'll find the Todra Gorges, renowned for being both the highest and narrowest in the region, just 15 km from Tinghir. The road along the Todra Gorges offers stunning views of palm tree-covered riverbanks. Next, we'll continue our drive to Ouarzazate via Boumalne, Kelaa M'Gouna, and Skoura. Upon arriving in Ouarzazate, you'll have the opportunity to explore its main Kasbahs. Afterward, we'll check in at the hotel, where you'll spend the night. Breakfast and dinner are included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Ouarzazate to Marrakech
package_itineraries.description: Today, we will embark on a journey to the famous Ait Benhadou Kasbah, located just 30 kilometers from Ouarzazate. This stunning fortress is a true gem of southern Morocco and has served as the backdrop for numerous films, including the iconic "Lawrence of Arabia." Aït Benhaddou: This fortified village, now home to only five families, holds UNESCO recognition as a global cultural treasure. Its ancient beauty is a testament to Morocco's rich history. After our exploration, we set out on a scenic route towards Marrakech, taking us through winding mountain roads and the Tizin Tichka Pass, the highest mountain pass in Morocco. Upon arrival, we'll check into our hotel for a comfortable overnight stay. Breakfast and dinner included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Marrakech - City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Today, embark on a full-day city tour of Marrakech, the second oldest Imperial City and often referred to as the "Pearl of the South." Founded by the Almoravides in the late 11th century, Marrakesh is a vibrant city surrounded by the snow-capped Atlas Mountains and lush oases. Your journey includes visits to renowned attractions such as the Bahia Palace, Menara Gardens, an external view of the Koutoubia Mosque, and an opportunity for a leisurely lunch. Later, immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of the souks and the famous Jemaa El Fna square. Tonight, rest comfortably at your Marrakech hotel. Optional: In the evening, you have the choice to enjoy dinner at the local restaurant "Chez Ali" with captivating folkloric performances and a spectacular Fantasia show or savour the delights of an Arab palace with mesmerising belly dancing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Marrakech to Essaouira
package_itineraries.description: This morning, we'll journey to Essaouira, a city with a rich history that echoes the times when Spain, Portugal, and England vied for control of its coast. This charming coastal town showcases a blend of Moorish and Portuguese architecture, featuring a picturesque Portuguese harbour. Essaouira is renowned for its skilled artisans working with thuja wood, a vibrant silver market, an inspiring art gallery, and its bustling harbour and islands. Fun fact: Orson Welles filmed his masterpiece, Othello, right here in Essaouira. During your visit, explore the impressive Skala ramparts, admire the seaside port, and wander through the captivating Medina. You'll spend the night at a cozy hotel in Essaouira, with both breakfast and dinner provided. Enjoy your stay in this enchanting coastal town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Essaouira – Safi - El Jadida - Casablanca
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before embarking on your journey to Safi, one of Africa's oldest ports beyond Gibraltar. You'll explore the remnants of the Portuguese Sea Castle and can shop for exquisite pottery on Pottery's Hill. Next, you'll head to Oualidia, a charming seaside resort famous for its oyster farming, where you can choose to have a leisurely lunch. In the afternoon, you'll continue your adventure to the picturesque beach resort of El Jadida, formerly known as “Mazagan” during the Portuguese era, for a brief visit. Afterward, you'll make your way to Casablanca, where you'll check in at the hotel for a restful night. Your stay in Casablanca includes breakfast and dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Leaving Casablanca
package_itineraries.description: Today, after having a delicious breakfast, it's time to say goodbye to your hotel and head to Mohamed V Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cape Town
package_itineraries.description: Touch down at Cape Town International Airport, where a friendly representative will greet you and take you to your hotel. Enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure to explore the city on your own. Spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cape Town – Half-Day City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and then set off for a half-day Cape Town City tour. If the weather allows, you'll visit Table Mountain. Drive past the Castle of Good Hope, accompanied by a Driver Guide, and see the Parliament Buildings, City Hall, and the Slave Lodge. Explore the Malay Quarter and pay a visit to the Diamond Cutters. Wrap up your tour with a visit to the Victoria & Alfred Waterfront for some shopping before returning to your hotel. Spend the night at your Cape Town hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cape Town - Full-Day Cape Peninsula Tour
package_itineraries.description: On this full-day tour, we'll make several stops to explore the beauty of the Cape Peninsula. Our first stop is at Hout Bay Harbour, where we'll enjoy a Seal Island Cruise. If it's open, we'll take the picturesque Chapmans Peak Drive. We'll also visit the Cape Point National Park, where you can take an optional Funicular Tour. Next, we'll head to Simons Town to see the charming Boulders Beach Penguin Colony. The tour also includes a visit to the Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. You'll spend the night at the hotel in Cape Town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cape Town to Knysna
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast, and then set off on a private transfer to Knysna. You'll follow Route 62, a scenic route, to reach Knysna. In the evening, enjoy a picturesque sunset cruise on the Knysna Lagoon aboard the John Benn. Afterward, return to your hotel, and the rest of the evening is yours to relax and unwind. You'll spend the night at your Knysna hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Knysna - Full Day Oudtshoorn Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying your breakfast, embark on a full-day excursion to Oudtshoorn, where you'll visit the remarkable Cango Caves, an ostrich farm, and the Cango Wildlife Ranch. After the day's adventures, return to your hotel. The evening is yours to relax and enjoy at your leisure. You'll spend the night at the Knysna hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: George to Johannesburg to Sun City
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast today, we'll arrange for your transfer to George Airport for your flight to Johannesburg. Please note that the flight cost is not included in the tour price, and we suggest a flight departing around 09:00. Upon your arrival in Johannesburg, a private transfer will take you to Sun City. After checking in at the hotel, the rest of the day is yours to explore the resort at your own pace. Enjoy an overnight stay at the hotel in Sun City.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Sun City – A Day of Relaxation
package_itineraries.description: Today is a day for relaxation and leisure. You have the opportunity to indulge in endless entertainment at the Valley of the Waves. Enjoy thrilling entertainment choices, live concerts, sporting events, and much more. Spend the night at the hotel in Sun City. (Breakfast included)

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Sun City to Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast, then check out of the hotel. You'll continue your journey with a private transfer to Johannesburg for a Half Day Gold Reef Tour, featuring fascinating historical gold mining attractions. After the tour, you'll be taken to the hotel for check-in. Enjoy an overnight stay in Johannesburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Depart Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: This morning you need to check out from the hotel take the complimentary shuttle from Emperor's Palace to JNB Airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: As you land at OR Tambo International Airport, a welcoming representative will greet you. They will then escort you to your awaiting vehicle, which will transport you to your chosen game lodge in Kruger National Park or nearby hotels. Enjoy the remainder of the day at your own pace. You'll spend the night at the lodge.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kruger National Park
package_itineraries.description: Start with a hearty breakfast. A full day of game drives awaits those staying outside the Kruger National Park. For clients inside the park, enjoy early morning and afternoon game drives. Spend the night at the lodge.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Depart Johannesburg
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast you will be collected and transferred back to OR Tambo International Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Anchorage
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Anchorage Airport, you'll be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. Anchorage, Alaska’s largest city, is a hub of urban comforts nestled in the vast wilderness. After check-in, the rest of the day is yours to relax or explore the surroundings at leisure. Enjoy your first overnight stay in Anchorage.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Anchorage to Talkeetna – Rail Journey & Jet Boat Safari
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed to the Anchorage Railway Station to board the Alaska Rail Road bound for Talkeetna. This scenic train ride offers dramatic views of alpine landscapes, winding rivers, and—on clear days—the towering Mt. Denali (formerly Mount McKinley). Wildlife sightings are common, so keep your camera ready. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel in Talkeetna. In the afternoon, set out on the exciting Talkeetna Wilderness Jet Boat Safari. Travel deep into the river systems as you spot bald eagles, beavers, moose, and perhaps even bears in their natural habitat. Return for an overnight stay in Talkeetna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Talkeetna to Denali – Scenic Rail to the Great North
package_itineraries.description: This morning, check out and head to Talkeetna Railway Station to continue your journey aboard the Alaska Rail Road toward Denali. As you travel through the heart of Alaska, enjoy stunning views of glacial valleys and cross Broad Pass—the highest point of the Alaska Railroad. Upon arrival in Denali, transfer to your hotel. In the evening, you may choose to add an optional glacier flightseeing tour or a glacier landing for an unforgettable aerial perspective of the Alaska Range. Spend the night at your hotel in Denali.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Denali National Park – Tundra Wilderness Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast, followed by a guided Tundra Wilderness Tour into Denali National Park. This immersive 53-mile narrated journey offers extraordinary opportunities to witness Alaska’s famed wildlife, such as moose, Dall sheep, caribou, wolves, and grizzly bears. The tour also provides remarkable views of Mt. Denali, weather permitting, and your naturalist guide will share insights into the region’s ecology, geology, and native history. After your adventure, return to the hotel for a well-deserved rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Denali to Fairbanks – River Canyon Views & Rail Ride
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head to Denali Railway Station for your final scenic train ride aboard the Alaska Rail Road to Fairbanks. Journey past the Nenana River Canyon, popular for its rafting thrills, and cross the impressive single-span bridge over the Tanana River. On arrival in Fairbanks—often called the “Golden Heart City”—transfer to your hotel. The evening is free for you to enjoy local dining or perhaps witness the aurora borealis if conditions are favorable. Overnight in Fairbanks.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Fairbanks Exploration & Departure
package_itineraries.description: This morning, dive into Alaska’s gold rush heritage with the Gold Dredge Tour. Begin with a ride on the Tanana Valley Railroad, where live narration guides you through gold-mining history and past the Trans-Alaska Pipeline. At the dredge site, learn how massive gold machines once operated and try your luck at gold panning with your own bag of pay dirt—keep what you find! Later in the afternoon, check out from your hotel and transfer to Fairbanks Airport for your onward flight. Your McKinley Holiday Package ends here, but the memories of Alaska’s untamed beauty will stay with you forever.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Anchorage
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Anchorage Airport, you will be greeted and transferred to your hotel. After checking in, the remainder of the day is free for you to relax or explore at your own pace. Enjoy your first night in the comfort of your Anchorage hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Scenic Journey from Anchorage to Talkeetna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and make your way to the Anchorage Railway Station. Board the renowned Alaska Railroad en route to Talkeetna. During this breathtaking ride, take in sweeping views from large panoramic windows, with chances to see native wildlife and the impressive silhouette of Mt. Denali. Upon arrival in Talkeetna, you'll be transferred to your hotel. In the afternoon, set out on the Talkeetna Wilderness Jet Boat Safari—a thrilling ride that offers close encounters with bald eagles, moose, beavers, and possibly bears in their natural surroundings. Overnight stay in Talkeetna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Talkeetna to Denali by Rail
package_itineraries.description: Today, depart from your hotel and head to Talkeetna Railway Station for your train ride to Denali. Enjoy another scenic rail journey as you travel through Alaska’s stunning backcountry and over Broad Pass—the highest point on the Alaska Railroad at 2,363 feet—while keeping your eyes open for wildlife and Mt. McKinley in the distance. Upon reaching Denali, you will be taken to your hotel. In the evening, consider an optional glacier flightseeing excursion or even a glacier landing for an unforgettable aerial experience. Rest overnight at your hotel in Denali.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Toronto to Ottawa – Scenic VIA Rail Journey
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with the unforgettable Denali Tundra Wilderness Tour. This narrated experience travels deep into Denali National Park, where you'll witness stunning landscapes and an abundance of wildlife. Be on the lookout for moose, wolves, caribou, Dall sheep, and grizzly bears. Led by a certified naturalist driver, this 53-mile journey offers not only amazing animal sightings but also fascinating commentary on the park’s history, ecology, and geology. After a day immersed in nature, return to your Denali hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Denali to Anchorage
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a relaxed morning before checking out. You’ll then proceed to Anchorage Airport for your onward flight or the next chapter of your journey. Let the memories of your Denali tour package adventure stay with you forever.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Trinidad
package_itineraries.description: Your tropical escape begins as you land at Port of Spain, the capital city of Trinidad. A warm welcome awaits you at the airport, followed by a smooth transfer to your hotel. Take the rest of the day to unwind and soak in the island vibe. Overnight stay in Trinidad.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover the City of Port of Spain
package_itineraries.description: Dive into the heart of Trinidad with a guided city tour of Port of Spain. Discover historic architecture, vibrant local markets, and notable attractions such as art galleries, museums, Queen’s Park Savannah, Emperor Valley Zoo, and the Botanical Gardens. Conclude the day with a scenic stop at Lady Young Lookout, offering a sweeping view of the cityscape. Overnight stay in your Trinidad hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Explore Asa Wright Nature Centre
package_itineraries.description: Set off on a nature-filled excursion to the renowned Asa Wright Nature Centre, nestled in the green folds of the Northern Range. After a picturesque drive, join an expert guide for a serene walk through this 200-acre sanctuary. Spot exotic birds like toucans and hummingbirds, admire colorful flora, and take in the tranquil sounds of the forest. Optional: Enjoy a traditional lunch at the Old Plantation House or take a dip at a nearby waterfall before heading back. Return to your hotel for a relaxing night in Trinidad.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Flight to Tobago
package_itineraries.description: This morning, you'll transfer to Piarco Airport for your flight to the island of Tobago. Upon arrival, you’ll be met and escorted to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours—relax by the beach or explore at your own pace. Overnight stay in Tobago.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Full-Day Tobago Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a scenic journey across Tobago, taking in the breathtaking beauty of both the Caribbean and Atlantic coastlines. You'll pass through tropical rainforests, unspoiled beaches, and cascading waterfalls. Highlights include a visit to historical landmarks and a refreshing dip at the Argyle Waterfall. Enjoy lunch at Jemma’s Treehouse—a local favorite offering authentic island cuisine. On days it's closed, a similar local eatery will be provided. Return to your hotel and unwind after a full day of sightseeing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Tobago Rainforest Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Start your day early with a nature-filled adventure along Tobago’s Caribbean coast. Visit local gems like Castara Bay and, when open, a traditional clay oven bakery. Continue on to Englishman’s Bay for postcard-perfect views. Taste seasonal fruits and sample local treats along the way. The highlight of the day is a hike through the Main Ridge Rainforest—the oldest protected reserve in the Western Hemisphere. Keep an eye out for the island’s native wildlife, including the White-tailed Sabrewing hummingbird and the national bird, the Cocrico. After your hike, enjoy lunch in Castara before heading back for an overnight stay at your Tobago hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Farewell from Tobago
package_itineraries.description: On your final day, you’ll be transferred to Scarborough Airport for your return flight, connecting through Trinidad. Depart with unforgettable memories from your Trinidad and Tobago Tour Package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sao Paulo
package_itineraries.description: Once you land at Sao Paulo Airport, you’ll be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at your own pace, relaxing and settling in. Overnight stay in Sao Paulo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sao Paulo - Rio De Janeiro City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a refreshing breakfast. Then, embark on a city tour of Sao Paulo. The journey starts at Centro Cultural and continues through Old Downtown where you’ll see major attractions such as Cathedral Se, Patio do Colegio, Monastery of Sao Bento, Banespa Building, Martinelli Building, Viaduto do Cha, the Municipal Theater, Sala Sao Paulo concert hall, Estaçao da Luz station, and the Municipal Market. Post tour, you’ll be transferred to the airport for your flight to Rio de Janeiro. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and spend the evening at your leisure. Overnight in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rio De Janeiro
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a tour to Sugar Loaf Mountain. Enjoy a panoramic drive through downtown Rio, passing by landmarks like Maracana Stadium, Sambodrome, and the unique Metropolitan Cathedral. Stop at Cinelandia Square with its historical buildings, including the National Library and the Museum of Fine Arts. Then, ascend to Sugar Loaf by cable car for incredible views. Later, visit Corcovado Mountain and enjoy Rio’s iconic beaches. Overnight stay in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rio De Janeiro
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before heading on a scenic cruise along Guanabara Bay. Discover islands like Ilha Fiscal, Ilha das Cobras, and Ilha das Enxadas, and enjoy views of Rio-Niteroi Bridge and surrounding landscapes. On the return, take in the beauty of Niteroi’s coast and see the Museum of Contemporary Art, Santa Cruz Fortress, and beaches like Icarai and Jurujuba. Spend the night at your hotel in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Rio De Janeiro – Iguassu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport and fly to Iguassu. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and later visit the Brazilian side of the Iguassu Falls. Begin at the Visitor Center, then board a panoramic bus to reach the trails. Walk along a scenic path to view the falls from various platforms. Conclude your visit at Floriano fall and explore the upper viewing areas. Return for an overnight stay in Iguazu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Iguassu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a day tour to the Argentinean side of the falls. Begin at the New Visitors Center and explore the Nature Interpretation Center. Ride the train to the Cataratas Station or take the Green Trail. Upper Circuit: 800 meters of raised walkways offering aerial views. Lower Circuit: 1,600 meters with viewpoints surrounding the falls. Devil's Gorge: Take a train to Garganta Station and walk 1,200 meters to a stunning lookout point. Return for your overnight stay in Iguazu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Iguassu to Buenos
package_itineraries.description: AiresTransfer to the airport for your flight to Buenos Aires. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Buenos Aires is a vibrant city filled with European-inspired architecture and culture. In the evening, enjoy a Tango Show and Dinner at Tango Porteño. Overnight in Buenos Aires.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Buenos Aires
package_itineraries.description: Start your city tour of Buenos Aires after breakfast. Visit major landmarks like Av. 9 de Julio, the Colón Theatre, and the Obelisk. Explore Plaza de Mayo, San Telmo, La Boca, Caminito, and Puerto Madero. Continue to Palermo and Recoleta, ending at San Telmo Flea Market if it's Sunday. Overnight in Buenos Aires.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Buenos Aires to Ushuaia
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, fly from El Calafate to Ushuaia, the world’s southernmost city. Enjoy scenic views of the Beagle Channel and check in at your Ushuaia hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Ushuaia
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, explore Tierra del Fuego National Park with a ride on the Train of the End of the World. Enjoy nature and history in Argentina's only coastal national park. In the afternoon, sail the Beagle Channel and visit Seals Island to see sea life in its natural habitat. Overnight in Ushuaia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Ushuaia to El Calafate
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport and fly to El Calafate. Upon arrival, head to your hotel and enjoy a free day. Overnight stay in El Calafate.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: El Calafate
package_itineraries.description: Visit the spectacular Perito Moreno Glacier after breakfast. Tour Los Glaciares National Park and walk the glacier trails. Take a Nautical Safari to witness the glacier from the water. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: El Calafate to Bariloche
package_itineraries.description: Fly from El Calafate to Bariloche. Transfer to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at your own pace. Overnight in Bariloche.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Bariloche Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Explore Bariloche after breakfast with a scenic drive along Ezequiel Bustillo Avenue. Discover lakes, peninsulas, islands, and mountain peaks. Visit the Panoramic Point for breathtaking views. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 15: Bariloche to Puerto Varas
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Bariloche to Puerto Varas via the Cardenal Samore Pass. Stop at Osorno and continue through beautiful landscapes to reach your hotel in Puerto Varas. Overnight in Puerto Varas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 17: Puerto Varas - Santiago
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport and fly to Santiago. Visit La Moneda Palace, Plaza de Armas, San Cristobal Hill, and explore neighborhoods like Bellavista, Las Condes, and Providencia. Overnight stay in Santiago.

package_itineraries.title: Day 18: Santiago
package_itineraries.description: Take a full-day tour of Vina del Mar and Valparaiso. Stop in Pomaire village, explore the Garden City of Vina del Mar, and the historical hills of Valparaiso, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Return for an overnight stay in Santiago.

package_itineraries.title: Day 19: Departing from Santiago
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey or return home, bringing along cherished memories of your South America Travel Packages adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Rio de Janeiro
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Rio’s international airport where a friendly local representative will guide you to your hotel. Known affectionately as "The Marvelous City," Rio de Janeiro was once the capital of both Portugal and Brazil until 1960. Today, it’s a dazzling mix of dramatic mountain landscapes and coastal charm. One of Brazil’s most dynamic cities, Rio is famed for its landmarks like Sugarloaf Mountain (Pão de Açúcar), Christ the Redeemer (Corcovado), and the world-famous Copacabana and Ipanema beaches. The city exudes an irresistible energy, and its locals—Cariocas—are known for their warm, easy-going nature. Whether you're here to enjoy nature, soak in the culture, or join the Carnival celebrations, Rio has something for every kind of traveler. Enjoy your first night at your hotel in Rio.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore the Icons of Rio
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a delicious breakfast, then embark on the thrilling Sugarloaf Mountain excursion. This panoramic journey begins with a city tour, passing through downtown Rio and notable spots such as Maracanã Stadium, the Sambadrome, and the architecturally stunning Metropolitan Cathedral—famous for its massive pyramid shape and a height of 80 meters. Next, explore Cinelandia Square, home to Rio's cultural gems like the Municipal Theater, the National Library, and the Museum of Fine Arts. Then, take a scenic cable car ride to Sugarloaf Mountain for breathtaking views over the bay and city skyline. In the afternoon, visit Corcovado Mountain, home to the iconic Christ the Redeemer statue, and enjoy a drive along some of the city’s most beautiful beaches. Return to your hotel in the evening for a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cruise Through Guanabara Bay
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head out to explore the stunning Guanabara Bay on a scenic cruise. Surrounded by mountains and lined with golden beaches, the bay reveals Rio from a magical perspective. During the cruise, sail past several islands, including Ilha Fiscal, Ilha das Cobras, and Ilha de Villegaignon. Enjoy amazing views of the Rio-Niterói Bridge and the busy city port. On the opposite shore, discover the charming coastline of Niterói, featuring highlights like Gragoatá Beach and Fort, the Museum of Contemporary Art, and beaches like Icaraí, São Francisco, Jurujuba, and Charitas. Capture panoramic views of Pedra do Índio and Pedra Itapuca along the way. Your return cruise offers glimpses of Santa Cruz Fortress and the scenic beaches of Flamengo and Botafogo. After this delightful day, unwind back at your hotel in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Flight to Iguazu – Brazilian Side of the Falls
package_itineraries.description: This morning, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Iguazu. Once you land, a transfer will take you to your hotel where you can settle in and prepare for the natural wonders ahead. Your exploration begins at the Brazilian side of the Iguazu Falls. After arriving at the visitor center, board a panoramic bus that leads you into the park. Your journey includes a 950-meter walking trail, offering fantastic views of the Argentine side of the falls and the mighty Iguazu River. A highlight of the walk is the platform that brings you face-to-face with the impressive Floriano Falls. Take in breathtaking views of the Devil’s Throat and the lower river from a privileged vantage point. End your visit with a ride up the panoramic elevator to the shopping and dining area. Enjoy a peaceful night at your hotel in Iguazu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Argentina Side of the Falls
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast before heading out to explore the Argentine side of Iguazu Falls. The tour begins at the newly upgraded Visitors Center, where you can visit the Nature Interpretation Center and then choose between a short hike on the Green Trail or a scenic train ride to reach the starting points of the walkways. On the Upper Circuit, you’ll walk along 800 meters of catwalks suspended above the forest floor, offering aerial views of the falls and the surrounding jungle. The Lower Circuit, a 1,600-meter network of trails, lets you experience the waterfalls from below, bringing you close to the thunderous flow and misty spray of the cascades. Finally, head toward the Devil’s Throat—the most powerful and iconic part of the falls. After an 18-minute train ride, walk over elevated pathways to an incredible viewing platform directly above this roaring natural wonder. After an awe-inspiring day, return to your hotel in Iguazu for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Iguazu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel. A transfer will take you to the airport, where you’ll board your flight to your next destination or back home—carrying unforgettable memories from your incredible journey through Brazil, made special by your Rio De Janeiro tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Lima
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to Peru! Upon your arrival at Lima’s international airport, you will be met by a representative and transferred to your hotel. Take time to rest and prepare for the adventure ahead. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in Lima.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discovering Lima’s Historic & Modern Charms
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin a fascinating half-day tour of Peru’s capital city. Dive into the historical centre of Lima as you explore notable sites such as the Plaza Mayor, Government Palace, San Martín Square, the Justice Palace, and the Archbishop's Palace. Admire colonial-era architecture including the Torre Tagle Palace and the charming Desamparados train station. Visit the San Francisco Convent, famous for its intricate catacombs, and stroll by elegant colonial mansions with traditional Moorish balconies. Later, head into the vibrant districts of San Isidro and Miraflores, where the city’s modern side comes alive, ending with a scenic view of the Pacific coastline. Return to your hotel and relax for the night in Lima.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Lima to Cusco – Gateway to the Andes
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast and a transfer to the airport for your flight to Cusco. Once in Cusco, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. The morning is free to rest and acclimate to the altitude. In the afternoon, embark on a guided tour of Cusco—a city that beautifully blends Incan roots with colonial heritage. Visit the sacred Temple of the Sun, known as Koricancha, followed by the grand Cusco Cathedral in the historic main square. Continue to the nearby archaeological sites including Tambomachay (the Incan bathing site), the military lookout of Puca Pucara, the ceremonial site of Kenko, and the impressive fortress of Sacsayhuaman with its massive stone walls. Return to your hotel in Cusco for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Visit to Machu Picchu – The Lost City of the Incas
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with breakfast and head to the train station for your journey through the Sacred Valley toward Aguas Calientes. This scenic ride offers breathtaking views of the Andes and the Urubamba River. Upon arrival, you’ll board a bus that will take you up the winding mountain road to Machu Picchu. Explore one of the New Seven Wonders of the World with a guided tour, learning about its history, significance, and architectural brilliance. A delicious lunch is included during the excursion. After a day of discovery at this mystical site, return to Cusco by train and enjoy a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Farewell – Cusco to Lima
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your return flight to Lima or your onward journey. Your Classic Peru Tour Package concludes here, leaving you with incredible memories of ancient wonders, cultural treasures, and unforgettable experiences.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to São Paulo
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at São Paulo International Airport, a local representative will meet and assist you with your transfer to the hotel. After checking in, enjoy the rest of the day at leisure or explore the nearby attractions on your own. Overnight stay in São Paulo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: São Paulo City Tour – Flight to Rio de Janeiro
package_itineraries.description: After a delicious breakfast, begin your day with a guided city tour of São Paulo. Dive into the vibrant history and dynamic culture of Brazil’s largest metropolis. The tour includes stops at cultural landmarks such as the Se Cathedral, Pátio do Colégio, São Bento Monastery, and the Banespa and Martinelli Buildings. Walk across the historic Viaduto do Chá, explore the Municipal Theater, Sala São Paulo, Estação da Luz, and discover local flavors at the Municipal Market. Later in the afternoon, you’ll head to the airport for a short flight to Rio de Janeiro. Upon arrival, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. Relax and prepare for the exciting experiences that await you in the Marvelous City. Overnight in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rio de Janeiro – Sugar Loaf & City Landmarks
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast before embarking on a full-day city tour and Sugar Loaf Mountain excursion. The morning tour takes you through the heart of Rio, passing the legendary Maracanã Stadium, the Sambodrome, and the distinctive Metropolitan Cathedral with its towering pyramid design. A stroll through Cinelândia Square showcases classical architecture, including the National Library and Fine Arts Museum. Then, take a thrilling cable car ride to the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain. The first stop is Urca Hill (215 meters high), followed by the summit at 395 meters, offering awe-inspiring panoramic views of Guanabara Bay, Copacabana Beach, and the Corcovado Mountain. Later, visit the Corcovado itself, home to the iconic Christ the Redeemer statue. Wind down your day by soaking in the stunning coastal views. Overnight at your hotel in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Guanabara Bay Cruise & Niterói Highlights
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a scenic Half-Day Guanabara Bay cruise. Sail past picturesque islands like Ilha Fiscal, Ilha das Cobras, and Ilha das Enxadas, with views of the Rio-Niterói Bridge and city skyline. Crossing the bay to Niterói, explore beautiful beaches and landmarks such as Gragoatá Fort, Boa Viagem Island, the Contemporary Art Museum, and the historic Church of Nossa Senhora da Boa Viagem. Admire scenic coastal spots like Icaraí Beach, São Francisco, and Charitas, and witness the striking rock formations of Pedra Itapuca and Pedra do Índio. The day concludes with a view of the majestic Santa Cruz Fortress. Overnight stay in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Rio de Janeiro
package_itineraries.description: Following a relaxing breakfast, check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport for your departure. Whether you’re heading home or continuing your journey elsewhere, you’ll leave with unforgettable memories from your Brazil tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Buenos Aires
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Buenos Aires via Ezeiza International Airport, where you’ll be warmly received and transferred to your hotel. The city, stretching gracefully along the Rio de la Plata, offers a blend of modern vibrancy and deep-rooted tradition. Known as the cultural heart of Argentina, Buenos Aires reflects European charm with its grand architecture and elegant boulevards. The locals, or Porteños, take great pride in their heritage, which blends sophistication and passion—especially evident in the birthplace of tango. Spend the rest of your day at leisure, soaking in the city’s atmosphere. Overnight stay in Buenos Aires.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: City Tour & Tango Experience in Buenos Aires
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with breakfast, followed by a guided city tour showcasing the unique charm and architectural diversity of Buenos Aires. Discover a mix of historic and contemporary styles as you visit landmarks like Plaza de Mayo, the National Congress, Avenida de Mayo, Recoleta Cemetery, Caminito in La Boca, Puerto Madero, and the iconic El Ateneo bookstore. In the evening, prepare for a magical cultural experience with a Tango Show & Dinner at the renowned Tango Porteño. Witness the elegance of this traditional dance in an extravagant setting, paired with fine Argentine cuisine. Return to your hotel for a restful night in Buenos Aires.
