package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Flight to El Calafate – Gateway to Patagonia
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to the airport for your flight to El Calafate, a picturesque town on the shores of Lake Argentino. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy the tranquil surroundings. El Calafate is famed for its colorful seasonal changes and the mythic calafate berry—legend has it that those who eat the berry will return to Patagonia. The rest of your day is at leisure to explore the town or relax. Overnight in El Calafate.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Full-Day Tour to Perito Moreno Glacier
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast and prepare for a full-day adventure to the legendary Perito Moreno Glacier in Los Glaciares National Park. Travel along the scenic route tracing the southern shore of Lake Argentino until you reach the park entrance. Walk along panoramic trails offering awe-inspiring views of the 30,000-year-old glacier, which spans 192 square kilometers and rises nearly 80 meters high. Enhance your experience with a Nautical Safari on Rico Lake. Departing from Bajo de las Sombras Port, this boat tour takes you close to the towering ice wall where you can watch chunks of glacier break off and crash into the water below. After a thrilling day, return to your hotel in El Calafate for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Journey to Ushuaia – The Southernmost City
package_itineraries.description: This morning, fly to Ushuaia, the southernmost city in the world, located on Isla Grande de Tierra del Fuego. Framed by mountains and bordered by the Beagle Channel, Ushuaia is a stunning destination offering dramatic landscapes and rich heritage. Enjoy a relaxed evening in the city and check in to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Tierra del Fuego Park & Beagle Channel Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a Half-Day Tour of Tierra del Fuego National Park, which includes a scenic ride on the famous End of the World Train. Located just 12 km from Ushuaia, this national park is the only one in Argentina with an oceanfront. Explore its pristine forests, tranquil rivers, and native flora, including orchids, lengas, and calafates. In the afternoon, embark on a catamaran cruise through the Beagle Channel to Seals Island. This waterway connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans and is home to a wealth of marine wildlife including sea lions and seabirds. After the cruise, return to Ushuaia for a peaceful overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Fly to Iguazu Falls
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Iguazu. Upon arrival, meet your local guide and proceed to your hotel. Iguazu Falls straddles the border between Argentina and Brazil and is one of the world’s most stunning natural wonders. The name “Iguazu” comes from the Guarani word meaning "Big Waters," a fitting description for these majestic cascades. Overnight stay in Iguazu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Explore Argentine Side of Iguazu Falls
package_itineraries.description: Today’s excursion takes you to the Argentine side of Iguazu Falls. Begin at the Visitor Center and choose between a short train ride or a scenic walk along the Green Trail. Explore the Upper Circuit, where walkways suspended above the jungle offer panoramic views of the waterfalls, followed by the Lower Circuit, which provides closer access and unique vantage points. End the tour with a visit to the Devil’s Throat—the most powerful and dramatic section of the falls. Reach it via a train ride followed by a 1.2 km catwalk offering unforgettable views. After a full day immersed in natural beauty, return to your hotel in Iguazu for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Brazilian Falls & Departure
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a visit to the Brazilian side of Iguazu Falls. Board a panoramic bus at the entrance and enjoy sweeping views of the Argentine Falls before continuing on foot along a 950-meter trail leading to the stunning Floriano Falls. An optional elevator ride offers a higher viewpoint of the Iguazu River and Devil’s Throat Canyon. After your visit, return by bus to the entrance and transfer to the airport for your return flight to Buenos Aires. Upon arrival, connect to your international flight home, bringing your unforgettable Argentina tour package to a close—filled with diverse landscapes, vibrant cities, and memories to last a lifetime.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Buenos Aires
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to Argentina! Upon arrival at Buenos Aires International Airport, you’ll be greeted and transferred to your hotel. Buenos Aires, a dynamic port city stretched along the Rio de la Plata, is rich in European heritage and Latin spirit. Known for its elegant architecture and passionate locals (Porteños), the city blends old-world charm with modern sophistication. In the evening, enjoy a dazzling Tango Show with dinner at the renowned Tango Porteño. Overnight stay in Buenos Aires.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discovering Buenos Aires
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided city tour of Buenos Aires—often dubbed the "Paris of South America." Visit key landmarks including Av. 9 de Julio, the historic Colón Theatre, and the iconic Obelisk. Explore Plaza de Mayo, San Telmo's cobbled streets and tango culture, the colourful Caminito in La Boca, and the upscale Puerto Madero district. Continue to Palermo's lush green spaces and Recoleta, home to cultural landmarks and chic boutiques. If it’s a Sunday, enjoy browsing antiques and local crafts at the San Telmo Flea Market. Overnight in Buenos Aires.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Flight to Ushuaia
package_itineraries.description: Today, take a domestic flight from El Calafate to Ushuaia, the southernmost city in the world, located on Argentina’s Tierra del Fuego archipelago. Nestled between the Beagle Channel and snowcapped mountains, Ushuaia is rich in natural beauty and history. Its name means “bay that faces the west” in the indigenous Yamana language. After check-in at the hotel, enjoy the evening at leisure. Overnight in Ushuaia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Tierra del Fuego National Park & Beagle Channel
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a guided half-day tour of Tierra del Fuego National Park, including a ride on the historic End of the World Train. This scenic journey through pristine landscapes offers insight into the region’s past. Later, set sail on a catamaran through the Beagle Channel. Visit Seals Island, spot sea lions, and admire seabirds in their natural habitat. This breathtaking navigation offers a rare look at where the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans meet. Overnight stay in Ushuaia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Travel to El Calafate
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to El Calafate, a charming Patagonian town and the gateway to the famous Perito Moreno Glacier. After arrival, settle into your hotel and enjoy some leisure time. Relax and explore the local area before an overnight stay in El Calafate.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Perito Moreno Glacier Adventure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a full-day excursion to the breathtaking Perito Moreno Glacier. Travel along the shores of Lago Argentino to reach this immense ice formation—one of the few in the world still advancing. Witness towering walls of ice and hear the dramatic crack and crash of calving icebergs. For a closer look, join the optional Nautical Safari to sail near the glacier's massive face. Return to El Calafate for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Flight to Bariloche
package_itineraries.description: Depart El Calafate and fly to San Carlos de Bariloche, nestled beside the stunning Lake Nahuel Huapi and surrounded by the Andes. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is free for you to explore the lakeside town or relax. Overnight stay in Bariloche.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Scenic Bariloche Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast and a scenic city tour along Ezequiel Bustillo Avenue, hugging the shores of Lake Nahuel Huapi. Enjoy views of El Trebol Lagoon, Moreno and Nahuel Huapi Lakes, and surrounding mountains including Cerro Otto and Cerro Catedral. Stop at the panoramic lookout for unforgettable photos of the Llao Llao Peninsula and Moreno Lake. Return to your hotel in Bariloche for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Journey to Puerto Varas via Andes Crossing
package_itineraries.description: Set off early for a scenic journey across the Andes into Chile. Travel via the Cardenal Samore Pass, one of the region’s key international routes. Along the way, pass customs and admire views of Antillanca Volcano, hot springs, and lush forests. Continue onward through Osorno and Frutillar before reaching Puerto Varas. Overnight at a hotel in the beautiful lakeside town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Frutillar Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Today, take a half-day excursion to Frutillar, a quaint town on the shores of Lake Llanquihue. Known for its German-inspired architecture and spectacular volcano views—including Osorno and Calbuco—Frutillar offers charm and history. Visit the stunning Teatro del Lago and stroll through flower-lined streets. Return to Puerto Varas for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Fly to Santiago
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Puerto Montt Airport for your flight to Santiago, Chile's lively capital. Upon arrival, you’ll be taken to your hotel. In the afternoon, enjoy a guided city tour, visiting La Moneda Palace, Plaza de Armas, Santiago Cathedral, and the pedestrian streets of Ahumada and Huerfanos. Conclude with a visit to San Cristobal Hill for sweeping city views, and explore Bellavista and Las Condes districts. Overnight in Santiago.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Valparaiso & Viña del Mar
package_itineraries.description: Set off on a full-day trip to Chile’s Pacific coast. Begin in Pomaire, famous for its artisanal clay crafts, before heading to Viña del Mar—"The Garden City"—known for its flower-filled parks and beaches. Later, visit the colourful port city of Valparaiso, a UNESCO World Heritage Site built on 43 hills. Ride funiculars, explore winding alleys, and soak in the city’s bohemian charm. Return to Santiago for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Departure from Santiago
package_itineraries.description: After a final breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight home or next destination. Your Explore South America Tour Package concludes with unforgettable memories of vibrant cities, natural wonders, and cultural treasures.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Providenciales (Turks and Caicos)
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to the pristine shores of Turks and Caicos—a British Overseas Territory nestled in the Lucayan Archipelago of the Atlantic Ocean. The territory includes the larger Caicos Islands and the smaller Turks Islands. Upon arrival at Providenciales International Airport, you'll be warmly greeted and transferred to your hotel. Take time to unwind and soak in the coastal vibes as your unforgettable island getaway begins.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Providenciales – Optional Sunset Safari Experience
package_itineraries.description: Embrace the island's charm as the sun begins to dip. This optional guided sunset tour whisks you away to Sapodilla Beach in safari-style vehicles. With round-trip hotel transport included, you can fully enjoy the island's scenic beauty without any hassle. Explore the calm turquoise waters, and hear fascinating insights from your local guide about the island's culture, geography, and legends. It’s a magical way to start your journey through Turks and Caicos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Providenciales Discovery Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, venture out on a guided island tour that showcases the highlights of Providenciales. Begin with a visit to the famous Conch Farm, where you'll learn about the island's unique marine industry. Enjoy stunning beach views, sip on refreshing Rum Punch, and capture incredible photos atop Blue Mountain. Continue your adventure with a stop at “The Hole,” a natural limestone sinkhole, before indulging in a tasty seafood platter at the beloved “Da Conch Shack.” Optional snorkelling at Sapodilla is also available for those seeking a little underwater thrill.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Providenciales – Optional Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a peaceful evening on the water with an optional catamaran sunset cruise along Grace Bay. This adults-only experience invites you to toast the Caribbean sunset with Champagne, wine, or rum punch. Relax on deck with delicious local snacks like fresh conch fritters, while the calm ocean breeze and pastel skies create an unforgettable setting. The cruise includes convenient pick-up and drop-off from your hotel, ensuring a smooth and serene night out.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Providenciales – Half-Day Snorkelling & Island Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Today’s adventure takes you on a half-day cruise along the spectacular north shore. Your first stop is the TCI Barrier Reef—the third-largest reef in the world—where you'll snorkel in vibrant waters teeming with marine life. Then, your journey heads to the quieter southern side, where the crew will search for wild conch, giving you a glimpse into traditional island practices. Next, set sail toward one of the uninhabited cays, where you’ll enjoy a freshly prepared lunch and have time to explore the untouched beauty of this secluded paradise. This day offers a perfect blend of exploration, local culture, and relaxation on the open sea.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Providenciales
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, it's time to check out and transfer to the airport. As your Turks and Caicos Tour Package comes to a close, take a moment to reflect on the island's beauty, the warmth of its people, and the memories you’ve made. Depart with a heart full of joy and a camera full of stunning moments.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Trinidad
package_itineraries.description: Your tropical escape begins as you land at Port of Spain, the capital city of Trinidad. A warm welcome awaits you at the airport, followed by a smooth transfer to your hotel. Take the rest of the day to unwind and soak in the island vibe. Overnight stay in Trinidad.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover the City of Port of Spain
package_itineraries.description: Dive into the heart of Trinidad with a guided city tour of Port of Spain. Discover historic architecture, vibrant local markets, and notable attractions such as art galleries, museums, Queen’s Park Savannah, Emperor Valley Zoo, and the Botanical Gardens. Conclude the day with a scenic stop at Lady Young Lookout, offering a sweeping view of the cityscape. Overnight stay in your Trinidad hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Explore Asa Wright Nature Centre
package_itineraries.description: Set off on a nature-filled excursion to the renowned Asa Wright Nature Centre, nestled in the green folds of the Northern Range. After a picturesque drive, join an expert guide for a serene walk through this 200-acre sanctuary. Spot exotic birds like toucans and hummingbirds, admire colorful flora, and take in the tranquil sounds of the forest. Optional: Enjoy a traditional lunch at the Old Plantation House or take a dip at a nearby waterfall before heading back. Return to your hotel for a relaxing night in Trinidad.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Flight to Tobago
package_itineraries.description: This morning, you'll transfer to Piarco Airport for your flight to the island of Tobago. Upon arrival, you’ll be met and escorted to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours—relax by the beach or explore at your own pace. Overnight stay in Tobago.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Full-Day Tobago Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a scenic journey across Tobago, taking in the breathtaking beauty of both the Caribbean and Atlantic coastlines. You'll pass through tropical rainforests, unspoiled beaches, and cascading waterfalls. Highlights include a visit to historical landmarks and a refreshing dip at the Argyle Waterfall. Enjoy lunch at Jemma’s Treehouse—a local favorite offering authentic island cuisine. On days it's closed, a similar local eatery will be provided. Return to your hotel and unwind after a full day of sightseeing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Tobago Rainforest Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Start your day early with a nature-filled adventure along Tobago’s Caribbean coast. Visit local gems like Castara Bay and, when open, a traditional clay oven bakery. Continue on to Englishman’s Bay for postcard-perfect views. Taste seasonal fruits and sample local treats along the way. The highlight of the day is a hike through the Main Ridge Rainforest—the oldest protected reserve in the Western Hemisphere. Keep an eye out for the island’s native wildlife, including the White-tailed Sabrewing hummingbird and the national bird, the Cocrico. After your hike, enjoy lunch in Castara before heading back for an overnight stay at your Tobago hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Farewell from Tobago
package_itineraries.description: On your final day, you’ll be transferred to Scarborough Airport for your return flight, connecting through Trinidad. Depart with unforgettable memories from your Trinidad and Tobago Tour Package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Vancouver International Airport, collect your rental vehicle, and drive to your hotel. In the evening, enjoy the exhilarating Fly Over Canada 4D experience—soar across Canada's diverse landscapes with immersive visuals and special effects. Relax overnight at your Vancouver hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Vancouver Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Today begins with a visit to Vancouver’s top attractions. Cross the iconic Lions Gate Bridge and explore the Capilano Salmon Hatchery before arriving at the Capilano Suspension Bridge Park. Stroll along the thrilling Cliff Walk and immerse yourself in the Treetops Adventure. Continue your day with a scenic ride up Grouse Mountain on the Skyride. Enjoy activities such as the Lumberjack Show, the Peak Chairlift, wildlife encounters, and panoramic views from the Eye of the Wind. In the evening, unwind in downtown Vancouver—shop on Robson Street, visit Stanley Park, or explore the historic Gastown district. Overnight in Vancouver.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Vancouver to Victoria
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal for a 90-minute ferry ride across the Strait of Georgia to Swartz Bay. Visit the world-famous Butchart Gardens, known for its immaculate floral displays. Then, explore Victoria’s Inner Harbour, steeped in British charm. Overnight stay in Victoria.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Victoria to Whistler
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with an included Whale Watching Tour. Spot orcas, seals, and marine birds in their natural habitat. Later, take the ferry from Nanaimo to Horseshoe Bay and enjoy a scenic drive along the Sea-to-Sky Highway to Whistler. Stop at Shannon Falls and soak in views of rugged mountains and glacial fjords. Overnight in Whistler.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Whistler Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Explore Whistler Village and savour a local breakfast. Enjoy shopping, dining, or outdoor cafés before boarding the Peak-2-Peak Gondola—an engineering marvel offering breathtaking views. Optional adventures include ATV tours, bungee jumping, or a paddling trip across Alta Lake and the River of Golden Dreams. Stay overnight in Whistler.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Whistler to Kamloops
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Kamloops, where dramatic desert plateaus meet lush valleys. Enjoy scenic views of Kamloops Lake and the Thompson River. Experience the peaceful rhythm of small-town life and settle in for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Kamloops to Jasper
package_itineraries.description: Travel north along the Thompson River, passing through Yellowhead Pass into Jasper National Park. Admire the alpine lakes, towering peaks, and chance wildlife sightings like elk. End your day in the picturesque mountain town of Jasper. Overnight at a Jasper hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Explore Jasper National Park
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day exploring Jasper's natural beauty. Visit Maligne Canyon and take a boat cruise on Maligne Lake to view Spirit Island. Optional activities include visiting Miette Hot Springs, white water rafting, or the Jasper SkyTram. Overnight stay in Jasper.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Jasper to Lake Louise via Columbia Icefields
package_itineraries.description: Today, journey along the Icefields Parkway—one of the most scenic drives in the world. Stop at the Columbia Icefield Discovery Centre for the Glacier Adventure and Glacier Skywalk. En route to Lake Louise, pass scenic spots like Peyto Lake and Bow Lake. Spend the night at a hotel near the tranquil turquoise waters of Lake Louise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Lake Louise to Banff
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day exploring Lake Louise with optional activities such as hiking to Lake Agnes, kayaking, or visiting the Lake Louise Gondola. Later, head to Banff, a vibrant alpine town. Check into your hotel and enjoy Banff Avenue’s quaint shops and restaurants. Overnight in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Banff Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Explore Banff’s majestic surroundings. Visit Bow Falls, Surprise Corner, Hoodoos, and take a Lake Minnewanka Cruise. Ascend Sulphur Mountain via Banff Gondola for panoramic views. In the afternoon, explore the trails or stroll through town. Overnight in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Banff to Calgary
package_itineraries.description: Drive from Banff to Calgary. Once in the city, check into your hotel and enjoy free time exploring urban attractions or relaxing. Overnight stay in Calgary.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Departure from Calgary
package_itineraries.description: Spend the morning exploring Calgary’s top sites like Heritage Park, Canada Olympic Park, or the Calgary Tower. Return your rental vehicle at Calgary Airport and catch your return flight or continue your journey elsewhere.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Calgary
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Calgary International Airport and head straight to your designated car rental service to pick up your vehicle. Once your vehicle is secured, proceed to your hotel and check in. Spend the remainder of the day at your leisure—explore the city streets, enjoy a relaxed evening, or discover local gems on your own. Overnight stay at a hotel in Calgary.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Journey from Calgary to Banff
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin your scenic drive towards Banff. Upon your arrival, check into your hotel and settle in. Enjoy your evening wandering through the charming mountain town or simply unwind at the hotel. Overnight stay in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Exploring Banff
package_itineraries.description: Today is all about taking in the natural beauty and attractions of Banff. Surrounded by Rundle, Tunnel, Cascade, and Norquay mountains, Banff offers endless scenic spots. Start with a tour that includes Bow Falls, Tunnel Mountain Drive, Surprise Corner, Hoodoos, and the Two Jack Viewpoint. Enjoy a one-hour Lake Minnewanka Cruise (included), where you'll have the chance to spot local wildlife and admire the lush landscapes, including the spectacular Devil’s Gap. Take in panoramic views with a ride on the Banff Gondola (included), lifting you up Sulphur Mountain for a 360-degree view of the Bow Valley. Later, enjoy a walk on one of Banff’s hiking trails or visit local boutiques and cafes in town. Overnight in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Banff to Lake Louise
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before setting off on a stunning drive through Bow Valley to Lake Louise. This famous lake, with its emerald-green waters and dramatic Victoria Glacier backdrop, is one of the most photographed spots in Canada. Check into your hotel and relax for the night in Lake Louise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Lake Louise to Jasper via Icefields Parkway
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast and prepare for one of the most scenic drives in the world—the Icefields Parkway. Travel past rugged mountains, turquoise lakes, and tumbling waterfalls. Stop at the Columbia Icefield Discovery Centre, where you’ll board the Ice Explorer for a once-in-a-lifetime journey onto the Athabasca Glacier. Afterward, continue to the Glacier Skywalk (included), a glass-floored platform offering breathtaking views of the Sunwapta Valley and surrounding peaks. Along the way to Jasper, take in the beauty of Bow Lake, Peyto Lake, and Crowfoot Glacier. Overnight stay in Jasper.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Discover Jasper
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day soaking in the wild charm of Jasper National Park. Discover the townsite and visit the Athabasca Viewpoint, Maligne Canyon, and Maligne Lake. As you walk beside the canyon’s towering limestone walls, you’ll get a glimpse of its hidden water networks. Later, enjoy a relaxing cruise on Maligne Lake (included). Optional activities include visiting Miette Hot Springs, trying white water rafting, riding the Jasper Skytram, or enjoying night sky stargazing. Overnight in Jasper.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Jasper to Edmonton – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive towards Edmonton. Upon arrival, return your rental vehicle at the designated location. Proceed to the airport for your return flight home or your next exciting destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to Vancouver! Upon your arrival at Vancouver International Airport, a transfer will take you to your centrally located hotel. The rest of the day is free for you to relax or explore the vibrant downtown area at your leisure. Framed by mountain peaks and ocean waters, Vancouver is known for its natural beauty, diverse culture, and laid-back lifestyle. Whether you choose to stroll along the waterfront, explore local boutiques, or sample global cuisine, your adventure begins here. Overnight stay at your hotel in Vancouver.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Vancouver City Highlights & Capilano Suspension Bridge
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a scenic tour showcasing Vancouver's top attractions. Explore historic Gastown and Chinatown, see the sails of Canada Place, shop on Robson Street, and take in the serene beauty of Stanley Park with its totem poles and coastal paths. Later, head across the Lions Gate Bridge to Capilano Suspension Bridge Park. Here, you'll walk the legendary bridge, experience the Treetops Adventure, and feel the thrill of the Cliffwalk. In the evening, unwind with a gourmet dinner at one of Vancouver’s top restaurants. Return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leisure Day in Vancouver (Optional Victoria Day Tour)
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast and a full day to explore Vancouver at your own pace. Visit museums, stroll through art galleries, or relax at English Bay. For those seeking more, opt for an optional day tour to the charming city of Victoria. Highlights include the famous Butchart Gardens, Victoria Harbour, and the Royal BC Museum. After a full day of exploration, return to your hotel in Vancouver for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Travel from Vancouver to Whistler
package_itineraries.description: This morning, depart on a scenic coach journey to Whistler, a world-famous alpine resort town. Upon arrival and check-in at your hotel, enjoy the breathtaking Peak 2 Peak Gondola Experience, offering panoramic views of Whistler Village, glaciers, lakes, and surrounding mountain ranges. Soaring between Whistler and Blackcomb Mountains, this is the world’s longest and highest lift of its kind. After this unforgettable aerial journey, unwind at your hotel and enjoy a peaceful evening in Whistler.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Adventure Day in Whistler
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast, followed by a full day of leisure or adventure in Whistler. You may choose to explore the village on foot or opt for thrilling activities like a guided Snowmobile Tour across the powdery backcountry. For adrenaline seekers, the Winter Ziplining experience offers an exhilarating ride through snowy treetops. After a day of discovery and fun, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Whistler to Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy one last breakfast in Whistler before checking out. You’ll be transferred to Vancouver Airport for your flight to your next destination, bringing your Vancouver Tour Package to a memorable close.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Calgary – Transfer to Banff
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Calgary International Airport, where your journey begins with a smooth transfer to the charming town of Banff. After checking into your hotel, the rest of the day is yours to relax or explore the vibrant Banff Avenue—filled with shops, local cafes, and mountain-town charm. Enjoy an overnight stay in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Banff to Lake Louise – Mountain Majesty Awaits
package_itineraries.description: After a delicious breakfast, check out and leave your luggage in the hotel’s lobby before heading out on a guided tour of Banff’s scenic highlights. Surrounded by towering mountain ranges including Rundle, Tunnel, and Norquay, you’ll visit landmarks such as Bow Falls, Surprise Corner, the Hoodoos, and Tunnel Mountain Drive. Stop by Lake Minnewanka, where you may choose an optional boat cruise offering a peaceful view of the lake, the surrounding wildlife, and the geological marvel of Devil’s Gap. Next, ride the Banff Gondola to the top of Sulphur Mountain, where panoramic views of the Bow Valley await. In the afternoon, travel to Lake Louise—famed for its vivid turquoise waters, dramatic glaciers, and the iconic lakeside chateau. Settle in for an overnight stay at your Lake Louise hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Lake Louise – Icefields Parkway Experience
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before setting off on a drive along the spectacular Icefields Parkway, often described as one of the most beautiful road trips in the world. Along the route, marvel at glacial valleys, alpine lakes, and cascading waterfalls. Your main stop will be the Columbia Icefields Discovery Centre, where you'll board an Ice Explorer to traverse the surface of the Athabasca Glacier—an unforgettable experience. Then, continue to the Glacier Skywalk, a glass-floored observation deck with dramatic views over Sunwapta Valley. As the tour continues, take in other natural landmarks such as Crowfoot Glacier, Peyto Lake, and Bow Lake. The evening is free to enjoy the peaceful ambiance of Lake Louise. Whether you choose to go kayaking, hike to Lake Agnes, or ride the Lake Louise Gondola, the natural beauty will leave you mesmerized. Spend another night at your Lake Louise hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Return to Calgary – Departure
package_itineraries.description: Savor your final breakfast in the Rockies before checking out. You'll be transferred to Calgary International Airport for your onward journey, bringing your unforgettable Rockies Sampler Tour Package to a close.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Vancouver and get transferred to your hotel. Later in the afternoon, experience the thrill of FlyOver Canada, a state-of-the-art 4D flight simulation. This immersive ride takes you on a breathtaking aerial journey across Canada, complete with motion seats and atmospheric effects like wind, mist, and scents. Before boarding, enjoy a visually engaging pre-show called "Uplift," setting the tone for your airborne adventure. After this unforgettable experience, return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Victoria & Butchart Gardens Day Trip
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day guided tour to Victoria and Butchart Gardens. Begin your journey with a scenic 90-minute ferry ride across the Strait of Georgia and through the picturesque Gulf Islands. Once in Victoria, visit the world-renowned Butchart Gardens, an expansive 55-acre botanical paradise. Wander through beautifully landscaped gardens and enjoy the floral artistry. After a day filled with natural beauty and historical charm, return to Vancouver for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Whistler & Shannon Falls Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Today’s adventure takes you north on the Sea to Sky Highway to Whistler. After breakfast, set off on a scenic drive along the coast, stopping at Shannon Falls and the Squamish Adventure Centre. As you approach Whistler Village, the towering peaks of Whistler and Blackcomb Mountains provide a majestic backdrop. Enjoy free time in the alpine village, with the option to ride the famous Peak 2 Peak Gondola for panoramic views. After a full day of exploration, return to Vancouver and relax at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Vancouver City Highlights & Capilano Park
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast before diving into a full-day city tour. Discover Vancouver’s vibrant neighborhoods including Gastown, Chinatown, and the cultural haven of Granville Island. Take in the beauty of Stanley Park, drive past Robson Street and Canada Place, and enjoy the scenic Lions Gate Bridge. The tour also includes admission to Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, where you’ll walk the thrilling Cliffwalk and sway high above the forest on the Treetops Adventure. After a memorable day, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, it’s time to check out. You’ll be transferred to Vancouver International Airport for your onward journey, marking the end of your delightful Vancouver Tour Package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Toronto – Transfer to Niagara Falls
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing in Toronto, you’ll be greeted and transferred to the world-famous Niagara Falls. Check in at your hotel and spend your evening admiring the dazzling illumination of the falls — a truly enchanting sight. Overnight stay at your hotel in Niagara Falls.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Niagara Falls – Travel to Toronto
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off on a self-guided adventure with your included Niagara Adventure Pass, giving you access to top attractions like the Hornblower Cruise – Voyage to the Falls, Journey Behind the Falls, Niagara’s Fury, and the White-Water Walk. Later in the day, return to Toronto and check in at your hotel. Enjoy the rest of your evening exploring Canada’s vibrant urban centre. Overnight stay in Toronto.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Toronto City Exploration – Hop On/Hop Off Tour
package_itineraries.description: Kick-start your morning with breakfast, followed by a full-day Hop On/Hop Off tour of Toronto. Visit key landmarks such as the Eaton Centre, City Halls, Casa Loma, Yorkville, and the University of Toronto. Glide past the CN Tower, Rogers Centre, and enjoy the scenic Harbourfront. Overnight at your hotel in Toronto.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Toronto to Ottawa – Scenic VIA Rail Journey
package_itineraries.description: Today, check out after breakfast and head to Union Station for your train journey to Ottawa via VIA Rail. Enjoy the charming views of lakeside towns, historic Kingston, and the stunning Thousand Islands along the way. Upon arrival in Ottawa, transfer independently to your hotel. The evening is free for you to explore at your own pace. Overnight in Ottawa.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Ottawa Sightseeing – Travel to Montreal by Train
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast before setting out on a guided tour of Ottawa. Visit Parliament Hill, the Canadian Mint, National Gallery, Museum of Civilization, and more. Later, board your VIA Rail train to Montreal. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the evening at leisure. Overnight in Montreal.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Montreal City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a captivating sightseeing tour of Montreal. Highlights include a photo stop at Notre Dame Basilica (entry not included), exploring Old Montreal, the residential and financial districts, a panoramic view from Mont Royal, and an external view of the Olympic Complex. Overnight stay in Montreal.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Full-Day Quebec City & Montmorency Falls Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day trip to Quebec City, exploring its rich history and vibrant charm. Discover landmarks such as Upper and Lower Town, Parliament Buildings, Plains of Abraham, Chateau Frontenac, and Place d’Armes. A visit to Montmorency Falls — taller than Niagara — is also included, along with a scenic cruise. Return and stay overnight in Montreal.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure from Montreal
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast and spend your morning at leisure. In the afternoon, check out and transfer to Montreal Airport or VIA Rail Station for your onward journey or flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Vancouver International Airport, you will be greeted and transferred to your hotel. Later, enjoy a mesmerizing experience at FlyOver Canada, a 4D virtual flight ride that lifts you above Canada's iconic landscapes. With motion seats and a wraparound screen, you'll feel like you’re soaring over mountains, valleys, and coastlines. Spend the night in the heart of Vancouver.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Vancouver City & Capilano Suspension Bridge
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, dive into the city with a guided Vancouver tour. You’ll discover famous spots like Canada Place, Robson Street, English Bay, Stanley Park, Granville Island, Gastown, and Chinatown. Later, cross the Lions Gate Bridge to visit the Capilano Salmon Hatchery and the legendary Capilano Suspension Bridge. Test your courage on the thrilling Cliffwalk and Treetops Adventure trails. End the day with a comfortable overnight stay in Vancouver.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Vancouver to Kamloops – All Aboard the Rocky Mountaineer
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with breakfast, then check out and head to the train station. Board the Rocky Mountaineer Holiday Package train and journey toward Kamloops. This route winds through dramatic landscapes including Hell’s Gate in Fraser Canyon, sheer cliffs, and scenic riversides. Watch the terrain transform as you travel in luxury and comfort. Overnight stay in Kamloops.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kamloops to Jasper – Mountain Majesty
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast before continuing your railway journey into the majestic Canadian Rockies. This leg of the trip includes spectacular views of Mount Robson, the highest peak in the range, and the cascading Pyramid Falls. Ascend the Yellowhead Pass and glide into Jasper National Park. Upon arrival in Jasper, transfer to your hotel for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Discover Jasper’s Natural Wonders
package_itineraries.description: Today’s adventure begins with the Explore Jasper Tour. Visit landmarks such as Athabasca Viewpoint, Maligne Canyon, Jasper town-site, and the serene Maligne Lake. At Maligne Canyon, walk beside deep rock formations and discover the area’s unique underground water system. The afternoon is free to explore activities like white-water rafting, Jasper SkyTram, stargazing, or a lake cruise. Return to your Jasper hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Journey to Banff via Columbia Icefields
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and travel along the world-renowned Icefields Parkway, known for its striking scenery. Stop at the Columbia Icefields Discovery Centre to hop aboard the Ice Explorer and ride across the Athabasca Glacier. Next, experience the Glacier Skywalk—a glass platform that hovers above the Sunwapta Valley. En route to Banff, enjoy views of Peyto Lake, Bow Lake, and the Crowfoot Glacier. Overnight stay in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Banff Exploration & Departure to Calgary
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with breakfast and check out. Store your bags at the hotel while you explore Banff, a picturesque alpine town surrounded by the Rockies. Highlights include Bow Falls, Tunnel Mountain Drive, Hoodoos, Surprise Corner, and Two Jack Viewpoint. At Lake Minnewanka, opt for a relaxing boat cruise to see wildlife and the dramatic Devil’s Gap. For a final treat, ascend Sulphur Mountain via the Banff Gondola. From the summit, take in breathtaking 360-degree views over Bow Valley. Later, you'll be transferred to Calgary Airport for your flight home or onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Toronto Arrival & City Discovery
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Toronto Airport, you’ll be warmly welcomed by our local representatives and guided to your hotel. Later, set out to uncover the highlights of this vibrant city. Visit the famed Hockey Hall of Fame and get a glimpse of the prestigious Stanley Cup. Stop by the impressive Rogers Centre, known for its iconic architecture and events. The day culminates with a thrilling elevator ride up the CN Tower to its glass-floored outdoor observation deck at 1,122 feet—offering a mesmerizing panoramic view of Toronto’s skyline.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kingston Cruise & Ottawa Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to the historic city of Kingston. Here, enjoy a relaxing and scenic cruise through the breathtaking 1000 Islands—an unforgettable experience. Continue to Ottawa, Canada’s capital, where you'll explore Parliament Hill, a symbol of national heritage. Discover the beautiful Rideau Canal, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and other notable landmarks in the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Montreal – The Cultural Gem
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, board a comfortable coach to Montreal, a city known for its European flair. Visit the magnificent Notre Dame Basilica, celebrated for its elaborate interior, religious artwork, and detailed carvings. Then, ascend Mont Royal for sweeping views of Montreal’s skyline—an ideal photo opportunity to capture your memories.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Quebec City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with breakfast before diving into the charms of Quebec City. Led by an expert guide, you’ll tour North America's only fortified city. Highlights include the Parliament Buildings, Upper and Lower Towns, the historic Plains of Abraham, Chateau Frontenac, the Citadel, Place d’Armes, and the National Assembly of Quebec—each echoing the city’s storied past.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: From Quebec to Calgary
package_itineraries.description: After a fulfilling breakfast, proceed to the airport for your flight to Calgary. Upon arrival, our team will be ready to assist you. Explore the city’s major highlights, including Heritage Park and the iconic Olympic Park. Afterwards, you'll journey to Banff—a picturesque town nestled in the Canadian Rockies, known for its charming streets and alpine beauty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Icefield Parkway & Glacier Encounter
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast and prepare for an unforgettable drive along the legendary Icefield Parkway. This scenic route treats you to dramatic mountain views, crystal-clear lakes, and towering glaciers. Step onto the ancient ice at the Athabasca Glacier and embark on a Glacier Adventure ride. A stop at the stunning Johnston Canyon caps off a thrilling day of nature and exploration.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Rocky Mountains to Kelowna
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a peaceful breakfast before continuing your journey to Kelowna. En route, feast your eyes on the majestic Canadian Rockies. Upon arrival, you’ll take part in a brief orientation tour to discover the serene beauty and lakeside charm of Kelowna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: From Kelowna to Vancouver via Whistler
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart by luxury coach towards the alpine village of Whistler. Upon reaching, you’ll ride the record-breaking Peak 2 Peak Gondola that connects Whistler and Blackcomb Mountains. As you glide between peaks, soak in the breathtaking mountain and valley views that make this one of Canada’s most iconic experiences.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Immersive Vancouver City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today begins with breakfast and a guided exploration of Vancouver’s top attractions. Visit the lush Stanley Park and cross the thrilling Capilano Suspension Bridge. See Prospect Point, English Bay, and the symbolic West Coast Native Totem Poles. Continue to Gastown, the city’s historic heart, filled with Victorian charm and cobblestone streets, ending with more scenic highlights of Vancouver’s urban and natural beauty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure from Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Wrap up your memorable journey with a final breakfast. Then, transfer to the airport for your flight home, taking with you unforgettable moments from your Quebec Tour Package.

package_itineraries.description: Upon landing in Toronto, you’ll be greeted and transferred to the world-famous Niagara Falls. Check in at your hotel and spend your evening admiring the dazzling illumination of the falls — a truly enchanting sight. Overnight stay at your hotel in Niagara Falls.

Later in the day, return to Toronto and check in at your hotel. Enjoy the rest of your evening exploring Canada’s vibrant urban centre. Overnight stay in Toronto.

package_itineraries.description: Kick-start your morning with breakfast, followed by a full-day Hop On/Hop Off tour of Toronto. Visit key landmarks such as the Eaton Centre, City Halls, Casa Loma, Yorkville, and the University of Toronto. Glide past the CN Tower, Rogers Centre, and enjoy the scenic Harbourfront. Enjoy the charming views of lakeside towns, historic Kingston, and the stunning Thousand Islands along the way. Upon arrival in Ottawa, transfer independently to your hotel. The evening is free for you to explore at your own pace. Overnight in Ottawa.

Later, board your VIA Rail train to Montreal. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the evening at leisure. Overnight in Montreal.

package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a captivating sightseeing tour of Montreal. Highlights include a photo stop at Notre Dame Basilica (entry not included), exploring Old Montreal, the residential and financial districts, a panoramic view from Mont Royal, and an external view of the Olympic Complex. Overnight stay in Montreal.

package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day trip to Quebec City, exploring its rich history and vibrant charm. Discover landmarks such as Upper and Lower Town, Parliament Buildings, Plains of Abraham, Chateau Frontenac, and Place d’Armes. A visit to Montmorency Falls — taller than Niagara — is also included, along with a scenic cruise. Return and stay overnight in Montreal.

package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast and spend your morning at leisure. In the afternoon, check out and transfer to Montreal Airport or VIA Rail Station for your onward journey or flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in New York
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to New York City, often called the "Big Apple" or "The City That Never Sleeps." This global metropolis is known for its towering skyscrapers, vibrant culture, and unmatched energy. As the largest and most dynamic city in the USA, New York has long been a symbol of ambition and diversity. Upon your arrival, our representative will greet you and assist with your hotel transfer. Settle into your accommodation in the heart of the city and get ready for the adventure ahead.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: New York City Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast before diving into the highlights of New York. Begin with a visit to the Statue of Liberty via a scenic ferry ride to Liberty Island, followed by breathtaking panoramic views from the One World Observatory. Later, enjoy a guided city tour that covers the Rockefeller Center, Wall Street, Ground Zero, Central Park, and the bustling Times Square. You'll also pass iconic locations such as the United Nations Headquarters and Trump Tower. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: New York to Washington D.C.
package_itineraries.description: Today, travel to the nation’s capital, Washington, D.C. This historic city is home to the U.S. government and an abundance of monuments and museums. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and begin exploring major landmarks including the White House, Capitol Building, Lincoln Memorial, Smithsonian Museums, Supreme Court, Pentagon, Union Station, and the World War II Memorial. After a cultural and historical deep dive, spend the night at your Washington hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Washington – Buffalo – Niagara Falls
package_itineraries.description: Depart for Buffalo by flight or road to reach the majestic Niagara Falls. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel near the falls and unwind. Get ready for an unforgettable experience the next day.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Niagara Falls – USA Side Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on the thrilling “Maid of the Mist” boat ride (seasonal), bringing you close to both the American and Horseshoe Falls. Feel the mist and power of the cascading water in a one-of-a-kind adventure. Later, return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Niagara to Atlanta
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Atlanta, Georgia – the cultural and economic center of the American South. Known as the "New Capital of the South," Atlanta is full of charm, history, and entertainment. Spend your evening exploring shopping malls or enjoy a walk through the city’s lively streets. Overnight stay in Atlanta.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Atlanta City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today’s itinerary includes a guided city tour that showcases Atlanta’s highlights. Visit the World of Coca-Cola, go behind the scenes at the CNN News Studio, and be amazed at the Georgia Aquarium – the largest in the world. Overnight in Atlanta.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Atlanta to Orlando
package_itineraries.description: Take a flight to Orlando, Florida’s entertainment capital and home to world-famous theme parks. After hotel check-in, you can relax or explore nearby attractions. Overnight in Orlando.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Magic Kingdom – Walt Disney World
package_itineraries.description: Get ready to visit the iconic Magic Kingdom. Step into a world of fantasy and fun with seven themed lands, thrilling rides, and beloved Disney characters. From Main Street U.S.A. to Cinderella’s Castle, it’s a day packed with magic. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Epcot Center Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Head to Epcot, where technology meets world culture. Explore Future World and the World Showcase featuring 11 pavilions representing different nations. Experience global cuisine, interactive exhibits, and more. Overnight in Orlando.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Sea World Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Today’s journey takes you to Sea World – the world’s premier marine park. Dive into exciting shows, animal encounters, and thrilling rides like Journey to Atlantis and Wild Arctic. After a full day of fun, return to your Orlando hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Orlando to Chicago
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Chicago, the "Windy City," a vibrant metropolis on Lake Michigan known for its skyline, deep-dish pizza, and arts scene. After airport transfer, check in to your hotel and relax. Overnight stay in Chicago.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Chicago City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a guided tour of Chicago’s top landmarks including the Sears Tower, Millennium Park, Navy Pier, Magnificent Mile, and the historic Art Institute. Explore architectural marvels and the city’s bustling downtown. Overnight in Chicago.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Chicago to Las Vegas
package_itineraries.description: Catch a flight to Las Vegas – the ultimate entertainment hub in the Nevada desert. After settling into your hotel, enjoy an evening tour to see the Dancing Fountains of Bellagio, Treasure Island Pirate Show, Fremont Street light show, and more. Overnight in Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 15: Grand Canyon (Optional Tour)
package_itineraries.description: Today is free for leisure or an optional tour to the Grand Canyon – one of the world’s seven natural wonders. Choose a bus or helicopter tour, and don’t miss the thrilling Skywalk experience. In the evening, consider a helicopter night flight over the Strip or attend a live Vegas show. Overnight in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 16: Las Vegas to Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Los Angeles, California – the glamorous city of movies and stars. Upon arrival, go on a city tour covering Hollywood, Beverly Hills, Sunset Strip, Rodeo Drive, Grauman's Chinese Theatre, and more. Overnight in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 17: Universal Studios Hollywood
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Universal Studios, home to thrilling rides and behind-the-scenes glimpses of your favorite movies and shows. Experience themed attractions, live entertainment, and possibly a celebrity sighting. Return to your hotel in Los Angeles for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 18: Los Angeles to San Francisco
package_itineraries.description: Take a flight to San Francisco, a charming city known for its iconic Golden Gate Bridge, steep streets, and diverse culture. Your city tour includes Pier 39, Lombard Street, Nob Hill, Civic Center, Union Square, and the Palace of Fine Arts. Overnight in San Francisco.

package_itineraries.title: Day 19: San Francisco Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today, continue exploring San Francisco with visits to Twin Peaks, the Golden Gate Bridge, Cable Car rides, Fisherman’s Wharf, and more. Enjoy views of the Bay and the city's unique architecture. Spend your final night in this beautiful city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 20: Departure from San Francisco
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy some free time before your transfer to the airport. Your USA holiday package comes to an end with unforgettable memories across America’s top cities.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Buenos Aires
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Buenos Aires via Ezeiza International Airport, where you’ll be warmly received and transferred to your hotel. The city, stretching gracefully along the Rio de la Plata, offers a blend of modern vibrancy and deep-rooted tradition. Known as the cultural heart of Argentina, Buenos Aires reflects European charm with its grand architecture and elegant boulevards. The locals, or Porteños, take great pride in their heritage, which blends sophistication and passion—especially evident in the birthplace of tango. Spend the rest of your day at leisure, soaking in the city’s atmosphere. Overnight stay in Buenos Aires.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: City Tour & Tango Experience in Buenos Aires
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with breakfast, followed by a guided city tour showcasing the unique charm and architectural diversity of Buenos Aires. Discover a mix of historic and contemporary styles as you visit landmarks like Plaza de Mayo, the National Congress, Avenida de Mayo, Recoleta Cemetery, Caminito in La Boca, Puerto Madero, and the iconic El Ateneo bookstore. In the evening, prepare for a magical cultural experience with a Tango Show & Dinner at the renowned Tango Porteño. Witness the elegance of this traditional dance in an extravagant setting, paired with fine Argentine cuisine. Return to your hotel for a restful night in Buenos Aires.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Flight to El Calafate – Gateway to Patagonia
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to the airport for your flight to El Calafate, a picturesque town on the shores of Lake Argentino. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy the tranquil surroundings. El Calafate is famed for its colorful seasonal changes and the mythic calafate berry—legend has it that those who eat the berry will return to Patagonia. The rest of your day is at leisure to explore the town or relax. Overnight in El Calafate.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Full-Day Tour to Perito Moreno Glacier
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast and prepare for a full-day adventure to the legendary Perito Moreno Glacier in Los Glaciares National Park. Travel along the scenic route tracing the southern shore of Lake Argentino until you reach the park entrance. Walk along panoramic trails offering awe-inspiring views of the 30,000-year-old glacier, which spans 192 square kilometers and rises nearly 80 meters high. Enhance your experience with a Nautical Safari on Rico Lake. Departing from Bajo de las Sombras Port, this boat tour takes you close to the towering ice wall where you can watch chunks of glacier break off and crash into the water below. After a thrilling day, return to your hotel in El Calafate for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Journey to Ushuaia – The Southernmost City
package_itineraries.description: This morning, fly to Ushuaia, the southernmost city in the world, located on Isla Grande de Tierra del Fuego. Framed by mountains and bordered by the Beagle Channel, Ushuaia is a stunning destination offering dramatic landscapes and rich heritage. Enjoy a relaxed evening in the city and check in to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Tierra del Fuego Park & Beagle Channel Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a Half-Day Tour of Tierra del Fuego National Park, which includes a scenic ride on the famous End of the World Train. Located just 12 km from Ushuaia, this national park is the only one in Argentina with an oceanfront. Explore its pristine forests, tranquil rivers, and native flora, including orchids, lengas, and calafates. In the afternoon, embark on a catamaran cruise through the Beagle Channel to Seals Island. This waterway connects the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans and is home to a wealth of marine wildlife including sea lions and seabirds. After the cruise, return to Ushuaia for a peaceful overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Fly to Iguazu Falls
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Iguazu. Upon arrival, meet your local guide and proceed to your hotel. Iguazu Falls straddles the border between Argentina and Brazil and is one of the world’s most stunning natural wonders. The name “Iguazu” comes from the Guarani word meaning "Big Waters," a fitting description for these majestic cascades. Overnight stay in Iguazu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Explore Argentine Side of Iguazu Falls
package_itineraries.description: Today’s excursion takes you to the Argentine side of Iguazu Falls. Begin at the Visitor Center and choose between a short train ride or a scenic walk along the Green Trail. Explore the Upper Circuit, where walkways suspended above the jungle offer panoramic views of the waterfalls, followed by the Lower Circuit, which provides closer access and unique vantage points. End the tour with a visit to the Devil’s Throat—the most powerful and dramatic section of the falls. Reach it via a train ride followed by a 1.2 km catwalk offering unforgettable views. After a full day immersed in natural beauty, return to your hotel in Iguazu for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Brazilian Falls & Departure
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a visit to the Brazilian side of Iguazu Falls. Board a panoramic bus at the entrance and enjoy sweeping views of the Argentine Falls before continuing on foot along a 950-meter trail leading to the stunning Floriano Falls. An optional elevator ride offers a higher viewpoint of the Iguazu River and Devil’s Throat Canyon. After your visit, return by bus to the entrance and transfer to the airport for your return flight to Buenos Aires. Upon arrival, connect to your international flight home, bringing your unforgettable Argentina tour package to a close—filled with diverse landscapes, vibrant cities, and memories to last a lifetime.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in San Juan
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to Puerto Rico, a Caribbean treasure officially known as the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico. Located between the Dominican Republic and the Virgin Islands, this vibrant island offers a mix of natural beauty and colonial charm. Upon arrival, our team will transfer you to your hotel in San Juan. After check-in, enjoy the rest of your day at leisure. Spend the night at your hotel in San Juan.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: San Juan City Tour & Bacardi Distillery
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin your day with a visit to the world-renowned Bacardi Distillery, the largest rum distillery in the world. Learn about the history of the brand and enjoy a tasting session. Next, explore the colorful streets of Old San Juan, known for its Spanish colonial architecture, cobblestone lanes, and historical landmarks. Recognized as a National Historic Preservation site, Old San Juan is a must-see highlight of your Puerto Rico tour package. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: San Juan – Free Day for Leisure
package_itineraries.description: Today is yours to enjoy however you wish. Relax on one of San Juan’s stunning beaches, take a stroll through local markets, or indulge in Puerto Rican cuisine at a seaside café. This is the perfect time to explore the island at your own pace. Overnight stay at your hotel in San Juan. (Breakfast included)

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: San Juan to Vieques Island
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast, then check out and travel to Fajardo for your ferry to the tranquil island of Vieques. Please note that ferry tickets must be purchased by the traveler directly, as they cannot be reserved by third parties. Upon arrival at Vieques Island, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. Enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. Spend the night at your hotel on Vieques Island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Leisure Day on Vieques Island
package_itineraries.description: Wake up in paradise and enjoy a leisurely breakfast. Today is free for you to explore the natural beauty of Vieques. You may choose to relax on the island’s serene beaches, take a guided tour of the famous Bioluminescent Bay, or simply enjoy the calm surroundings. Overnight stay at your hotel on Vieques Island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Vieques Island to San Juan
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before checking out of your hotel. Today marks the end of your Puerto Rico tour package. Transfer back to San Juan to catch your flight home or continue your onward journey with unforgettable memories of your Caribbean escape.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Montego Bay
package_itineraries.description: Touch down in Montego Bay, where the laid-back rhythm of reggae meets sun-drenched shores. From vibrant street scenes to golden beaches, your Jamaican escape begins in style. On arrival, our local team will assist with your hotel transfer. Spend the evening soaking in the tropical ambiance and enjoy your first night in Montego Bay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Montego Bay – North Coast & Dunn’s River Falls
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a scenic journey along Jamaica’s northern coastline. Stop by Columbus Park, a historical open-air museum, and take time to shop for local crafts in Ocho Rios. Along the way, pass the fishing town of Falmouth and visit Discovery Bay, the historic landing site of Columbus in 1494. The highlight of the day is a visit to Dunn’s River Falls, where you’ll have the thrilling chance to climb the 600-foot limestone waterfall surrounded by lush rainforest. Enjoy the cascading waters and the excitement of this natural wonder before returning to Montego Bay for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Montego Bay to Negril
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before heading west to Negril, famous for its powdery beaches and laid-back vibe. The day is yours to relax—lounge on Seven Mile Beach, enjoy a cocktail, or take a dip in the warm Caribbean waters. Check into your beachside hotel and enjoy a peaceful evening in Negril.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Negril – YS Falls Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Today’s adventure takes you to the serene beauty of YS Falls, one of Jamaica’s most picturesque natural attractions. Start with a scenic jitney ride through the countryside, where lush tropical landscapes unfold before your eyes. At YS Falls, explore seven cascading waterfalls surrounded by gardens and jungle. Walk the eco-friendly paths, swim in the cool natural pools, or simply enjoy the sights and sounds of nature. After your refreshing visit, return to Negril for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Negril – Appleton Estate Rum Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today, embark on a cultural and culinary journey to the famous Appleton Estate, nestled in Jamaica’s scenic Nassau Valley. Be welcomed with a signature rum punch before touring the historic distillery. Witness traditional cane-crushing techniques and visit the Ageing House, where world-renowned rums mature. Sample fresh cane juice and rich molasses, then enjoy an authentic Jamaican lunch. Finish the day with a rum tasting session at the Appleton lounge. After a flavorful day, return to Negril for your final night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Negril
package_itineraries.description: Your Jamaica tour package ends today. After breakfast, check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport for your onward journey. Leave with warm island memories and a taste of Jamaica’s vibrant culture.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Calgary
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Calgary International Airport and head straight to your designated car rental service to pick up your vehicle. Once your vehicle is secured, proceed to your hotel and check in. Spend the remainder of the day at your leisure—explore the city streets, enjoy a relaxed evening, or discover local gems on your own. Overnight stay at a hotel in Calgary.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Journey from Calgary to Banff
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin your scenic drive towards Banff. Upon your arrival, check into your hotel and settle in. Enjoy your evening wandering through the charming mountain town or simply unwind at the hotel. Overnight stay in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Exploring Banff
package_itineraries.description: Today is all about taking in the natural beauty and attractions of Banff. Surrounded by Rundle, Tunnel, Cascade, and Norquay mountains, Banff offers endless scenic spots. Start with a tour that includes Bow Falls, Tunnel Mountain Drive, Surprise Corner, Hoodoos, and the Two Jack Viewpoint. Enjoy a one-hour Lake Minnewanka Cruise (included), where you'll have the chance to spot local wildlife and admire the lush landscapes, including the spectacular Devil’s Gap. Take in panoramic views with a ride on the Banff Gondola (included), lifting you up Sulphur Mountain for a 360-degree view of the Bow Valley. Later, enjoy a walk on one of Banff’s hiking trails or visit local boutiques and cafes in town. Overnight in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Banff to Lake Louise
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before setting off on a stunning drive through Bow Valley to Lake Louise. This famous lake, with its emerald-green waters and dramatic Victoria Glacier backdrop, is one of the most photographed spots in Canada. Check into your hotel and relax for the night in Lake Louise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Lake Louise to Jasper via Icefields Parkway
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast and prepare for one of the most scenic drives in the world—the Icefields Parkway. Travel past rugged mountains, turquoise lakes, and tumbling waterfalls. Stop at the Columbia Icefield Discovery Centre, where you’ll board the Ice Explorer for a once-in-a-lifetime journey onto the Athabasca Glacier. Afterward, continue to the Glacier Skywalk (included), a glass-floored platform offering breathtaking views of the Sunwapta Valley and surrounding peaks. Along the way to Jasper, take in the beauty of Bow Lake, Peyto Lake, and Crowfoot Glacier. Overnight stay in Jasper.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Discover Jasper
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day soaking in the wild charm of Jasper National Park. Discover the townsite and visit the Athabasca Viewpoint, Maligne Canyon, and Maligne Lake. As you walk beside the canyon’s towering limestone walls, you’ll get a glimpse of its hidden water networks. Later, enjoy a relaxing cruise on Maligne Lake (included). Optional activities include visiting Miette Hot Springs, trying white water rafting, riding the Jasper Skytram, or enjoying night sky stargazing. Overnight in Jasper.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Jasper to Edmonton – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive towards Edmonton. Upon arrival, return your rental vehicle at the designated location. Proceed to the airport for your return flight home or your next exciting destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Anchorage
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Anchorage Airport, you'll be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. Anchorage, Alaska’s largest city, is a hub of urban comforts nestled in the vast wilderness. After check-in, the rest of the day is yours to relax or explore the surroundings at leisure. Enjoy your first overnight stay in Anchorage.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Anchorage to Talkeetna – Rail Journey & Jet Boat Safari
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed to the Anchorage Railway Station to board the Alaska Rail Road bound for Talkeetna. This scenic train ride offers dramatic views of alpine landscapes, winding rivers, and—on clear days—the towering Mt. Denali (formerly Mount McKinley). Wildlife sightings are common, so keep your camera ready. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel in Talkeetna. In the afternoon, set out on the exciting Talkeetna Wilderness Jet Boat Safari. Travel deep into the river systems as you spot bald eagles, beavers, moose, and perhaps even bears in their natural habitat. Return for an overnight stay in Talkeetna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Talkeetna to Denali – Scenic Rail to the Great North
package_itineraries.description: This morning, check out and head to Talkeetna Railway Station to continue your journey aboard the Alaska Rail Road toward Denali. As you travel through the heart of Alaska, enjoy stunning views of glacial valleys and cross Broad Pass—the highest point of the Alaska Railroad. Upon arrival in Denali, transfer to your hotel. In the evening, you may choose to add an optional glacier flightseeing tour or a glacier landing for an unforgettable aerial perspective of the Alaska Range. Spend the night at your hotel in Denali.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Denali National Park – Tundra Wilderness Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast, followed by a guided Tundra Wilderness Tour into Denali National Park. This immersive 53-mile narrated journey offers extraordinary opportunities to witness Alaska’s famed wildlife, such as moose, Dall sheep, caribou, wolves, and grizzly bears. The tour also provides remarkable views of Mt. Denali, weather permitting, and your naturalist guide will share insights into the region’s ecology, geology, and native history. After your adventure, return to the hotel for a well-deserved rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Denali to Fairbanks – River Canyon Views & Rail Ride
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head to Denali Railway Station for your final scenic train ride aboard the Alaska Rail Road to Fairbanks. Journey past the Nenana River Canyon, popular for its rafting thrills, and cross the impressive single-span bridge over the Tanana River. On arrival in Fairbanks—often called the “Golden Heart City”—transfer to your hotel. The evening is free for you to enjoy local dining or perhaps witness the aurora borealis if conditions are favorable. Overnight in Fairbanks.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Fairbanks Exploration & Departure
package_itineraries.description: This morning, dive into Alaska’s gold rush heritage with the Gold Dredge Tour. Begin with a ride on the Tanana Valley Railroad, where live narration guides you through gold-mining history and past the Trans-Alaska Pipeline. At the dredge site, learn how massive gold machines once operated and try your luck at gold panning with your own bag of pay dirt—keep what you find! Later in the afternoon, check out from your hotel and transfer to Fairbanks Airport for your onward flight. Your McKinley Holiday Package ends here, but the memories of Alaska’s untamed beauty will stay with you forever.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in New York
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to the legendary “Big Apple,” a city that truly never sleeps. Known for its unmatched energy, towering skyscrapers, and cultural influence, New York is the largest and one of the most vibrant cities in America. Upon your arrival, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure and rest up for the exciting journey ahead.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring New York City
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast before heading out for a comprehensive city tour. Begin with a ferry ride to Liberty Island to visit the world-famous Statue of Liberty. Enjoy panoramic views of the city skyline before continuing to the One World Observatory for a sweeping look at Manhattan from above. The rest of your tour includes must-see sights like Times Square, Central Park, Rockefeller Center, Wall Street, Ground Zero, the United Nations Headquarters, and more. Capture moments at the Trump Tower and other architectural marvels. Return to your hotel in New York for a restful overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: New York to Washington D.C.
package_itineraries.description: Today, depart for Washington D.C., the historic capital of the United States. Known for its monuments, political significance, and charming neighbourhoods, the city attracts millions of visitors each year. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy some time to explore or relax. Overnight stay in Washington.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Washington City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore some of the most important landmarks in American history. Your guided city tour includes visits to the White House (external view), the Capitol Building, Lincoln Memorial, Supreme Court, Pentagon, Washington Monument, Union Station, World War II Memorial, and the Smithsonian Air and Space Museum. Wrap up your historical journey with a peaceful night at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Washington to Niagara Falls (via Buffalo)
package_itineraries.description: This morning, take a flight to Buffalo and transfer to the USA side of Niagara Falls—an awe-inspiring natural wonder. Experience the powerful beauty of the falls on the iconic “Maid of the Mist” boat ride (seasonal), which brings you close to both the American and Horseshoe Falls. After the adventure, check in and relax at your hotel in Niagara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Niagara to Orlando
package_itineraries.description: Catch your flight to sunny Orlando, Florida’s inland jewel and a global hub for theme park magic. Best known as the home of Walt Disney World, Orlando offers excitement and fun for all ages. Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Enjoy a relaxing night in this entertainment paradise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Walt Disney Magic Kingdom
package_itineraries.description: Today, visit the legendary Magic Kingdom, a 107-acre park often called "The Most Magical Place on Earth." Step into a storybook world with themed lands like Adventureland, Fantasyland, and Tomorrowland. Ride iconic attractions, meet beloved characters, and feel the magic come alive. Return to your hotel in Orlando for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Explore Epcot Center
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, spend the day at Epcot, a 260-acre park dedicated to human achievement and innovation. Discover futuristic rides and attractions in Future World, then tour 11 international pavilions in the World Showcase. Enjoy cultural performances, global cuisine, and a nighttime show before heading back to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Dive into Sea World Orlando
package_itineraries.description: Today, enjoy the wonders of Sea World, the world’s largest marine park. From thrilling rides like Journey to Atlantis to up-close encounters with sea creatures, it’s an unforgettable mix of excitement and education. Watch live shows and explore aquatic exhibits before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Fly to San Francisco
