package_itineraries.description: Fly across the country to the hilly city of San Francisco, famed for its scenic charm, historical landmarks, and vibrant culture. From cable cars to the Golden Gate Bridge, this city offers a little bit of everything. After arrival, you’ll be transferred to your hotel for check-in and overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: San Francisco Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a guided tour of San Francisco. Visit the iconic Golden Gate Bridge, then head to Lombard Street, the crookedest street in the world. Ride a traditional cable car, explore Fisherman’s Wharf, Pier 39, Twin Peaks, Union Square, Nob Hill, and the Civic Center. You’ll also see the elegant Palace of Fine Arts. Spend the night in San Francisco.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: San Francisco to Las Vegas
package_itineraries.description: Fly to the dazzling desert city of Las Vegas. After checking into your hotel, your evening city tour awaits. Marvel at the famous Bellagio Fountains, watch the pirate battle at Treasure Island, view the Stratosphere Tower, and wander through Fremont Street, aglow with over 12 million lights. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Optional Grand Canyon Experience
package_itineraries.description: Today is yours to relax or take an optional trip to the Grand Canyon, one of the world’s most stunning natural wonders. Add on the Skywalk experience for a thrilling view or enjoy a helicopter ride on the Las Vegas Night Flight. Watch a fabulous live show or explore more free Vegas spectacles before retiring to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Las Vegas to Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: Depart for Los Angeles, the entertainment capital of the world. Upon arrival, set out on a city tour covering highlights such as Hollywood Boulevard, the Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, Rodeo Drive, Sunset Strip, and Chinatown. Capture the glitz and glam of Tinseltown before heading back to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 15: Universal Studios Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Spend a full day at Universal Studios Hollywood, where blockbuster films come to life. Experience thrilling rides, behind-the-scenes studio tours, and movie-themed attractions. Be part of your favorite cinematic universes and enjoy live entertainment throughout the park. Overnight in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 16: Depart from Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your final morning at leisure. Depending on your flight time, you may have time for some last-minute shopping or sightseeing. Later, transfer to the airport to catch your onward flight. Your unforgettable journey with the Ultimate USA Tour Package concludes here—with cherished memories that will last a lifetime.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Providenciales (Turks and Caicos)
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to the pristine shores of Turks and Caicos—a British Overseas Territory nestled in the Lucayan Archipelago of the Atlantic Ocean. The territory includes the larger Caicos Islands and the smaller Turks Islands. Upon arrival at Providenciales International Airport, you'll be warmly greeted and transferred to your hotel. Take time to unwind and soak in the coastal vibes as your unforgettable island getaway begins.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Providenciales – Optional Sunset Safari Experience
package_itineraries.description: Embrace the island's charm as the sun begins to dip. This optional guided sunset tour whisks you away to Sapodilla Beach in safari-style vehicles. With round-trip hotel transport included, you can fully enjoy the island's scenic beauty without any hassle. Explore the calm turquoise waters, and hear fascinating insights from your local guide about the island's culture, geography, and legends. It’s a magical way to start your journey through Turks and Caicos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Providenciales Discovery Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, venture out on a guided island tour that showcases the highlights of Providenciales. Begin with a visit to the famous Conch Farm, where you'll learn about the island's unique marine industry. Enjoy stunning beach views, sip on refreshing Rum Punch, and capture incredible photos atop Blue Mountain. Continue your adventure with a stop at “The Hole,” a natural limestone sinkhole, before indulging in a tasty seafood platter at the beloved “Da Conch Shack.” Optional snorkelling at Sapodilla is also available for those seeking a little underwater thrill.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Providenciales – Optional Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a peaceful evening on the water with an optional catamaran sunset cruise along Grace Bay. This adults-only experience invites you to toast the Caribbean sunset with Champagne, wine, or rum punch. Relax on deck with delicious local snacks like fresh conch fritters, while the calm ocean breeze and pastel skies create an unforgettable setting. The cruise includes convenient pick-up and drop-off from your hotel, ensuring a smooth and serene night out.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Providenciales – Half-Day Snorkelling & Island Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Today’s adventure takes you on a half-day cruise along the spectacular north shore. Your first stop is the TCI Barrier Reef—the third-largest reef in the world—where you'll snorkel in vibrant waters teeming with marine life. Then, your journey heads to the quieter southern side, where the crew will search for wild conch, giving you a glimpse into traditional island practices. Next, set sail toward one of the uninhabited cays, where you’ll enjoy a freshly prepared lunch and have time to explore the untouched beauty of this secluded paradise. This day offers a perfect blend of exploration, local culture, and relaxation on the open sea.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Providenciales
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, it's time to check out and transfer to the airport. As your Turks and Caicos Tour Package comes to a close, take a moment to reflect on the island's beauty, the warmth of its people, and the memories you’ve made. Depart with a heart full of joy and a camera full of stunning moments.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Honolulu International Airport, where you'll be met and transferred to your hotel. Spend the evening settling in and soaking up the island vibes. Overnight stay in Honolulu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Pearl Harbor and USS Arizona Memorial
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, get ready for a compelling historical journey. You’ll be picked up from your hotel and taken on a guided tour of Pearl Harbor. Here, you’ll revisit the events of December 7, 1941, through immersive storytelling and exhibits that reflect Hawaii’s pivotal place in global history. Board a boat to the USS Arizona Memorial, a solemn tribute to the brave lives lost during the attack. The tour also includes a visit to the National Memorial Cemetery of the Pacific, honoring those who served in the armed forces. The day continues with a drive past key historical landmarks in Honolulu such as Iolani Palace, Kawaiahao Church, the Hawaii State Capitol, and Honolulu City Hall. Return to your hotel for another restful night in Honolulu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leisure Day in Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day at your own pace. Relax on the beach, go shopping, or opt for exciting excursions like the Atlantis Submarine adventure or a cultural tour of the Polynesian Cultural Center. End your day with another peaceful overnight stay in Honolulu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: From Honolulu to Maui
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast and hotel checkout, you'll travel to Maui—known for its natural beauty and relaxed atmosphere. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight stay in Maui.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: The Scenic Road to Hana Tour
package_itineraries.description: Prepare for a full day of adventure as you embark on the legendary Road to Hana. This breathtaking route, lined with tropical rainforests, waterfalls, and dramatic coastlines, offers a truly immersive look into the untouched side of Maui. Your experienced guide will navigate over 600 curves and nearly 60 narrow bridges, providing stories and insights along the way. From hidden beaches to cascading falls, the journey to Hana is as captivating as the destination itself. After a day filled with scenic wonder, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay in Maui.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Maui
package_itineraries.description: As your island getaway comes to an end, check out from your hotel and prepare for your transfer to the airport. Whether you're heading home or on to your next adventure, your Hawaii tour package leaves you with memories of an unforgettable island escape.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Vancouver International Airport, you will be greeted and transferred to your hotel. Later, enjoy a mesmerizing experience at FlyOver Canada, a 4D virtual flight ride that lifts you above Canada's iconic landscapes. With motion seats and a wraparound screen, you'll feel like you’re soaring over mountains, valleys, and coastlines. Spend the night in the heart of Vancouver.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Vancouver City & Capilano Suspension Bridge
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, dive into the city with a guided Vancouver tour. You’ll discover famous spots like Canada Place, Robson Street, English Bay, Stanley Park, Granville Island, Gastown, and Chinatown. Later, cross the Lions Gate Bridge to visit the Capilano Salmon Hatchery and the legendary Capilano Suspension Bridge. Test your courage on the thrilling Cliffwalk and Treetops Adventure trails. End the day with a comfortable overnight stay in Vancouver.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Vancouver to Kamloops – All Aboard the Rocky Mountaineer
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with breakfast, then check out and head to the train station. Board the Rocky Mountaineer Holiday Package train and journey toward Kamloops. This route winds through dramatic landscapes including Hell’s Gate in Fraser Canyon, sheer cliffs, and scenic riversides. Watch the terrain transform as you travel in luxury and comfort. Overnight stay in Kamloops.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kamloops to Jasper – Mountain Majesty
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast before continuing your railway journey into the majestic Canadian Rockies. This leg of the trip includes spectacular views of Mount Robson, the highest peak in the range, and the cascading Pyramid Falls. Ascend the Yellowhead Pass and glide into Jasper National Park. Upon arrival in Jasper, transfer to your hotel for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Discover Jasper’s Natural Wonders
package_itineraries.description: Today’s adventure begins with the Explore Jasper Tour. Visit landmarks such as Athabasca Viewpoint, Maligne Canyon, Jasper town-site, and the serene Maligne Lake. At Maligne Canyon, walk beside deep rock formations and discover the area’s unique underground water system. The afternoon is free to explore activities like white-water rafting, Jasper SkyTram, stargazing, or a lake cruise. Return to your Jasper hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Journey to Banff via Columbia Icefields
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and travel along the world-renowned Icefields Parkway, known for its striking scenery. Stop at the Columbia Icefields Discovery Centre to hop aboard the Ice Explorer and ride across the Athabasca Glacier. Next, experience the Glacier Skywalk—a glass platform that hovers above the Sunwapta Valley. En route to Banff, enjoy views of Peyto Lake, Bow Lake, and the Crowfoot Glacier. Overnight stay in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Banff Exploration & Departure to Calgary
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with breakfast and check out. Store your bags at the hotel while you explore Banff, a picturesque alpine town surrounded by the Rockies. Highlights include Bow Falls, Tunnel Mountain Drive, Hoodoos, Surprise Corner, and Two Jack Viewpoint. At Lake Minnewanka, opt for a relaxing boat cruise to see wildlife and the dramatic Devil’s Gap. For a final treat, ascend Sulphur Mountain via the Banff Gondola. From the summit, take in breathtaking 360-degree views over Bow Valley. Later, you'll be transferred to Calgary Airport for your flight home or onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Toronto Arrival & City Discovery
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Toronto Airport, you’ll be warmly welcomed by our local representatives and guided to your hotel. Later, set out to uncover the highlights of this vibrant city. Visit the famed Hockey Hall of Fame and get a glimpse of the prestigious Stanley Cup. Stop by the impressive Rogers Centre, known for its iconic architecture and events. The day culminates with a thrilling elevator ride up the CN Tower to its glass-floored outdoor observation deck at 1,122 feet—offering a mesmerizing panoramic view of Toronto’s skyline.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kingston Cruise & Ottawa Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to the historic city of Kingston. Here, enjoy a relaxing and scenic cruise through the breathtaking 1000 Islands—an unforgettable experience. Continue to Ottawa, Canada’s capital, where you'll explore Parliament Hill, a symbol of national heritage. Discover the beautiful Rideau Canal, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and other notable landmarks in the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Montreal – The Cultural Gem
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, board a comfortable coach to Montreal, a city known for its European flair. Visit the magnificent Notre Dame Basilica, celebrated for its elaborate interior, religious artwork, and detailed carvings. Then, ascend Mont Royal for sweeping views of Montreal’s skyline—an ideal photo opportunity to capture your memories.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Quebec City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with breakfast before diving into the charms of Quebec City. Led by an expert guide, you’ll tour North America's only fortified city. Highlights include the Parliament Buildings, Upper and Lower Towns, the historic Plains of Abraham, Chateau Frontenac, the Citadel, Place d’Armes, and the National Assembly of Quebec—each echoing the city’s storied past.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: From Quebec to Calgary
package_itineraries.description: After a fulfilling breakfast, proceed to the airport for your flight to Calgary. Upon arrival, our team will be ready to assist you. Explore the city’s major highlights, including Heritage Park and the iconic Olympic Park. Afterwards, you'll journey to Banff—a picturesque town nestled in the Canadian Rockies, known for its charming streets and alpine beauty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Icefield Parkway & Glacier Encounter
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast and prepare for an unforgettable drive along the legendary Icefield Parkway. This scenic route treats you to dramatic mountain views, crystal-clear lakes, and towering glaciers. Step onto the ancient ice at the Athabasca Glacier and embark on a Glacier Adventure ride. A stop at the stunning Johnston Canyon caps off a thrilling day of nature and exploration.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Rocky Mountains to Kelowna
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a peaceful breakfast before continuing your journey to Kelowna. En route, feast your eyes on the majestic Canadian Rockies. Upon arrival, you’ll take part in a brief orientation tour to discover the serene beauty and lakeside charm of Kelowna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: From Kelowna to Vancouver via Whistler
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart by luxury coach towards the alpine village of Whistler. Upon reaching, you’ll ride the record-breaking Peak 2 Peak Gondola that connects Whistler and Blackcomb Mountains. As you glide between peaks, soak in the breathtaking mountain and valley views that make this one of Canada’s most iconic experiences.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Immersive Vancouver City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today begins with breakfast and a guided exploration of Vancouver’s top attractions. Visit the lush Stanley Park and cross the thrilling Capilano Suspension Bridge. See Prospect Point, English Bay, and the symbolic West Coast Native Totem Poles. Continue to Gastown, the city’s historic heart, filled with Victorian charm and cobblestone streets, ending with more scenic highlights of Vancouver’s urban and natural beauty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure from Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Wrap up your memorable journey with a final breakfast. Then, transfer to the airport for your flight home, taking with you unforgettable moments from your Quebec Tour Package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Vancouver and get transferred to your hotel. Later in the afternoon, experience the thrill of FlyOver Canada, a state-of-the-art 4D flight simulation. This immersive ride takes you on a breathtaking aerial journey across Canada, complete with motion seats and atmospheric effects like wind, mist, and scents. Before boarding, enjoy a visually engaging pre-show called "Uplift," setting the tone for your airborne adventure. After this unforgettable experience, return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Victoria & Butchart Gardens Day Trip
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day guided tour to Victoria and Butchart Gardens. Begin your journey with a scenic 90-minute ferry ride across the Strait of Georgia and through the picturesque Gulf Islands. Once in Victoria, visit the world-renowned Butchart Gardens, an expansive 55-acre botanical paradise. Wander through beautifully landscaped gardens and enjoy the floral artistry. After a day filled with natural beauty and historical charm, return to Vancouver for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Whistler & Shannon Falls Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Today’s adventure takes you north on the Sea to Sky Highway to Whistler. After breakfast, set off on a scenic drive along the coast, stopping at Shannon Falls and the Squamish Adventure Centre. As you approach Whistler Village, the towering peaks of Whistler and Blackcomb Mountains provide a majestic backdrop. Enjoy free time in the alpine village, with the option to ride the famous Peak 2 Peak Gondola for panoramic views. After a full day of exploration, return to Vancouver and relax at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Vancouver City Highlights & Capilano Park
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast before diving into a full-day city tour. Discover Vancouver’s vibrant neighborhoods including Gastown, Chinatown, and the cultural haven of Granville Island. Take in the beauty of Stanley Park, drive past Robson Street and Canada Place, and enjoy the scenic Lions Gate Bridge. The tour also includes admission to Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, where you’ll walk the thrilling Cliffwalk and sway high above the forest on the Treetops Adventure. After a memorable day, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, it’s time to check out. You’ll be transferred to Vancouver International Airport for your onward journey, marking the end of your delightful Vancouver Tour Package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in New York City
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to New York, famously known as the “Big Apple.” A city of towering ambition and endless energy, New York is a global hub for culture, fashion, business, and entertainment. As the most populous city in the USA, it promises a vibrant start to your East Coast adventure. Once you arrive at the airport, our representative will greet you and assist with your hotel transfer. The rest of the evening is yours to rest or explore at your leisure. Overnight stay at your hotel in New York.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: New York City Sightseeing Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided sightseeing tour of New York City. Begin with a ferry ride to Liberty Island to admire the iconic Statue of Liberty, one of America’s most enduring symbols of freedom. Capture stunning photos of the Manhattan skyline along the way. Later, visit the One World Observatory, located at the top of the World Trade Center, where you'll be treated to panoramic views of the city. Your tour also includes important landmarks such as Rockefeller Center, Wall Street, Ground Zero, Central Park, and a drive past Times Square, the United Nations Headquarters, and properties linked to Donald Trump. After a day of exploration, return to your hotel in New York for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: New York to Washington, D.C.
package_itineraries.description: This morning, journey to Washington, D.C., the capital of the United States. Upon arrival, proceed to your hotel and complete the check-in formalities. Named in honor of George Washington, the first President of the United States, the city also incorporates “Columbia,” a poetic term that represents the nation itself. After settling in, spend the evening at leisure exploring nearby attractions or relaxing at your hotel. Overnight stay in Washington.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Washington D.C. City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, get ready to explore the heart of American politics and history. Today’s guided city tour includes stops at major landmarks such as the White House, the Lincoln Memorial, the U.S. Capitol, the Supreme Court, and the Smithsonian Air and Space Museum. You’ll also visit Union Station, the World War II Memorial, the Pentagon, and the towering Washington Monument. The tour offers deep insights into the nation's legacy and ideals. After a full day of sightseeing, return to your hotel in Washington for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Washington – Buffalo – Niagara Falls (USA Side)
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, catch a domestic flight to Buffalo, where your adventure continues with a visit to the mighty Niagara Falls on the U.S. side. These cascading waterfalls are one of the most remarkable natural wonders in the world. You’ll enjoy a thrilling boat ride on the famous Maid of the Mist, which brings you up close to the thunderous falls, including the breathtaking American and Horseshoe Falls (seasonal operation). After your exciting excursion, check in to your hotel and enjoy a relaxing evening in Niagara. Overnight stay in Niagara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Niagara to Orlando
package_itineraries.description: Today, you will board a flight to Orlando, Florida. Known as the largest inland city in the state, Orlando is synonymous with theme park magic and family fun. It is home to Walt Disney World, one of the most visited vacation destinations in the world. After arriving in Orlando, you will be transferred to your hotel. The rest of the evening is yours to enjoy at your leisure. Overnight stay in Orlando.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Magic Kingdom at Walt Disney World
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to the world-famous Magic Kingdom. Spanning 107 acres, this enchanting theme park is divided into seven themed lands, each filled with thrilling rides, parades, and shows that bring your favorite Disney stories to life. From Main Street USA to Cinderella’s Castle, every corner is bursting with wonder and joy. Experience classic attractions, meet beloved characters, and enjoy live entertainment throughout the day. After an unforgettable experience, return to your hotel in Orlando for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Epcot Center – A Glimpse of the Future and the World
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with breakfast, then head to Epcot Center, a park dedicated to technological innovation and global culture. Divided into Future World and the World Showcase, Epcot offers interactive exhibits, cutting-edge attractions, and pavilions representing eleven different countries. It’s a cultural and futuristic journey unlike any other, offering both inspiration and entertainment. Return to your hotel in Orlando for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Sea World Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Today, get ready to explore Sea World, the largest marine theme park in the world. Dive into aquatic adventures as you encounter dolphins, sharks, and majestic killer whales. Ride thrilling attractions like the water coaster that leads you through the mythical lost city of Atlantis, or experience an exhilarating jet copter simulation in the Wild Arctic zone. Sea World also offers interactive exhibits, where you can feed and interact with marine animals. After an exciting day, return to your hotel in Orlando for a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure from Orlando
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your final breakfast of the tour before heading to the airport. With your heart full of memories and your camera full of pictures, it’s time to fly home or continue on your next adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in San Francisco
package_itineraries.description: Your journey begins as you arrive in the beautiful city of San Francisco—often compared to global icons like Paris or London for its charm and cultural richness. The city's famous rolling hills provide sweeping views of the Pacific Ocean and San Francisco Bay. With its diverse neighborhoods, vibrant nightlife, and proximity to Silicon Valley, San Francisco welcomes you with open arms. After arrival, you’ll check in at your hotel and spend the night in this iconic city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: San Francisco City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delightful breakfast before setting out on a full-day tour of San Francisco. Visit the Golden Gate Bridge, known for its towering structure and spectacular views. Explore landmarks like Twin Peaks, the famous Lombard Street, Nob Hill, Union Square, Civic Center, and the Palace of Fine Arts. Take in the lively vibe at Fisherman’s Wharf, hop on a historic cable car, and browse shops at Pier 39. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in San Francisco.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: San Francisco to Las Vegas
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, catch your flight to Las Vegas—America’s glittering city of entertainment. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and prepare for an exciting evening. Enjoy a panoramic city tour featuring dazzling sights like the Bellagio Fountains, Treasure Island's pirate show, the towering Stratosphere, Downtown Vegas, and the famous Fremont Street Experience—a light and sound show unlike any other. Overnight stay at a hotel in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Optional Grand Canyon Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with breakfast and choose how you'd like to spend it. Either relax and explore Las Vegas at your pace or take an optional excursion to the Grand Canyon—one of the world’s natural wonders. Opt for a ground or air tour and don't miss the thrilling SKYWALK experience. You may also enjoy the Las Vegas Night Flight, offering a bird’s-eye view of the illuminated cityscape. Another option is to attend one of the city’s spectacular shows. Overnight in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Las Vegas to Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast before departing for Los Angeles, the world’s entertainment capital. Upon arrival, take a guided city tour that includes Hollywood Boulevard, the Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, Grauman’s Chinese Theatre, Rodeo Drive, the Sunset Strip, and vibrant Chinatown. Discover the glitz and glam of this star-studded city before retiring for the night at your Los Angeles hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Universal Studios Hollywood
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, prepare for a thrilling day at Universal Studios. Enjoy cutting-edge attractions and immersive rides that bring your favorite films to life. Step behind the scenes of a working studio, enjoy live-action shows, and explore themed zones designed for all ages. Wrap up the day and spend another night in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Los Angeles to Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast before boarding your flight to Honolulu, the gateway to Hawaii. Upon arrival, enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure. Honolulu is the capital of Hawaii and the largest city across all Pacific islands. Rich in both culture and modern charm, it serves as a key financial and tourism center in the region. Settle into your hotel and relax in paradise. Overnight stay in Honolulu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Pearl Harbor and USS Missouri Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and embark on a memorable visit to historic Pearl Harbor. Explore the USS Missouri and the poignant Arizona Memorial. Your guided tour also includes a drive through Punchbowl National Memorial Cemetery and stops at key downtown landmarks. With pre-arranged access, you can skip the long lines and enjoy seamless transport to and from your hotel. Spend the evening relaxing in Honolulu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Optional Big Island Volcano Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Start with breakfast and, if you choose, take an optional flight to the Big Island for an epic volcano tour. Visit Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, the Jaggar Museum, Thurston Lava Tube, Kilauea Iki Crater, and Rainbow Falls. This full-day adventure includes return airfare, guided transport, and park entry. Return to Honolulu in the evening and enjoy your final night on the island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure from Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and prepare for your flight home or onward travel. Your West Coast and Hawaii tour package concludes with unforgettable memories of iconic cities, natural wonders, and island bliss.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Lima
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to Peru! Upon your arrival at Lima’s international airport, you will be met by a representative and transferred to your hotel. Take time to rest and prepare for the adventure ahead. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in Lima.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discovering Lima’s Historic & Modern Charms
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin a fascinating half-day tour of Peru’s capital city. Dive into the historical centre of Lima as you explore notable sites such as the Plaza Mayor, Government Palace, San Martín Square, the Justice Palace, and the Archbishop's Palace. Admire colonial-era architecture including the Torre Tagle Palace and the charming Desamparados train station. Visit the San Francisco Convent, famous for its intricate catacombs, and stroll by elegant colonial mansions with traditional Moorish balconies. Later, head into the vibrant districts of San Isidro and Miraflores, where the city’s modern side comes alive, ending with a scenic view of the Pacific coastline. Return to your hotel and relax for the night in Lima.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Lima to Cusco – Gateway to the Andes
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast and a transfer to the airport for your flight to Cusco. Once in Cusco, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. The morning is free to rest and acclimate to the altitude. In the afternoon, embark on a guided tour of Cusco—a city that beautifully blends Incan roots with colonial heritage. Visit the sacred Temple of the Sun, known as Koricancha, followed by the grand Cusco Cathedral in the historic main square. Continue to the nearby archaeological sites including Tambomachay (the Incan bathing site), the military lookout of Puca Pucara, the ceremonial site of Kenko, and the impressive fortress of Sacsayhuaman with its massive stone walls. Return to your hotel in Cusco for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Visit to Machu Picchu – The Lost City of the Incas
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with breakfast and head to the train station for your journey through the Sacred Valley toward Aguas Calientes. This scenic ride offers breathtaking views of the Andes and the Urubamba River. Upon arrival, you’ll board a bus that will take you up the winding mountain road to Machu Picchu. Explore one of the New Seven Wonders of the World with a guided tour, learning about its history, significance, and architectural brilliance. A delicious lunch is included during the excursion. After a day of discovery at this mystical site, return to Cusco by train and enjoy a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Farewell – Cusco to Lima
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your return flight to Lima or your onward journey. Your Classic Peru Tour Package concludes here, leaving you with incredible memories of ancient wonders, cultural treasures, and unforgettable experiences.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Jackson Hole
package_itineraries.description: Once you arrive at Jackson Hole Airport, you’ll be greeted and taken to your hotel. After check-in, spend the evening at leisure, enjoying the relaxed atmosphere of this charming mountain town. Overnight stay in Jackson Hole.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Jackson Hole – Yellowstone National Park
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day by waiting in your hotel lobby for your Yellowstone tour departure. This full-day guided excursion will take you from Jackson Hole deep into the iconic Yellowstone National Park. Prepare to witness geothermal wonders, rugged canyons, flowing rivers, and an abundance of wildlife. Highlights of the day include visits to Old Faithful, the Grand Canyon of Yellowstone, and the picturesque Lake Yellowstone Hotel. Throughout the trip, your guide will explain the fascinating volcanic origins and biodiversity of the park. Don’t forget to keep watch for native animals like bison, bears, elk, and wolves. Marvel at the powerful eruptions of Old Faithful and admire the vivid hues of Fountain Paint Pot. Capture unforgettable photos of the magnificent Yellowstone Falls and relax at scenic viewpoints. After an eventful day of sightseeing, return to your hotel in Jackson Hole for a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Jackson Hole – Grand Teton National Park
package_itineraries.description: Meet your guide in the hotel lobby for another scenic tour, this time to Grand Teton National Park. This journey through the Upper Loop provides breathtaking views of the jagged Teton Range. Highlights include serene Jenny Lake, the historic Menor’s Ferry, and the rustic Chapel of the Transfiguration—both important cultural landmarks. Your guide will share stories and geological insights as you explore these majestic natural surroundings. After the day’s exploration, return to your Jackson Hole hotel to relax and spend the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Jackson Hole – Rapid City
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before checking out. Await your transfer to Jackson Hole Airport for your flight to Rapid City, South Dakota (note: flight fare not included in the package). Upon arrival, you’ll be taken to your hotel in Rapid City. Unwind and settle in for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Rapid City – Mount Rushmore Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today’s excursion begins with a transfer to Fort Hayes Chuckwagon, where you’ll begin your Mount Rushmore experience. This region of the Black Hills offers more than just the famous sculpture—it’s a scenic and historical delight. Spend an hour exploring Mount Rushmore and its surrounding grounds. Then, continue along the Peter Norbeck Scenic Byway, famous for its pigtail bridges and mountain tunnels. You’ll pause for lunch at a former presidential retreat used by Calvin Coolidge and Dwight Eisenhower, with options to enjoy a meal from the menu or a buffet. Next, journey through Custer State Park and along the dramatic Needles Highway, featuring granite spires and panoramic overlooks. End the day with a visit to the Crazy Horse Memorial—the largest mountain carving in progress. Visit on-site museums and the sculptor’s original studio. Return to your hotel in Rapid City after a full day of discovery.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Rapid City
package_itineraries.description: Your journey concludes today. After breakfast, check out from your hotel and proceed with the arranged transfer to the airport for your departure to your next destination or home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in New York
package_itineraries.description: Step into the vibrant buzz of the “Big Apple.” Upon landing at New York’s airport, our team will escort you to your hotel. Known as America’s largest city, New York dazzles with its mix of business, fashion, arts, and entertainment. Settle into your hotel and enjoy a relaxing evening at your leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Iconic Sights of New York City
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin your city tour with a ferry ride to Liberty Island to visit the world-famous Statue of Liberty. Then, head to the One World Observatory for spectacular 360-degree views. Your day continues with key stops at Rockefeller Center, Wall Street, Ground Zero, and the peaceful surroundings of Central Park. Enjoy glimpses of Times Square, Trump Tower, and the United Nations headquarters before heading back to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Travel to Washington D.C.
package_itineraries.description: Today, travel to the capital of the United States, Washington D.C., a city steeped in political and historical significance. Upon arrival and hotel check-in, enjoy a guided tour featuring the White House, Lincoln Memorial, the Capitol Building, Supreme Court, Union Station, the Smithsonian Air and Space Museum, Pentagon, and World War II Memorial. Rest overnight in Washington.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Journey to Niagara via Buffalo
package_itineraries.description: Travel today to Buffalo by air or road for an exciting visit to the iconic Niagara Falls. Check into your hotel in Niagara and soak in the sights and sounds of one of nature’s greatest wonders.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Explore Niagara Falls – USA Side
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast followed by a ride on the legendary “Maid of the Mist” boat tour (seasonal), which takes you right up to the thundering American and Horseshoe Falls. Enjoy the rest of your day relaxing or exploring the illuminated falls by night. Stay overnight in Niagara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Fly to Las Vegas
package_itineraries.description: Take a morning flight to the dazzling city of Las Vegas. After hotel check-in, enjoy a city tour including the Bellagio Fountains, Treasure Island’s Pirate Show, Stratosphere Tower, Fremont Street, and the glittering lights of Downtown Vegas. Spend the night soaking in the city’s energy.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Grand Canyon Optional Tour
package_itineraries.description: You have the option today to explore the majestic Grand Canyon—by bus or air—along with the incredible Skywalk. In the evening, you may also enjoy a Vegas Night Flight (optional helicopter ride) or attend one of the city’s spectacular shows. Overnight stay in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Travel to Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: Proceed to Los Angeles by flight or road. Begin your city tour visiting landmarks like the Hollywood Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, Grauman’s Chinese Theatre, Sunset Strip, Rodeo Drive, and Chinatown. Enjoy an overnight stay in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Universal Studios Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore Universal Studios, home to thrilling rides, movie-themed attractions, and real film sets. Get an insider’s look into Hollywood’s magical movie-making world. Return to your hotel in Los Angeles for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Disneyland Experience
package_itineraries.description: Step into a fairy-tale world at Disneyland, where your favorite characters and childhood dreams come to life. From Main Street USA to magical rides and parades, enjoy a full day of wonder and joy. Overnight in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Fly to San Francisco
package_itineraries.description: Fly to the iconic city of San Francisco, a hub of art, culture, and technology. Explore iconic landmarks like the Golden Gate Bridge, Twin Peaks, Lombard Street, Pier 39, Civic Center, Union Square, Fisherman’s Wharf, and the Palace of Fine Arts. Check in and relax at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Departure from San Francisco
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy some free time to shop or relax. Later, you’ll be transferred to the airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Vancouver
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Vancouver International Airport, collect your rental vehicle, and drive to your hotel. In the evening, enjoy the exhilarating Fly Over Canada 4D experience—soar across Canada's diverse landscapes with immersive visuals and special effects. Relax overnight at your Vancouver hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Vancouver Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Today begins with a visit to Vancouver’s top attractions. Cross the iconic Lions Gate Bridge and explore the Capilano Salmon Hatchery before arriving at the Capilano Suspension Bridge Park. Stroll along the thrilling Cliff Walk and immerse yourself in the Treetops Adventure. Continue your day with a scenic ride up Grouse Mountain on the Skyride. Enjoy activities such as the Lumberjack Show, the Peak Chairlift, wildlife encounters, and panoramic views from the Eye of the Wind. In the evening, unwind in downtown Vancouver—shop on Robson Street, visit Stanley Park, or explore the historic Gastown district. Overnight in Vancouver.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Vancouver to Victoria
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal for a 90-minute ferry ride across the Strait of Georgia to Swartz Bay. Visit the world-famous Butchart Gardens, known for its immaculate floral displays. Then, explore Victoria’s Inner Harbour, steeped in British charm. Overnight stay in Victoria.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Victoria to Whistler
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with an included Whale Watching Tour. Spot orcas, seals, and marine birds in their natural habitat. Later, take the ferry from Nanaimo to Horseshoe Bay and enjoy a scenic drive along the Sea-to-Sky Highway to Whistler. Stop at Shannon Falls and soak in views of rugged mountains and glacial fjords. Overnight in Whistler.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Whistler Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Explore Whistler Village and savour a local breakfast. Enjoy shopping, dining, or outdoor cafés before boarding the Peak-2-Peak Gondola—an engineering marvel offering breathtaking views. Optional adventures include ATV tours, bungee jumping, or a paddling trip across Alta Lake and the River of Golden Dreams. Stay overnight in Whistler.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Whistler to Kamloops
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Kamloops, where dramatic desert plateaus meet lush valleys. Enjoy scenic views of Kamloops Lake and the Thompson River. Experience the peaceful rhythm of small-town life and settle in for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Kamloops to Jasper
package_itineraries.description: Travel north along the Thompson River, passing through Yellowhead Pass into Jasper National Park. Admire the alpine lakes, towering peaks, and chance wildlife sightings like elk. End your day in the picturesque mountain town of Jasper. Overnight at a Jasper hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Explore Jasper National Park
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day exploring Jasper's natural beauty. Visit Maligne Canyon and take a boat cruise on Maligne Lake to view Spirit Island. Optional activities include visiting Miette Hot Springs, white water rafting, or the Jasper SkyTram. Overnight stay in Jasper.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Jasper to Lake Louise via Columbia Icefields
package_itineraries.description: Today, journey along the Icefields Parkway—one of the most scenic drives in the world. Stop at the Columbia Icefield Discovery Centre for the Glacier Adventure and Glacier Skywalk. En route to Lake Louise, pass scenic spots like Peyto Lake and Bow Lake. Spend the night at a hotel near the tranquil turquoise waters of Lake Louise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Lake Louise to Banff
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day exploring Lake Louise with optional activities such as hiking to Lake Agnes, kayaking, or visiting the Lake Louise Gondola. Later, head to Banff, a vibrant alpine town. Check into your hotel and enjoy Banff Avenue’s quaint shops and restaurants. Overnight in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Banff Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Explore Banff’s majestic surroundings. Visit Bow Falls, Surprise Corner, Hoodoos, and take a Lake Minnewanka Cruise. Ascend Sulphur Mountain via Banff Gondola for panoramic views. In the afternoon, explore the trails or stroll through town. Overnight in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Banff to Calgary
package_itineraries.description: Drive from Banff to Calgary. Once in the city, check into your hotel and enjoy free time exploring urban attractions or relaxing. Overnight stay in Calgary.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Departure from Calgary
package_itineraries.description: Spend the morning exploring Calgary’s top sites like Heritage Park, Canada Olympic Park, or the Calgary Tower. Return your rental vehicle at Calgary Airport and catch your return flight or continue your journey elsewhere.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to New York City
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in New York, the legendary metropolis fondly called “The Big Apple” and known globally as “The City That Never Sleeps.” As the cultural and financial capital of the USA, New York dazzles with its towering skyscrapers, bustling streets, and unmatched energy. Upon arrival, you’ll be met and transferred to your hotel. Settle in and relax for your first overnight stay in this dynamic city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Guided Tour of New York
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin your journey through New York with a city tour filled with iconic sights. Board a ferry to Liberty Island for an up-close view of the Statue of Liberty—an enduring symbol of freedom. Next, ascend to the One World Observatory at the World Trade Center for panoramic views of Manhattan. Your sightseeing continues past notable landmarks such as Times Square, Central Park, Wall Street, Trump Tower, Ground Zero, the United Nations, and Rockefeller Center. After a full day of exploration, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Travel from New York to Washington, D.C.
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast before departing for the nation's capital—Washington, D.C. Known for its national monuments and political heritage, the city also thrives on tourism and culture. After reaching Washington and checking into your hotel, you’ll have time to unwind or explore nearby attractions on your own. Overnight stay in Washington.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Discover the Sights of Washington, D.C.
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast before embarking on a city tour of Washington. Visit key attractions such as the White House, the Lincoln Memorial, the U.S. Capitol, the Supreme Court, and the Pentagon. Explore the fascinating exhibits at the Smithsonian Air and Space Museum, stroll through Union Station, and stop by the World War II Memorial and the towering Washington Monument. After soaking in the city's history, return to your hotel for another restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Washington to Buffalo – Arrival in Niagara
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, you’ll catch a flight to Buffalo and continue your journey to Niagara Falls, one of the world's most breathtaking natural wonders. After checking into your Niagara hotel, you’ll have time to explore the local area, shop for souvenirs, or simply relax. Later, enjoy a hearty dinner and feel free to visit the nearby casinos at your leisure. Overnight stay in Niagara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Niagara Falls Experience – USA Side
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast, followed by the exciting highlight of the tour—an unforgettable boat ride on the seasonal "Maid of the Mist." Feel the power of Niagara up close as you sail near the American and Horseshoe Falls. After the tour, head back to the hotel and freshen up. In the evening, take the optional opportunity to revisit the falls to witness their dazzling night-time illumination. Overnight stay at the hotel in Niagara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Niagara
package_itineraries.description: Start your final day with a fulfilling breakfast. It’s time to say goodbye as your incredible journey through the East Coast comes to an end. Depending on your schedule, you will either head home or continue onward to your next destination—carrying unforgettable memories from our Exciting East USA Tour Packages.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Calgary – Transfer to Banff
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Calgary International Airport, where your journey begins with a smooth transfer to the charming town of Banff. After checking into your hotel, the rest of the day is yours to relax or explore the vibrant Banff Avenue—filled with shops, local cafes, and mountain-town charm. Enjoy an overnight stay in Banff.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Banff to Lake Louise – Mountain Majesty Awaits
package_itineraries.description: After a delicious breakfast, check out and leave your luggage in the hotel’s lobby before heading out on a guided tour of Banff’s scenic highlights. Surrounded by towering mountain ranges including Rundle, Tunnel, and Norquay, you’ll visit landmarks such as Bow Falls, Surprise Corner, the Hoodoos, and Tunnel Mountain Drive. Stop by Lake Minnewanka, where you may choose an optional boat cruise offering a peaceful view of the lake, the surrounding wildlife, and the geological marvel of Devil’s Gap. Next, ride the Banff Gondola to the top of Sulphur Mountain, where panoramic views of the Bow Valley await. In the afternoon, travel to Lake Louise—famed for its vivid turquoise waters, dramatic glaciers, and the iconic lakeside chateau. Settle in for an overnight stay at your Lake Louise hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Lake Louise – Icefields Parkway Experience
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before setting off on a drive along the spectacular Icefields Parkway, often described as one of the most beautiful road trips in the world. Along the route, marvel at glacial valleys, alpine lakes, and cascading waterfalls. Your main stop will be the Columbia Icefields Discovery Centre, where you'll board an Ice Explorer to traverse the surface of the Athabasca Glacier—an unforgettable experience. Then, continue to the Glacier Skywalk, a glass-floored observation deck with dramatic views over Sunwapta Valley. As the tour continues, take in other natural landmarks such as Crowfoot Glacier, Peyto Lake, and Bow Lake. The evening is free to enjoy the peaceful ambiance of Lake Louise. Whether you choose to go kayaking, hike to Lake Agnes, or ride the Lake Louise Gondola, the natural beauty will leave you mesmerized. Spend another night at your Lake Louise hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Return to Calgary – Departure
package_itineraries.description: Savor your final breakfast in the Rockies before checking out. You'll be transferred to Calgary International Airport for your onward journey, bringing your unforgettable Rockies Sampler Tour Package to a close.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in New York City
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to New York—America’s legendary city known for its energy, ambition, and unmatched skyline. Often dubbed “The Big Apple” and “The City That Never Sleeps,” New York is a thriving metropolis, rich in business, culture, and history. Once you arrive, head to your hotel to check in and unwind. Overnight stay in New York.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Iconic Sights of New York
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a full-day city tour. Begin your experience with a ferry ride to Liberty Island, where the majestic Statue of Liberty stands tall as a global symbol of freedom. Next, take in sweeping panoramic views at the One World Observatory. Your exploration continues with visits to Rockefeller Center, Wall Street, Ground Zero, Central Park, and Times Square. Drive past the UN Headquarters and Trump properties. Return to your hotel for a well-earned rest. Overnight in New York.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Journey to Washington, D.C.
package_itineraries.description: Today, travel to the historic U.S. capital, Washington, D.C.—a city that blends heritage and grandeur. Upon hotel check-in, spend the day discovering its monumental beauty. Visit iconic landmarks including the White House, the Capitol, Lincoln Memorial, Supreme Court, Smithsonian Air and Space Museum, Union Station, World War II Memorial, and the Washington Monument. Overnight stay in Washington, D.C.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Washington to Buffalo – Niagara Falls (USA Side)
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast before flying or driving to Buffalo. Then continue to Niagara Falls, one of nature’s most awe-inspiring spectacles. Check in to your hotel in Niagara and enjoy some leisure time in this quaint town. Overnight stay in Niagara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Up Close with Niagara Falls
package_itineraries.description: Today brings a thrilling adventure aboard the seasonal "Maid of the Mist" boat, taking you right up to the thunderous roar of the American and Horseshoe Falls. Feel the mist, the power, and the beauty of these world-famous cascades. Afterward, return to your hotel and relax. Overnight in Niagara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Niagara to Orlando
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Orlando, Florida—a popular inland destination famed for its theme parks and year-round sunshine. As one of the most visited vacation cities in the U.S., Orlando offers fun for all ages. Upon arrival, check in and settle at your hotel. Overnight stay in Orlando.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Disney’s Magic Kingdom
package_itineraries.description: Today is reserved for wonder and imagination at the Magic Kingdom, the crown jewel of Walt Disney World. Opened in 1971, this 107-acre park features iconic attractions, parades, themed lands, and fairy-tale magic around every corner. Step into a dreamland on Main Street USA and beyond. Overnight stay in Orlando.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Discover Epcot Center
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Epcot, a celebration of technological innovation and global culture. Roam through Future World’s attractions and the World Showcase’s eleven country pavilions. Enjoy hands-on experiences and cultural shows all in one place. Overnight stay in Orlando.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Adventure at SeaWorld
package_itineraries.description: Today, dive into marine magic at SeaWorld, the largest marine theme park in the world. Explore thrilling rides like Journey to Atlantis and Wild Arctic, and interact with marine animals in unforgettable ways. End the day with lasting memories. Overnight stay in Orlando.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Orlando to Miami
package_itineraries.description: Depart for the coastal paradise of Miami—known for its art deco vibes, sizzling nightlife, and iconic beaches. After checking in, enjoy your afternoon strolling through South Beach, Little Havana, or simply soaking in the sun. Overnight stay in Miami.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Miami City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today’s city tour will take you through some of Miami’s most iconic neighborhoods and landmarks. Highlights include Ocean Drive, Lincoln Road, Coconut Grove, Collins Avenue, Midtown, Little Havana, the Design District, and Bayfront Park. Cap off your day with a scenic Biscayne Bay boat ride. Overnight stay in Miami.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Miami to Las Vegas
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Las Vegas, the entertainment capital of the world. After checking in, get ready for a magical city tour. Witness the Bellagio Fountains, Treasure Island’s pirate battle, the views from Stratosphere Tower, and Fremont Street's dazzling light show. Overnight stay in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Grand Canyon Day (Optional)
package_itineraries.description: Choose between a leisurely day or an optional Grand Canyon tour by bus or flight. Marvel at the Skywalk’s views or soar above the canyon by helicopter during the Las Vegas Night Flight. Catch a live show or stroll along the Strip. Overnight in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Las Vegas to Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Los Angeles by flight or bus. Embark on a guided city tour through Hollywood, Beverly Hills, Rodeo Drive, Sunset Strip, the Hollywood Walk of Fame, and China Town. Discover why this is called the "Entertainment Capital of the World." Overnight stay in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 15: Universal Studios Experience
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Universal Studios, where Hollywood comes alive. Experience cutting-edge rides, live-action shows, and behind-the-scenes glimpses of movie magic. You might even catch a real film shoot. Overnight stay in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Day 16: Los Angeles to San Francisco
package_itineraries.description: Fly to San Francisco, a city of hills, charm, and iconic landmarks. Enjoy a panoramic tour that includes the Golden Gate Bridge, Twin Peaks, Lombard Street, Fisherman’s Wharf, Union Square, Nob Hill, and Pier 39. Overnight in San Francisco.

package_itineraries.title: Day 17: San Francisco City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Delve deeper into San Francisco’s charm as you explore more of its highlights. Enjoy another chance to walk the Golden Gate Bridge, explore Chinatown, ride a cable car, visit the Civic Center, and see the elegant Palace of Fine Arts. Overnight in San Francisco.

package_itineraries.title: Day 18: Departure from San Francisco
package_itineraries.description: After a final breakfast, enjoy free time for last-minute shopping or sightseeing before heading to the airport for your return flight or onward journey. Treasure the memories of your unforgettable journey across the USA with our USA trip packages.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Rio de Janeiro
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Rio’s international airport where a friendly local representative will guide you to your hotel. Known affectionately as "The Marvelous City," Rio de Janeiro was once the capital of both Portugal and Brazil until 1960. Today, it’s a dazzling mix of dramatic mountain landscapes and coastal charm. One of Brazil’s most dynamic cities, Rio is famed for its landmarks like Sugarloaf Mountain (Pão de Açúcar), Christ the Redeemer (Corcovado), and the world-famous Copacabana and Ipanema beaches. The city exudes an irresistible energy, and its locals—Cariocas—are known for their warm, easy-going nature. Whether you're here to enjoy nature, soak in the culture, or join the Carnival celebrations, Rio has something for every kind of traveler. Enjoy your first night at your hotel in Rio.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore the Icons of Rio
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a delicious breakfast, then embark on the thrilling Sugarloaf Mountain excursion. This panoramic journey begins with a city tour, passing through downtown Rio and notable spots such as Maracanã Stadium, the Sambadrome, and the architecturally stunning Metropolitan Cathedral—famous for its massive pyramid shape and a height of 80 meters. Next, explore Cinelandia Square, home to Rio's cultural gems like the Municipal Theater, the National Library, and the Museum of Fine Arts. Then, take a scenic cable car ride to Sugarloaf Mountain for breathtaking views over the bay and city skyline. In the afternoon, visit Corcovado Mountain, home to the iconic Christ the Redeemer statue, and enjoy a drive along some of the city’s most beautiful beaches. Return to your hotel in the evening for a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cruise Through Guanabara Bay
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head out to explore the stunning Guanabara Bay on a scenic cruise. Surrounded by mountains and lined with golden beaches, the bay reveals Rio from a magical perspective. During the cruise, sail past several islands, including Ilha Fiscal, Ilha das Cobras, and Ilha de Villegaignon. Enjoy amazing views of the Rio-Niterói Bridge and the busy city port. On the opposite shore, discover the charming coastline of Niterói, featuring highlights like Gragoatá Beach and Fort, the Museum of Contemporary Art, and beaches like Icaraí, São Francisco, Jurujuba, and Charitas. Capture panoramic views of Pedra do Índio and Pedra Itapuca along the way. Your return cruise offers glimpses of Santa Cruz Fortress and the scenic beaches of Flamengo and Botafogo. After this delightful day, unwind back at your hotel in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Flight to Iguazu – Brazilian Side of the Falls
package_itineraries.description: This morning, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Iguazu. Once you land, a transfer will take you to your hotel where you can settle in and prepare for the natural wonders ahead. Your exploration begins at the Brazilian side of the Iguazu Falls. After arriving at the visitor center, board a panoramic bus that leads you into the park. Your journey includes a 950-meter walking trail, offering fantastic views of the Argentine side of the falls and the mighty Iguazu River. A highlight of the walk is the platform that brings you face-to-face with the impressive Floriano Falls. Take in breathtaking views of the Devil’s Throat and the lower river from a privileged vantage point. End your visit with a ride up the panoramic elevator to the shopping and dining area. Enjoy a peaceful night at your hotel in Iguazu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Argentina Side of the Falls
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast before heading out to explore the Argentine side of Iguazu Falls. The tour begins at the newly upgraded Visitors Center, where you can visit the Nature Interpretation Center and then choose between a short hike on the Green Trail or a scenic train ride to reach the starting points of the walkways. On the Upper Circuit, you’ll walk along 800 meters of catwalks suspended above the forest floor, offering aerial views of the falls and the surrounding jungle. The Lower Circuit, a 1,600-meter network of trails, lets you experience the waterfalls from below, bringing you close to the thunderous flow and misty spray of the cascades. Finally, head toward the Devil’s Throat—the most powerful and iconic part of the falls. After an 18-minute train ride, walk over elevated pathways to an incredible viewing platform directly above this roaring natural wonder. After an awe-inspiring day, return to your hotel in Iguazu for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Iguazu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel. A transfer will take you to the airport, where you’ll board your flight to your next destination or back home—carrying unforgettable memories from your incredible journey through Brazil, made special by your Rio De Janeiro tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sao Paulo
package_itineraries.description: Once you land at Sao Paulo Airport, you’ll be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at your own pace, relaxing and settling in. Overnight stay in Sao Paulo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sao Paulo - Rio De Janeiro City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a refreshing breakfast. Then, embark on a city tour of Sao Paulo. The journey starts at Centro Cultural and continues through Old Downtown where you’ll see major attractions such as Cathedral Se, Patio do Colegio, Monastery of Sao Bento, Banespa Building, Martinelli Building, Viaduto do Cha, the Municipal Theater, Sala Sao Paulo concert hall, Estaçao da Luz station, and the Municipal Market. Post tour, you’ll be transferred to the airport for your flight to Rio de Janeiro. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and spend the evening at your leisure. Overnight in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rio De Janeiro
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a tour to Sugar Loaf Mountain. Enjoy a panoramic drive through downtown Rio, passing by landmarks like Maracana Stadium, Sambodrome, and the unique Metropolitan Cathedral. Stop at Cinelandia Square with its historical buildings, including the National Library and the Museum of Fine Arts. Then, ascend to Sugar Loaf by cable car for incredible views. Later, visit Corcovado Mountain and enjoy Rio’s iconic beaches. Overnight stay in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rio De Janeiro
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before heading on a scenic cruise along Guanabara Bay. Discover islands like Ilha Fiscal, Ilha das Cobras, and Ilha das Enxadas, and enjoy views of Rio-Niteroi Bridge and surrounding landscapes. On the return, take in the beauty of Niteroi’s coast and see the Museum of Contemporary Art, Santa Cruz Fortress, and beaches like Icarai and Jurujuba. Spend the night at your hotel in Rio de Janeiro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Rio De Janeiro – Iguassu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport and fly to Iguassu. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and later visit the Brazilian side of the Iguassu Falls. Begin at the Visitor Center, then board a panoramic bus to reach the trails. Walk along a scenic path to view the falls from various platforms. Conclude your visit at Floriano fall and explore the upper viewing areas. Return for an overnight stay in Iguazu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Iguassu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a day tour to the Argentinean side of the falls. Begin at the New Visitors Center and explore the Nature Interpretation Center. Ride the train to the Cataratas Station or take the Green Trail. Upper Circuit: 800 meters of raised walkways offering aerial views. Lower Circuit: 1,600 meters with viewpoints surrounding the falls. Devil's Gorge: Take a train to Garganta Station and walk 1,200 meters to a stunning lookout point. Return for your overnight stay in Iguazu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Iguassu to Buenos
package_itineraries.description: AiresTransfer to the airport for your flight to Buenos Aires. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Buenos Aires is a vibrant city filled with European-inspired architecture and culture. In the evening, enjoy a Tango Show and Dinner at Tango Porteño. Overnight in Buenos Aires.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Buenos Aires
package_itineraries.description: Start your city tour of Buenos Aires after breakfast. Visit major landmarks like Av. 9 de Julio, the Colón Theatre, and the Obelisk. Explore Plaza de Mayo, San Telmo, La Boca, Caminito, and Puerto Madero. Continue to Palermo and Recoleta, ending at San Telmo Flea Market if it's Sunday. Overnight in Buenos Aires.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Buenos Aires to Ushuaia
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, fly from El Calafate to Ushuaia, the world’s southernmost city. Enjoy scenic views of the Beagle Channel and check in at your Ushuaia hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Ushuaia
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, explore Tierra del Fuego National Park with a ride on the Train of the End of the World. Enjoy nature and history in Argentina's only coastal national park. In the afternoon, sail the Beagle Channel and visit Seals Island to see sea life in its natural habitat. Overnight in Ushuaia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Ushuaia to El Calafate
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport and fly to El Calafate. Upon arrival, head to your hotel and enjoy a free day. Overnight stay in El Calafate.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: El Calafate
package_itineraries.description: Visit the spectacular Perito Moreno Glacier after breakfast. Tour Los Glaciares National Park and walk the glacier trails. Take a Nautical Safari to witness the glacier from the water. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: El Calafate to Bariloche
package_itineraries.description: Fly from El Calafate to Bariloche. Transfer to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at your own pace. Overnight in Bariloche.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Bariloche Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Explore Bariloche after breakfast with a scenic drive along Ezequiel Bustillo Avenue. Discover lakes, peninsulas, islands, and mountain peaks. Visit the Panoramic Point for breathtaking views. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 15: Bariloche to Puerto Varas
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Bariloche to Puerto Varas via the Cardenal Samore Pass. Stop at Osorno and continue through beautiful landscapes to reach your hotel in Puerto Varas. Overnight in Puerto Varas.

package_itineraries.title: Day 17: Puerto Varas - Santiago
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport and fly to Santiago. Visit La Moneda Palace, Plaza de Armas, San Cristobal Hill, and explore neighborhoods like Bellavista, Las Condes, and Providencia. Overnight stay in Santiago.

package_itineraries.title: Day 18: Santiago
package_itineraries.description: Take a full-day tour of Vina del Mar and Valparaiso. Stop in Pomaire village, explore the Garden City of Vina del Mar, and the historical hills of Valparaiso, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Return for an overnight stay in Santiago.

package_itineraries.title: Day 19: Departing from Santiago
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey or return home, bringing along cherished memories of your South America Travel Packages adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Arrival in San Francisco
package_itineraries.description: Kickstart your adventure as you arrive in San Francisco—an iconic American city often compared to Paris and London for its charm and cultural blend. With its dramatic hills, scenic bay views, and vibrant neighborhoods, San Francisco offers a stunning first impression. Explore trendy boutiques, savor global cuisine, and enjoy the city’s exciting nightlife. On arrival, transfer to your hotel and relax with an overnight stay in San Francisco.

package_itineraries.title: San Francisco City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a guided city tour showcasing the best of San Francisco. Walk across the legendary Golden Gate Bridge, admire panoramic views from Twin Peaks, and visit famous spots like Lombard Street, Nob Hill, Civic Center, Union Square, Pier 39, and Fisherman’s Wharf. Don’t miss a photo stop at the elegant Palace of Fine Arts and a glimpse of the historic Cable Cars. Return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day Trip to Yosemite National Park
package_itineraries.description: Today, set out on an unforgettable excursion to Yosemite National Park. Behold awe-inspiring landscapes shaped by ancient glaciers, including thundering waterfalls, serene lakes, towering cliffs, and giant sequoia trees. Capture memorable views of Half Dome, El Capitan, and Yosemite Falls. After an adventurous day in nature’s masterpiece, head back to San Francisco for a restful night.

package_itineraries.title: San Francisco to Las Vegas
package_itineraries.description: Catch a morning flight to the dazzling city of Las Vegas. Upon arrival, check in and later gear up for an exciting evening city tour. Witness the iconic Bellagio Dancing Fountains, the vibrant Fremont Street light show, Pirate Ships at Treasure Island, and the stunning views from the Stratosphere Tower. Soak in the city’s electric atmosphere before heading back for an overnight stay in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Leisure or Optional Grand Canyon Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your day at leisure or join the optional Grand Canyon Tour by bus or air. Marvel at the vast natural wonder and experience the thrilling Skywalk. In the evening, you can opt for the Las Vegas Night Flight—an exhilarating helicopter ride over the glittering Strip—or attend one of Vegas’s many live shows. Overnight in Las Vegas.

package_itineraries.title: Las Vegas to Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Los Angeles, the entertainment capital of the world. Embark on a scenic city tour covering top attractions such as Hollywood, the Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, Sunset Strip, Grauman’s Chinese Theater, Rodeo Drive, and China Town. After exploring the star-studded city, unwind with an overnight stay in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Universal Studios Tour
package_itineraries.description: Step into the world of movies with a full-day visit to Universal Studios. Enjoy thrilling rides, live-action shows, and behind-the-scenes movie experiences. This working studio lets you see where magic is made and gives you a taste of Hollywood like never before. Stay overnight in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: San Diego – SeaWorld Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Today’s adventure takes you to SeaWorld in San Diego, home to thrilling marine life shows, rides, and interactive exhibits. Brave the water coaster through Atlantis, ride a virtual copter to the Wild Arctic, and get up close with dolphins, sea lions, and orcas. After a fun-filled day, return to your Los Angeles hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Disneyland Magic
package_itineraries.description: Delight in a magical day at Disneyland, where fairy tales come to life. Wander through the enchanting Main Street USA, meet beloved characters, and enjoy classic rides and shows. The park’s immersive atmosphere promises fun for all ages. Overnight at your hotel in Los Angeles.

package_itineraries.title: Departure from Los Angeles
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a relaxed morning followed by checkout. Proceed to the airport for your onward journey, bringing an end to your memorable Western Explorer Tour Package experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Anchorage
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Anchorage Airport, you will be greeted and transferred to your hotel. After checking in, the remainder of the day is free for you to relax or explore at your own pace. Enjoy your first night in the comfort of your Anchorage hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Scenic Journey from Anchorage to Talkeetna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and make your way to the Anchorage Railway Station. Board the renowned Alaska Railroad en route to Talkeetna. During this breathtaking ride, take in sweeping views from large panoramic windows, with chances to see native wildlife and the impressive silhouette of Mt. Denali. Upon arrival in Talkeetna, you'll be transferred to your hotel. In the afternoon, set out on the Talkeetna Wilderness Jet Boat Safari—a thrilling ride that offers close encounters with bald eagles, moose, beavers, and possibly bears in their natural surroundings. Overnight stay in Talkeetna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Talkeetna to Denali by Rail
package_itineraries.description: Today, depart from your hotel and head to Talkeetna Railway Station for your train ride to Denali. Enjoy another scenic rail journey as you travel through Alaska’s stunning backcountry and over Broad Pass—the highest point on the Alaska Railroad at 2,363 feet—while keeping your eyes open for wildlife and Mt. McKinley in the distance. Upon reaching Denali, you will be taken to your hotel. In the evening, consider an optional glacier flightseeing excursion or even a glacier landing for an unforgettable aerial experience. Rest overnight at your hotel in Denali.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Toronto to Ottawa – Scenic VIA Rail Journey
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with the unforgettable Denali Tundra Wilderness Tour. This narrated experience travels deep into Denali National Park, where you'll witness stunning landscapes and an abundance of wildlife. Be on the lookout for moose, wolves, caribou, Dall sheep, and grizzly bears. Led by a certified naturalist driver, this 53-mile journey offers not only amazing animal sightings but also fascinating commentary on the park’s history, ecology, and geology. After a day immersed in nature, return to your Denali hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Denali to Anchorage
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a relaxed morning before checking out. You’ll then proceed to Anchorage Airport for your onward flight or the next chapter of your journey. Let the memories of your Denali tour package adventure stay with you forever.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Orlando
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in the lively and dynamic city of Orlando! As the sixth largest city in Florida and the biggest inland city in the state, Orlando has become a top destination for family fun, drawing over 52 million tourists every year. With world-famous attractions like Disney World, it truly lives up to its reputation as a magical getaway. Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to your hotel for check-in and an overnight stay in Orlando.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: A Magical Day at Walt Disney Magic Kingdom
