Sovereign Hill Gold Rush Experience (Morning): Available on Mon, Tue, Thu, Sat. Departs at 8 am and ends at 5:30 pm. Step into the 1850s Gold Rush at Sovereign Hill. Puffing Billy & Yarra Valley Wineries (Morning): Operates on Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun. Departs at 8 am. Enjoy a steam train ride and visit premium wineries. Puffing Billy & Healesville Wildlife (Morning): Runs on Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun. Departs at 8 am. Combine a train ride with a visit to Healesville Sanctuary. Return to your Melbourne hotel for an overnight stay after your chosen excursion.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Melbourne to Brisbane/Gold Coast
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your Melbourne hotel and head to Tullamarine Airport for your flight to Brisbane or Gold Coast. Upon arrival, transfer to your Gold Coast hotel and spend the night at your leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Full Day at Movie World
package_itineraries.description: Spend an exciting day at Movie World, enjoying thrilling rides and attractions inspired by blockbuster films. After a fun-filled day, return to your Gold Coast hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Explore Sea World
package_itineraries.description: Devote your day to Sea World – an oceanarium, marine sanctuary, and amusement park. Experience marine life exhibits and thrilling rides. (Combo Ticket - No Refund if 1 Park Used or Lost). Optionally, you can replace either Movie World or Sea World with Dreamworld for an additional AUD 20 per adult and AUD 10 per child (Return SIC). Stay overnight at your Gold Coast hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Gold Coast/Brisbane to Cairns
package_itineraries.description: Check out and head to the airport for your flight to Cairns. Upon arrival, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. Spend the rest of your day exploring at your pace. Overnight stay in Cairns.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Full-Day Big Cat Cruise to Green Island
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a full-day cruise to Green Island Reef aboard the Big Cat. Includes buffet lunch and your choice of either a semi-submarine and glass-bottom boat tour or snorkelling gear (Package 4). You can upgrade to the Sunlover Outer Barrier Reef Cruise for AUD 70 (adult) / AUD 50 (child) or to Reef Magic Outer Barrier Reef Cruise for AUD 75 (adult) / AUD 40 (child). Stay overnight at your Cairns hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Choose Your Cairns Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Today, choose a full-day SIC Kuranda Tour, including a one-way Skyrail ride (excluding Diamond Gondola), leisure time at Kuranda Village, and a return Scenic Rail journey (Gold Class not included). Optional upgrades include Diamond Gondola (AUD 18/adult, AUD 9/child) and Gold Class Rail (AUD 44/person). Note Skyrail closures: Oct 15, Oct 26, Dec 25. Scenic Rail closed: Oct 15–16, Nov 8–9, Dec 6–7, Dec 25. Optionally, add Tjapukai Cultural Park or Rainforestation with Pamagirri Dance & Army Duck Tour (AUD 50/adult, AUD 35/child). Or, choose the Full-Day SIC Cape Tribulation & Daintree Wilderness Tour with lunch (AUD 35/adult, AUD 20/child). This tour does not run on Dec 25, Jan 1, or February. Return to your Cairns hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Cairns to Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and head to Cairns Airport for your flight to Sydney. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Half-Day Sydney City Tour & More
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, join a complimentary SIC Half-Day City Tour featuring Sydney Opera House, Harbour Bridge, and Manly Beach. Ends at 11:45 near Darling Harbour/Circular Quay (no hotel drop-off). Later, use your Combo 2 Pass to visit Sea Life Aquarium and Sydney Tower Eye with a 4D experience (transfers not included). In the evening, head to King Street Wharf #5 between 6:50 pm – 7:00 pm for the Sydney ShowBoat Indian Dinner Cruise (standard seating). The cruise doesn’t operate on Tuesdays, Sundays, Note: Jain meals are not available. Stay overnight at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Select a Full-Day Sydney Tour
package_itineraries.description: Choose one of the following SIC Full-Day Blue Mountains Tours (limited hotel pickup from 7:00 to 7:50 am depending on location): Option 1: Blue Mountains with Wildlife Park & Scenic World Rides. Operates 8 am to 6 pm. Option 2: Blue Mountains with Wildlife Park, Scenic World Rides & Lunch. From 8 am to 6 pm. Option 3: Blue Mountains with Wildlife Park, 2-Course Lunch & River Cruise. Ends at Darling Harbour or Circular Quay. Hotel pickup is mandatory and non-refundable for all. Return to your Sydney hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Departure from Sydney
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to Sydney Airport for your onward flight. Transfer service is available for domestic flights departing after 7 am and international flights after 8 am. If departing earlier, private transfer charges will apply.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Nadi International Airport and complete the formalities at Immigration and Customs. Exit the hall to a warm Fijian welcome with shell leis, fresh towels, and bottled water from our local representative. Visit the nearby office for a short briefing and to collect your travel vouchers. Then meet your driver and proceed via a seat-in-coach transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure and rest overnight at Yatule Resort & Spa.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Leisure at Yatule Resort & Spa
package_itineraries.description: Today is yours to explore or unwind as you please. Enjoy the serene beach or explore local culture at your own pace. Overnight stay at Yatule Resort & Spa.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Free Day in Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Another day to explore the island freely. Whether it’s lounging at the beach, engaging in water activities, or exploring nearby attractions, enjoy your stay. Overnight at Yatule Resort & Spa.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Relax and Unwind in Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Spend a relaxing day at the resort. Enjoy the tranquil surroundings or opt for optional excursions. (Breakfast included.) Overnight at Yatule Resort & Spa.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: From Fiji to Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Check out in the morning and proceed to Nadi Airport for your flight to Singapore. Upon arrival at Changi International Airport, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. After checking in, the rest of the day is free. Optional: In the evening, consider visiting the renowned Night Safari – the world’s first nocturnal zoo. Return to your hotel for the night. (Breakfast included.)

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Discover Singapore at Your Pace
package_itineraries.description: Today is reserved for self-exploration. For an unforgettable experience, consider visiting Gardens by the Bay. This lush, award-winning park features breathtaking waterfront views and an expansive collection of plants across 101 hectares. Spend another night at your hotel in Singapore.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Your journey concludes as you check out and transfer to Changi International Airport for your flight home or your next destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Melbourne
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Melbourne Tullamarine Airport, proceed to your hotel via transfer. After check-in, the rest of the day is yours to relax or explore at your own pace. Enjoy your overnight stay in Melbourne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Melbourne – Half-Day City Discovery
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a guided half-day city tour of Melbourne. Limited hotel pickups are available between 7:00 AM and 7:50 AM. After the tour, choose between two experiences: a one-hour guided tour of the Melbourne Cricket Ground (available 10:00 AM–3:00 PM on non-event days), or take a leisurely walk to Southgate Art & Leisure Precinct for a 1-hour Yarra River cruise (final departure between 3:00–3:30 PM). Return to the hotel independently and stay overnight in Melbourne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Melbourne – Great Ocean Road or Phillip Island
package_itineraries.description: Today, choose from two exciting full-day SIC tours: A full-day Great Ocean Road tour departing at 8:00 AM and returning after 8:00 PM. Or, opt for a full-day SIC tour to Phillip Island, departing at 1:00 PM, with opportunities to view penguins, kangaroos, and koalas, returning after 9:30 PM. Spend the night at your Melbourne hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Melbourne to Brisbane – Onward to Tangalooma
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head to Melbourne Airport for an early flight to Brisbane. Arrive by 7:30 AM (International) or 8:40 AM (Domestic) and continue to Holt Street Wharf. Check-in by 9:30 AM for the 10:00 AM launch to Tangalooma Island Resort on Moreton Island (subject to weather/tide). The remainder of the day is free to explore optional island activities. In the evening, witness the Wild Dolphin Feeding session (weather permitting). Overnight at Tangalooma Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Tangalooma to Gold Coast
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast and enjoy the Desert Safari & Sand Tobogganing tour. Later, catch the 4:00 PM launch back to Holt Street Wharf in Brisbane. From there, travel to Gold Coast by Hotel Conxions SIC transfer and check into your hotel. Overnight stay in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Gold Coast – Dream World Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a full day of fun and adventure at Dream World, packed with thrilling rides and entertainment. Return to your hotel in the evening for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Gold Coast – Wildlife & Marine Parks
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a Half-Day Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary tour to explore native Australian animals. In the afternoon, visit SeaWorld for marine life exhibits, exciting rides, and shows. Return to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Gold Coast – Movie World Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Spend your day at Movie World, home to movie-themed rides, live shows, and attractions. Enjoy a day of cinematic excitement before returning to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Gold Coast to Cairns
package_itineraries.description: After checking out from your Gold Coast hotel, transfer to Brisbane or Gold Coast Airport for your flight to Cairns. Upon arrival, proceed to your Cairns hotel for check-in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure and relax overnight. (Breakfast included)

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Cairns – Green Island Reef Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Embark on the Big Cat Cruise to Green Island, which includes a buffet lunch and a choice between a semi-submarine ride or a glass-bottom boat tour. Snorkelling gear is also available for underwater exploration. Optional upgrades are available for cruises to SunLover or Reef Magic Outer Barrier Reefs. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay. (Breakfast and Lunch included)

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Cairns – Kuranda or Daintree Option
package_itineraries.description: Choose a full-day SIC tour to Kuranda, including one-way Sky Rail and one-way Scenic Railway (Diamond Gondola excluded). Explore Kuranda Village at your leisure. Alternatively, opt for a full-day SIC tour to Cape Tribulation and the Daintree Wilderness with lunch at an additional supplement. Spend the night at your hotel in Cairns.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Cairns to Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your Cairns hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight to Sydney. Upon arrival, proceed to your Sydney hotel for check-in. The rest of the day is at leisure. Overnight stay in Sydney.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Sydney – City Tour & Attractions
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a morning Sydney City Tour that includes highlights like the Opera House, Harbour Bridge, and Manly Beach. This complimentary, non-refundable tour concludes by 11:45 AM at Darling Harbour or Circular Quay, without hotel drop-off. Later, make your way to Sea Life Aquarium to use your Combo 2 Pass, which grants access to the Aquarium and the Sydney Tower Eye with its 4D Experience. Transfers are not included. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Sydney – Full Day Tour Options
package_itineraries.description: Choose from the following two full-day SIC tours (hotel pickups limited to select locations between 7:00 AM and 7:50 AM): A full-day Blue Mountains tour with a Wildlife Park visit and Scenic World rides. Pickup is mandatory and non-refundable. Or, a similar Blue Mountains tour that includes lunch, wildlife interaction, and Scenic World rides. Also non-refundable with mandatory pickup. After a full day of exploration, return to your hotel in Sydney.

package_itineraries.title: Day 15: Departure from Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to Sydney Airport for your flight. This service is valid for departures after 7:00 AM (Domestic) or 8:00 AM (International). Early transfers may incur a surcharge. Carry with you the cherished memories of your Australian adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nadi – Journey to Likuliku
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Nadi International Airport, complete immigration and customs, and receive a traditional Fijian welcome with shell leis, minted towels, and bottled water. You’ll be taken to Port Denarau, where you’ll board a catamaran bound for Likuliku Lagoon Resort. Check in and enjoy a relaxing night with all meals included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: At Likuliku Lagoon Resort
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a range of inclusions: All meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner) Refreshing welcome drinks and leis Twice-daily bottled water in your bure Access to non-motorised water sports: paddle skis, catamarans, snorkeling, windsurfing Gym access and weekly cocktail party Wi-Fi hotspot availability

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Likuliku Lagoon Resort
package_itineraries.description: Continue your stay with the same inclusions and experiences. Lounge on the beach, join in water activities, or enjoy resort amenities. Another overnight stay in paradise awaits.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Transfer to Denarau Island
package_itineraries.description: Today, optional experiences include jet boat rides on the Nadi River, parasailing, river safaris, and more. As night falls, explore Denarau’s local nightlife at popular venues like PURPLE HAZE or ICE BAR. Overnight at Denarau Resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Denarau Island
package_itineraries.description: Check out early for your transfer to Nadi International Airport to catch your departing flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing in Auckland, you’ll be warmly welcomed by our tour representatives at the airport. They’ll assist you with your transfer and hotel check-in. Once settled, enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Auckland's Iconic Sights
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a visit to Viaduct Harbour, then head to the Harbour Bridge for incredible views. Finish the day at the Michael Joseph Savage Memorial for panoramic scenes of the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Journey from Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo
package_itineraries.description: Travel through the Waikato region to the Waitomo Caves for a magical glowworm boat tour. Later, continue to Rotorua, a city famous for geothermal activity and Maori heritage.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rotorua’s Wonders and Maori Culture
package_itineraries.description: Explore Te Puia’s geysers, experience farm life at Agrodome, and meet native wildlife. Conclude the evening with a traditional Maori Hangi feast and cultural performance.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Rotorua to Christchurch
package_itineraries.description: Board a domestic flight and head to Christchurch, the largest city in the South Island. Spend the day unwinding and soaking in its serene, garden-filled setting.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Mount Cook and Queenstown
package_itineraries.description: Drive through scenic valleys and lakes to reach Mount Cook. Then, head onward to Queenstown—a lively town known for its vineyards, lakes, and adventure sports.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: From New Zealand to Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Depart New Zealand and arrive in Fiji. Discover the Garden of the Sleeping Giant, home to vibrant orchids and tropical flora. Rest in this new island paradise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Explore Local Culture in Fiji
package_itineraries.description: Visit Viseisei Village, one of Fiji’s oldest settlements, or relax by the ocean. Enjoy the local lifestyle and warm island hospitality.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure from Fiji
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your accommodation and head to the airport, concluding your enriching and romantic journey across New Zealand and Fiji.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Brisbane/Gold Coast Arrival
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at either Brisbane or Gold Coast Airport by 10:00 AM. Transfer to your hotel. Optional afternoon jet boat ride and fire truck tour (transfers not included). Overnight in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Dream World Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Spend a fun-filled day at Dream World. Enjoy rides and attractions before returning to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Wildlife Encounters & SeaWorld
package_itineraries.description: Visit Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary in the morning, followed by an afternoon trip to SeaWorld. Enjoy animal exhibits and marine-themed attractions. Overnight in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Movie World Excitement
package_itineraries.description: Experience Movie World with return transfers and a souvenir gift combo. Immerse in the entertainment and thrill. Overnight in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Travel to Hamilton Island
package_itineraries.description: Fly from Brisbane to Hamilton Island. Enjoy complimentary resort activities like snorkeling, catamarans, and the Island Shuttle. Overnight on Hamilton Island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Whitehaven Beach Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Visit Wildlife Hamilton Island in the morning, followed by a half-day cruise to Whitehaven Beach. Overnight stay on the island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Great Barrier Reef Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Full-day reef cruise with lunch. Discover the vibrant underwater world before returning to your Hamilton Island resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Hamilton to Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Sydney and transfer to your hotel. Arrive by evening and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Hop-On Hop-Off & Showboat Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Explore Sydney at your pace with a hop-on hop-off bus ticket. In the evening, enjoy an Indian vegetarian dinner aboard the Sydney ShowBoat Cruise. Overnight in Sydney.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Iconic Sights & Attractions
package_itineraries.description: Visit Sydney Opera House for a guided tour. Later, redeem your Combo 4 Pass at Sea Life Aquarium for access to top attractions like Madame Tussauds and Sydney Tower Eye. Return independently to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Departure from Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport. Departure transfers valid only for later flights (after 7:00 AM domestic or 8:00 AM international).

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Auckland
package_itineraries.description: Once you arrive in Auckland, seat-in-coach passengers will be greeted by a local representative for transfer to the hotel. If you’re self-driving, collect your rental car at the airport and head to your accommodation. Overnight in Auckland.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Auckland to Rotorua via Waitomo
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast, then head south to explore the famous Waitomo Glowworm Caves. After your guided tour, continue through the Mamaku Ranges to Rotorua. Stay overnight in Rotorua.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Discover Rotorua
package_itineraries.description: Visit Te Puia Thermal Reserve, Rainbow Springs, and the Agrodome. Enjoy a free afternoon followed by a Maori Hangi feast and cultural show in the evening. Dinner included. Overnight in Rotorua.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Rotorua to Napier (Approx. 219km)
package_itineraries.description: Journey past Lake Taupo and into the East Coast to the art-deco city of Napier. Overnight at a local hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Napier Leisure Day
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at leisure. Optional tours include walking or vintage car tours of Napier. In the afternoon, enjoy a wine tour and tastings at three wineries. Overnight in Napier.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Napier to Wellington (Approx. 322km)
package_itineraries.description: Drive through Manawatu Gorge and Palmerston North, arriving in the capital city of Wellington. Overnight in Wellington.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Wellington
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head to Wellington Airport or return your rental car. Your unforgettable North Island experience comes to a close.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Melbourne
package_itineraries.description: Land in Melbourne and transfer to your hotel. Enjoy a leisurely day. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Melbourne City Tour & Optional Activities
package_itineraries.description: Explore Melbourne on a half-day city tour. Afterwards, choose between a guided MCG tour or a Yarra River Cruise. Return to the hotel at your convenience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Full Day Tour of Your Choice
package_itineraries.description: Pick from the Great Ocean Road or Phillip Island Penguin Parade. Return to Melbourne for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Fly to Gold Coast via Brisbane
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your flight to Brisbane or Gold Coast. On arrival, explore local attractions like a thrilling Jet Boat ride or a Fire Truck Tour. Overnight in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Full Day at Dreamworld
package_itineraries.description: Spend an action-packed day at Dreamworld, enjoying roller coasters and wildlife shows. Overnight in Gold Coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Wildlife & Seaworld Combo
package_itineraries.description: Visit Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary in the morning, then explore Seaworld in the afternoon with its marine exhibits and thrilling rides. Return to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Movie World Adventures
package_itineraries.description: Experience the cinematic thrills of Movie World with themed rides and attractions. Return to your hotel by evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Journey to Hamilton Island
package_itineraries.description: Fly from Brisbane to Hamilton Island. Check in at your resort and enjoy access to water sports and the island shuttle. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Great Barrier Reef Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day cruise to the Great Barrier Reef. Enjoy a buffet lunch onboard. Return to the resort for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Whitehaven Beach Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Choose from a morning or afternoon half-day tour to Whitehaven Beach. Spend the rest of your day relaxing at the resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Fly to Sydney
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Sydney. On arrival, check in to your hotel. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Sydney City & Aquarium Visit
package_itineraries.description: Take a half-day tour of Sydney including key landmarks. Later, visit Sea Life Aquarium and Sydney Tower Eye. In the evening, enjoy an Indian dinner cruise aboard the Sydney ShowBoat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Full Day Blue Mountains Tour
package_itineraries.description: Choose between two full-day tour options to the Blue Mountains, both including Scenic World and a Wildlife Park, with or without lunch. Return to Sydney for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Departure from Sydney
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight home, concluding your 14-day exploration of Australia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Saigon – Immersive Saigon City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Saigon, now officially Ho Chi Minh City – a vibrant, bustling heart of Vietnam. Upon landing, transfer to the city centre for hotel check-in. In the evening, begin your sightseeing with the iconic Reunification Palace, an important historical site from the Vietnam War, now preserved as a museum and event venue. Just a short walk away lies the French colonial-era Central Post Office, a masterpiece of architecture. Continue your stroll along Nguyen Hue Street, snapping photos of the Opera House and Ho Chi Minh Committee building (viewed from outside). End the day with a visit to the lively Ben Thanh Market, a true cultural hub where you can explore local crafts and flavours. Overnight stay in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Saigon – Mekong Delta Adventure – Saigon
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off for My Tho in the Mekong Delta. Board a boat to cruise the mighty Mekong River, passing riverside villages and lush landscapes. Stop at one of the four islands to explore its charm before switching to smaller rowboats, drifting along coconut-lined canals. Visit local workshops to taste honey tea, observe coconut candy-making, and walk through fragrant fruit gardens. Experience a relaxing horse-cart ride through peaceful village lanes before enjoying lunch at a riverside restaurant, sampling the local speciality – Elephant Ear fish. On your return to Saigon, visit Vinh Trang Pagoda, famed for its blend of Chinese, Cambodian, and French architecture. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels Exploration – Flight to Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning at the Cu Chi Tunnels, an extraordinary 200-km underground network used by Vietnamese fighters during the war. Gain insight into the resourcefulness and resilience of those who lived here, and, if you wish, crawl through a short tunnel section. In the afternoon, transfer to the airport for your flight to Siem Reap. Upon arrival, meet your local guide for a hotel transfer. The rest of the evening is at leisure. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Full-Day Angkor Temple Discovery
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, step into the ancient world of Angkor. Begin at the South Gate of Angkor Thom, once the royal city of the Khmer Empire, and visit Bayon Temple, a fascinating structure with its serene stone faces. Explore the Terrace of the Elephants, the Terrace of the Leper King, Baphuon, and the Royal Palace area, including Phimeanakas Temple. Wander through Ta Prohm, a photogenic site where massive tree roots intertwine with the temple’s stone walls. In the afternoon, marvel at Angkor Wat, the largest religious monument in the world, with its five lotus-shaped towers, detailed carvings, and graceful Apsara dancers etched into the stone. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi – Cultural Introduction
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Noi Bai Airport and transfer to your hotel. Begin your exploration at the Temple of Literature, built in 1070, followed by a photo stop at Ba Dinh Square to view Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum from outside. Stroll by Hoan Kiem Lake, visit Ngoc Son Temple, and enjoy a cyclo ride around the Old Quarter. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Halong Bay Day Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Travel through the Red River Delta to reach Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Board a wooden junk boat to sail past formations like Stone Dog and Fighting Cock. Enjoy a seafood lunch before visiting Thien Cung Cave or relaxing on board. Return to Hanoi in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi to Saigon – Evening Tour
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Saigon and check into your hotel. Visit the Reunification Palace, pass European-inspired landmarks, and see Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mekong Delta Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Cruise along the Mekong River, visit tropical gardens, listen to traditional folk music, and ride small boats through coconut groves. Explore local workshops and enjoy a horse-cart ride before visiting Vinh Trang Pagoda. Return to Saigon for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Saigon City Tour – Flight to Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Tour the Reunification Palace, City Hall, Opera House, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and the Central Post Office before flying to Siem Reap. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Angkor Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Visit the South Gate of Angkor Thom, Bayon Temple, Terrace of the Leper King, and Ta Prohm. In the afternoon, explore Angkor Wat. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before transferring to the airport for your flight home or onward travel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, transfer to your Siem Reap hotel and refresh before beginning your journey with a visit to East Mebon, Neak Poan, and Prasat Preah Khan. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Apsara Dance performance during dinner. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Temples of Angkor
package_itineraries.description: Witness a magical sunrise before heading to the Angkor archaeological area. Explore Banteay Srei, Banteay Samre, Ta Prohm, Banteay Kdei, Prasat Kravan, Chau Say Tevoda, and Thommanon. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: More Angkor Wonders
package_itineraries.description: Visit Bayon Temple, Baphuon Temple, and Angkor Thom. Continue to the Terrace of the Elephants, Terrace of the Leper King, and Phnom Bakheng before enjoying dinner back in Siem Reap. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: To Sihanoukville via Phnom Penh
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Phnom Penh, then drive to Sihanoukville. Check in and relax before enjoying water activities such as snorkelling, diving, or kayaking at nearby islands. Overnight in Sihanoukville.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bamboo Island Day Trip
package_itineraries.description: Sail to Bamboo Island for swimming, sunbathing, and water sports before returning to Sihanoukville. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Phnom Penh City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Phnom Penh to visit the Royal Palace, Silver Pagoda, Independence Monument, and the National Museum. Overnight in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Before heading to the airport, visit the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum. Depart for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Phnom Penh – Discover the City’s Historic Heart
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Phnom Penh International Airport, our friendly representative will welcome you and assist with your hotel transfer. After checking in and freshening up, your exploration begins. Your first stop will be the iconic Royal Palace of Cambodia – a splendid complex that serves as the official residence of the King. Just south of the palace lies the dazzling Silver Pagoda, home to an impressive life-sized gold Buddha decorated with over 2,000 diamonds. Continue to the Independence Monument, built to commemorate Cambodia’s liberation from French colonial rule, before visiting the National Museum of Cambodia, the country’s largest repository of cultural treasures. Stroll past the picturesque river-front park, where four rivers meet, and finish your day at Wat Phnom, a serene hilltop Buddhist temple steeped in local legend. Overnight stay in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phnom Penh – Heritage & Local Markets
package_itineraries.description: Begin your morning with a visit to the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum, a deeply moving site that tells the tragic story of Cambodia’s recent history. Once a school, it was converted into Security Prison 21 by the Khmer Rouge between 1975 and 1979. Afterwards, shift to a lighter mood with a shopping excursion at the Russian Market – one of the city’s most vibrant hubs for local handicrafts. Browse through silk fabrics, Buddha statues, wooden carvings, jewellery, paintings, and more. End the day with a hearty dinner before returning to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Phnom Penh to Siem Reap – Journey into Ancient Wonders
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, take a short flight to Siem Reap, the gateway to the legendary temples of Angkor. Upon arrival and hotel check-in, your temple exploration begins. Marvel at Prasat Kravan, known for its exquisite brick sculptures, admire the peaceful beauty of Srah Srang, and visit the intricately carved Banteay Srei, often called the “Citadel of Women.” Continue to Banteay Samre, a restored 11th-century temple, before heading to Wat Bo Pagoda, one of Siem Reap’s oldest and most significant religious sites. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Apsara dance performance at the Apsara Theatre while savouring a delicious dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Siem Reap – Biking Through the Ancient City
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore Siem Reap from a different perspective as you set off on a guided bike tour. Cycle your way to the legendary Angkor Wat complex, visiting iconic sites such as Angkor Thom, the South Gate, Bayon Temple, and the grand Baphuon Temple. Wander along the Terrace of the Elephants and the Terrace of the Leper King, both adorned with fascinating carvings. In the evening, immerse yourself in Siem Reap’s vibrant nightlife or shop for souvenirs at the Angkor Night Market. Treat yourself to a soothing foot massage before heading back to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Siem Reap – Sunrise & Floating Villages
package_itineraries.description: Rise early to witness a breathtaking sunrise over the Angkor area, followed by a scenic boat trip on Tonle Sap Lake, the largest freshwater lake in Southeast Asia. Observe the unique floating villages and the traditional lifestyle of the locals. Before departing, visit Artisans Angkor to discover the artistry behind traditional Khmer crafts. Later, transfer to the airport for your onward journey, marking the end of your unforgettable Cambodia holiday tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Saigon – Evening City Sights
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Saigon and check into your hotel. Visit the Reunification Palace, Central Post Office, Nguyen Hue Street, the Opera House, and Ben Thanh Market. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Mekong Delta Experience
package_itineraries.description: Cruise along the Mekong River, visit local islands, enjoy tropical fruits and folk music, and ride small boats through shaded canals. Visit Vinh Trang Pagoda before returning to Saigon. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Cu Chi Tunnels – Flight to Phnom Penh
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Cu Chi Tunnels, then fly to Phnom Penh. Transfer to your hotel and relax. Overnight in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Phnom Penh Heritage & History
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Royal Palace, Silver Pagoda, Independence Monument, National Museum, Phnom Daun Penh, Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum, and the Russian Market. Overnight in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Check in and start with a visit to the Angkor complex, including Ta Prohm, Srah Srang, Banteay Kdei, Thommanon, and Chau Say Tevoda. Enjoy an Apsara Dance show with dinner. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Biking Adventure through Angkor
package_itineraries.description: Cycle to Angkor Wat and explore Bayon Temple, Angkor Thom South Gate, Baphuon Temple, the Royal Palace, and the Terraces of the Elephants and Leper King. Visit Phnom Bakheng for sunset views, then enjoy dinner and a foot massage in downtown Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Banteay Srei & Wat Bo
package_itineraries.description: Visit Banteay Srei Temple, take a Tonle Sap cruise to floating villages and crocodile farms, then explore Artisans Angkor and Wat Bo Pagoda. Dinner and overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Phnom Penh Arrival & City Discovery
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Phnom Penh, a captivating blend of traditional Khmer heritage and French colonial elegance, evident in its charming villas and leafy boulevards. Upon arrival, a representative will welcome you at the airport and assist with your hotel transfer. After a refreshing breakfast, begin your exploration at the magnificent Royal Palace complex, built in 1866, a symbol of Cambodia’s regal heritage. Continue to the glittering Silver Pagoda, also known as the Emerald Buddha Temple, adorned with statues in gold, silver, diamonds, and precious gemstones. Next, visit the Independence Monument before heading to the National Museum, a masterpiece of Khmer architecture housing over 5,000 rare artefacts crafted from bronze, silver, wood, copper, sandstone, and more. Enjoy a leisurely walk along the riverside park where four rivers, including the legendary Mekong, meet. Climb the sacred Phnom Daun Penh Hill for panoramic city views before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phnom Penh Highlights & Transfer to Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, delve into Cambodia’s somber past with a visit to Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum, once the infamous S-21 security camp during the Khmer Rouge era. Continue to the lively Russian Market for a shopping experience filled with local crafts and souvenirs. Later, proceed to the airport or bus station for your journey to Siem Reap. Upon arrival, meet your local representative for hotel transfer and rest overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Angkor Thom & Angkor Wat Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a visit to the South Gate of Angkor Thom, the grand entrance to the final capital of the Angkor Empire. Explore the impressive Bayon Temple, famed for its smiling stone faces, before walking along the Terrace of the Elephants and visiting the Baphuon Temple Mountain. Discover the Royal Palace area and the intricately carved Terrace of the Leper King. End the morning at the photogenic Ta Prohm, where massive tree roots entwine ancient stonework. In the afternoon, visit Angkor Wat, one of the world’s greatest architectural wonders, symbolizing the Hindu universe. Admire its five towering spires, intricate bas-reliefs, and depictions of celestial Apsara dancers. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Temples & Sunset Views
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, revisit the enchanting Ta Prohm before continuing to Angkor Wat for deeper exploration. Visit Preah Khan, known as “The Sacred Sword,” with its endless corridors and intricate carvings. Explore Neak Pean, a small but elegant island temple, and East Mebon, set atop a former island in the now-dry East Baray reservoir. Conclude at Pre Rup, a 10th-century temple-mountain offering breathtaking sunset views. Overnight stay in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Siem Reap City & Floating Villages
package_itineraries.description: Start with a visit to Wat Thmei, a memorial site with a glass stupa containing remains from the Khmer Rouge era. Continue to Les Artisans d’Angkor – Chantiers Ecole, preserving authentic Khmer handicrafts. After lunch, enjoy a traditional wooden boat ride to the Floating Villages of Tonle Sap, Asia’s largest freshwater lake. Visit Wat Bo Pagoda to admire wall paintings depicting the Reamker and shop for souvenirs at Psar Chars, the Old Market. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Phnom Penh
package_itineraries.description: Cambodia, home to the legendary Angkor Wat—the eighth wonder of the ancient world—offers much more than temples. This captivating Southeast Asian destination delights visitors with its lush landscapes, beautiful beaches, and delectable cuisine. Embark on this journey with the “Cambodia travel package” and immerse yourself in its rich heritage. Day 1: Arrival in Phnom Penh Upon landing at Phnom Penh International Airport, you’ll be greeted by a local tour representative who will assist with your transfer to the hotel. As you travel through the city, admire the charming blend of French colonial elegance and traditional Khmer architecture along scenic, tree-lined boulevards. After check-in and some relaxation, begin your exploration with iconic city landmarks such as the Royal Palace and Wat Phnom Daun Penh. Visit the Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum for a sobering look into Cambodia’s past, and marvel at the Silver Pagoda, renowned for its Temple of the Emerald Buddha adorned with gold, diamonds, and precious stones. Conclude your day at the National Museum, home to over 5,000 ancient Khmer artefacts crafted from bronze, wood, gold, silver, copper, and sandstone. Overnight in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phnom Penh City Sights and Silk Island Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Begin the morning with a visit to the former Tuol Sleng prison, now a moving Genocide Museum. Continue to the bustling Russian Market to browse for traditional handicrafts, souvenirs, and fashionable local wear. In the afternoon, set out for Silk Island, travelling along the Mekong River by boat. Pass traditional stilt houses, many of which have workshops underneath where artisans weave intricate silk fabrics. Later, enjoy a scenic Mekong River cruise, watching the sunset glow over the Royal Palace skyline. Overnight in Phnom Penh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Phnom Penh
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, it’s time to bid farewell to Cambodia as you transfer to the airport for your onward journey or continue your Asia adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Check in and enjoy an evening city tour including the Temple of Literature, Ba Dinh Square, Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum (exterior), and a cyclo ride around the Old Quarter. Visit Ngoc Son Temple by Hoan Kiem Lake. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Halong Bay Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Travel through Red River Delta villages to Halong Bay. Board a wooden boat to cruise past formations like Stone Dog, Incense Burner, and Fighting Cock. Explore Thien Cung Cave before returning to Hanoi. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi Heritage & Flight to Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Ho Chi Minh Complex, One Pillar Pagoda, Tran Quoc Pagoda, Hanoi Flag Tower, and Thang Long Citadel. Fly to Siem Reap. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Angkor Discovery
package_itineraries.description: See the South Gate of Angkor Thom, Bayon Temple, Terrace of the Elephants, Royal Palace, Phimeanakas, Terrace of the Leper King, and Ta Prohm. Visit Angkor Wat in the afternoon. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi – Evening City Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Noi Bai Airport, where you’ll be greeted and transferred to your hotel. In the evening, begin your exploration with a visit to the Temple of Literature, Vietnam’s first university built in 1070. Stroll through its serene gardens and admire well-preserved architecture that offers a glimpse into the country’s scholarly past. Continue to Hoan Kiem Lake and the Ngoc Son Temple, followed by a leisurely cyclo ride through Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi – Tam Coc & Hoa Lu – Return to Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel south to Ninh Binh, home to the scenic Tam Coc Caves and the ancient capital Hoa Lu. Glide along the waterways on a traditional sampan boat, passing limestone karsts that rise dramatically from emerald rice fields—earning the nickname “Halong Bay on land.” Visit the 10th-century temples of King Dinh and King Le, famed for their intricate wooden carvings. Enjoy lunch en route before returning to Hanoi for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi to Halong Bay Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before heading to the UNESCO-listed Halong Bay. Board a traditional vessel to cruise through a seascape dotted with limestone islands and hidden grottoes. Savor a seafood lunch on board, visit the Surprising Grotto, and choose between swimming or kayaking. Glide past floating villages and secluded islets before dining and spending the night aboard the boat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Halong Bay – Hanoi – Flight to Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Begin the morning with a visit to Luon Cave, a tranquil lagoon surrounded by cliffs. As you cruise back, pass iconic rock formations like Cock-Fighting Rock and Sail Island. Disembark at Halong Wharf and return to Hanoi for your flight to Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City). Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Saigon – Mekong Delta Excursion
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, journey to the Mekong Delta and embark on a boat cruise along the mighty river. Visit one of the area’s lush islands, ride through coconut-lined canals in small rowboats, and explore local workshops. Enjoy a horse-cart ride along peaceful village paths before visiting the ornate Vinh Trang Pagoda, blending Chinese, Cambodian, and French design elements. Return to Saigon for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels & City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore the legendary Cu Chi Tunnels, a 200km underground network used during the war for shelter, storage, and defense. Return to Saigon to visit the Reunification Palace and the War Remnants Museum, then view European-inspired landmarks like the City Hall and the Opera House from the outside. Stop at Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office before spending the night in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Saigon to Siem Reap – First Glimpse of Cambodia
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, fly to Siem Reap. Visit Wat Thmei, the “Killing Field” memorial with its striking glass stupa. Continue to Les Artisans d’Angkor – Chantiers École to discover the preservation of Khmer arts and crafts. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Siem Reap – Angkor Thom & Angkor Wat
package_itineraries.description: Explore the South Gate of Angkor Thom and marvel at the Terrace of the Elephants, Baphuon temple, Phimeanakas, and the Terrace of the Leper King. In the afternoon, visit the world-famous Angkor Wat, a stunning architectural masterpiece inspired by Hindu cosmology. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Siem Reap – Temples & Sunset
package_itineraries.description: Discover Ta Prohm, where giant tree roots entwine ancient stone walls. Visit Srah Srang royal bath, Thommanon temple, Preah Khan, Ta Som, and end the day at Pre Rup temple for a spectacular sunset view. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure from Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast before transferring to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Siem Reap International Airport, where you’ll be met and transferred to your hotel. Spend the afternoon unwinding or strolling around your neighbourhood. Later, explore highlights such as the Baray Big Pond and Les Artisans – Chantiers Ecoles, where you’ll witness the art of traditional Khmer crafts. Visit historical treasures including Bayon Temple, Ta Prohm Temple, and Prasat Preah Khan. End your day at the Pre Rup Temple, a striking Hindu monument dedicated to Lord Shiva. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Full-Day Angkor Wat Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Set out for the awe-inspiring Angkor Wat, spanning 402 acres. Built in the early 12th century under King Suryavarman II, the temple showcases intricate carvings and grand towers inspired by Mount Meru, the mythical home of the gods. Take time to appreciate the architecture and the serene spiritual atmosphere before returning to your hotel. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Floating Villages and City Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Today, visit the fascinating Floating Villages on Tonle Sap Lake, such as Chong Khneas, Kampong Phluk, and Prek Toal. These communities, with markets and houses on stilts, offer a glimpse into daily life on the water. Explore Wat Bo, a historic 18th-century pagoda adorned with rare Ramayana paintings, and Wat Thmei, home to a memorial stupa dedicated to Khmer Rouge victims. Spend the evening shopping at Psar Chars (Old Market) and sampling local street food. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Say farewell to Siem Reap as you head to the airport for your flight home or to carry on with your Cambodia journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Beijing
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Beijing International Airport, you’ll be warmly welcomed and escorted to your hotel. The rest of the day is free for you to relax or explore the city on your own. Overnight stay in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Beijing Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out for the Great Wall of China at Juyong Pass, a breathtaking stretch of the legendary fortification. Visit the Jade Factory before returning to the city for a Silk Factory tour. Along the way, pause to take photographs of the Olympic Stadium. Spend the night at your Beijing hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a visit to Tiananmen Square, followed by the grand Forbidden City, the largest collection of preserved ancient buildings in China. Explore its 8,706 rooms spread across 170 acres. Later, head to the Summer Palace, then enjoy some shopping time at Yaxiu Market. Overnight stay in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Beijing to Xian
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport or train station for your journey to Xi’an. Upon arrival, you’ll be greeted and taken to your hotel. In the afternoon, enjoy a city tour with stops at the City Wall (photo stop) and Big Wild Goose Pagoda Square, where you can watch the fountain show. Overnight in Xian.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Xian
package_itineraries.description: Today’s highlight is the Terra-cotta Warriors, a vast army of life-sized figures guarding the tomb of Emperor Qin Shi-Huang for over 2,000 years. Visit the Arts and Crockery Factory before enjoying free time at the bustling Muslim Bazaar. Chinese lunch included. Overnight stay in Xian.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Xian to Guilin
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a flight to Guilin, a city known for its scenic mountains, lakes, and caves. Transfer to your hotel upon arrival. Overnight stay in Guilin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Guilin
package_itineraries.description: Start with a visit to the Pearl Factory, then enjoy a two-hour Li River cruise surrounded by stunning limestone peaks. In the afternoon, explore Yangshuo West Street for shopping. Overnight in Guilin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Guilin to Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Take a morning flight to Shanghai. Meet your English-speaking guide at the airport and transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Shanghai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Tour the Jade Buddha Temple and Silk Factory before strolling along the Bund, famous for its colonial architecture. Head up to the 88th floor of the Jinmao Tower for panoramic city views and shop along Nanjing Road. Overnight stay in Shanghai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure from Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a ride on the magnetic train to Pudong International Airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Beijing International Airport, where you’ll be warmly greeted and transferred to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours to relax or explore at your own pace. Overnight stay in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Beijing
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off to witness one of the world’s most famous landmarks — the Great Wall of China at Juyong Pass. Visit a Jade factory to see exquisite craftsmanship, followed by a photo stop at the Olympic Stadium. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Discovering Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before heading out to explore Tiananmen Square, the grand Forbidden City, and the picturesque Summer Palace. Later, browse through the lively Xiushui Market. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Beijing to Xi’an
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, transfer to the airport or train station for your journey to Xi’an. Upon arrival, meet your guide for a transfer to the hotel. In the afternoon, enjoy a city tour featuring a photo stop at the City Wall. Overnight stay in Xi’an.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Xi’an to Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a visit to the famous Terracotta Warriors and a tour of a crockery factory. Afterward, transfer to the airport for your flight to Shanghai. Upon arrival, you’ll be taken to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Exploring Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: This morning, discover Shanghai’s highlights, including People’s Square, a Silk factory, the Shanghai Museum, and panoramic city views from the 88th floor of Jinmao Tower. End the tour at the iconic Bund before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit the Jade Buddha Temple and the bustling Taobao Market. Later, enjoy shopping along Nanjing Road. Overnight in Shanghai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure from Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast before transferring to the airport for your departure flight or continue with optional activities.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong – Transfer to Macao
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Hong Kong International Airport, proceed to the pier for a scenic ferry ride to the charming city of Macao. After arriving, check in at your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the surroundings on your own. Overnight stay in Macao.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Macao – Half-Day Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Start the morning with a guided half-day city tour, covering famous spots such as the Ruins of St. Paul’s, A-Ma Temple, a local Cake Shop, and the Macao Tower (Observation Deck ticket not included), followed by a visit to one of the city’s casinos. The remainder of the day is free for personal activities. Overnight stay in Macao.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Macao to Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: In the morning, head to the pier for a ferry transfer to Hong Kong. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight stay in Hong Kong. (B)

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hong Kong – Half-Day City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a half-day sightseeing trip featuring the Water Front, a Jewellery Workshop, and a bus journey up to Victoria Peak. The evening is yours to enjoy freely. Overnight stay in Hong Kong. Optional: Visit Madame Tussauds independently for USD 24 per person.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hong Kong – Full Day at Disneyland
package_itineraries.description: Spend an entire day at Hong Kong Disneyland, enjoying rides, themed attractions, parades, and character meet-and-greets. Cap off the experience with shopping and dining. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Hong Kong to Shenzhen
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the pier and take the ferry to Shenzhen. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and explore at your leisure. Overnight stay in Shenzhen.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Shenzhen – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today’s sightseeing includes Window of the World, Lianhua Park, a Bamboo Shop visit, and shopping at Luohu Mall. Overnight stay in Shenzhen.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Farewell to Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Begin your morning with a delicious breakfast. Afterward, transfer to the pier for your ferry ride to Hong Kong Airport. From here, board your flight for the journey back to your hometown, carrying with you wonderful memories of the trip.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Meet your tour representative upon arrival in Beijing and transfer to your hotel, where you’ll be welcomed with a refreshing drink. Later, view the Bird’s Nest (Olympic Stadium) and Water Cube from the outside. Overnight stay in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Beijing Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Visit Tian’anmen Square and the Forbidden City, once home to emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties. Stop at a pearl shop before heading to the Summer Palace to admire the Marble Boat and Long Corridor. In the evening, watch an exciting Kung Fu show. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Beijing to Shanghai by Train
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a visit to the Longdi Jade shop, then continue to the Great Wall at Juyong Pass. After this, transfer to the railway station for your train ride to Shanghai. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Start at the Shanghai Museum, then explore People’s Square and Nanjing Road. Visit the silk shop and Yuyuan Garden, followed by Yu Market. End the day with a Huangpu River Cruise to admire the city lights. Overnight in Shanghai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Spend your morning at leisure or shopping before heading to the airport for your departing flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Hong Kong Airport, meet your local representative and transfer to your hotel for check-in. The remainder of the day is free to relax. Overnight in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hong Kong City Delights
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a half-day city tour featuring the scenic Waterfront, an inspiring Jewellery Workshop, and a visit to Victoria Peak by bus. Spend the evening at leisure before returning to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leisurely Day in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and spend the entire day exploring the city at your own pace. Overnight in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Farewell to Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Hong Kong Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Hong Kong International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the day exploring nearby attractions — ride the cable car to Victoria Peak for panoramic city views, browse local flea markets, or visit Madame Tussauds. Sample the city’s bistros or fine-dining restaurants.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hong Kong Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Discover the city’s highlights, including Aberdeen Fishing Village, Repulse Bay, Tian Tan Buddha, Ngong Ping 360, and Nan Lian Garden. If time permits, visit Hong Kong Disneyland. Overnight in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hong Kong – Macau
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take the ferry to Macau. Known as the “Las Vegas of the East,” the city is famous for casinos, luxury hotels, and nightlife. Check in to your hotel and explore the area.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Macau – Full-Day Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Macau Tower Convention and Entertainment Centre, the Ruins of St. Paul’s, Senado Square, A-Ma Temple, and the Macao Giant Panda Pavilion. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Macau
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel back to Hong Kong for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Beijing

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Beijing Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Summer Palace, with its Marble Boat and Long Corridor, then shop for pearls. Continue to Tian’anmen Square and the Forbidden City. In the afternoon, take a rickshaw Hutong tour before exploring Houhai Lake. In the evening, watch a thrilling Kung Fu show. Overnight stay in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Beijing
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit the Great Wall at Juyong Pass, followed by the Longdi Jade shop. Stop by the Bird’s Nest and Water Cube for photos, shop at Yaxiu Market, and end the day with an acrobatic show. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Beijing

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Beijing and transfer to your hotel. The day is free for you to relax or explore the city. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Beijing Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Great Wall at Juyong Pass and learn about its rich history. Stop at the Jade Factory before heading to the Silk Factory in the city, and take a photo at the Olympic Stadium. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then tour Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City, with its sprawling 170-acre palace grounds and thousands of rooms once occupied by the imperial court. Continue to the Summer Palace and finish the day with shopping at Xiushui Market. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Beijing to Xian
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport or train station for your trip to Xi’an. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel before taking a city tour with a stop at the City Wall. Overnight in Xi’an.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Xian
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Terracotta Warriors and a pottery factory, then explore Bell Tower Square and enjoy shopping time. Lunch is included. Overnight in Xi’an.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Xi’an – Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Shanghai by flight or bullet train. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Explore Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Tour the Jade Buddha Temple, the Tian Hou Silk Factory, and the Bund’s colonial-era buildings. Visit the 88th floor of Jinmao Tower for city views, then shop along Nanjing Road. Overnight in Shanghai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Depart Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport after breakfast for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Meet your local representative at Hong Kong Airport and transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to explore. Overnight in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hong Kong – Half-Day Tour

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hong Kong – Ocean Park Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Spend a full day at Ocean Park, enjoying thrilling rides, aquariums, animal exhibits, shows, and scenic views. Overnight in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hong Kong – Lantau Island & Ngong Ping 360
package_itineraries.description: Take the cable car from Tung Chung to Ngong Ping, enjoying views of the South China Sea, North Lantau Country Park, Hong Kong International Airport, and the Big Buddha. Explore Ngong Ping Village, Po Lin Monastery, and Tai O fishing village. Overnight in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hong Kong – Leisure Day
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy the city at your own pace, exploring markets, shopping malls, or cultural spots. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Beijing

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Beijing
package_itineraries.description: Explore Tiananmen Square, the Forbidden City, and the Summer Palace. Shop at Yaxiu Market. Overnight in Beijing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Beijing to Zhangjiajie

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Zhangjiajie

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Zhangjiajie to Shanghai

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Xi’an to Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore the Terracotta Warriors and a crockery factory before flying to Shanghai. Transfer to your hotel and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Exploring Shanghai
package_itineraries.description: Join a full-day city tour covering People’s Square, a Silk factory, the Shanghai Museum, the 88th floor of Jinmao Tower, and the Bund. Enjoy shopping at Nanjing Road. Overnight in Shanghai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Shanghai

package_itineraries.title: Macao – Half-Day Sightseeing Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start the morning with a delicious breakfast before setting out on a fascinating half-day exploration of Macao. Discover some of the city’s most celebrated landmarks, including the historic Ruins of St. Paul’s, the serene A-Ma Temple, a charming Cake Shop, and the impressive Macao Tower (please note: Observation Deck admission not included). Round off the tour with a peek into the city’s vibrant casino culture. The rest of the day is free for you to explore on your own. Spend the night in comfort at your hotel in Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Macau to Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take the ferry to Hong Kong, check in to your hotel, and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Hong Kong – Morning City Tour

package_itineraries.title: Hong Kong – Full Day Disneyland Experience
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Hong Kong Disneyland, enjoying attractions, live shows, parades, and themed zones. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Departure from Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your return journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tokyo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Narita where our representatives will welcome you and escort you to your hotel by bus. Spend the night relaxing in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tokyo City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a guided exploration of Tokyo. Visit famous spots including Tokyo Tower, Akasaka Guest House, Meiji Shrine, and the National Diet Building. Continue to the Imperial Palace Plaza, East Garden, Ginza shopping hub, Tasaki Pearl Gallery, Asakusa Kannon Temple, and take a Sumida River Cruise. Stroll through Nakamise Street, Kappabashi, Ueno, and Akihabara. Return from Harajuku Station for an overnight stay in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hakone
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before travelling towards Mt. Fuji and Hakone. Explore Tomei Expressway-Fuji Skyline 5th Station with stunning views. Have lunch at Hakone Lake Hotel before riding the Hakone Sky Gondola and visiting Owakudani Valley. Take a Lake Ashi cruise before returning by motor coach to Tokyo for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Tokyo Station and board the express train to Kyoto. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and rest. In the afternoon, join a coach tour to see Helan Shrine, Kiyomizu Temple, and Sanjusangendo Hall. Travel to Osaka by JR Rapid Train and stay overnight in Osaka.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Osaka
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, prepare for your transfer to Kansai International Airport to board your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast and transfer once more to Kansai Airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Macau

Visit the world-famous Ruins of St. Paul’s Church and enjoy the lively atmosphere of Senado Square. Continue with a visit to the Portuguese Cathedral, Na Tcha Temple, and the beautiful A-Ma Temple, where history and spirituality blend seamlessly. Later, enjoy an authentic Indian dinner at a popular restaurant before moving to the Venetian Hotel for an elegant overnight stay in Macau.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Macau to Hong Kong

Complete the day with a visit to Madame Tussauds Hong Kong before returning to the hotel for the night.

See pandas, dolphins, sea lions, and a variety of other animals before enjoying thrilling rides. Conclude the day with an overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hong Kong Disneyland

In the evening, treat yourself to dinner at an Indian restaurant before heading back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Relish your last breakfast in Hong Kong, followed by free time for shopping across the bustling markets. In the evening, you will be dropped at the airport for your return journey.

package_itineraries.title: Macau to Hong Kong

package_itineraries.title: Hong Kong – Morning City Tour

package_itineraries.title: Hong Kong – Full Day Disneyland Experience

package_itineraries.title: Magical Day at Hong Kong Disneyland

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hong Kong – Half-Day City Tour

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Shenzhen – City Tour

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hong Kong Disneyland Delight
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off for Disneyland. Spend the day enjoying thrilling rides, themed zones, and encounters with beloved cartoon characters. As evening arrives, dine at an Indian restaurant before returning to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hong Kong City Exploration and Shenzhen Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before starting a half-day tour of Hong Kong Island. Visit Victoria Peak, the historic Man Mo Temple, and the scenic Aberdeen Fishing Village. package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Discover Shenzhen’s Treasures
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin with a visit to the Mineral Museum, home to fascinating exhibits. Explore the Terra-Cotta Warriors and continue to the bustling Bamboo Market. Visit the Window of the World park, featuring replicas of global wonders, before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay in Shenzhen.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Journey from Shenzhen to Macau
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel by ferry to Macau. The day is free for you to explore at leisure, enjoying the city’s historical attractions and lively streets. In the evening, enjoy dinner before heading to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Discover Macau’s Charms with Macau Tower
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast before embarking on a city tour of Macau. Explore Porto De Cerco, Kun Lam Temple, Penha Hill Church, and the Ruins of Sao Paulo. End with a visit to the impressive Macau Tower. After the tour, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Farewell to Macau, Hello to Hong Kong

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Hong Kong’s Ocean Park
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, spend the day at Ocean Park. Ride the scenic cable car, admire marine animals, and experience one of the world’s largest aquariums. Spot giant pandas, red pandas, dolphins, and more while enjoying thrilling attractions. Conclude your day with an overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hong Kong Disneyland
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast before heading to Hong Kong Disneyland. From fun-filled rides to beloved cartoon characters and vibrant shows, enjoy the magical ambience all day. In the evening, have dinner at an Indian restaurant before returning to the hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Hong Kong

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Hong Kong International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the day exploring nearby attractions — ride the cable car to Victoria Peak for panoramic city views, browse local flea markets, or visit Madame Tussauds. Sample the city’s bistros or fine-dining restaurants.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hong Kong Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Discover the city’s highlights, including Aberdeen Fishing Village, Repulse Bay, Tian Tan Buddha, Ngong Ping 360, and Nan Lian Garden. If time permits, visit Hong Kong Disneyland. Overnight in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hong Kong – Macau
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take the ferry to Macau. Known as the “Las Vegas of the East,” the city is famous for casinos, luxury hotels, and nightlife. Check in to your hotel and explore the area.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Macau – Full-Day Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Macau Tower Convention and Entertainment Centre, the Ruins of St. Paul’s, Senado Square, A-Ma Temple, and the Macao Giant Panda Pavilion. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Macau
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel back to Hong Kong for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Once you arrive at Hong Kong Airport, you will be greeted by a local representative who will escort you to your hotel for check-in. The rest of the day is free for leisure—take time to rest, stroll nearby attractions, or simply relax at the hotel. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hong Kong City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After a delicious breakfast, set out on a half-day sightseeing journey. Visit the scenic Waterfront, discover craftsmanship at a Jewellery Workshop, and enjoy panoramic views from Victoria Peak. The rest of the day is left open for shopping or personal exploration. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Farewell to Hong Kong – Hello, Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Today you will board a flight to Jeju Island, Korea’s largest volcanic island and a UNESCO World Natural Heritage site. Famous for its pleasant climate and stunning natural scenery, Jeju is known for beaches, cliffs, waterfalls, and lava caves. Recognised as a Global Geopark and one of the New 7 Wonders of Nature, the island offers a memorable welcome. Overnight stay at a hotel in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Discovering Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast and enjoy leisure time or join the optional West Jeju tour (available Mon/Wed/Fri). Highlights include Hyupjae Beach with its clear waters, Hanlim Park showcasing vast botanical gardens, and O’Sulloc Green Tea Field where you can learn about traditional Korean tea culture. The day ends with a hotel drop-off. Overnight stay in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Explore Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: This day is also free or can be used for an optional East Jeju tour (Tue/Thu/Sat). Experience horse-riding or visit the Horse Museum, explore Seongup Folk Village, and stop at Gwangchigi Beach. Watch the Woman Diver show, a UNESCO Intangible cultural heritage, and continue to Sunrise Peak, one of Jeju’s most famous UNESCO sites. The tour also includes Manjang Cave, Asia’s longest lava cave. Overnight stay in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Farewell to Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you will be transferred to the airport for your return journey home or onward connection, concluding your delightful trip.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Almaty
