package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Almaty airport, you will be greeted and transferred to your hotel. Complete the check-in process, take some time to relax, and in the evening, enjoy a delicious Indian dinner at a local restaurant. Spend the night at your hotel in Almaty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Almaty City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast before heading out for a guided city tour of Almaty. Visit key attractions such as the Palace of the President, Republic Square, Monument of Independence, Panfilov Park, Abai Square, Astana Square, Presidential Park, and the Palace of the Republic. Stop for a flavorful Indian lunch before returning to the hotel. In the afternoon, explore the Rakhat Chocolate Factory and the lively Zilyoni Bazaar, famous for chocolates, nuts, and souvenirs. Head back to your hotel and spend the evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Almaty – Meadows & Chimbulak Ski Resort
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a full-day excursion into the scenic mountains near Almaty. Begin with a stop at the stunning Medeo Gorge to admire the Trans-Ili Ala-Tau peaks. Continue to the Chimbulak Ski Resort, perched 2230 meters above sea level (note: cable car fee is not included). Take in the panoramic views, enjoy the fresh mountain air, and later return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Almaty Zoo & Family Park
package_itineraries.description: Relish breakfast at the hotel before visiting the famous Almaty Zoo, home to a wide variety of animals. Capture the exciting sights on camera before continuing to one of Kazakhstan’s largest family amusement parks for a fun-filled afternoon. Conclude the day with dinner and spend another restful night at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Almaty
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Almaty International Airport for your onward journey or return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Bounty Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival in Bali, you will be welcomed by our local representative at the airport and transferred to your hotel. After checking in and refreshing yourself, head to Benoa Port in the evening to board the Bounty Sunset Cruise. Glide along the waters of Benoa while enjoying a variety of culinary delights, traditional dance performances, and live music onboard. Conclude the evening with a delicious dinner on the cruise before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Nusa Penida Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a full-day excursion to Nusa Penida, one of Bali’s largest and most spectacular islands. Often referred to as the “Golden Egg of Bali,” Nusa Penida is home to dramatic cliffs, sacred temples, and turquoise lagoons that showcase the raw beauty of nature. Spanning nearly 200 square kilometers, this enchanting island promises breathtaking views and unforgettable experiences. Return to your hotel after a day of exploration.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tanjung Benoa Beach
package_itineraries.description: No trip to Bali is complete without soaking up the charm of its world-famous beaches. Spend your morning at Tanjung Benoa Beach, where you can bask under the sun, enjoy a peaceful walk along the shore, or indulge in water adventures such as jet skiing, parasailing, and banana boat rides. Later in the afternoon, unwind with a soothing two-hour spa session designed to rejuvenate your senses. Rest for the night at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Bali
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed to the airport for your onward journey, carrying along cherished memories of your Bali holiday.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Bali – Ayung River Rafting
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Bali, you will be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. Begin your journey with an adrenaline-pumping rafting experience on the Ayung River, the longest river in Bali. Surrounded by lush jungle and waterfalls, this thrilling activity is the perfect way to kickstart your holiday. After the adventure, relax at your hotel for the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tanjung Benoa Beach
package_itineraries.description: The second day is all about Bali’s beaches. Spend your time at Tanjung Benoa, enjoying sunbathing, walks along the shore, or watersports like jet skiing, parasailing, and banana boat rides. In the afternoon, unwind with a soothing spa therapy session. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Celuk – Mas Village – Elephant Cave – Kintamani – Ubud Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Bali’s cultural side by visiting Celuk, famous for silver and gold jewellery, and Mas Village, known for exquisite wooden carvings. Next, stop at Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave), a sacred archaeological site. Visit Tirta Empul, Bali’s holy water temple, before travelling to Kintamani to witness Mount Batur. Wrap up the day with shopping at Ubud’s bustling local market before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Bounty Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Head to Benoa Harbour in the evening to board the Bounty Sunset Cruise. Enjoy live entertainment, cultural shows, and a delicious dinner as you sail along Bali’s coastline, watching the sun dip below the horizon. Return to your hotel afterwards.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Ubud Monkey Forest – Waterbom Bali
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Ubud Monkey Forest, home to playful macaques and ancient temples nestled in greenery. Later, visit Waterbom Bali, the island’s premier water park filled with exciting rides and attractions. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Bali
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before checking out of your hotel. You will be transferred to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Bali - Bounty Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing in Bali, you’ll be greeted at the airport and transferred to your hotel. Enjoy a hearty lunch and relax at your resort before beginning your evening adventure. Board the Bounty Sunset Cruise at Benoa Port and sail across Bali’s stunning coastline while savoring a delicious buffet dinner, cultural performances, and live music. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Celuk Village - Mas Village - Elephant Cave - Kintamani - Ubud Village Tour
package_itineraries.description: Your cultural exploration starts at Celuk Village, famous for its exquisite gold and silver craftsmanship. Continue to Mas Village, renowned for masterfully carved wooden sculptures. Visit Goa Gajah, or Elephant Cave, an archaeological and spiritual landmark, followed by a scenic drive to Kintamani, where you can admire views of Mount Batur. Conclude your day at Ubud Market, a hub for local handicrafts and souvenirs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Transfer to Yogyakarta - Sultan Palace - Taman Sari Water Castle
package_itineraries.description: On the third day, take a flight from Bali to Yogyakarta, one of Indonesia’s cultural capitals. Start with a tour of the Sultan Palace, still serving as the royal residence of the Yogyakarta monarchy. Next, explore Taman Sari Water Castle, a historic retreat for the royal family known for its elegant blend of Javanese and European design.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Borobudur Temple
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day discovering Borobudur Temple, the world’s largest Buddhist monument. This UNESCO World Heritage Site, set amid lush greenery, features intricate carvings and towering stupas that reflect Indonesia’s spiritual and cultural depth. Return to your hotel and relax after a fulfilling day.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart from Yogyakarta
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and head to the airport to board your flight home, marking the end of your enriching journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Singapore – Gardens by the Bay – Marina Bay Sands
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Singapore and check into your hotel. Begin with Gardens by the Bay, a futuristic park filled with rare plants and iconic Supertree structures. Later, visit Marina Bay Sands, an architectural masterpiece offering attractions like a rooftop infinity pool, fine dining, and luxury shopping. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Botanic Gardens – Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Spend your morning at Singapore Botanic Gardens, a lush UNESCO World Heritage Site. Afterwards, explore the Singapore Zoo, home to thousands of species from around the world, making it a great family-friendly experience. Overnight stay in Singapore.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a full day at Universal Studios Singapore, a theme park packed with thrilling rides, shows, and attractions inspired by blockbuster films. Return to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Arrive at Bali – Celuk – Mas Village
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Bali and start with visits to Celuk Village, famous for its silver jewellery, and Mas Village, renowned for intricate wooden carvings. Later, check into your hotel for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Batubulan – Kintamani Volcano – Ubud Market
package_itineraries.description: Discover Batubulan Village, where traditional dance performances take place. Then, head to Kintamani for sweeping views of Mount Batur. Conclude your day at Ubud Market, picking up souvenirs and handicrafts. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Tanjung Benoa Beach
package_itineraries.description: Spend your day at Tanjung Benoa Beach, enjoying its calm waters and thrilling activities like parasailing, banana boat rides, and jet skiing. Later, relax with a rejuvenating spa treatment. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Bali
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your final breakfast before departing for the airport to catch your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Bali – Uluwatu Temple
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Bali, meet your tour assistant who will transfer you to the hotel for check-in and some time to refresh. After lunch, begin your journey with a visit to the famous Uluwatu Temple, dramatically perched on cliffs overlooking the Indian Ocean. This sacred temple is known for its strong spiritual significance and breathtaking sunsets. As evening approaches, continue to Jimbaran Beach for a delightful seafood dinner before heading back to your hotel for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Batubulan – Ubud Handicraft – Kintamani – Tampaksiring
package_itineraries.description: Start your day at Batubulan village, a hub for traditional Balinese dance performances, including the famous Barong and Keris show. Continue to Ubud to witness local handicrafts, wood carvings, and paintings made by skilled artisans. After exploring Ubud, travel to Kintamani village, where Mount Batur and its stunning caldera dominate the scenery. Later, visit Tampaksiring to explore Tirta Empul Temple, a holy site with natural springs believed to hold purifying powers. Return to your hotel for dinner and rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Transfer to Jakarta – Sunda Kelapa – Fatahillah Square – National Monument
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before flying to Jakarta. Upon arrival, you will be transferred to your hotel. Your city tour begins with Sunda Kelapa Harbour, once a bustling port for Dutch traders. Move on to Fatahillah Square in Old Town Jakarta, surrounded by historical buildings and the iconic Puppet Museum displaying figures from Asia and Europe. End your sightseeing at the National Monument (Monas), a striking landmark that represents the country’s fight for independence.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Taman Mini Indonesia Indah
package_itineraries.description: The fourth day is dedicated to exploring Taman Mini Indonesia Indah, a cultural theme park that showcases Indonesia’s diversity. Spread across 250 acres, this park features replicas of traditional houses, lush gardens, theatres, museums, and even an IMAX theatre. Each pavilion represents the rich heritage of the Indonesian provinces, giving you a complete insight into the country’s traditions and natural wealth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Shopping – Depart from Jakarta
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Jakarta’s vibrant shopping hubs. Choose from Pasar Santa, known for quirky finds, or Tanah Abang Market, the largest textile marketplace in Southeast Asia. After shopping, you will be dropped at the airport to board your flight for onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Singapore – Night Safari
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Changi Airport, you will be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. After settling in, the evening begins with a visit to the renowned Night Safari at Mandai Wildlife Reserve. As the world’s first nocturnal zoo, it offers a rare opportunity to see creatures like leopards, lions, and civets in their natural nighttime habitats.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Singapore City Tour – Gardens by the Bay – National Gallery – Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Singapore’s highlights. Wander through Gardens by the Bay, famous for its Supertree Grove and Cloud Forest Dome. Continue to the National Gallery Singapore, which showcases Southeast Asian art across beautifully restored historic buildings. Later, enjoy an immersive experience at the Singapore Zoo, known for its open enclosures and wide variety of wildlife.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sentosa – Universal Studios – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day at Sentosa Island, where you can enjoy a cable car ride, relax on its beaches, or meet marine animals at Dolphin Island. In the afternoon, step into the world of movies at Universal Studios Singapore, where thrilling rides and shows bring stories like Jurassic Park and Transformers to life. In the evening, head to Chinatown, a lively spot for street food, cultural sights, and souvenir shopping.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Singapore – Bintan – Banyan Tree Temple
package_itineraries.description: Take a ferry ride from Singapore to Bintan, a tropical Indonesian island known for its resorts and beaches. After arrival at Tanah Merah Ferry Terminal, you’ll be transferred to your hotel for check-in and relaxation. Later, visit the Banyan Tree Temple, a revered Chinese shrine that has stood for more than two centuries.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bintan Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Discover Bintan’s charm on a full-day exploration. The island offers everything from stunning beaches and ancient temples to delicious seafood and lively local markets. Adventure seekers can indulge in water sports like snorkelling, jet skiing, and windsurfing, while others may simply enjoy the island’s serenity.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Bintan – Singapore – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and travel back to Singapore. From there, you will be assisted to the airport for your flight home, bringing your journey to a close.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Bali – Tanjung Benoa Beach
package_itineraries.description: On landing in Bali, meet your representative who will escort you to your hotel. Start your journey with a visit to Tanjung Benoa Beach, a perfect place for a leisure walk or to indulge in exciting water sports such as parasailing, jet skiing, and banana boat rides. Later, rejuvenate with a two-hour spa session designed to refresh your senses. Overnight stay at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Batubulan Village – Kintamani Volcano Safari
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, proceed to Batubulan Village, well known for its artistic performances and cultural heritage. Watch the dramatic Barong dance, followed by the rhythmic Kecak dance performance. Continue your day with a trip to Kintamani, where you can admire the scenic views of Mount Batur and its lava fields, surrounded by rice terraces and coffee plantations. Return to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bedugul – Botanical Garden – Ulun Danu Beratan Temple
package_itineraries.description: Begin your third day with a trip to Bedugul, a cool mountain retreat in central Bali. Explore the Bali Botanical Garden, Indonesia’s largest garden that houses rare orchids and unique flora. Afterwards, visit Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, a picturesque lakeside temple dedicated to Hindu deities, where the reflection of the temple on Lake Beratan creates a stunning sight. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Bali
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before checking out. You will be transferred to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Bali
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Bali, you’ll be greeted at the airport and transferred to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to unwind, enjoy the surroundings, or explore nearby attractions at your leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Celuk Village – Mas Village – Elephant Cave – Kintamani – Ubud Village Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start the day at Celuk Village, renowned for its intricate gold and silver jewellery crafted by local artisans. Continue to Mas Village, where skilled craftsmen create elaborate wooden carvings. Visit the historic Elephant Cave (Goa Gajah), an important Hindu archaeological site. The journey then leads to Tirta Empul Temple, where holy spring water is believed to hold purifying powers. Later, admire the volcanic beauty of Mount Batur and Lake Batur in Kintamani. Before heading back, explore Ubud Market for traditional Balinese crafts and souvenirs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tanjung Benoa Beach
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a fun-filled day at Tanjung Benoa Beach, a hub for exciting water sports like parasailing, jet skiing, and banana boat rides. In the afternoon, relax with a rejuvenating spa session that will leave you refreshed and re-energized. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Bali
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your return flight, carrying with you the memories of a splendid Bali experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive In Moscow
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Moscow, you will be greeted and escorted to your hotel for check-in. Spend the rest of the day unwinding or strolling around nearby attractions at your leisure. Overnight stay in a premium hotel in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Moscow City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin a sightseeing tour of Moscow’s renowned landmarks. Highlights include Poklonnaya Hill, Novodevichy Convent, Vorobyovy Hills, Manezhnaya Square, and Lubyanka Square. Continue to see Bolshoi Theatre, Ohotny Ryad, Tverskaya Street, Cathedral of Christ the Saviour, and Kropotkinskaya Embankment. Later, explore the iconic Red Square and tour the Kremlin to admire its historic cathedrals. Overnight in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Moscow - St Petersburg
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the train station for your Sapsan journey to St Petersburg with a complimentary lunch onboard. Upon arrival, you’ll be assisted to your hotel. Spend your evening leisurely exploring the surroundings before resting overnight in St Petersburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : St Petersburg City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Founded in 1703 by Peter the Great, St Petersburg is Russia’s second-largest city, famed for its White Nights in summer. Visit its iconic attractions, including the Spit of Vasilievsky Island, St Isaac’s Cathedral, Church of the Saviour on Spilled Blood, Cruiser Aurora Museum, Nevsky Prospekt, Neva Embankments, and Peter and Paul Fortress, where Russian Tsars are laid to rest. Overnight stay in St Petersburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : St Petersburg – Hermitage Museum
package_itineraries.description: This day is dedicated to visiting the Catherine Palace, a grand baroque estate famed for its striking blue-and-white façade. It now forms part of the Hermitage Museum, home to millions of artefacts—paintings, sculptures, ceramics, costumes, and medieval weaponry. Overnight in St Petersburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : Depart Russia
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive in Moscow
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing in Moscow, you will be assisted to your hotel for check-in. Take some time to relax or explore the local neighbourhoods. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Russian dinner before overnighting at a hotel in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Moscow City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Moscow, dating back to the 12th century, remains the heart of Russia and the seat of its Orthodox Church. Today’s city tour will include the Kremlin, Red Square, St Basil’s Cathedral, Bolshoi Theatre, Lubyanka Square, and the Cathedral of Christ the Saviour. You will also witness the splendour of the Moscow Metro stations, decorated like underground palaces. After lunch, experience one of Moscow’s famous circus performances at either Nikulin or Bolshoi. Overnight stay in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Moscow City Tour Day 2
package_itineraries.description: Start your day at Old Arbat Street, Moscow’s oldest cultural street filled with shops, historic buildings, and local performers. After lunch, visit Bunker 42, a Cold War museum hidden underground, showcasing how thousands lived self-sufficiently during the Soviet era. Later, enjoy a river cruise for stunning city views, followed by dinner. Overnight in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Moscow - St Petersburg
package_itineraries.description: Board the Sapsan train to St Petersburg with lunch included. On arrival, transfer to your hotel and later attend a vibrant folk performance at Nikolaevsky Palace featuring traditional dances and Cossack music. End the evening with dinner at a local restaurant.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : St Petersburg City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore St Petersburg’s highlights today: Spit of Vasilievsky Island, St Isaac’s Cathedral, Palace Square, Church of the Saviour on Spilled Blood, Nevsky Prospekt, Isaac’s Square, Cruiser Aurora, and Peter and Paul Fortress. Overnight in St Petersburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : Catherine Palace Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Pushkin to visit Catherine Palace, an ornate masterpiece with the famous Amber Room. Afterwards, head to Peterhof to see the opulent Grand Palace, built by Peter the Great, with its fountains, gardens, and gilded interiors. Spend the evening shopping before enjoying a farewell dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7 : Depart Russia
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive in Moscow
package_itineraries.description: After arrival, you’ll be greeted and taken to your hotel. Later, explore Moscow’s green parks and boulevards, home to hundreds of gardens and tree-lined spaces.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Moscow City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin a guided tour of Moscow’s most famous sites: Red Square, State Historical Museum, St Basil’s Cathedral, Lenin Mausoleum, and Cathedral of Christ the Saviour. Continue to Novodevichy Convent, Moscow State University, Sparrow Hills, and the Kremlin from the Moskvoretskaya Embankment. In the evening, see other highlights such as Victory Park, Triumphal Arch, Tverskaya Street, Pushkin Square, and Kutuzovsky Avenue before ending with Tsar Cannon, Tsar Bell, and Senate Square.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Moscow Metro Tour – St Petersburg
package_itineraries.description: This morning, visit Moscow’s stunning metro stations such as Komsomolskaya, Mayakovskaya, Novoslobodskaya, and Arbatskaya. Later, board a train to St Petersburg and transfer to your hotel upon arrival. Enjoy a relaxed evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : St Petersburg City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring landmarks such as St Isaac’s Cathedral, Alexander Nevsky Lavra, Peter and Paul Fortress, Pavlovsk Palace, Yusupov Palace, and Catherine Palace. Overnight in St Petersburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Hermitage State Museum
package_itineraries.description: Today’s highlight is the Hermitage Museum, one of the world’s greatest collections of art, with millions of works ranging from classical sculptures to Renaissance masterpieces. After lunch, visit a flea market before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : Depart St Petersburg
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Pulkovo Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive In Moscow
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, you will be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. The day is free for you to explore nearby areas or simply relax. Overnight in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Moscow City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start your Moscow city tour with sites such as Poklonnaya Hill, Novodevichy Convent, and Vorobyovy Hills. Drive along Tverskaya Street, Manezhnaya Square, and Lubyanka Square. Visit landmarks like the Cathedral of Christ the Saviour, Kremlin, Ohotny Ryad, Bolshoi Theatre, and Kropotkinskaya Embankment before concluding at Red Square. Overnight stay in Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Moscow City Tour Day 2
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore Old Arbat Street, one of Moscow’s oldest cultural hubs. Walk along its cobblestones, enjoy live performances, and shop for unique souvenirs. Return to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Moscow - Izmailovo
package_itineraries.description: Visit Izmailovo, a suburb known for its lively market and the Izmailovo Kremlin. Shop for antiques, handicrafts, and paintings before returning to Moscow.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Moscow - St Petersburg
package_itineraries.description: Board the Sapsan train to St Petersburg. After check-in at your hotel, enjoy a leisurely evening. Overnight in St Petersburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : St Petersburg City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore landmarks such as St Isaac’s Cathedral, Palace Square, Church of the Saviour on Spilled Blood, Nevsky Prospekt, and the Aurora. Visit Peter and Paul Fortress, the burial place of Russian royalty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7 : St Petersburg City Tour Day 2
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at the Winter Palace, now housing the Hermitage Museum with its extraordinary collection of art, artefacts, and history.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8 : St Petersburg - Pushkin
package_itineraries.description: Visit Pushkin to see Catherine Palace and Alexander Palace. The famed Amber Room in Catherine Palace is an unmissable highlight. Spend the evening shopping before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9 : Depart Russia
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tokyo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Narita and transfer to your hotel. Evening free. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tokyo – City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, start a sightseeing tour including Tokyo Tower, a tea ceremony, Imperial Palace Plaza, Nijubashi Bridge, Hinode Pier, and a Sumida River Cruise. Visit Sensoji Temple and Nakamise Street. Tour concludes at Hamamatsucho. Return to hotel at leisure. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Tokyo – Mt. Fuji & Hakone Adventure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Mt. Fuji’s 5th Station. Enjoy views before a Japanese lunch. Cruise on Lake Ashi, then ride the Komagatake Ropeway. Return to Tokyo by bus, ending at Ginza. Overnight in Tokyo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Tokyo to Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, make your way to Tokyo Station and board the Shinkansen to Kyoto. Check into your hotel and relax. Overnight in Kyoto.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kyoto – Nara – Kyoto
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast, then tour Kyoto’s landmarks including Nijo Castle, Kinkaku-ji, and Imperial Palace. Visit Nara to explore Todai-ji, Nara Park, and Kasuga Shrine. Drop-off provided to hotels in Kyoto. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Kyoto to Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast and transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight to Seoul. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Seoul City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast followed by an optional guided tour. Highlights include Jogyesa Temple, Blue House, Gyeongbok Palace, Guard Changing Ceremony, Insadong, Namdaemun Market, and Changdeok Palace. Return to hotel. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast and free time to explore on your own. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure from Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast followed by transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Incheon Airport and transfer to your hotel. In the evening, enjoy free time in Seoul’s lively streets—explore Myeongdong shopping area and Itaewon’s dining and nightlife. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast at the hotel. The day is free, or you may opt for the Palace Tour (USD 95 per person). This includes Joggye Temple, Blue House, Gyeongbok Palace with Guard Ceremony, Insadong, Namdaemun Market, Ginseng or Amethyst shops, lunch, and Changdeok Palace. Tour ends around 17:00. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Seoul
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy at leisure or take an optional excursion: DMZ Tour (USD 70): Imjingak Park, 3rd Tunnel, Dora Observatory, Dorasan Station (closed Mondays). Nami Island & Petit France Tour (USD 140): Visit drama filming sites with French-inspired architecture and Nami’s scenic landscapes. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Seoul to Busan
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast, then transfer by high-speed train to Busan. Check in at your hotel and enjoy leisure time in the evening. Overnight in Busan.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Busan
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer back to Seoul via train for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Seoul International Airport, you’ll be welcomed by our representatives who will assist with your hotel transfer. Once checked in, take some time to relax after your journey and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Seoul City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, begin a full-day guided tour of Seoul. Discover historical gems such as the National Folk Museum, Gyeongbokgung Palace, Jogye Temple, and a drive past the famous Blue House. Later, travel to Yeoju Green Village and visit the scenic Nami Island, renowned as a filming spot for Winter Sonata. Enjoy unique experiences like Korean Kimchi making and trying on a Hanbok costume before stopping at a local Ginseng plantation to sample Ginseng Juice. Return to Seoul for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Seoul – Everland Theme Park
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your breakfast before departing for Everland Theme Park, South Korea’s most popular amusement park. Spend the day enjoying thrilling rides, attractions, and entertainment before returning to Seoul for an overnight stay. Breakfast included, other meals not provided.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast, then transfer to Incheon Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Land at Incheon Airport, meet your guide, and transfer to your hotel. In the evening, explore Myeongdong’s shopping lanes or Itaewon’s bustling dining scene. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Seoul City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off on a guided city tour with lunch included. Highlights: Joggye Temple, Blue House, Gyeongbok Palace with Guard Ceremony, Insadong antique street, Korean Ginseng or Amethyst shopping, Namdaemun Market, and Changdeok Palace. Tour ends by 17:00. Overnight stay in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Seoul – DMZ Tour & Optional Excursions
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then head on a half-day DMZ tour (08:00–14:00, closed Mondays). Stops include Imjingak Park, Unification Bridge, 3rd Tunnel, Dora Observatory, Dorasan Station, and a shopping stop. Drop-off at Itaewon street. Optional tours include Nami Island & Petit France (USD 140) or Everland Theme Park (USD 140). Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Seoul to Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a morning flight to Jeju Island. Transfer to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Eastern Jeju Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, join an optional shared tour (available Tue, Thu, Sat). Activities include horse riding, Seongup Folk Village, and visits to local attractions showcasing Jeju’s traditional culture. Overnight in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Farewell to Jeju
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then fly back to Seoul for your transfer to Incheon Airport and your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Incheon Airport, meet your guide and transfer comfortably to your hotel. In the evening, explore the streets filled with Indian restaurants, vibrant Myeongdong shopping district, and the lively Itaewon street, known for its international dining and nightlife. Rest overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discovering Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day at leisure or join the optional Palace Tour (USD 95 per person). The guided tour begins at 09:00 with a visit to Joggye Buddhist Temple and a drive past the Presidential Blue House. Highlights include Gyeongbok Palace with the Royal Guard Changing Ceremony, Insadong antique street, a local lunch, Namdaemun Traditional Market, and Changdeok Palace. The day ends around 17:00 with a return to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Seoul
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you may relax or join the optional DMZ Half Day Tour (USD 70 per person, closed on Mondays and holidays). Starting at 07:50, this guided trip covers Imjingak Park, Unification Bridge ID check, DMZ theatre & exhibition hall, the 3rd Tunnel, Dora Observatory, Dorasan Station, and a visit to a Ginseng or Amethyst shop. The tour ends around 14:00 at Itaewon street, leaving you free to explore before returning to the hotel independently.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Seoul to Busan
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then board a train to Busan. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy leisure time. Overnight in Busan.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Busan to Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Catch a morning flight to Jeju Island and check in at your hotel. The rest of the day is free for personal exploration.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Jeju Island Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, relax or join the optional western Jeju tour (USD 105 per person). Visit Hyupjae Beach, Hanlim Park with its botanical gardens, and O’Sulloc Green Tea Field for a taste of Korea’s tea culture. The tour runs from 09:00 to 17:00. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast, then fly to Seoul and transfer to Incheon Airport for your international departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hong Kong
package_itineraries.description: Once you arrive at Hong Kong Airport, you will be greeted by a local representative who will escort you to your hotel for check-in. The rest of the day is free for leisure—take time to rest, stroll nearby attractions, or simply relax at the hotel. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hong Kong City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After a delicious breakfast, set out on a half-day sightseeing journey. Visit the scenic Waterfront, discover craftsmanship at a Jewellery Workshop, and enjoy panoramic views from Victoria Peak. The rest of the day is left open for shopping or personal exploration. Overnight stay in Hong Kong.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Farewell to Hong Kong – Hello, Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Today you will board a flight to Jeju Island, Korea’s largest volcanic island and a UNESCO World Natural Heritage site. Famous for its pleasant climate and stunning natural scenery, Jeju is known for beaches, cliffs, waterfalls, and lava caves. Recognised as a Global Geopark and one of the New 7 Wonders of Nature, the island offers a memorable welcome. Overnight stay at a hotel in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Discovering Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast and enjoy leisure time or join the optional West Jeju tour (available Mon/Wed/Fri). Highlights include Hyupjae Beach with its clear waters, Hanlim Park showcasing vast botanical gardens, and O’Sulloc Green Tea Field where you can learn about traditional Korean tea culture. The day ends with a hotel drop-off. Overnight stay in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Explore Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: This day is also free or can be used for an optional East Jeju tour (Tue/Thu/Sat). Experience horse-riding or visit the Horse Museum, explore Seongup Folk Village, and stop at Gwangchigi Beach. Watch the Woman Diver show, a UNESCO Intangible cultural heritage, and continue to Sunrise Peak, one of Jeju’s most famous UNESCO sites. The tour also includes Manjang Cave, Asia’s longest lava cave. Overnight stay in Jeju.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Farewell to Jeju Island
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you will be transferred to the airport for your return journey home or onward connection, concluding your delightful trip.

package_itineraries.title: Welcome to Seoul
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Incheon Airport where your guide will greet you. Transfer to your hotel and relax. In the evening, stroll through Myeongdong shopping street and the dynamic Itaewon area filled with restaurants and nightlife. Overnight in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Exploring Seoul
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, spend the day at leisure or join the optional Palace Tour (USD 94 per person, including lunch). This guided trip includes Joggye Temple, Blue House view, Gyeongbok Palace with Royal Guard Ceremony, Insadong antique street, Namdaemun Market, Ginseng or Amethyst shopping, and Changdeok Palace. The tour runs from 09:00–17:00. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Seoul – Day of Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then explore freely or choose optional tours: DMZ Half Day Tour (USD 75): Includes Imjingak Park, 3rd Tunnel, Dora Observatory, Dorasan Station. Nami Island & Petit France Tour (USD 145): Includes visits to the filming sites of Winter Sonata and My Love from the Star. Everland Tour (USD 145): A full day of fun at South Korea’s largest theme park. After your chosen activity, return for an overnight stay in Seoul.

package_itineraries.title: Farewell to Seoul
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hilo
package_itineraries.description: Land at Hilo International Airport, where friendly representatives will welcome you and assist with your hotel transfer. Complete your check-in and spend the rest of the day relaxing at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Volcanoes National Park – Hilo – Wailuku River State Park
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day exploring Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, home to two active giants—Kīlauea and Mauna Loa. Continue to Akatsuka Orchid Gardens and enjoy the exotic blooms before visiting a Macadamia Nut Farm. Spend time at Richardson Ocean Park for swimming and snorkelling. Later, witness the beauty of Wailuku River State Park, King Kamehameha Statue, and Rainbow Falls before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leisure Day
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, choose between a peaceful day of rest or engage in thrilling water sports and beachside activities.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Akaka Falls State Park – Lava Tree State Monument – Hilo
package_itineraries.description: Discover the enchanting Akaka Falls State Park with its famous cascades—Akaka and Kahuna Falls. Wander through Nani Mau Gardens, filled with tropical blooms. Explore Lava Trees State Monument, where lava formations preserve the shapes of once-standing trees. End the day at the Kapoho Tide Pools and Kalapana Beach before heading back.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hilo – Maui – Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: Travel to the island of Maui, a haven of scenic beaches, lush parks, and adventurous hiking trails. By evening, make your way to Honolulu for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Pearl Harbor – Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a visit to the historic Pearl Harbor, the most significant landmark in the Hawaiian Islands. Pay respects at the USS Arizona Memorial, the final resting place of sailors who perished during the 1941 attack. Later, return to Honolulu and relax.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Exploring Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out to explore Honolulu’s iconic landmarks, including Iolani Palace, Kawaiahaʻo Church, Honolulu Hale, and the National Memorial Cemetery of the Pacific.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Free Day in Honolulu
package_itineraries.description: Spend your day shopping, relaxing by the beach, or simply enjoying the city’s vibrant vibe.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and head to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Manila
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Manila, where you’ll be warmly received and transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Manila Heritage Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Makati’s landmarks before heading to Rizal Park. Continue to Intramuros, San Agustin Church, Casa Manila, and Fort Santiago. Experience Quiapo’s local markets and conclude with a visit to the Chinese Cemetery before heading back to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Manila to Boracay
package_itineraries.description: Board a domestic flight to Boracay via Caticlan Airport. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy the day at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Boracay Island Hopping
package_itineraries.description: Embark on an island-hopping tour around Boracay’s hidden beaches, coral reefs, and turquoise waters. Snorkel, swim, and discover marine life in one of the world’s most picturesque destinations.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Manila airport for your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Arrival in Manila
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Manila where a warm reception awaits. You’ll be escorted to your hotel for check-in and an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Discover Manila
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before embarking on a city tour. Visit Makati’s financial district, Fort Bonifacio, and the American Cemetery. Explore Rizal Park, dedicated to Dr. Jose Rizal, then stroll through the Walled City of Intramuros. Admire San Agustin Church, Casa Manila, and Fort Santiago. Later, explore Quiapo’s bustling markets and end the day at the Chinese Cemetery, where ornate mausoleums reflect a blend of Buddhist and Christian traditions. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Manila to Coron, Palawan
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your flight to Palawan. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy the day at leisure. Overnight in Coron.

package_itineraries.title: Coron Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Set out on an island-hopping experience in Coron. Marvel at the crystal waters of Kayangan Lake, the striking Twin Lagoons, and the breathtaking seascapes. Snorkel and swim before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight back to Manila, carrying home unforgettable memories.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Manila
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, you’ll be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. Overnight stay in Manila.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Manila City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Makati’s Fort Bonifacio and the American Cemetery before visiting Rizal Park. Tour Intramuros, San Agustin Church, Casa Manila, and Fort Santiago. Continue to Quiapo’s vibrant centre and end with a visit to the unique Chinese Cemetery. Overnight in Manila.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Flight to Bohol
package_itineraries.description: Take a morning flight to Bohol. Upon arrival, transfer to your resort and relax for the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Bohol Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Explore Bohol’s wonders with visits to the Philippine Tarsier Sanctuary, Baclayon Church, and the historic Blood Compact site. Drive through the man-made Bilar Forest and marvel at the Chocolate Hills, which change colours with the seasons. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Manila
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Manila and transfer to your hotel for check-in. Overnight stay in Manila.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Manila Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Start with Makati’s highlights including Fort Bonifacio. Move on to Rizal Park, Intramuros, San Agustin Church, Casa Manila, and Fort Santiago. Visit Quiapo’s busy market and the Chinese Cemetery before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Manila to Cebu
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Cebu in the morning. Upon arrival, transfer to your resort and spend the day relaxing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cebu Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Temple of Leah, Celosia Flower Farm, local markets, and Terrazas de Flores, showcasing hundreds of blooming flower species. Overnight stay in Cebu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your onward flight, taking with you lasting memories.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at Taipei
package_itineraries.description: When you arrive at Taipei International Airport, you will be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. After checking in, spend the rest of your day at leisure to recover from your journey. Relax overnight at your hotel in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Half-Day Tour of Taipei City, Jiufen Village & Northeast Coast
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with breakfast before exploring Taipei City. Visit the National Palace Museum, filled with historic treasures, and stop by iconic sites such as Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, Presidential Square, and Martyrs’ Shrine. Experience the local heritage with a visit to a Taiwanese temple and explore handicrafts at the Taipei Handicraft Centre. In the afternoon, travel to the charming Jiufen Village, where narrow streets, tea houses, and mountain views await. On the way, admire the unique Nanya Rock Formations and the beautiful Bay of Two Colours. Visit the mysterious Jinguashi 13 Ruins before returning to Taipei for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Discover Taroko Gorge in Taiwan
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before heading to Taipei Main Station for a train journey to Hualien. Upon arrival, begin your exploration of Taroko Gorge. Walk the scenic Shakadang Trail, visit the Eternal Spring Shrine (Changchun Temple), and take in the beauty of the Swallow Grotto (Tianxiang). A stop at a Marble Factory showcases the artistry of stonework in this region. Later, visit Qixing Lake and Hualien Stone Sculptural Park before traveling back to Taipei for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Taipei
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to Taoyuan International Airport for your flight home or onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Taoyuan International Airport, where you will be greeted and escorted to your hotel. After check-in, enjoy the remainder of the day at leisure. Overnight stay at your hotel in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Taipei to Sun Moon Lake
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a scenic journey to Sun Moon Lake, located 762 metres above sea level and surrounded by mountains. Explore Wenwu Temple (Literature-Warrior Temple), dedicated to Confucius and Kuan Ti, followed by visits to the Holy Monk Shrine and Ci En Pagoda. Relax at your lakeside accommodation, where you can enjoy hot springs, walking trails, biking, or boating. Overnight stay at Sun Moon Lake.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sun Moon Lake – Foguangshan Monastery – Kaohsiung
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before visiting Jiji Railway Station, a quaint historical stop. Continue to the famous Foguangshan Monastery, southern Taiwan’s most important Buddhist site. Tour the Buddha Memorial Centre and interact with monks and nuns. Later, arrive in Kaohsiung and enjoy sightseeing at Love River and the lively Liuhe Night Market. Overnight stay in Kaohsiung.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kaohsiung to Kenting and Zhiben Hot Springs
package_itineraries.description: Travel south to Kenting National Park, famous for its 37 miles of coral-fringed coastline. Visit Eluanbi Lighthouse, Maobitou scenic area, and Longpan Park. Continue along the Southern Link Highway to Taitung. End your day by relaxing in the hot springs at Hotel Royal Chihpen. Overnight stay in Taitung.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Taitung to Taroko via East Coast National Scenic Area
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, discover Taiwan’s untouched eastern coast. Explore Xiaoyeliu, Sanxiantai, Shitiping (Stone Steps), and visit a marble factory and showroom. This coastal region, often called “Taiwan’s last unspoiled paradise,” offers dramatic views and unique rock formations. Continue to Hualien and stay overnight inside Taroko National Park.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Taroko National Park to Taipei
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Taroko Gorge, a spectacular ravine carved through marble cliffs. Visit Tunnel of Nine Turns, Ci Mu Bridge, Swallow Grotto, and Changchun Temple (Eternal Spring Shrine). On the return to Taipei, admire Cingshui Cliff and pass through the 12.9 km Syue-Shan Long Tunnel. Overnight stay in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Farewell Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before transferring to Taoyuan International Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Taoyuan International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the day relaxing or exploring at your own pace. Overnight stay in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Taipei’s Charm
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off for a half-day Taipei city tour. Visit Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, National Palace Museum, and Martyrs’ Shrine, where you can watch the Changing of the Guards. Explore a Taiwanese temple and discover traditional crafts at the Handicraft Centre. The rest of the day is free. Overnight stay in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: From Taipei to Sun Moon Lake
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Sun Moon Lake after breakfast. Visit Wenwu Temple, Holy Monk Shrine, and Ci En Pagoda. In the evening, relax at your hotel, where you can enjoy hot springs or outdoor activities such as cycling or boat rides on the lake. Overnight stay at Sun Moon Lake.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Sun Moon Lake – Foguangshan Monastery – Kaohsiung
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Jiji Railway Station and then the Fo Guang Shan Monastery. Explore the Buddha Memorial Centre and interact with monks before heading to Kaohsiung. Spend the evening exploring Love River and Liuhe Night Market. Overnight stay in Kaohsiung.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kaohsiung to Kenting and Zhiben Hot Springs
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Kenting National Park, where highlights include Eluanbi Lighthouse, Maobitou, and Longpan Park. Continue your journey to Taitung via the Southern Link Highway. Relax in the hot springs at Hotel Royal Chihpen before an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Taitung – East Coast – Taroko
package_itineraries.description: Embark on an East Coast Scenic Tour, stopping at Xiaoyeliu, Sanxiantai, Shitiping, and a marble factory. Continue to Hualien for an overnight stay inside Taroko National Park.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Explore Taroko National Park and Return to Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day visiting Taroko Gorge highlights, including Tunnel of Nine Turns, Ci Mu Bridge, Swallow Grotto, and Eternal Spring Shrine. On your way back to Taipei, admire Cingshui Cliff before passing through the Syue-Shan Long Tunnel. Overnight stay in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure from Taipei
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Taoyuan International Airport for your flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Taipei International Airport and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, the rest of the day is yours to relax or explore. Overnight stay in Taipei.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Half-Day Taipei City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided half-day tour. Visit Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, Presidential Square (drive past), Martyrs’ Shrine, and National Palace Museum. Explore a Taiwanese temple and admire handicrafts at the Taipei Handicraft Centre. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before checking out. Transfer to Taoyuan International Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Singapore Changi Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and escorted to your hotel. After checking in and freshening up, get ready to begin your adventure with a visit to the beautiful Sentosa Island. Explore the thrilling attractions it offers—interact with dolphins at Dolphin Island, stroll along Palawan Beach to admire the famous suspension bridge, and experience an adrenaline rush on the Skyline Luge and Skyride. The island promises a perfect blend of relaxation and excitement for all ages.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Merlion Park - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Begin your second day with a journey to Gardens By The Bay, an iconic nature park spanning 101 hectares with three waterfront gardens. Next, immerse yourself in Southeast Asian artistry at the National Gallery Singapore, showcasing captivating works of art. Visit the legendary Merlion Park, where the half-lion, half-fish statue symbolizes Singapore's beginnings as a fishing village. Conclude your day with a visit to the Singapore Zoo, home to over 4,200 animals, offering an unforgettable wildlife experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios - Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Spend a day at Universal Studios Singapore, Southeast Asia’s first theme park of its kind. Thrill-seekers can enjoy Battlestar Galactica, the tallest duelling rollercoaster in the world, and relive classic movies such as Transformers, The Mummy, and Jurassic Park. Later, explore Chinatown, a vibrant district perfect for picking up souvenirs and enjoying authentic oriental cuisine.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: After an enriching vacation, check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport to board your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Night Safari
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Singapore and check in at your hotel. Start your evening with the Night Safari, the world’s first nocturnal zoo. Encounter wildlife such as Asian Elephants, Malayan Tigers, and fishing cats in an immersive nocturnal setting.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Singapore City Tour - Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a half-day city tour of Singapore, covering attractions like Chinatown’s Thian Hock Keng temple and other historical spots. Continue to Sentosa Island, where adventure awaits with cable car rides, dolphin encounters, and beach relaxation. Experience Underwater World and the Song of the Sea light show before returning to the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios
package_itineraries.description: Revisit your childhood at Universal Studios Singapore, the first in Southeast Asia. Enjoy thrilling rides, movie-themed attractions, and memorable experiences for both adults and children.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Genting Highlands
package_itineraries.description: Board the Star Virgo Cruise to Genting Highlands in Malaysia. Visit Chin Swee Caves Temple, explore Genting Strawberry Leisure Farm, and enjoy the evening Captain’s Cocktail dinner on board. Experience the entertainment and luxury offered on the cruise for a delightful night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Genting Highlands – Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a buffet breakfast, followed by a visit to Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park for fun and adventure. Travel to Kuala Lumpur to explore the city’s top attractions and spend a restful night in Malaysia’s vibrant capital.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Kuala Lumpur City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Kuala Lumpur’s iconic landmarks, including the Petronas Towers, Batu Caves, and the National Museum, gaining a full perspective on Malaysia’s cultural and architectural wonders.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out and head to the airport for your flight back home, concluding a dynamic city and nature exploration tour.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Singapore and check in at your hotel. Begin your adventure at Sentosa Island with activities such as Dolphin Island, cable car rides, and beach visits.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Explore Gardens by the Bay with its spectacular plant conservatories, followed by the National Gallery showcasing Southeast Asian art. Later, visit Singapore Zoo, known for its rainforest setting.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy an exciting day at Universal Studios theme park, followed by an evening stroll and dining experience in Chinatown.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kuala Lumpur – Genting Highlands
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Kuala Lumpur and visit Genting Highlands. Highlights include Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park, Strawberry Leisure Farm, and the Chin Swee Caves Temple.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
package_itineraries.description: Tour the historic city of Malacca before heading to the iconic Petronas Twin Towers.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Batu Caves and the National Mosque of Malaysia, both offering cultural and spiritual insights.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out and head to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: National Gallery - Merlion Park - St. Andrew's Cathedral
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, check into your hotel and prepare for your first day of exploration. Start with the National Gallery, where Southeast Asian art and culture come alive. Continue to Merlion Park to see the iconic half-lion, half-fish statue, a reminder of Singapore’s fishing village origins. End the day in the tranquil St. Andrew’s Cathedral, enjoying its serene and sacred ambiance.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend a full day on Sentosa Island, home to countless activities and attractions. Marvel at marine life at S.E.A. Aquarium, meet playful dolphins at Dolphin Island, and enjoy panoramic views with a cable car ride on the Skyline Luge and Skyride. Relax and unwind at Siloso Beach to end your action-packed day.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios - Singapore Botanic Gardens
package_itineraries.description: Venture into Universal Studios Singapore to ride the thrilling Battlestar Galactica and explore attractions like The Lost World. Later, visit the Singapore Botanic Gardens, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and wander through the National Orchid Garden with its impressive collection of over 1,000 orchid species.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Gardens by the Bay - Singapore Zoo – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day at Gardens By The Bay, a scenic nature park with three waterfront gardens. Continue to the Singapore Zoo to observe more than 4,200 animals. Conclude your day in Chinatown, savoring oriental cuisine and shopping for souvenirs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport for your onward journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Singapore and transfer to your hotel. Start your day at Gardens by the Bay, a futuristic nature park, then explore Southeast Asian art at the National Gallery. End the day at Singapore Zoo, home to over 4,000 animals.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Sentosa Island, where you can enjoy beaches, dolphin encounters, and cable car rides.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Step into a world of adventure at Universal Studios, Southeast Asia’s first. Experience themed rides and attractions, then head to Chinatown in the evening for delicious cuisine and souvenir shopping.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kuala Lumpur – Genting Highlands
package_itineraries.description: Travel by coach to Kuala Lumpur. Your first excursion is Genting Highlands, where you’ll visit Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park, Genting Strawberry Leisure Farm, and the Chin Swee Caves Temple.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
package_itineraries.description: Explore Malacca, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, before visiting the famous Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Discover Batu Caves, a spiritual site with colorful shrines, followed by the serene National Mosque of Malaysia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Gardens By The Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Singapore and check in at your hotel. Visit Gardens by the Bay, the National Gallery, and Singapore Zoo for a day filled with art, nature, and wildlife.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Discover the charm of Sentosa Island with its beaches, dolphin encounters, and scenic rides.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Universal Studios, packed with thrilling rides, before heading to Chinatown for food and shopping.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Reach Langkawi - Langkawi Cable Car - Langkawi Wildlife Park
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Langkawi and check in at your hotel. Ride the Langkawi Cable Car for stunning views and explore Langkawi Wildlife Park.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Pantai Cenang Beach - Paradise 3D Museum - Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls
package_itineraries.description: Relax at Pantai Cenang Beach, then explore the Paradise 3D Museum. End the day at the enchanting Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Langkawi
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Singapore - Indian National Army Monument - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, check into your hotel and freshen up before beginning your historic journey. Start at the Indian National Army Monument in Downtown Singapore, established on 8th July 1945, commemorating the brave soldiers. Then, visit the Singapore Zoo to interact with over 4,200 animals.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Sentosa Island, combining adventure and leisure. Ride the Skyline Luge and Skyride, meet dolphins at Dolphin Island, and explore other attractions that make the island a must-visit destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day filled with excitement at Universal Studios Singapore. Experience thrilling rides like Battlestar Galactica and revisit beloved movie worlds. Later, explore Chinatown’s markets and eateries, picking up unique souvenirs and tasting authentic dishes.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Singapore - Gardens by The Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, check in at your hotel before starting the tour with the Night Safari at Mandai Wildlife Reserve, the world’s first open-air nocturnal zoo. Discover over 2,500 animals from more than 900 species, including civets, leopards, and porcupines.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Singapore Half-Day City Tour – Merlion Park, Chinatown & More
package_itineraries.description: Take a city coach tour covering Merlion Park, Mount Faber, the Jewellery Factory, Chocolate Shop, and Little India. Chinatown offers bargain shopping and souvenirs, while Little India showcases Indian culture, cuisine, and handicrafts.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy Sentosa Island’s numerous attractions, including S.E.A. Aquarium, Universal Studios Singapore, Madame Tussauds, and Mega Adventure Park’s Mega Zip. Take a cable car ride, swim with dolphins at Dolphin Island, or unwind on its picturesque beaches.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Check out from the hotel and proceed to the airport for your onward journey, concluding your Singapore Delight tour.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Night Safari
package_itineraries.description: After arriving in Singapore, check in at your hotel and refresh. Begin your adventure in the evening with the Night Safari, the world’s first nocturnal zoo. Witness exotic creatures such as Asian Elephants, Malayan Tigers, and fishing cats in their naturalistic habitats while enjoying an immersive evening safari experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Gardens By The Bay - National Gallery Singapore – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Start the day at Gardens By The Bay, a sprawling 101-hectare park with three spectacular waterfront gardens. Continue to the National Gallery Singapore, showcasing an exceptional collection of Southeast Asian art and culture. End your day in Chinatown, exploring vibrant streets filled with shops and indulging in authentic oriental cuisine. In the evening, board the Star Virgo Cruise to begin a luxury voyage.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Penang
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Penang early in the morning. Explore this Malaysian gem by visiting the Tropical Spice Garden, Kek Lok Si Temple, and the Pinang Peranakan Mansion. Experience the unique culture and scenery before returning to the Star Virgo Cruise for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Phuket
package_itineraries.description: The cruise reaches Phuket, where you can relax at Patong Beach, enjoy snorkeling adventures, and visit the revered Wat Chalong temple. Return to the cruise for an evening journey back to Singapore.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Back to Singapore - Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day soaking in Sentosa Island’s attractions. Enjoy interactive dolphin experiences, ride the Skyline Luge and Skyride, or relax at Palawan Beach, making this an unforgettable day for the entire family.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Universal Studios
package_itineraries.description: Visit Universal Studios Singapore, Southeast Asia’s first theme park of its kind. Enjoy adrenaline-pumping rides, relive cinematic memories with classics like Transformers, The Mummy, and Jurassic Park, and create magical moments with your family.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport for your flight home after a memorable family vacation.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive at Singapore - Night Safari
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and enjoy a meal before heading to the Mandai Wildlife Reserve. Experience the world’s first nocturnal zoo, encountering exotic animals like Asian elephants, civets, Malayan tigers, and fishing cats.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sentosa Island Tour And Singapore Half-Day City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a half-day city tour covering Merlion Park, Mount Faber, Jewellery Factory, Chocolate Shop, and Little India. Then, spend the day at Sentosa Island exploring attractions such as cable car rides, Dolphin Island experiences, and pristine beaches.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios
package_itineraries.description: Relive your childhood at Universal Studios Singapore, Southeast Asia’s first theme park of its kind. Ride Battlestar Galactica and enjoy other thrilling attractions. Later, visit Chinatown for authentic cuisine and souvenir shopping.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Explore Gardens by the Bay’s 101-hectare park, marvel at art at the National Gallery Singapore, and meet over 4,200 animals at the Singapore Zoo for an enriching experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Explore Little India And Other Attractions
package_itineraries.description: Discover the vibrant streets of Little India, sampling street food, shopping for handicrafts, and experiencing local art. Enjoy the river view at night along Boat Quay for a perfect end to your day.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Singapore
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your return flight, concluding your Singapore family adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Reach Kuching - Kuching Waterfront - Sarawak Cultural Village
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Kuching, you will be welcomed at the airport and transferred to your hotel. After check-in and freshening up, your journey begins at the scenic Kuching Waterfront, a lively riverside promenade lined with eateries, historic colonial buildings, and cultural attractions. Later, explore the Sarawak Cultural Village, where you can experience the traditions and heritage of the many indigenous communities of Malaysia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Gunung Gading National Park - Cat Museum
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a visit to Gunung Gading National Park, one of the rare places in the world where you can witness the rafflesia flower blooming in its natural setting. In the afternoon, explore the famous Cat Museum in Kuching, home to over 2,000 fascinating exhibits that highlight the cultural and historical significance of cats.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bidayuh Annah Rais Longhouse - Tua Pek Kong Temple - Main Bazaar
package_itineraries.description: Journey to the Bidayuh Annah Rais Longhouse, a traditional communal home of the Bidayuh tribe nestled at the base of the Borneo Highlands. Continue to Tua Pek Kong Temple, a centuries-old Chinese temple perched on a small hill overlooking Kuching. In the evening, stroll through the Main Bazaar, where you can shop for handmade crafts, antiques, and souvenirs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Kuching
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Reach Kuala Lumpur – Petronas Twin Towers - KL Bird Park
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Kuala Lumpur and transfer to your hotel. After settling in, begin your journey with a visit to the iconic Petronas Twin Towers, followed by the vibrant KL Bird Park, home to over 3,000 bird species within its 20.9-acre expanse.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Taman Negara - Night Jungle Walk
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Kuala Tahan and board a boat to reach Taman Negara National Park. After registering and receiving permits at the Department of Wildlife, watch an introduction video about the park. At night, experience an adventurous jungle walk guided by experts.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Canopy Walkway - Teresek Hill - Lata Berkoh
package_itineraries.description: Visit Kuala Terengganu for recreational shooting activities. Later, discover the Orang Asli Aboriginal Village, where you will learn about the culture and traditions of Malaysia’s indigenous people.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Sabah State Museum - Kota Kinabalu City Mosque
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at the Sabah State Museum, which houses cultural treasures, followed by the Floating Mosque, one of Kota Kinabalu’s most striking landmarks.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Back to Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Return to Kuala Lumpur via Kuala Tahan and spend your free time exploring the city or relaxing at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Reach Kuala Lumpur - Petronas Twin Towers - KL Bird Park
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Kuala Lumpur and transfer to your hotel. Begin your sightseeing with iconic landmarks such as the Petronas Twin Towers, Batu Caves, the bustling Petaling Street market, and the Kuala Lumpur Bird Park, which spans over 20 acres and houses thousands of bird species.

package_itineraries.title: Cameron Highlands - Boh Tea Plantation - Cameron Lavender Garden
package_itineraries.description: Travel to the cool, lush Cameron Highlands, one of Malaysia’s most beloved hill stations. Visit the Boh Tea Plantation, the largest in Southeast Asia, and enjoy the panoramic views of the tea terraces. Later, explore the Cameron Lavender Garden, where colorful lavender and tropical flowers bloom year-round.

package_itineraries.title: Cameron Highlands Butterfly Farm - Time Tunnel Museum
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at the Cameron Highlands Butterfly Farm, home to butterflies, reptiles, and small animals. Continue to the Time Tunnel Museum, an interactive place filled with nostalgic memorabilia and displays that reflect Malaysia’s history.

package_itineraries.title: Pangkor Laut Island – Jungle Trekking
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Pangkor Laut Island by speedboat and check into the luxurious resort. After lunch, embark on a guided jungle trek, where you’ll discover the island’s flora and fauna in their natural habitat.

package_itineraries.title: Water Sports – Sunset View Chalet - Fisherman’s Cove
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy thrilling water sports such as kayaking, paddleboarding, or wakeboarding. In the evening, visit the Sunset View Chalet to feed hornbills before savoring a seafood dinner at the popular Fisherman’s Cove.

package_itineraries.title: Coral Beach - Chinatown
