package_itineraries.description: Relax at Coral Beach, one of Pangkor’s most serene coastal stretches. Later, explore Chinatown, where you can sample authentic Chinese dishes and shop for local specialties.

package_itineraries.title: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Arrive at Langkawi - Langkawi Cable Car - Langkawi Wildlife Park
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Langkawi, transfer to your hotel. Start your journey with the Langkawi Cable Car ride, which takes you up 650 metres for spectacular aerial views. End the day at Langkawi Wildlife Park, where you can interact with over 150 animal species.

package_itineraries.title: Pantai Cenang Beach - Paradise 3D Museum - Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls
package_itineraries.description: Relax at Pantai Cenang Beach, a lively stretch with cafes and water activities. Continue to the Paradise 3D Museum, one of the world’s largest, before finishing the day at the majestic Telaga Tujuh Waterfalls.

package_itineraries.title: Reach Kuala Lumpur - Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Kuala Lumpur and begin sightseeing with Malacca, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the evening, marvel at the Petronas Twin Towers, the city’s most iconic landmark.

package_itineraries.title: KL Bird Park - Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Batu Caves, followed by the National Mosque of Malaysia. Later, visit KL Bird Park and enjoy the wide variety of exotic bird species.

package_itineraries.title: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Sabah State Museum - Kota Kinabalu City Mosque
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Kota Kinabalu, you’ll be taken to your hotel. Begin sightseeing at the Sabah State Museum, which showcases the state’s cultural heritage and artifacts. Next, visit the Kota Kinabalu City Mosque, often called the Floating Mosque due to its serene lagoon setting.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: White Water Rafting
package_itineraries.description: Get ready for an adrenaline-filled day as you board a train to the starting point of your white water rafting adventure on the Padas River. Surrounded by lush scenery, this thrilling activity is followed by a hearty lunch before heading back to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Klias Wildlife Safari River Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Venture into the Klias wetlands, located about 112 km from Kota Kinabalu. Cruise along the river and spot exotic wildlife such as proboscis monkeys, silver leaf langurs, and long-tailed macaques.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart from Kota Kinabalu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Reach Kuala Lumpur – Petronas Twin Towers - KL Bird Park
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Kuala Lumpur, transfer to your hotel. Begin exploring the city with the Petronas Twin Towers, Batu Caves, and the KL Bird Park, home to over 3,000 bird species.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Johor Bahru - Johor Zoo - Johor Bahru Old Chinese Temple
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Johor Bahru and visit Johor Zoo, one of the oldest in Malaysia. Later, stop at the historic Johor Bahru Old Chinese Temple, which holds great cultural importance.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Legoland Malaysia - Desaru Beach
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy an entire day at Legoland Malaysia, where rides, attractions, and family-friendly entertainment await. In the evening, relax at Desaru Beach with options for boating, swimming, and fishing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Melaka - A’Famosa - Baba Nyonya Heritage Museum
package_itineraries.description: Discover Melaka, starting with the historic A’Famosa fortress ruins. Continue to the Baba Nyonya Heritage Museum, showcasing Peranakan culture and history.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Safari Wonderland - Jonker Street
package_itineraries.description: Head to A’Famosa Resort and enjoy Safari Wonderland, featuring live animal shows and rides. In the evening, stroll through Jonker Street, perfect for shopping antiques, souvenirs, and street food.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Arrive in Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Kuala Lumpur International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Begin exploring Kuala Lumpur with visits to the Petronas Twin Towers, Thean Hou Temple, Central Market, and Batu Caves. In the evening, enjoy the Kuala Selangor Fireflies Tour, a magical sight of glowing fireflies.

package_itineraries.title: Kuala Lumpur - Langkawi
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Langkawi and check into your hotel. Spend the rest of the day enjoying beach activities such as jet skiing, parasailing, or snorkeling.

package_itineraries.title: Langkawi Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Langkawi’s highlights including the Langkawi Sky Bridge, Dataran Lang, Telaga Tujuh Waterfall, and Underwater World Langkawi. Visit Kuah Town and Atma Alam Batik Art Village before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Langkawi Day 2
package_itineraries.description: Set out for a mangrove and geopark tour, a UNESCO site. Cruise along the Kilim River, spot sea eagles, and explore bat caves. Learn about rare plants like the Cycad Langkawiensis while admiring the island’s diverse birdlife.

package_itineraries.title: Depart Langkawi
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Langkawi International Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Reach Kuala Lumpur - Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing in Kuala Lumpur, head to your hotel. Begin your journey with a visit to Malacca, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its history and architecture. End the day at the Petronas Twin Towers, Kuala Lumpur’s iconic landmark.

package_itineraries.title: KL Bird Park - Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Batu Caves, a spiritual and cultural hub, followed by the National Mosque of Malaysia. Later, head to the KL Bird Park, a massive aviary home to over 3,000 birds from around the world.

package_itineraries.title: Kota Kinabalu - Lok Kawi Wildlife Park - Tanjung Aru Beach
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Kota Kinabalu and begin exploring with a visit to the Lok Kawi Wildlife Park. In the evening, unwind at Tanjung Aru Beach, famous for its beautiful sunsets.

package_itineraries.title: Sabah State Museum - Kota Kinabalu City Mosque
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at the Sabah State Museum, which houses cultural treasures, followed by the Floating Mosque, one of Kota Kinabalu’s most striking landmarks.

package_itineraries.title: Mount Kinabalu
package_itineraries.description: Witness the grandeur of Mount Kinabalu, Malaysia’s highest peak at 4,101 meters, known as one of the most accessible mountains in the world.

package_itineraries.title: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Gardens by the Bay - National Gallery Singapore - Singapore Zoo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Singapore and transfer to your hotel. Start your day at Gardens by the Bay, a futuristic nature park, then explore Southeast Asian art at the National Gallery. End the day at Singapore Zoo, home to over 4,000 animals.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Sentosa Island, where you can enjoy beaches, dolphin encounters, and cable car rides.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Universal Studios – Chinatown
package_itineraries.description: Step into a world of adventure at Universal Studios, Southeast Asia’s first. Experience themed rides and attractions, then head to Chinatown in the evening for delicious cuisine and souvenir shopping.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kuala Lumpur – Genting Highlands
package_itineraries.description: Travel by coach to Kuala Lumpur. Your first excursion is Genting Highlands, where you’ll visit Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park, Genting Strawberry Leisure Farm, and the Chin Swee Caves Temple.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Malacca - Petronas Twin Towers
package_itineraries.description: Explore Malacca, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, before visiting the famous Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Batu Caves - National Mosque of Malaysia
package_itineraries.description: Discover Batu Caves, a spiritual site with colorful shrines, followed by the serene National Mosque of Malaysia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Kuala Lumpur
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Pattaya – Experience the Alcazar Cabaret Show
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Bangkok International Airport, you'll be warmly welcomed and transferred to your hotel in the lively city of Pattaya. After check-in, prepare for a glittering evening at the world-famous Alcazar Cabaret Show. Known as Thailand’s top transvestite cabaret, the performance dazzles with vibrant costumes, state-of-the-art lighting, and music that celebrates Thai and international cultures. Return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Coral Island Adventure from Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a thrilling speedboat ride to Coral Island, the largest in Pattaya’s archipelago. Glide across crystal-clear waters and hop onto a glass-bottom boat to marvel at colorful marine life and coral reefs. You’ll have time to try out exhilarating water sports like parasailing and water skiing (optional). Return to your hotel and unwind for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Visit to Nong Nooch Village
package_itineraries.description: Begin your morning with breakfast before heading to Nong Nooch Village, a cultural park offering daily shows, themed gardens, and recreational activities. The sprawling botanical gardens and cultural performances reflect the heart of Thailand’s traditions and natural beauty. Spend the evening back at your Pattaya hotel in comfort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Travel to Bangkok – Explore the City’s Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your Pattaya hotel and travel to Bangkok. En route, embark on a guided city and temple tour. Visit Wat Traimit, home to the Golden Buddha, an awe-inspiring statue standing 3 meters tall and weighing over five tons. Then, explore the elegant Wat Benchamabophit (Marble Temple), a fine example of modern Thai architecture featuring Italian marble and serene surroundings. After sightseeing, check in to your hotel in Bangkok. Optional: Chao Phraya River Dinner Cruise – Enjoy an evening of dining and cultural performances while cruising past iconic Bangkok landmarks (additional cost).

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Safari World & Marine Park Experience
package_itineraries.description: Post breakfast, get ready for a wild day at Safari World and Marine Park. The Safari Park lets you get up close with exotic wildlife, including lions and tigers during the thrilling feeding session. The Marine Park features entertaining shows with dolphins, sea lions, and birds. After an adventurous day, return to your hotel in Bangkok and relax.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, you'll be transferred to Bangkok International Airport for your flight back home or onward journey. Carry with you the unforgettable memories of your Thai escapade.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Chiang Mai
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Chiang Mai Airport, you will be welcomed by our representative and escorted to your hotel. After check-in, take some time to refresh while we provide a brief overview of your itinerary and share essential travel tips for visiting Chiang Mai’s many sacred temples. Chiang Mai is renowned for its stunning temples, historic chedis (stupas), boutique stays, and vibrant night markets. It’s also a hub for adventure lovers, offering trekking, river rafting, and cultural visits to local hill tribes. Spend the rest of the day exploring the city at your leisure before an overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Chiang Mai Temple Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with a delicious complimentary breakfast buffet at the hotel. Your tour guide will share fascinating insights into the diverse temple styles of Thailand, including Thai, Burmese, Lanna, Sri Lankan, and Mon influences. The journey begins at Wat Phra Singh, one of Chiang Mai’s most treasured and historic temples. Marvel at the chedi’s exquisite Lanna-style architecture and the revered Phra Buddha Sihing statue. Next, visit Wat Chedi Luang, a magnificent 14th-century temple renowned for its towering stupa, standing about 282 feet tall and 144 feet wide. Once home to the sacred Emerald Buddha—one of Thailand’s most venerated relics—this temple partially collapsed during an earthquake centuries ago. Here, you may engage in thoughtful conversations with resident monks to learn more about Buddha and Buddhism. Please remember to seek their permission before taking photographs. Continue to Wat Suan Dok, a 14th-century temple that blends Lanna and Burmese styles, now home to important relics of Chiang Mai’s royal family. After the temple visits, take a well-deserved lunch break before heading to the Chiang Mai Market, the city’s largest and most popular shopping destination. Browse through an array of goods, including shoes, bags, handicrafts, and electronics, offering the perfect opportunity for souvenir hunting.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Chiang Mai
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, head to Mae Tang Elephant Camp, where you can enjoy captivating elephant shows, elephant rides, ox-cart rides, and other cultural activities. The scenic drive to the camp takes you through beautiful mountainous landscapes. Later, visit the Sankampaeng Area, famous for traditional Thai handicrafts such as lacquerware, silverware, and iconic Thai umbrellas. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Chiang Mai to Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with breakfast, then transfer to Chiang Mai Airport for your flight to Bangkok. Upon arrival in the bustling capital, embark on a half-day city tour featuring some of Bangkok’s most significant temples: Wat Pho – Home to the majestic Reclining Buddha and the city’s largest temple complex. Wat Traimit – Known for its massive golden Buddha statue, one of the largest in the world. Wat Benchamabopit (The Marble Temple) – A 19th-century architectural gem built with Italian marble. The tour also includes a visit to Bangkok’s renowned gems and jewellery stores, where you can shop for jade and other precious stones. Spend the evening at leisure before staying overnight in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, make a final stop at Indra Market for souvenir shopping before bidding farewell to Bangkok, carrying with you cherished memories of its rich heritage.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Krabi
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Krabi International Airport, our friendly representative will greet you and arrange a smooth transfer to your hotel. After check-in, take time to relax and absorb the charm of Thailand’s stunning coastline. Bask in the sunshine, enjoy the fresh sea breeze, and leave the stress of daily life behind. The coastline of Krabi is dotted with dramatic limestone formations that create unforgettable silhouettes against the sparkling Andaman Sea. The rest of the day is at leisure. Spend a serene night in Krabi, surrounded by its coastal beauty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Krabi – Four Island Adventure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a thrilling island-hopping journey aboard a speedboat. Discover the jewels of the Krabi Sea—Tub Island, Chicken Island, Poda Island, and the picturesque Pranang Cave. Enjoy swimming in turquoise waters, snorkelling among vibrant marine life, sunbathing on soft white sand, and capturing postcard-perfect photographs. Marvel at the tropical charm of coconut-lined shores and crystal-clear lagoons. In the evening, return to your hotel and rest overnight in Krabi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Krabi to Phuket (Approx. 158 km / 2 hrs 30 mins)
package_itineraries.description: This morning, enjoy a scenic drive to Phuket, the sparkling gem of the Andaman Sea, famed for its gorgeous beaches and island charm. After checking in at your hotel, the day is yours to explore or simply relax. Overnight stay in Phuket. Optional Activity – Phuket Fantasea Show (No Dinner) For an unforgettable evening, experience the Phuket Fantasea Show—a cultural extravaganza combining dazzling special effects, music, dance, and even performing elephants. Hosted at the impressive Palace of the Elephants Theater, the performance brings to life Thai traditions, myths, and values in spectacular style.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Explore the Wonders of Phi Phi Island from Phuket
package_itineraries.description: Today, take a ferry to Phi Phi Island and fall in love with its powdery beaches, framed by towering limestone cliffs and surrounded by crystal waters. Spend the day soaking up the views, swimming, or simply relaxing. Return to Phuket in the afternoon for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Phuket to Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Phuket International Airport for your flight to Bangkok. On arrival, you’ll be transferred to your hotel in the city’s heart. The evening is free to unwind. Overnight stay in Bangkok. Optional Evening – Chaophraya River Cruise Dinner Sail along the Chao Phraya River, enjoying a delicious buffet dinner while admiring illuminated landmarks and temples. Live music and performances complete the experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Explore Bangkok’s Rich Heritage
package_itineraries.description: Begin your city tour with a visit to the Golden Buddha temple, home to a 3-metre-tall, 5.5-ton solid gold Buddha from the Sukhothai Period. Continue to Chinatown to see the gold-plated Reclining Buddha, measuring 46 metres in length. In the evening, enjoy leisure time or go shopping. Overnight in Bangkok. Optional Tour – Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World & Madame Tussauds Visit Southeast Asia’s largest aquarium or meet lifelike wax figures of world-famous personalities at Madame Tussauds.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Farewell Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Bangkok International Airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at Bangkok – Pattaya – Alcazar Show
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Bangkok International Airport, where our representative will greet you and assist with your transfer to the scenic city of Pattaya. After checking in at your hotel and taking some time to refresh, prepare for a spectacular evening at the world-famous Alcazar Cabaret Show. Known globally as one of Thailand’s finest cabarets, Alcazar features dazzling costumes, incredible choreography, and a blend of traditional and contemporary performances. After the show, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay in Pattaya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Pattaya – Coral Island
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on an exciting speedboat ride to Coral Island, the largest jewel in Pattaya’s chain of islands. Admire the colourful marine life and coral reefs through a glass-bottom boat, then enjoy thrilling water sports like parasailing, water skiing, and more. Spend the evening at leisure before returning to your hotel in Pattaya for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Pattaya – Safari World & Marine Park – Nong Nooch Village
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before heading to Bangkok’s Safari World & Marine Park. At Safari Park, get up close with exotic and endangered animals, and witness the dramatic tiger and lion feeding shows. Continue to Marine Park for dolphin and seal performances, along with entertaining bird and ape shows. Later, visit Nong Nooch Village, a beautifully landscaped park featuring cultural shows, themed gardens, and dining options. End the day with an overnight stay at your hotel in Pattaya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Farewell to Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you will be transferred to Bangkok International Airport for your onward journey or flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Phuket
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Phuket International Airport, our welcoming team will be there to meet you and escort you to your hotel in Phuket. Check in to your accommodation, a true treasure on the Andaman Sea coastline and an ideal tropical getaway. The rest of the day is free for you to relax or explore at leisure. Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay at your hotel in Phuket.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover the Beauty of Phi Phi Island
package_itineraries.description: Savour a hearty breakfast before setting out on an exciting ferry ride to Phi Phi Island. Absorb the natural beauty of powdery beaches bordered by dramatic limestone cliffs and turquoise waters. Spend the day soaking in the charm of this island paradise. Later in the afternoon, return to Phuket and enjoy a peaceful evening. Overnight stay at your hotel in Phuket.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: From Phuket to the Heart of Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Phuket International Airport for your flight to Bangkok. Upon arrival at Bangkok International Airport, you’ll be greeted and transferred to your hotel in central Bangkok. Once checked in, take the rest of the day to explore or unwind at your pace. Overnight stay at your Bangkok hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Bangkok - City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Start with breakfast before embarking on a captivating temple and city tour. Your first stop is the Golden Buddha temple, home to a magnificent seated golden Buddha from the Sukhothai Period, measuring 3 metres high and weighing five and a half tons. Continue to the Marble Temple (Wat Benchamabophit), an exquisite example of Thai religious architecture built with white Carara Italian marble. Here you’ll find a replica of Thailand’s most admired Buddha image. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departing Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before your transfer to Bangkok International Airport for your journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Singapore – Night Safari
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Changi Airport, meet our tour representative, who will transfer you to your hotel. After check-in and some rest, begin your adventure with the Night Safari at Mandai Wildlife Reserve. This unique open-air zoo, the first of its kind, is home to thousands of animals and offers a memorable wildlife experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Singapore City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Your second day starts with a tour of key attractions, such as Gardens By The Bay, a 101-hectare nature park; the National Gallery, with impressive Southeast Asian art collections; and Merlion Park, known for the half-lion, half-fish statue. You’ll also see the Esplanade Theatre, Suntec City, Marina Bay, and the Indian National Army Monument, which honors INA soldiers. End the day with a visit to the Singapore Zoo, home to more than 2,800 animals.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sentosa Island – Universal Studios
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your city hotel and head to Sentosa Island. Begin with Universal Studios, Southeast Asia’s only Universal Studios theme park, famous for rides, games, and shows inspired by films such as Jurassic Park, Shrek, and Madagascar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Sentosa Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Continue exploring Sentosa Island, which offers over 25 attractions, including SEA Aquarium, Adventure Cove Waterpark, Madame Tussauds, and Palawan Beach. Enjoy a cable car ride from Mount Faber or try the Skyline Luge and Skyride for scenic island views.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Singapore – Pattaya – Big Buddha Temple – Dolphin World
package_itineraries.description: Fly from Singapore to Bangkok, where you’ll be met and taken to your Pattaya hotel. Visit the Big Buddha Temple with its towering 300-foot statue, then enjoy a fun dolphin show at Dolphin World.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Coral Island – Night Bazaar
package_itineraries.description: Travel by speedboat to Coral Island, Pattaya’s largest and a popular tourist spot. Relax on golden beaches or take part in parasailing, snorkelling, banana boat rides, and more. In the evening, visit Pattaya’s bustling Night Bazaar for shopping.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Pattaya – Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Drive from Pattaya to Bangkok. Spend the rest of the day at leisure or opt for a Chao Phraya River Cruise with dinner, live music, and views of riverside temples and landmarks. End with a dazzling Cabaret Show.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Bangkok City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Grand Palace, the Golden Buddha Temple with its 5.5-ton gold statue, Wat Pho with its enormous reclining Buddha, and Wat Arun, the Temple of the Dawn.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Depart from Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Bangkok - Transfer to Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Bangkok International Airport, meet our representatives, and proceed by coach to Pattaya. Situated along the eastern Gulf of Thailand, this vibrant city offers gorgeous beaches, bustling shopping, and exciting attractions. Once a quaint fishing village, Pattaya has become a top destination in Thailand. On arrival, check in to the hotel and relax. Later, watch the Alcazar Show, also known as Tiffany’s Show, a dazzling combination of costumes, art, and stage effects. Enjoy the performance before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before embarking on a Coral Island excursion. Witness colourful coral reefs and marine life via a glass-bottom boat. Try water activities such as parasailing, jet skiing, snorkelling, and sunbathing. Later, return to the city for shopping. Evening at leisure before heading back to the hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Pattaya - Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, journey to Bangkok, Thailand’s bustling capital. A half-day guided city tour will cover its renowned temple monasteries, including Wat Pho (Temple of the Reclining Buddha), Wat Trimit (Temple of the Solid Gold Buddha), and Wat Benchamabopit (The Marble Temple). Continue to the world-famous Gems and Jewelry Shop for jade shopping. Spend the remainder of the day at leisure and return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Bangkok Departure
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast and shop at Indhira Market before our guide transfers you to Bangkok International Airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Bangkok – Transfer to Hua Hin
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Bangkok Airport, you'll be greeted and driven to the serene seaside town of Hua Hin. After check-in and some rest, visit the historic Phetchaburi Palace via cable car. Later, wander through the lively night market and enjoy the local culture. Overnight stay in Hua Hin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hua Hin Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast and head out for a full-day city tour. Visit the Queen’s Project animal sanctuary to learn about Thailand’s wildlife conservation efforts. Continue to the beautiful Maruka Thai Yawan Palace, also called the Palace of Love and Hope, built entirely from teakwood. End the day at Khao Takiab (Monkey Mountain), which combines a Buddhist monastery with stunning coastal views. Return to Hua Hin for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hua Hin to Bangkok – Half-Day City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and drive to Bangkok. Your sightseeing begins with visits to Wat Pho (Reclining Buddha Temple), Wat Traimit (Golden Buddha Temple), and Wat Benchamabophit (Marble Temple). Next, visit the famous Gems and Jewelry Shop to browse authentic jade pieces. The remainder of the day is at your leisure before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Bangkok Departure
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a quick breakfast and head to Indira Market for some last-minute shopping. In the evening, you’ll be transferred to Bangkok International Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Phuket – FantaSea Show
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Phuket International Airport, you will be greeted and transferred to your hotel. After settling in, enjoy the Phuket FantaSea Show, a cultural theme park showcasing Thailand’s heritage through performances, shopping, and dining. Activities include browsing the Tribal Craft Bazaar, dining at the Golden Kinnaree Buffet Restaurant, shopping at Iyara Grande, and even elephant rides at Palace Court. End the evening exploring local markets before an overnight stay in Phuket.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phi-Phi Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast before setting off on a ferry to Phi-Phi Island, famed for its turquoise waters, vibrant coral reefs, and marine life such as leopard sharks and manta rays. Visit attractions like Maya Bay, Loh Samah Bay, Ko Yao Yai, and Laem Tong Beach. Activities include snorkelling, swimming, and glass-bottom boat rides. Return to your hotel and unwind at a wellness spa.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Phuket – Bangkok – Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Phuket Airport for your flight to Bangkok, then continue by coach to Pattaya. Explore the vibrant beaches, bustling night markets, and unique street food stalls. In the evening, attend the Alcazar Show, a spectacular cabaret performance featuring stunning costumes and choreography. Overnight stay in Pattaya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: Discover Pattaya’s attractions, including: The Sanctuary of Truth – An all-wood structure blending Hindu and Buddhist design. Wat Yansangwararam – Inspired by India’s Mahabodhi Temple. Enjoy water sports at Coral Island, visit Underwater World Pattaya, and stroll through Nong Nooch Tropical Botanical Garden. End the day with shopping in local markets. Overnight stay in Pattaya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Return to Bangkok for a half-day city tour, covering: Wat Pho – Temple of the Reclining Buddha. Wat Traimit – Golden Buddha Temple. Wat Benchamabopit – The Marble Temple. Explore The Grand Palace, Wat Arun, and Chatuchak Market. Overnight in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Safari World – Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Visit Safari World, Asia’s largest open zoo, where you can observe animals in a natural setting and enjoy attractions in the Marine Park, including wildlife shows and aquarium visits.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, shop for souvenirs at Indra Market before departing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Chiang Mai
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Chiang Mai International Airport, where our representative will meet and transfer you to your hotel. The rest of the day is at leisure. Overnight stay in Chiang Mai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Chiang Mai – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Chiang Mai’s cultural gems. Visit Wat Suan Dok, Wat Chiang Man—the city’s oldest temple—and the hilltop Doi Suthep Temple. Drive around the Old City, taking in the City Moat and Ruined City Gate. Conclude with a stroll through Warorot Market before returning to your hotel. Overnight stay in Chiang Mai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Chiang Mai – Day at Leisure
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then spend the day as you please. Optional Experience – Khantoke Dinner Savour a traditional northern Thai dinner served on low tables while enjoying cultural performances from local hill tribes.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Chiang Mai to Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Bangkok and transfer to your hotel. The evening is free to relax. Overnight stay in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bangkok – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Golden Buddha temple and the gold-plated Reclining Buddha in Chinatown, both iconic symbols of Thai heritage. Enjoy free time for shopping or relaxation. Overnight stay in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departing Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Bangkok International Airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Bangkok – Phuket – Fantasea Show
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Phuket Airport, meet our representative for your transfer to the hotel. Phuket, the largest island in Thailand, is surrounded by the Andaman Sea and known for its lush scenery. Spend the afternoon relaxing at your resort before enjoying the spectacular Phuket Fantasea Show in the evening. Overnight in Phuket.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phuket – Phi-Phi Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, board an express boat to the stunning Phi-Phi Islands. Visit Maya Bay, snorkel at Coral Bay, and enjoy swimming in crystal-clear waters. After lunch, return to Phuket for an evening at leisure. Overnight in Phuket.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Phuket – Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, fly to Bangkok. Embark on a half-day city tour, visiting iconic temples like Wat Pho (Reclining Buddha), Wat Trimit (Solid Gold Buddha), and Wat Benchamabopit (Marble Temple). Stop by the Gems and Jewelry centre before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Bangkok – Safari World
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before visiting Safari World, divided into Safari Park and Marine Park. Encounter wildlife in the open zoo, then enjoy entertaining shows such as the Dolphin Show, Bird Show, and Sea Lion Show. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bangkok Departure
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast, shop at Indhira Market, and transfer to Bangkok International Airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arriving in Bangkok – Phuket-Fantasea Show
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Phuket Airport, where our team will welcome you and escort you to your hotel. Phuket, the largest island in Thailand, sits in the Andaman Sea and is famed for its scenic landscapes. After check-in, enjoy a leisurely afternoon at the beach resort. In the evening, witness the dazzling Fantasea Show before returning to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phuket-Phi Phi Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, board the Express Boat to Phi Phi Island. Marvel at the beauty of Maya Bay and enjoy water activities. If you’re eager for underwater adventure, visit Coral Bay for swimming and snorkelling, spotting colourful marine life. After lunch, return to Phuket for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Phuket to Bangkok to Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: Have an early breakfast and transfer to Phuket Airport for your flight to Bangkok. Upon arrival, meet our representatives and travel to Pattaya by coach. Once a fishing town, Pattaya is now a vibrant tourist hub with beaches, shopping, and attractions. In the evening, enjoy the spectacular Alcazar Show and return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a coral island excursion, experiencing marine beauty through a glass-bottom boat. Try exciting watersports like parasailing, jet-skiing, snorkelling, or simply relax on the sand. Return to Pattaya for some shopping, then unwind at your hotel overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Pattaya to Bangkok - Departure
package_itineraries.description: Start with breakfast before a shopping visit to Indhira Market. In the evening, transfer to Bangkok International Airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Bangkok to Krabi City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Bangkok Airport and connect to a flight to Krabi. After hotel check-in, enjoy free time before an afternoon city tour of Krabi’s main sights. Overnight in Krabi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Krabi – Four Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Krabi’s famous islands, ideal for swimming, photography, snorkelling, and sunbathing on soft beaches fringed with coconut palms. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Krabi to Phi-Phi Island Tour to Phuket
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then board an Express Boat to Phi-Phi Island. Visit Maya Bay, snorkel at Coral Bay, and have lunch before continuing to Phuket for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Phuket – Fantasea Show
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Phuket, Thailand’s largest island. In the evening, enjoy the vibrant Fantasea Show before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Phuket Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, relax or explore until your transfer to Phuket Airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival In Chiang Mai
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Chiang Mai International Airport, meet our representative for hotel transfer. Receive a tour briefing and tips for visiting religious sites. Chiang Mai is celebrated for its handicrafts like silverware, lacquerware, woodwork, and umbrellas. Its historic temples, charming chedis, boutique stays, and night markets make it unforgettable. Adventure seekers will love activities like ziplining, rafting, trekking, and ATV rides. Enjoy the city at leisure before staying overnight in Chiang Mai.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Chiang Mai Temple Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Wat Chedi Luang, a 14th-century temple with an impressive Lanna-style chedi. Other highlights include: Wat Phra Singh – A temple with distinctive Lanna design influenced by Burmese and Sri Lankan styles, renowned for its detailed art and carvings. Wat Suan Dok – Also known as Wat Buppharam, this temple features Lanna architecture and houses a 500-year-old bronze Buddha statue. Visit in June for its annual fair. End the day at Chiang Mai Market for clothes, souvenirs, and jewellery before returning to the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Chiang Mai To Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast with Indian, Thai, and Continental dishes plus tropical fruits. Fly to Bangkok and check in to the hotel. Later, take a half-day city tour covering Wat Pho, Wat Traimit, and Wat Benchamabopit. Finish with jade and souvenir shopping at Bangkok’s gem stores. Overnight in a luxury Bangkok hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Safari World – Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Visit Safari World, Asia’s largest open-air zoo, home to lions, tigers, and zebras. Explore its Marine Park with live shows, an aquarium, and thrill zones. Activities include jungle cruises, underwater experiences, and animal shows like dolphins and orang-utans. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bangkok Departure
package_itineraries.description: Complete your shopping at Indra Market before flying back to India from Bangkok International Airport.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Phuket
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Phuket International Airport, meet your guide and transfer to your hotel. Known for its beaches and stunning Andaman coastline, Phuket is a great place to unwind. Enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure. Optional Activity: Attend the Fantasea Show – a grand Thai cultural performance featuring magical effects, elephants, and theatrical storytelling (extra charge).

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phi Phi Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a ferry to the world-renowned Phi Phi Islands. Soak up the beauty of white sand beaches, towering limestone cliffs, and clear turquoise waters. Lunch is included. Return to Phuket in the evening and relax at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Fly from Phuket to Pattaya via Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Bangkok. From there, continue to Pattaya and check in at your hotel. The remainder of the day is free to explore or relax. Overnight stay in Pattaya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Coral Island Excursion from Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast and embark on a speedboat ride to Coral Island. Discover the underwater world through a glass-bottom boat and enjoy water activities like parasailing. Lunch is provided, and your evening is free for leisure. Overnight stay in Pattaya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Transfer to Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Bangkok and check in to your hotel. The rest of the day is yours. Optional Tour: Chao Phraya River Cruise with Dinner – Enjoy a buffet, live entertainment, and beautiful city views from the river (extra cost).

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Bangkok Temple Tour
package_itineraries.description: Today’s city tour begins after breakfast. Visit Wat Traimit (Golden Buddha) and Wat Benchamabophit (Marble Temple), known for its exquisite architecture and serene atmosphere. Optional Visit: Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World and Madame Tussauds – One of Southeast Asia's largest aquariums and a popular wax museum featuring global celebrities (additional cost). Stay overnight in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you'll be transferred to Bangkok International Airport for your onward journey. Take home memories of adventure, culture, and relaxation.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Bangkok – Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Bangkok, transfer to Pattaya and check into your hotel. Spend the rest of the day relaxing or opt to attend the Alcazar Show, a world-famous cabaret performance. Overnight in Pattaya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Pattaya – Coral Island
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a speedboat ride to Coral Island. Marvel at the underwater world through a glass-bottom boat and try activities like parasailing and water skiing. Spend the evening at leisure before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Pattaya to Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Bangkok after breakfast and check in to your hotel. Optional evening activity: Chao Phraya Cruise for stunning riverside views, live music, and traditional performances. Overnight in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Explore Bangkok’s Beauty
package_itineraries.description: Take a guided city tour, visiting: Golden Buddha Temple – Featuring a 3-metre-tall golden statue. Marble Temple (Wat Benchamabopit) – Built from Italian marble with a replica of Thailand’s most beautiful Buddha image. Optional visits include Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World or Madame Tussauds Bangkok (additional cost). Overnight stay in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Farewell to Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Bangkok International Airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Bangkok – Chao Phraya River Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, check into your hotel. In the evening, enjoy a Chao Phraya River Cruise featuring a buffet dinner, live music, and panoramic views of illuminated temples and landmarks. Overnight in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a city and temple tour, visiting the Golden Buddha and the Marble Temple (Wat Benchamabophit), known for its white Carrara marble architecture. The afternoon is free. Overnight stay in Bangkok

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Day at Leisure
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring on your own or opt for exciting excursions. Optional – Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World & Madame Tussauds Walk above sharks at Southeast Asia’s largest aquarium or mingle with wax figures of global icons at Madame Tussauds.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Krabi
package_itineraries.description: Fly into Krabi via Bangkok International Airport and check in at your hotel. Enjoy the striking coastal views with dramatic limestone cliffs and turquoise waters. Spend the day relaxing or exploring at your own pace. Overnight in Krabi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Krabi – Four Island Adventure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off on a speedboat trip to Tub Island, Chicken Island, Poda Island, and Pranang Cave. Swim, snorkel, sunbathe, and take in the rich marine life and soft white sands. Return to your hotel in Krabi for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Krabi to Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, fly to Bangkok and check in at your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure. Optional: Chaophraya River Cruise Dinner with live music and scenic views (additional cost). Overnight in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Bangkok City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Take a guided city and temple tour, visiting the Golden Buddha, the Reclining Buddha, and other historic landmarks. Spend the evening at leisure or go shopping. Optional: Visit Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World & Madame Tussauds (additional cost). Overnight in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Bangkok International Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Koh Samui
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Koh Samui Island, meet our representative for a transfer to your hotel. Settle in and enjoy exploring nearby areas like Mae Nam and Choeng Mon for beaches or local shopping. In the evening, visit Koh Phangan, famed for its coral reefs and Full Moon Party. Return to your hotel in Koh Samui for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Koh Samui Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, tour Koh Samui’s highlights including Wat Phra Yai, Ladd Koh, Wat Kunaram, the Hin Ta and Hin Yai Rocks, and Tarnim Magic Garden. Enjoy the island’s beaches, lush rainforests, and cultural landmarks. Overnight stay in Koh Samui.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Koh Samui - Bangkok and Phuket
package_itineraries.description: Post-breakfast, check out and fly to Bangkok. After check-in, explore the city’s vibrant streets and cultural sites. Later, take a flight to Phuket, known for its beaches, temples, and vibrant nightlife. Visit FantaSea Park for a cultural and entertainment experience. Overnight stay in Phuket.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Phuket - Phi Phi Island
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before exploring Phuket’s attractions like Big Buddha, Old Phuket Town, Freedom Beach, and Monkey Hill. Then, visit Phi Phi Island to see Maya Bay, Monkey Beach, Bamboo Island, and Viking Caves. Return to your resort for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Phuket - Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your return flight to Bangkok, followed by your onward journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Phuket
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Phuket International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the day at leisure or attend the optional Phuket Fantasea Show, a grand cultural performance with music, costumes, and special effects.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phuket – Phi Phi Island Excursion
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a ferry to Phi Phi Island, famous for white beaches, limestone cliffs, and turquoise waters. Return to Phuket in the afternoon for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Phuket – Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Bangkok and transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure or opt for the Chaophraya River Cruise Dinner with scenic views and live entertainment.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Exploring Bangkok – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin with the Golden Buddha Temple, home to a 5.5-ton gold statue, then visit the Marble Temple. Optional activities include Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World and Madame Tussauds Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departing Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before your transfer to Bangkok International Airport for your onward journey.
