package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Phuket Airport, our team will escort you to your resort. Phuket, Thailand’s largest island, is surrounded by the sparkling Andaman Sea. After settling in, enjoy the spectacular Fantasea Show in the evening, which combines traditional Thai culture with advanced technology and vibrant stage performances. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Phi Phi Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off by express boat to the breathtaking Phi Phi Islands. Visit Maya Bay, famous for its scenic beauty. For those interested in marine life, Coral Bay offers snorkelling opportunities with a chance to spot tropical fish. Enjoy time on the Sun Deck before heading back to Phuket. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: James Bond Island Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast before heading to James Bond Island, located in Phang Nga Bay. Known for its appearance in "The Man with the Golden Gun," this location features towering limestone cliffs and emerald-green waters. Explore caves, enjoy canoeing, or simply soak in the panoramic views before returning to Phuket for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure from Phuket
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast and enjoy the morning at your own pace. Whether you relax at the resort or explore nearby attractions, the day is yours. Later, you will be transferred to Phuket International Airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Bangkok – Transfer to Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Bangkok and transfer to Pattaya. After check-in, enjoy the Alcazar or Tiffany Show, a dazzling cabaret experience. Overnight stay in Pattaya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: Visit Coral Island, where you can enjoy water sports and a glass-bottom boat ride to view the coral reefs. Return to Pattaya for shopping and leisure time. Overnight in Pattaya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Pattaya – Nong Nooch Village
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Nong Nooch Village, exploring tropical gardens, orchid nurseries, and cultural shows. Witness elephants performing and enjoy the scenic beauty before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Pattaya to Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Bangkok for a half-day city tour featuring: Wat Pho – The Reclining Buddha Temple. Wat Traimit – The Golden Buddha Temple. Wat Benchamabopit – The Marble Temple. Shop for jade at the famous Gems and Jewelry Shop before enjoying your evening at leisure. Overnight in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Shop at Indhira Market before transferring to Bangkok International Airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Krabi
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Krabi International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight stay in Krabi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Four Island Adventure
package_itineraries.description: Hop on a speedboat to Tub Island, Chicken Island, Poda Island, and Pranang Cave. Enjoy snorkelling, swimming, and photography before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Krabi to Phuket
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Phuket and check in to your hotel. Optional – Phuket Fantasea Show A spectacular Thai cultural performance with dazzling effects and music.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Phi Phi Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Sail to Phi Phi Island and relax on pristine beaches before returning to Phuket.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Phuket – Bangkok – Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Bangkok and transfer to Pattaya. The day is free to relax.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Coral Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Take a speedboat to Coral Island. Enjoy marine views from a glass-bottom boat or try water sports like parasailing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Pattaya to Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Bangkok and spend the evening at leisure. Optional – Chaophraya River Cruise Dinner Enjoy riverside views, music, and a buffet dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Bangkok City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Golden Buddha and the Reclining Buddha in Chinatown. Evening free for shopping. Optional – Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World & Madame Tussauds Explore marine wonders or meet wax figures of celebrities.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Koh Samui
package_itineraries.description: Meet your guide at Koh Samui International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Receive an overview of the itinerary and local customs. Spend the day relaxing or exploring nearby beaches. Overnight in Koh Samui.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Koh Samui Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, tour highlights such as Grandpa and Grandma Rocks, Nathon Town, Na Muang 2 Waterfalls, and the Big Buddha Monument. Enjoy local markets in the evening like Bankrak and Chaweng Walking Market. Overnight in Koh Samui.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Koh Samui to Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Bangkok and check in at your hotel. Visit famous landmarks such as Wat Pho, Wat Traimit, and Wat Benchamabopit. Spend the evening exploring markets like Chatuchak and Or Tor Kor. Overnight in Bangkok.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Safari World – Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Safari World, Asia’s largest open-air zoo. Explore the Safari Park and Marine Park with animal shows and exhibits. Return to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bangkok Departure
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a final breakfast before visiting Indra Market for souvenirs. Transfer to Bangkok International Airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at Koh Samui
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Koh Samui Airport, where you’ll be greeted and transferred to your hotel. The evening is yours to relax and prepare for the adventures ahead. Overnight stay in Koh Samui.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Koh Samui with a City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided Koh Samui City Tour, visiting the island’s most famous sights. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Koh Samui - Ang Thong National Park
package_itineraries.description: Post-breakfast, explore Ang Thong National Park, a cluster of 42 islands in the Gulf of Thailand. After your day trip, return to your hotel in Koh Samui for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Koh Samui - Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, check out, and transfer to the airport for your flight to Bangkok. On arrival, transfer to your hotel and spend the night in the vibrant capital. Optional Tour: Chao Phraya Cruise – No Dinner (Additional Cost): Enjoy a cruise with panoramic views, live music, and a buffet-style dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Exploring Bangkok's Rich Heritage
package_itineraries.description: Start with breakfast before visiting the Golden Buddha temple, home to a magnificent gold statue from the Sukhothai Period. Next, see the Marble Temple (Wat Benchamabophit), crafted from Carrara marble and housing a beautiful Buddha replica. Overnight stay in Bangkok. Optional Excursion: Visit Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World or Madame Tussauds Bangkok (additional cost).

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departing Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast, then transfer to Bangkok International Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Arrival & Welcome to Thailand
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at destination airport. Meet your private chauffeur and transfer to your luxury hotel. Relax and enjoy a leisure evening.

package_itineraries.title: Full Day Highlights of Thailand
package_itineraries.description: Scenic tour of iconic attractions, cultural landmarks, panoramic viewpoints, and local gourmet experiences.

package_itineraries.title: Full Day Highlights of Bangkok
package_itineraries.description: Scenic tour of iconic attractions, cultural landmarks, panoramic viewpoints, and local gourmet experiences.

package_itineraries.title: Full Day Highlights of Pattaya
package_itineraries.description: Scenic tour of iconic attractions, cultural landmarks, panoramic viewpoints, and local gourmet experiences.

package_itineraries.title: Departure & Farewell from Thailand
package_itineraries.description: Relish a lavish breakfast, check out of your resort, and transfer to the airport with wonderful memories of your journey.

package_itineraries.title: Arrival in Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Saigon and take an evening tour of the Reunification Palace, Central Post Office, Notre Dame Cathedral, Nguyen Hue Street, and Ben Thanh Market. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Saigon - Mekong Delta - Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Cruise along the Mekong River , visit islands, enjoy honey tea, taste coconut candy, and ride a horse-cart through a village. Stop at Vinh Trang Pagoda before returning to Saigon. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Saigon - Cu Chi Tunnels
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Cu Chi Tunnels , with the option to crawl through narrow passages. Evening free for shopping at Ben Thanh Market, Saigon Square, or Diamond Plaza. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Depart Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport after breakfast for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival at Hanoi and City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Upon arriving at Hanoi International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred to your hotel for check-in. Once refreshed, begin your exploration of Hanoi. Visit the Temple of Literature , Vietnam’s very first university, admired for its architecture and historic value. Continue to Ba Dinh Square , an iconic landmark where many national events are held. Later, enjoy a traditional “cyclo” ride around the atmospheric Old Quarter of Hanoi before stopping at Ngoc Son Temple on Hoan Kiem Lake. Overnight stay at your hotel in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi - Tam Coc - Hoa Lu - Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, journey south to Ninh Binh , home to picturesque countryside and historic sites. Begin with a tranquil boat trip through the Tam Coc caves , where limestone karsts rise dramatically from rice fields, creating scenery often called “Halong Bay on land.” Next, explore the ancient capital of Hoa Lu , once the seat of Vietnam’s royalty, and admire temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le. Lunch is included. By late afternoon, return to Hanoi for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi to Halong
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before departing for Halong Bay , recognized by UNESCO as a World Heritage site in 1994. Embark on a scenic boat cruise across emerald waters, surrounded by thousands of limestone cliffs and caves. Relish a seafood lunch on board before visiting the Surprising Grotto , with time for swimming or kayaking. Sail past floating villages and striking islands, then enjoy dinner on the boat. Stay overnight on board, immersed in Halong’s beauty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Halong to Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, continue your cruise to the serene Luon Cave , a circular lagoon surrounded by towering cliffs and lush greenery. On your return journey, pass remarkable islets with curious names such as Cock-Fighting Rock, Sail Island, Incense Burner Rock, and Sea Dog Rock. Lunch will be served before disembarking. By evening, return to Hanoi and enjoy free time. Overnight at your hotel in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Leaving Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight home or to your onward destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi and City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Hanoi, check in, and explore the Temple of Literature, Ba Dinh Square, and Ngoc Son Temple via a cyclo ride through the Old Quarter. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi to Halong Bay
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Halong Bay , a UNESCO Natural World Heritage site. Cruise among limestone islands, enjoy seafood lunch, and visit the Surprising Grotto . Optional swimming or kayaking. Dinner and overnight on board.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Halong Bay to Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Visit Luon Cave , a tranquil lagoon, before cruising past islets like Cock-Fighting Rock and Incense Burner Rock. Return to Hanoi for check-in. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Leaving Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi – Evening City Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Noi Bai Airport, where you’ll be greeted and transferred to your hotel. In the evening, begin your exploration with a visit to the Temple of Literature, Vietnam’s first university built in 1070. Stroll through its serene gardens and admire well-preserved architecture that offers a glimpse into the country’s scholarly past. Continue to Hoan Kiem Lake and the Ngoc Son Temple, followed by a leisurely cyclo ride through Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi – Tam Coc & Hoa Lu – Return to Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel south to Ninh Binh, home to the scenic Tam Coc Caves and the ancient capital Hoa Lu. Glide along the waterways on a traditional sampan boat, passing limestone karsts that rise dramatically from emerald rice fields—earning the nickname “Halong Bay on land.” Visit the 10th-century temples of King Dinh and King Le, famed for their intricate wooden carvings. Enjoy lunch en route before returning to Hanoi for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi to Halong Bay Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before heading to the UNESCO-listed Halong Bay. Board a traditional vessel to cruise through a seascape dotted with limestone islands and hidden grottoes. Savor a seafood lunch on board, visit the Surprising Grotto, and choose between swimming or kayaking. Glide past floating villages and secluded islets before dining and spending the night aboard the boat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Halong Bay – Hanoi – Flight to Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Begin the morning with a visit to Luon Cave, a tranquil lagoon surrounded by cliffs. As you cruise back, pass iconic rock formations like Cock-Fighting Rock and Sail Island. Disembark at Halong Wharf and return to Hanoi for your flight to Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City). Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Saigon – Mekong Delta Excursion
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, journey to the Mekong Delta and embark on a boat cruise along the mighty river. Visit one of the area’s lush islands, ride through coconut-lined canals in small rowboats, and explore local workshops. Enjoy a horse-cart ride along peaceful village paths before visiting the ornate Vinh Trang Pagoda, blending Chinese, Cambodian, and French design elements. Return to Saigon for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels & City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore the legendary Cu Chi Tunnels, a 200km underground network used during the war for shelter, storage, and defense. Return to Saigon to visit the Reunification Palace and the War Remnants Museum, then view European-inspired landmarks like the City Hall and the Opera House from the outside. Stop at Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office before spending the night in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Saigon to Siem Reap – First Glimpse of Cambodia
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, fly to Siem Reap. Visit Wat Thmei, the “Killing Field” memorial with its striking glass stupa. Continue to Les Artisans d’Angkor – Chantiers École to discover the preservation of Khmer arts and crafts. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Siem Reap – Angkor Thom & Angkor Wat
package_itineraries.description: Explore the South Gate of Angkor Thom and marvel at the Terrace of the Elephants, Baphuon temple, Phimeanakas, and the Terrace of the Leper King. In the afternoon, visit the world-famous Angkor Wat, a stunning architectural masterpiece inspired by Hindu cosmology. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Siem Reap – Temples & Sunset
package_itineraries.description: Discover Ta Prohm, where giant tree roots entwine ancient stone walls. Visit Srah Srang royal bath, Thommanon temple, Preah Khan, Ta Som, and end the day at Pre Rup temple for a spectacular sunset view. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure from Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast before transferring to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Hanoi and begin a city tour featuring the Temple of Literature , Ba Dinh Square , and the Old Quarter by cyclo, including a visit to Ngoc Son Temple . Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi - Tam Coc - Hoa Lu - Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Head to Ninh Binh for a boat trip through the Tam Coc caves and a visit to the ancient capital Hoa Lu . See temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le. Lunch included. Return to Hanoi for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi to Halong
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Halong Bay , a UNESCO Natural World Heritage site. Cruise among limestone cliffs, visit caves, and enjoy swimming or kayaking. Dinner and overnight on board.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Halong – Hanoi – Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Cruise back to Halong Wharf, passing by Cock-Fighting Rock, Sail Island, and other famous islets. Return to Hanoi and fly to Saigon . Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Saigon – Mekong Delta – Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Mekong Delta with boat trips, island visits, local factory stops, honey tea tasting, and a horse-cart ride. Visit Vinh Trang Pagoda before returning to Saigon. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Cu Chi Tunnels , a wartime relic. In the evening, explore Saigon’s shopping spots such as Ben Thanh Market, Saigon Square, or Diamond Plaza. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast at the hotel before your airport transfer.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi and City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Hanoi International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Begin your sightseeing with the Temple of Literature , followed by a visit to the historic Ba Dinh Square . Take a leisurely cyclo ride around the Old Quarter , with a stop at Ngoc Son Temple . Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Hanoi to Halong
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Halong Bay , passing through the rural landscapes of the Red River delta. Board your cruise to explore limestone caves, floating villages, and unique karst islands. Lunch and dinner are served on the boat. Overnight stay on board.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Halong – Hanoi – Danang – Hoi An
package_itineraries.description: Rise early to watch the sunrise over the bay. Cruise past fascinating islands such as Sail Island and Butterfly Rock before returning to Hanoi. Transfer to the airport for your flight to Danang , and upon arrival, proceed to Hoi An Ancient Town . Overnight in Hoi An.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Hoi An City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Hoi An’s Japanese Bridge , ancient houses, Chinese Assembly Halls, and traditional markets by the Thu Bon River. Enjoy local crafts, lantern shopping, and perhaps a bike ride to Cua Dai Beach. Overnight in Hoi An.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hoi An to Hue City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel via the scenic Hai Van Pass , stopping to admire Lang Co Beach . In Hue, visit the Royal Citadel, Forbidden City, Hue Royal Museum, Thien Mu Pagoda, and the Tombs of King Tu Duc . Overnight in Hue.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: From Hue to Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City) . Visit the Reunification Palace, Notre Dame Cathedral, Central Post Office, Opera House, and Ben Thanh Market. Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Saigon – Cu Chi Tunnels
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore the Cu Chi Tunnels , a network of underground passages used during the Vietnam War. Return to Saigon and enjoy shopping at Ben Thanh Market, Saigon Square, or Diamond Plaza . Overnight in Saigon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Saigon - Mekong Delta - Saigon
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a boat trip in My Tho , cruising along the Mekong River . Explore canals lined with coconut palms, enjoy honey tea, taste coconut candy, and take a horse-cart ride through a village. Visit Vinh Trang Pagoda before returning to Saigon. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Depart Saigon
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Hanoi
package_itineraries.description: Check in and enjoy an evening city tour including the Temple of Literature, Ba Dinh Square, Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum (exterior), and a cyclo ride around the Old Quarter. Visit Ngoc Son Temple by Hoan Kiem Lake. Overnight in Hanoi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Halong Bay Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Travel through Red River Delta villages to Halong Bay. Board a wooden boat to cruise past formations like Stone Dog, Incense Burner, and Fighting Cock. Explore Thien Cung Cave before returning to Hanoi. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Hanoi Heritage & Flight to Siem Reap
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Ho Chi Minh Complex, One Pillar Pagoda, Tran Quoc Pagoda, Hanoi Flag Tower, and Thang Long Citadel. Fly to Siem Reap. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Angkor Discovery
package_itineraries.description: See the South Gate of Angkor Thom, Bayon Temple, Terrace of the Elephants, Royal Palace, Phimeanakas, Terrace of the Leper King, and Ta Prohm. Visit Angkor Wat in the afternoon. Overnight in Siem Reap.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Brussels – Welcome to the Capital
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Brussels Airport or Brussels Train Station , where a private transfer will take you to your hotel. After check-in, enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. You can relax at the hotel, take a gentle evening walk through the neighborhood, or sample Belgian chocolates at a local café. Soak in the city’s charm as you prepare for the adventures ahead. Overnight stay in Brussels.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Brussels City Sightseeing – Landmarks and Heritage
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast before embarking on a City Sightseeing tour of Brussels . With 13 hop-on hop-off stops, you’ll have the freedom to explore at your own pace. Marvel at iconic landmarks such as the European Union headquarters , European Parliament , and the world-famous Atomium , a futuristic structure representing Belgium’s innovation. Stroll through the Grand-Place , a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its ornate guildhalls and lively atmosphere. Don’t miss the quirky Manneken Pis statue , the elegant Cinquantenaire Arch , and the stunning Art Nouveau designs of Victor Horta . From Renaissance beauty to contemporary wonders, Brussels is a city where every corner reveals a new story. After an enriching day, return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Brussels.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Brussels
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel, followed by free time for last-minute shopping or a relaxing stroll through the city center. Depending on your departure schedule, you might visit a café for a final taste of Belgian waffles or chocolates. Later, transfer to Brussels Airport or Train Station for your onward journey, carrying memories of a remarkable European getaway.

package_itineraries.title: Arrival in Tashkent
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Tashkent International Airport, you will be greeted warmly and transferred to your hotel for check-in. After a refreshing rest, enjoy a delightful lunch at an Indian restaurant. In the afternoon, set out on a guided city tour of Tashkent, visiting Independence Square, Amir Temur Square, Broadway Street, Lal Bahadur Shastri Monument, and the Victory Monument . The evening is reserved for a Cocktail Gala dinner, complete with an enchanting belly dance performance. Overnight stay at your hotel in Tashkent.

package_itineraries.title: Excursion to Charvak Mountains
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a scenic drive to the Chimgan Mountains. On the way, admire breathtaking landscapes and experience a thrilling cable car ride with views of snow-capped peaks. Continue your journey to Chirwak Lake and Charvak Mountains , where you can relax and soak in the natural beauty. Pause for a buffet lunch by the lakeside before returning to Tashkent. Overnight stay at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Exploring Tashkent
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel’s café. Your morning includes a visit to a viewpoint offering panoramic views of Tashkent. Later, enjoy sightseeing at the Tashkent TV Tower , followed by leisure time for shopping at Zoom Mall and Chorsu Bazaar , two of the city’s most vibrant shopping destinations. After lunch, continue exploring local markets before heading back to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Departure from Tashkent
package_itineraries.description: Relish your final breakfast in Tashkent. Afterward, you will be transferred to the airport for your departure flight, carrying cherished memories of your Uzbekistan adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tashkent
package_itineraries.description: On landing at Tashkent Airport, you will be welcomed and transferred to your hotel. After check-in, enjoy a traditional Indian lunch before starting your city sightseeing tour. Visit landmarks such as Independence Square, Amir Temur Square, Broadway Street, Lal Bahadur Shastri Monument, and the Victory Monument . Conclude the evening with a Cocktail Gala dinner and an engaging belly dance performance. Overnight stay in Tashkent.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Excursion to Charvak Mountains
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast. Journey to the Chimgan Mountains , where you can enjoy breathtaking views from a cable car ride. Continue to Charvak Lake , a popular spot for relaxation and leisure activities. Enjoy a buffet lunch by the lake before heading back to Tashkent. Complimentary bottled mineral water will be provided in both the coach and hotel. Overnight stay in Tashkent.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Day Trip to Samarkand
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, board a high-speed train to Samarkand, one of the most iconic Silk Road cities. Explore the architectural masterpieces of the Registan Square , including Medreseh Shir-Dor (17th century), Medreseh Ulughbek (15th century), and Medreseh Tilla-Kori (17th century) . Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant before visiting the Bibi-Khanym Mosque, Shakhi Zinda complex , and browsing through Sieb National Market for souvenirs. In the evening, return by train to Tashkent for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Tashkent Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast at the hotel café. Head out to see the city from elevated viewpoints and make a stop at the Tashkent TV Tower , one of the tallest structures in Central Asia. After lunch, enjoy shopping at Zoom Mall and Chorsu Market , perfect for souvenirs and local goods. Dinner and overnight stay in Tashkent.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Tashkent
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you will be transferred to the airport for your onward flight, concluding your unforgettable journey across Uzbekistan.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Vienna
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Vienna, you will be greeted and escorted to your hotel. After checking in, the rest of the day is yours to relax and unwind. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off on a Grand City Tour of Vienna. Explore the famous Ringstrasse boulevard and admire highlights such as the State Opera House, Parliament, National Theatre, Votive Church, City Hall, and Urania. Visit the magnificent Schönbrunn Palace for an inside tour, followed by a stop at Belvedere Palace. The tour concludes at the Opera, leaving your afternoon free for independent exploration. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Day Trip to Salzburg
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast and travel west through the Salzkammergut Lake District to reach Salzburg. Pause in Gmunden and enjoy the alpine scenery before arriving in Salzburg for lunch and shopping. A guided city tour will cover highlights like Fortress Hohensalzburg, Salzburg Cathedral, Festival Halls, Mozart’s Birthplace, Getreidegasse, and Mirabell Gardens. Return to Vienna in the evening and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Vienna to Prague
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and board your train to Prague. The scenic journey takes about four hours. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring at your own pace. Overnight stay in Prague.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Prague City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and set out for a guided city tour covering the State Opera, National Museum, Wenceslas Square, and Charles Square. Explore Prague Castle, its courtyards, and St. Vitus Cathedral before heading to the Old Town Square to see the Astronomical Clock. The afternoon is free for personal activities. Overnight stay in Prague.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Travel to Budapest
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and board a train to Budapest. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to relax. Overnight stay in Budapest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Budapest City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast, then embark on a panoramic city tour. Cross the Chain Bridge and Margaret Bridge to the Buda side. Explore Castle District, Matthias Church, and Fisherman’s Bastion, followed by Gellért Hill for stunning views. On the Pest side, visit the Central Market Hall, City Park, Heroes’ Square, and the Parliament. Drive along Andrássy Avenue, passing the Opera House and St. Stephen’s Basilica. The tour concludes in the city center. Free time in the evening. Overnight stay in Budapest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Budapest to Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and travel back to Vienna by train. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and spend the afternoon at leisure. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure from Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel. A transfer will take you to Vienna Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Vienna
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Vienna, transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is free for you to relax and enjoy at leisure. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Vienna City Tour & Transfer to Salzburg
package_itineraries.description: Start with breakfast, then enjoy a guided city tour. Admire landmarks such as the State Opera House, the Museum of Fine Arts, Hofburg, Parliament, City Hall, and Burg Theatre. Visit the grand Schönbrunn Palace, once the summer residence of the Habsburgs, before passing by Belvedere Palace. In the afternoon, board a train to Salzburg. On arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight stay in Salzburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Salzburg Tour & Travel to Innsbruck
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Mirabellplatz to join a half-day Salzburg tour. Discover the iconic filming sites of The Sound of Music while enjoying alpine scenery and a glimpse of the Lake District. Visit historic landmarks, including Mozart’s connections to the city. After the tour, return to your hotel. Later in the afternoon, travel by train to Innsbruck. Overnight stay in Innsbruck.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Leisure Day in Innsbruck
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, enjoy free time to explore Innsbruck at your own pace. Visit the Swarovski Crystal Factory showroom, stroll through the Old Town, or simply soak in the alpine atmosphere. Overnight stay in Innsbruck.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Innsbruck to Vienna
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast, then travel by train to Vienna. After arrival, check in at your hotel. The rest of the day is free for personal sightseeing or shopping. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel. A transfer will take you to Vienna Airport or train station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Innsbruck
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Innsbruck Airport or Train Station, transfer to your hotel. After check-in, the rest of the day is free to relax or begin exploring on your own. Overnight stay in Innsbruck.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Innsbruck
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out to explore the Tyrolean capital. You can join the local sightseeing Hop-on Hop-off service, “The Sightseer,” which covers major attractions. Alternatively, wander through the Old Town, browse souvenir shops, and stop at traditional cafés. A short trip to Wattens to visit Swarovski Crystal Worlds is also recommended. Overnight stay in Innsbruck.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Innsbruck
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before checking out. A transfer will be arranged to Innsbruck Airport or Train Station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Vienna
package_itineraries.description: On reaching Vienna Airport or Train Station, transfer to your hotel. After checking in, the day is yours to relax and explore at leisure. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, discover the city with a Hop-on Hop-off bus tour. With 35 stops around Vienna, you can explore iconic landmarks at your own pace. Stroll along Graben street, indulge in retail therapy, and pause at one of the city’s famous cafés. Don’t miss a slice of the original Sacher Torte at Café Sacher. Overnight stay in Vienna.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Vienna
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel. Depending on your schedule, either extend your stay or transfer to Vienna Airport or Train Station for your next destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sofia – Leisure and Relaxation
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Sofia Airport, a private transfer will take you to your hotel. After a smooth check-in, take the rest of the day to relax or stroll around nearby streets at your own pace. Enjoy the lively atmosphere of Bulgaria’s capital and soak in the first impressions of this sunny city. Overnight stay in Sofia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Guided Sofia City Tour – Discover the Landmarks
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a hearty breakfast before setting off on a city tour of Sofia . Visit the awe-inspiring St. Alexander Nevsky Cathedral , one of the city’s most iconic landmarks, admired for its golden domes and intricate architecture. Continue your exploration with stops at cultural and historical highlights around the city, from elegant squares to hidden gems tucked within Sofia’s charming streets. End the day back at your hotel for an overnight stay in Sofia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Farewell to Sofia – Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy some free time to shop, relax, or explore Sofia at leisure. Depending on your travel plans, you may extend your stay in the city or proceed with a transfer to the airport for your onward journey. Carry with you the wonderful memories of your Sofia tour package experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zagreb – Evening City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zagreb, Croatia’s lively capital, where history meets modernity. Check into your hotel and explore the city on an evening city tour , visiting the romantic Upper Town and bustling Lower Town. Walk through the iconic Stone Gate (Kamenita vrata) and soak in the city’s rich stories. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zagreb to Zadar – Evening City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Zadar (approx. 3.5 hours). Relax at your hotel before joining a guided evening tour, visiting Sea Organ, Greetings to the Sun, Roman Forum, St. Donat, St. Anastasia Cathedral , and more. End the day with a taste of traditional Maraskino liqueur before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Plitvice Lakes Tour
package_itineraries.description: Drive 1.5 hours to Plitvice Lakes , a UNESCO World Heritage site. Explore 16 terraced lakes, 92 waterfalls, and the Rastoke ethno village along the Korana River. Enjoy nature walks and wildlife spotting before returning to Zadar for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Zadar to Hvar via Split – Hvar Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Take a ferry to Hvar via Split. Discover landmarks such as Fortica Fortress, Hvar Cathedral, Arsenal, and Franciscan Monastery . Relax at the sunny beaches and explore the Pakleni Islands . Evening at leisure with dinner at a local restaurant. Overnight in Hvar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Hvar to Dubrovnik – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Hvar to Dubrovnik (approx. 3 hours). Enjoy the Discover Dubrovnik tour , visiting Old Town, Onofrio's Fountain, Prijeko Street, St. Saviour’s Church, Franciscan and Dominican churches , and historic vineyards. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Free Day in Dubrovnik
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a full day at leisure to explore Dubrovnik independently or relax at your hotel. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight back home or to your next destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Copenhagen
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Copenhagen Airport and make your way independently to your hotel. Spend the day at leisure and explore the city at your own pace. The central attractions are easily reachable by foot. You may choose to visit Tivoli Gardens, Amalienborg Palace, Christiansborg Palace, Gefion Fountain, Nyhavn harbour, the famous Little Mermaid statue, or the Round Tower. Art lovers can enjoy the many museums dedicated to history, design, and culture. A relaxed evening stroll along Strøget, the popular pedestrian shopping street, is highly recommended. Overnight stay in Copenhagen.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Copenhagen to Aarhus
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a delightful breakfast before heading to Copenhagen Central Rail Station to board a train to Aarhus. The journey will treat you to breathtaking views of farmlands and small Viking-era villages. On arrival, make your own way to the hotel. Aarhus, Denmark’s second-largest city, is affectionately known as the “City of Smiles.” Spend the rest of the day discovering the charm of Aarhus. Overnight stay in Aarhus.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Exploring Aarhus
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin sightseeing in Aarhus. Visit the Old Town (Den Gamle By), a living history museum that takes you back through centuries of Danish life. You may also stop at Aarhus Cathedral, the museum of Danish prehistory, or explore Marselisborg Castle. When the Royal Family is not in residence, the beautiful palace gardens are open for free visits. Spend the evening at leisure and overnight in Aarhus.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Aarhus to Odense
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with breakfast before continuing to Odense, Denmark’s third-largest city and birthplace of the legendary storyteller Hans Christian Andersen. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel. Spend the afternoon visiting Andersen’s childhood home, now transformed into a museum that celebrates his famous fairy tales. Overnight stay in Odense.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Odense to Copenhagen
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy some time exploring Odense on your own. Later, proceed to the train station and board your afternoon train back to Copenhagen, marking the end of your Denmark holiday package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Copenhagen
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Copenhagen Airport or Central Train Station, a private transfer will take you to your hotel. After check-in, the rest of the day is yours. You may relax at the hotel, take a leisurely evening stroll, or get an early start on discovering Copenhagen’s lively atmosphere. Overnight stay in Copenhagen.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Copenhagen
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a Hop-on/Hop-off sightseeing tour. The city is an exciting blend of culture, innovation, and tradition. Visit the royal Amalienborg Palace, see the world-famous Little Mermaid statue, and admire the colourful waterfront at Nyhavn. Stroll down Strøget, the longest pedestrian shopping street in Europe, where international boutiques meet Danish design shops. You can also sample local cuisine at charming cafés or enjoy fine dining. Copenhagen truly lives up to its name, “Wonderful Copenhagen.” Overnight stay in the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Farewell to Copenhagen
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a final breakfast at your hotel. Depending on your departure schedule, you can take a last walk around the city or pick up some souvenirs. Later, arrange your own transfer to the airport or train station for your onward journey. Your Copenhagen tour package ends here.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zagreb
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zagreb and check into your hotel. Explore the cultural heart of Croatia and enjoy the city at your leisure. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zagreb & Zadar City Tours
package_itineraries.description: Morning Zagreb city tour covering Upper Town, St. Stephen’s Cathedral, Jelacic Square. Travel to Zadar in the afternoon. Evening Zadar city tour, including Sea Organ, Land Gate, and famous sunsets. Overnight in Zadar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Plitvice Lakes National Park
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Plitvice Lakes, exploring 16 lakes, 92 waterfalls, and lush forests. Return to Zadar for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Split Evening Tour
package_itineraries.description: Head to Split and explore Diocletian Palace, Marjan Hill, and Austro-Hungarian architecture on a guided tour. Overnight in Split.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Split to Hvar by Ferry
package_itineraries.description: Ferry to Hvar. Explore lavender-scented streets, quiet coves, local vineyards, and nearby islands. Overnight in Hvar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Hvar to Dubrovnik – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Dubrovnik. Guided tour of Old Town, exploring historic streets, architecture, and culture. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Dubrovnik to Montenegro
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Montenegro via the Bay of Kotor. Check into your hotel and explore the town independently. Overnight in Montenegro (Kotor).

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Kotor Day Trip
package_itineraries.description: Walking tour of Kotor’s Old Town, St. Tryphon Cathedral, Clock Tower, Pima Palace, and local landmarks. Overnight in Montenegro.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport after breakfast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Zagreb – Evening Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zagreb, check into your hotel, and join the evening city tour. Explore Ban Josip Jelačić Square, Upper and Lower Towns, Stone Gate, and learn the stories behind the city’s formation. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Plitvice Lakes National Park
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Plitvice Lakes National Park, exploring Upper and Lower Lakes, Kozjak Lake, Stephanie’s Island, and the Great Waterfall. Enjoy nature trails, waterfalls, and local wildlife. Overnight in Plitvice.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Zadar Evening City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Head to Zadar, check into your hotel, and take a guided evening tour. Visit Narodni trg, Sea Organ, Roman Forum, St. Donat, Land Gate, Square of Five Wells, and enjoy sunset views over the Adriatic. Overnight in Zadar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Travel to Dubrovnik – City Introduction
package_itineraries.description: Journey to Dubrovnik. Check into your hotel and explore Old Town, St. Blaise Church, Sponza Palace, Stradun Street, and other historical gems. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Dubrovnik City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Embark on the Dubrovnik city tour, discovering architectural and cultural highlights. Enjoy historical stories and beautiful streets. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Split Evening Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Split. Join a 75-minute walking tour visiting Golden Gate, Diocletian Palace, Gregory of Nin statue, and other landmarks. Return to hotel for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Blue & Green Caves Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Sail from Split to visit Blue and Green Caves, islands of Vis and Pakleni, Stiniva, and relax at Palmižana Bay. Enjoy swimming, sunbathing, or seaside dining. Return to Split for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Split to Zagreb
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel back to Zagreb. Evening at leisure to explore the city independently. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your flight home or next destination.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zagreb – Discover the Capital
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zagreb, the largest and most vibrant city in Croatia, where culture, politics, sports, and art merge together. Check into your hotel and freshen up before joining the Zagreb City Tour in the evening. Starting from Ban Josip Jelačić Square, your English-speaking guide will take you on a 2.5 to 3-hour walking journey through the capital’s most treasured landmarks. Explore the Stone Gate, admire the iconic St. Mark’s Church, and learn how two medieval settlements merged to create today’s capital. Step inside the intriguing Museum of Broken Relationships, a unique cultural highlight. Conclude the day with a relaxing drink at one of Zagreb’s stylish cafés before resting overnight at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zagreb to Zadar – Walking Tour of Ancient Heritage
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Zadar, a coastal gem known for its marble streets, pine-scented beaches, and island-dotted surroundings. Once checked in, enjoy free time to relax before joining the Zadar walking tour in the evening. Meeting at Narodni Trg (People’s Square), your guide will introduce you to the town’s long history, from the Roman forum to medieval cathedrals. Highlights include the Church of St. Donat, Cathedral of St. Anastasia, Sea Gate, and Square of Five Wells. As the day ends, listen to the mystical sounds of the Sea Organ while watching one of the world’s most beautiful sunsets. Don’t miss tasting Zadar’s world-famous ice cream at its oldest shop before retiring for an overnight stay in Zadar.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Excursion to Plitvice Lakes National Park
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before setting off for Plitvice Lakes, Croatia’s most iconic natural wonder and a UNESCO World Heritage site. Stroll along wooden walkways as you explore the park’s 16 interconnected lakes divided into Upper and Lower Lakes. Admire the turquoise waters of Kozjak Lake, the largest of them all, and marvel at the impressive Great Waterfall, Croatia’s tallest at 78 meters. With lush greenery, limestone cliffs, and cascading streams, the scenery feels like a living painting. After an adventurous day in nature, return to Zadar for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Journey to Dubrovnik – Cable Car & Old Town Tour
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast and head south to Dubrovnik, the jewel of the Adriatic. After settling into your hotel, join a guided tour starting with a thrilling cable car ride up Mt. Srđ. From the panoramic terraces at the summit, capture sweeping views of the Dalmatian Coast, Old Town, and the sparkling Adriatic Sea. Back in Dubrovnik’s Old Town, your guide will walk you through its UNESCO-protected streets. Visit Onofrio’s Fountain, admire Sponza Palace, explore the grand Rector’s Palace, and see the Baroque Cathedral of the Assumption. End the evening with time to wander at your own pace before spending the night in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Leisure Day in Dubrovnik
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel, followed by a full day of leisure in Dubrovnik. You may choose to explore the City Walls, take a ferry to Lokrum Island, or simply relax at one of Dubrovnik’s beaches overlooking the Adriatic. This free day lets you soak in the city’s charm at your own pace. Overnight stay in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Dubrovnik
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, check out and transfer to Dubrovnik Airport for your flight home or onward journey, carrying unforgettable memories of your Croatia travel packages experience.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zagreb
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zagreb, Croatia’s cultural and political capital. Check into your hotel and rest after your journey. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zagreb City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a guided city tour of Lotrščak Tower, Stone Gate, St. Catherine’s Church, Croatian Parliament, and other landmarks. Afternoon at leisure to explore the city independently. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Free Time in Zagreb
package_itineraries.description: Spend a relaxed day exploring Zagreb at your own pace or take optional excursions. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Zagreb – Evening Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zagreb, check into your hotel, and join the evening Zagreb tour, visiting Ban Josip Jelačić Square, Tkalčićeva Street, Stone Gate, St. Mark’s Church, Lotrščak Tower, and the Museum of Broken Relationships. Overnight in Zagreb.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Split City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Split. Check into the hotel and join a 75-minute walking tour of Diocletian Palace, Cathedral of St. Duje, and other landmarks. Overnight in Split.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Plitvice Lakes Tour
package_itineraries.description: Visit Plitvice Lakes, exploring Upper and Lower Lakes, Big Waterfall, and local trails. Enjoy the natural beauty before returning to Split. Overnight in Split.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Dubrovnik – City Tour & Cable Car
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Dubrovnik. Take a cable car ride up Mt Srđ for panoramic views. Explore Old Town, Onofrio’s Fountain, Sponza Palace, Rector’s Palace, and the Cathedral of the Assumption. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Free Day in Dubrovnik
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a day at leisure exploring Dubrovnik independently. Overnight in Dubrovnik.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport after breakfast for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Helsinki
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Helsinki Airport or Port, where a transfer will take you to your hotel. After check-in, relax or take a short evening stroll to enjoy the atmosphere of the Finnish capital. Overnight stay in Helsinki.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: City Sightseeing in Helsinki
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin a Hop-on/Hop-off bus tour covering the most iconic landmarks. Visit the Senate Square, City Hall, the Parliament Buildings, Finlandia Hall, and the Opera House. Stop at the Sibelius Monument and the fascinating Temppeliaukio Church (Rock Church). End the day enjoying the panoramic ferris wheel or shopping for Nordic design products. Stay overnight in Helsinki.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Depending on your schedule, extend your stay or transfer to the Airport or Port for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Arrival in Rovaniemi
package_itineraries.description: Arrive by flight and transfer to your hotel. Optional Northern Lights hunting tour available in the evening. Overnight in Rovaniemi.

package_itineraries.title: Reindeer Farm & Santa Claus Village
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, ride a snowmobile through forest trails, then visit a reindeer farm for a sleigh ride and Arctic Circle ceremony. Enjoy lunch at Santa Claus Village, meet Santa, and explore souvenir shops. Overnight in Rovaniemi

package_itineraries.title: Husky Safari
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a thrilling husky safari, driving your sled across snowy landscapes. Learn about husky care at the farm and enjoy hot drinks by the fire. Overnight in Rovaniemi.

package_itineraries.title: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast. Optionally visit the Arktikum Museum before your transfer to Rovaniemi Airport.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Helsinki
package_itineraries.description: Pick up your rental car at Helsinki-Vantaa Airport. Drive into the city and visit Senate Square, Uspenski Cathedral, Parliament House, Finlandia Hall, Sibelius Monument, and Temppeliaukio Church. Overnight in Helsinki.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Helsinki to Porvoo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore the Suomenlinna Sea Fortress before heading to Porvoo via The King’s Road. Visit Haikko Manor, Sipoo’s old church, and enjoy the Old Town with its wooden houses and mediaeval church. Overnight stay in Porvoo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Porvoo to Turku
package_itineraries.description: Drive along The King’s Road to Turku, Finland’s oldest city. Visit Turku Castle, Luostarinmäki open-air museum, and Aboa Vetus & Ars Nova. Optionally visit Ruissalo Island. Overnight in Turku.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Turku to Naantali to Tuusula
package_itineraries.description: Explore Naantali, the President’s summer residence, Old Town, and Moomin World. Later, drive to Tuusula and stay at Krapi Estate, surrounded by cultural heritage. Overnight stay in Tuusula.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Tuusula
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning exploring Tuusula’s artist homes and museums before returning the car at Helsinki-Vantaa Airport.

package_itineraries.title: Arrival & Welcome to Helsinki
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at destination airport. Meet your private chauffeur and transfer to your luxury hotel. Relax and enjoy a leisure evening.

package_itineraries.description: Scenic tour of iconic attractions, cultural landmarks, panoramic viewpoints, and local gourmet experiences.

package_itineraries.title: Arrival – Helsinki to Porvoo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Helsinki-Vantaa Airport, rent a car, and visit Suomenlinna Fortress before driving to Porvoo. Explore its Old Town and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Porvoo to Savonlinna
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Punkaharju Ridge and visit the Lusto Forest Museum. Continue to Savonlinna, known for Olavinlinna Castle and its Opera Festival. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Savonlinna to Nurmes
package_itineraries.description: Visit New Valamo Monastery, Joensuu, and Lake Pielinen. Explore Koli National Park and end the day in Nurmes. Optional fishing available.

package_itineraries.title: Nurmes to Kuopio
package_itineraries.description: Tour Pielisen Museum, Ruunaa Nature Reserve, and Eva Ryynänen’s studio. Continue to Kuopio, famous for the Puijo Tower and Lake Kallavesi cruises.

package_itineraries.title: Kuopio to Tampere
package_itineraries.description: Drive via Jyväskylä, admiring Aalto architecture, before reaching Tampere. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Tampere to Helsinki
package_itineraries.description: Spend the morning in Tampere, visit Hämeenlinna Castle or Jean Sibelius’s birthplace, then proceed to Helsinki Airport.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Helsinki
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Helsinki Airport, transfer to your hotel, and explore the surroundings at leisure. Overnight in Helsinki

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Helsinki City Tour – Ferry to Stockholm
package_itineraries.description: Take a Hop On–Hop Off city tour, covering Senate Square, Uspenski Cathedral, Sibelius Monument, and Temppeliaukio Church. Later, board a ferry for Stockholm. Overnight on the cruise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Stockholm Panorama Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Stockholm and join a city tour covering Vasa Museum, Royal Palace, Skansen, ABBA Museum, and Gamla Stan. Overnight in Stockholm.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Stockholm to Copenhagen
package_itineraries.description: Travel by train to Copenhagen and explore the city at your leisure. Overnight in Copenhagen.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Copenhagen Tour – Ferry to Oslo
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a Hop On–Hop Off bus tour covering Tivoli Gardens, Rosenborg Castle, Amalienborg Palace, and Gefion Fountain. Board a ferry to Oslo. Overnight on the cruise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Oslo Hop On–Hop Off Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Oslo and take a Hop On–Hop Off tour covering Vigeland Park, Akershus Castle, Viking Ship Museum, and Royal Palace. Overnight in Oslo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Oslo – Myrdal – Flam – Oslo
package_itineraries.description: Take a scenic train to Myrdal and continue on the Flam Railway, one of the most scenic train journeys in the world. Return to Oslo in the evening. Overnight in Oslo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure from Oslo
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your flight back home or onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Rovaniemi
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Rovaniemi International Airport and transfer to your hotel. In the evening, join a Reindeer Safari to chase the Northern Lights. Learn from local herders while enjoying warm drinks and snacks. Overnight in Rovaniemi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Santa Claus Village & Snowmobile Safari
package_itineraries.description: Start with breakfast, then spend time at Santa Claus Village. Depending on the season, enjoy summer hikes or winter sleigh rides. Later, embark on a snowmobile safari, ride through snowy trails, and end the day with a bonfire picnic. Overnight in Rovaniemi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Snowshoe Hike
package_itineraries.description: Take a snowshoe hike to Wilderness Lodge beside the Raudanjoki River. Cross frozen rapids, stargaze, and relax by an open fire with hot drinks and buns. Overnight in Rovaniemi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Northern Lights by Bus
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day relaxing. In the evening, board a bus to chase the Northern Lights in remote areas with clear skies. Overnight in Rovaniemi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tahiti
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Tahiti International Airport, where you’ll be greeted and transferred to your hotel. After check-in, spend time at leisure soaking in the serene atmosphere. Take a short trip to Fa’aruma’i Waterfalls and stroll through the enchanting Water Gardens Vaipahi before resting overnight in Tahiti.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Journey to Bora Bora
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before catching a scenic flight from Tahiti to Bora Bora. Upon arrival, check into your resort and embrace the island’s natural beauty. Spend the day unwinding on white sandy beaches or taking in the sunset views. Overnight stay in Bora Bora.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bora Bora Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Set out on a full-day exploration of Bora Bora’s highlights. Visit the world-famous Matira Beach, admire Mount Otemanu’s majestic peak, and explore the lively Vaitape neighborhood. Adventure seekers can indulge in activities like snorkeling, scuba diving, parasailing, whale watching, or even an underwater walk. Relax overnight at your resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Lagoon Adventure & Island Safari
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a lagoon cruise, sipping champagne as you take in panoramic island views. Opt to snorkel with sharks and stingrays for a thrilling experience. Later, enjoy a jeep safari through Bora Bora’s jungles and wildlife. An optional aqua safari offers a deeper dive into the island’s rich marine world. Overnight stay at the resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Tahiti for your return flight home, taking unforgettable memories of your honeymoon paradise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Paris
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Charles de Gaulle Airport and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, explore the charming streets nearby or relax at a café. Overnight in Paris.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Paris City Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Start with a delicious French breakfast of pastries, baguettes, and crepes. Join a Hop On Hop Off bus tour to discover major landmarks such as Champs Elysees, Arc de Triomphe, Place de la Concorde, Les Invalides, and the Tuileries Garden. Enjoy a Seine River cruise and visit the Eiffel Tower for stunning city views. End the day with dinner at a Parisian bistro, experiencing the city’s vibrant nightlife. Overnight stay in Paris.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Paris
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your return flight or continue with your European journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cannes
package_itineraries.description: Land at Cannes International Airport, where you’ll be assisted to your hotel. After checking in, enjoy the rest of the day exploring nearby streets, beaches, and chic cafes at your own pace.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cannes, Nice, Antibes, Grasse, and More
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin your journey to Nice, passing through charming towns like Antibes, Monte Carlo, Monaco Ville, and Grasse. Explore attractions such as Musée Picasso, Cap d’Antibes, and Port Vauban. Visit a perfume factory in Grasse and savor a local lunch before continuing to Gourdon, a village famed for its stunning views and heritage. Next, head to Tourettes-sur-Loup, celebrated for its violet valleys. End the day with a stroll along La Croisette in Cannes before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Cannes
package_itineraries.description: Bid farewell to the French Riviera as you check out and proceed to Cannes International Airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Paris
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Paris and transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening relaxing or exploring the nearby neighborhoods. Overnight in Paris.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Paris Sightseeing Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a Hop On Hop Off city tour with audio commentary. Visit Champs Elysees, Arc de Triomphe, Place de la Concorde, Les Invalides, Tuileries Garden, and the Louvre. In the evening, enjoy a Seine River cruise and explore the lively Latin Quarter. Overnight in Paris.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Disneyland Paris (Optional)
package_itineraries.description: Customize your itinerary with a day at Disneyland Paris. Enjoy thrilling rides, magical parades, and Disney-themed attractions. Return to Paris or stay overnight in Disneyland.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Paris to Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: Travel by train to Interlaken, Switzerland. Enjoy scenic views during the journey. On arrival, check into your hotel and spend the evening at leisure. Overnight in Interlaken.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Jungfrau Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Take the train to Grindelwald and board the cogwheel railway to Jungfraujoch, the highest station in Europe. Visit the Ice Palace, Alpine Sensation, and the Sphinx Observatory. Enjoy skiing and other alpine activities before returning to Interlaken. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Interlaken to Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Board a train to Lucerne, known for its alpine beauty. Spend the evening exploring the charming old town and lakeside views. Overnight in Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Mount Titlis Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Take the Lucerne Engelberg Express to Engelberg, followed by a cable car ride up Mount Titlis. Experience ROTAIR, the rotating cable car, and the Ice Flyer chairlift. Return to Lucerne for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Lucerne to Milan
package_itineraries.description: Travel through breathtaking landscapes to Milan. Explore the city and stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Venice Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Milan before taking a train to Venice. Visit St. Mark’s Square, Ducal Palace, and Bell Tower. Shop at Merceria before retiring to your hotel. Overnight in Venice.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Venice to Florence
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Florence and embark on a tour of Pisa, including the Leaning Tower, Baptistery, and Cathedral. Return to Florence for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Florence Walking Tour
package_itineraries.description: Join a guided walking tour of Florence, visiting Piazza della Repubblica, Signoria Square, Uffizi Gallery, and more. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Florence to Rome
package_itineraries.description: Take a train to Rome. Explore the nearby areas at leisure. Overnight in Rome.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Rome City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Visit Trevi Fountain, Pantheon, Piazza Navona, Colosseum, St. Peter’s Basilica, and more on a combined coach and walking tour. Overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and depart Rome with memories of your grand European holiday.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nice
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Nice International Airport and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, explore local attractions and nearby markets at your own pace. Overnight in Nice.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: City Tour of Nice
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a guided tour. Walk along the Promenade des Anglais, visit the Cathedral of Saint Nicholas, Marc Chagall National Museum, and Place Massena. In the evening, shop for souvenirs like lavender products, olive oil, and traditional Herbin jams at local markets. Overnight stay in Nice.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and either return home or continue exploring nearby cities such as Cannes, Menton, or Monaco.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Nuuk
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Nuuk Airport, you will be welcomed and transferred to your hotel for check-in. Spend the remainder of the day at leisure, exploring the surroundings at your own pace. Overnight stay in a comfortable luxury hotel in Nuuk.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Half-Day Tour of Nuuk
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with breakfast before setting out on a half-day city tour of Nuuk. This historic settlement, established in 1728, showcases a blend of old traditions and modern culture. Highlights of the tour include the Colonial Harbour, Greenland National Museum, Nuuk Art Museum, and the Katuaq Cultural Centre. Your guide will share insights into the city’s geography, history, and everyday life in the Arctic climate. You’ll enjoy scenic views of the fjords, visit the main harbour, and explore both the old and new campuses of the University of Greenland. Return to the hotel for a relaxed evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Boat Excursion to Kangeq
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on an exciting boat journey to Kangeq, once a thriving fishing village in Southwestern Greenland, abandoned in the 1980s. The one-hour ride offers mesmerizing views of rugged mountains and opportunities to spot arctic wildlife such as seals and whales. At Kangeq, explore the deserted homes that resemble an open-air museum. Your guide will narrate the story of the mid-20th-century relocations, when residents were compelled to leave their villages for larger towns. You will also hear about Aron of Kangeq, an Inuit hunter and artist renowned for capturing Greenland’s myths and legends. Return to Nuuk for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Nuuk to Ilulissat
package_itineraries.description: Catch a flight from Nuuk to Ilulissat, the third-largest town in Greenland with a population of over 5,000. Check in at your hotel and enjoy the evening at leisure, discovering the charm of the town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Excursion to Eqip Sermia Glacier
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a full-day trip from Ilulissat Harbour to Eqip Sermia, one of Greenland’s most spectacular calving glaciers. Stretching 4 kilometres across and towering 200 metres above the sea, this glacier is a remarkable sight. Depending on your chosen option, you may hike to the moraine near the glacier or admire it from the boat, where lunch and coffee are served on board. Return to Ilulissat in the evening and spend the night at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Walking Tour and Evening Iceberg Cruise
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided two-hour walking tour of Ilulissat with a local expert. Visit the old town, the fishing harbour, the historic church, and the museum, while learning about the town’s foundation in 1741 and its cultural significance. Spend the afternoon at leisure before joining an evening cruise among the magnificent icebergs. Witness the surreal beauty of floating ice formations, illuminated by the golden glow of the midnight sun or dramatic contrasts under cloudy skies – a truly unforgettable experience. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Ilulissat
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your final morning at leisure until your transfer to Ilulissat Airport for your onward flight or continuation of your journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Budapest
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to the Hungarian capital! On arrival at Budapest International Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel. After completing the check-in process, the rest of the day is free for you to stroll around and begin exploring the nearby attractions at your own pace.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Budapest City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a comprehensive city tour with a local guide. Begin at the famous Chain Bridge, where you can admire both banks of the Danube River. Travel past the Parliament building and cross the Margaret Bridge to reach the Buda side. Here, stop at the Castle District and take in stunning views of the Matthias Church and Fishermen’s Bastion. Continue to Gellert Hill for a spectacular panoramic view over the city. Crossing the Elisabeth Bridge, you’ll arrive in Pest to discover the Central Market Hall and visit the Dohany Street Synagogue, the largest synagogue in Europe. Later, explore the Budapest Zoo, enjoy Europe’s largest thermal spa, and see the Amusement Park before heading to Heroes Square. In the evening, drive along Andrassy Avenue to view the Opera House and stop at St Stephen’s Basilica. Enjoy some leisure time in the city before heading back to the hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Depart Budapest
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and proceed to the airport for your onward journey home or continue exploring with your Europe tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Dusseldorf
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Dusseldorf International Airport, you’ll be greeted and assisted with a smooth transfer to your hotel. After check-in, take time to relax and later wander around the surrounding area, soaking in the local atmosphere.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 – Exploring Dusseldorf
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off on a Hop-On Hop-Off bus tour that highlights the city’s most popular attractions. The 90-minute loop includes an audio guide available in both English and German. Key sights include the Central Station, Königsallee shopping street, the Rhine Tower, Old Town, Schloss Jägerhof, Rheinterrasse, Lütticher Str, Niederkasseler Kirchweg, and Aquazoo. Later, you can enjoy a scenic cruise along the Rhine or spend time shopping and dining in the Old Town. Evening strolls through Dusseldorf’s lively districts are perfect for experiencing its nightlife and culture.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 – Departure from Dusseldorf
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Dusseldorf Airport for your flight home or continue with the next stage of your Europe journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Munich
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Munich International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening wandering nearby attractions.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 – Munich Highlights Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a Hop-On Hop-Off bus tour. Visit Marienplatz, Altes Rathaus, BMW Museum, Olympic Grounds, Nymphenburg Palace, English Garden, and Siegestor. Discover Munich’s cultural landmarks while enjoying time for refreshments.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 – Departure from Munich
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Munich Airport or the central station for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Frankfurt
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Frankfurt International Airport, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. After check-in, spend the day exploring the city center at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 – Frankfurt City Highlights
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a Hop-On Hop-Off tour across Frankfurt’s major attractions. Visit Hauptwache, Römerberg, the Städel Museum, Museum Embankment, St Paul’s Church, the Old Opera House, and the bustling Zeil shopping street. The city’s mix of Gothic architecture and modern skyscrapers makes for a fascinating contrast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 – Departure from Frankfurt
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Frankfurt Airport for your flight or continue with your European adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Munich
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Munich International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure, exploring nearby attractions.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 – Munich City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, join a Hop-On Hop-Off tour covering highlights such as Marienplatz, the Glockenspiel, the English Garden, Altes Rathaus, and the BMW Museum. Enjoy lunch along the way and immerse yourself in the Bavarian spirit.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 – Neuschwanstein & Linderhof Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Head out for a full-day excursion to the enchanting Neuschwanstein Castle and Linderhof Palace. Admire the alpine scenery, fairy-tale castles, and beautifully landscaped gardens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 – Munich to Salzburg
package_itineraries.description: Take a scenic train ride to Salzburg, a UNESCO World Heritage city famous for Mozart and The Sound of Music. Evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 – Salzburg Tour
