package_itineraries.description: Discover Salzburg with a Hop-On Hop-Off bus tour. Visit Mirabell Palace, Hohensalzburg Fortress, Mozart’s Residence, Trinity Church, Hellbrunn Palace, and Old Town streets. End your day with local chocolate delicacies.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 – Salzburg to Vienna
package_itineraries.description: Travel by train to Vienna, Austria’s imperial capital. Evening free to explore.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7 – Vienna City Tour
package_itineraries.description: A Hop-On Hop-Off bus takes you through Vienna’s highlights, including Schönbrunn Palace, St Stephen’s Cathedral, Hofburg Palace, Hundertwasser Museum, and the Vienna Zoo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8 – Vienna Woods Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Spend half a day exploring Vienna Woods. Visit Mayerling Chapel, Heiligenkreuz Abbey, Baden spa town, and Seegrotte Hinterbrühl, Europe’s largest underground lake.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9 – Departure from Vienna
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Vienna Airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 – Arrival in Munich
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Munich and check into your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 – Munich City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Take a Hop-On Hop-Off tour covering Marienplatz, Neues Rathaus, Viktualienmarkt, Nymphenburg Palace, BMW Museum, and the English Garden.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 – Excursion to Neuschwanstein & Linderhof
package_itineraries.description: Journey through Bavaria to visit Neuschwanstein Castle and Linderhof Palace, both associated with King Ludwig II.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 – Munich to Stuttgart
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Stuttgart by train. Visit the Mercedes-Benz Museum, Porsche Museum, Palace Square, and more on a Hop-On Hop-Off tour.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 – Stuttgart & Baden-Baden
package_itineraries.description: Explore Stuttgart in the morning before continuing to Baden-Baden, a spa town surrounded by the Black Forest. Evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 – Baden-Baden & Black Forest
package_itineraries.description: Tour Baden-Baden highlights, then head to Titisee in the Black Forest, famous for its lake and alpine views.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7 – Titisee (Black Forest)
package_itineraries.description: Explore the Black Forest countryside and relax by Lake Titisee.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8 – Departure
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Frankfurt or Zurich for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Athens
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Athens International Airport, you will be greeted and assisted with transfer to your hotel. After check-in, spend the evening discovering the lively streets and quaint cafés around your hotel. Overnight stay in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Athens City Tour and Acropolis Museum
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a city tour covering both ancient and modern Athens. Explore landmarks such as Omonia Square, the Acropolis, and the world-famous Panathenaic Stadium, where the first modern Olympic Games were held in 1896. Visit the Temple of Olympian Zeus, Zappeion Megaron, and the Temple of Athena Nike. Admire important sites such as the University of Athens, the Academy of Athens, Hadrian’s Arch, the National Garden, the Parliament, and the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. Other highlights include the Catholic Cathedral, Russian Orthodox Church, Erechtheion, and St. Paul’s Church. Later, visit the Acropolis Museum, home to more than 3,000 artefacts including the Elgin Marbles and the Caryatids. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Athens – Argolis/Delphi
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a relaxed morning or opt for a full-day excursion to Delphi or Argolis. Delphi is steeped in mythology and history, while Argolis is renowned for its classical ruins and coastal landscapes. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Athens
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Athens International Airport to catch your onward flight, bidding farewell to Greece’s historic capital.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Athens
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Athens and transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening discovering the city at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Athens Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a full-day tour visiting the Acropolis, Parthenon, Temple of Zeus, Erechtheion, and Roman Forum. Modern sites include the Panathenaic Stadium, Parliament, and National Archaeological Museum. End at the Acropolis Museum. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Athens to Naxos
package_itineraries.description: Take a scenic ferry to Naxos, the largest Cycladic island. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Naxos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Explore Naxos
package_itineraries.description: Discover Portara, the unfinished gate dedicated to Apollo, and explore the island’s charming villages. Overnight in Naxos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Naxos to Santorini
package_itineraries.description: Catch a ferry to Santorini, one of Greece’s most beautiful islands. Evening free. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Santorini Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Explore Santorini’s caldera, Akrotiri ruins, volcano, and hot springs. Experience its unique wines and traditional cuisine. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Santorini
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Santorini International Airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival In Athens
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Athens International Airport, where you’ll be welcomed by a representative and transferred to your hotel. Receive a briefing on the tour highlights and safety tips. Spend the evening wandering around the city, soaking in its lively nightlife. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Athens – City Tour And Acropolis
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, join a Hop On Hop Off bus tour of Athens. Visit landmarks including the Panathenaic Stadium, Maximos Mansion (Prime Minister’s Residence), Temple of Olympian Zeus, Hadrian’s Arch, Parliament, Academy, and National Library of Greece. Stop at Constitution Square before exploring the Acropolis Museum, home to the Parthenon Gallery and Archaic Gallery. Overnight stay in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Athens To Mykonos
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, travel by ferry to Mykonos, a 3–5 hour ride with stunning sea views. On arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy an evening stroll through the cobblestone streets or shop for local crafts. Overnight in Mykonos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mykonos Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a hearty breakfast before exploring the island’s famed attractions: windmills, Church of Panagia Paraportiani, and Paradise Beach. Try water sports like snorkelling or parasailing, or spend the evening enjoying the island’s vibrant nightlife. Overnight in Mykonos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Mykonos To Santorini
package_itineraries.description: Take a ferry ride from Mykonos to Santorini, a 2–3 hour journey. After check-in, explore Santorini’s scenic landscapes with whitewashed houses and breathtaking Aegean Sea views. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Santorini Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Santorini’s gems, including the archaeological sites of Akrotiri and Ancient Thera, inland villages with centuries-old churches, and picturesque vineyards. Activities like kayaking, hiking, or wine tasting can be added. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Santorini
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast and proceed to Santorini International Airport for your onward journey or to continue your Europe tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Athens
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Athens International Airport, transfer to your hotel. After check-in, enjoy a free evening exploring nearby attractions. Overnight stay in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Athens City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin a city tour covering the Acropolis, Parthenon, Temple of Zeus, Hadrian’s Arch, Erechtheion, Roman Forum, and Temple of Hephaestus. Modern sites include Panathenaic Stadium, National Archaeological Museum, Parliament, Maximos Mansion, and the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. End with a visit to the Acropolis Museum. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Athens – Argolis – Olympia
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Argolis after breakfast, stopping at Corinth Canal, Epidaurus Theatre, Nafplion, and Mycenae. Later, drive through Tripoli and Megalopolis to reach Olympia. Overnight in Olympia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Olympia to Delphi
package_itineraries.description: After visiting Olympia’s Sanctuary of Zeus, Ancient Stadium, and Archaeological Museum, continue via Rio-Antirrio Bridge and towns like Nafpaktos to Delphi. Overnight stay in Delphi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Delphi to Athens
package_itineraries.description: Explore Delphi’s archaeological wonders, including Temple of Apollo, Castalian Spring, Oracle of Delphi, and its museum with artefacts like the Charioteer of Delphi. Later, drive back to Athens for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart Athens
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, proceed to Athens International Airport to conclude your Greece tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Athens
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Athens International Airport and transfer to your hotel. In the evening, head out for a night city tour, including the Port of Piraeus, Mikrolimano Harbour, the Temple of Olympian Zeus, the National Garden, Parliament Building, and National Library. End the evening at Plaka, the historic district, enjoying dinner with traditional Greek folk music and dance. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Athens to Mykonos
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, board a scenic ferry to Mykonos. Famous for its nightlife, charming windmills, and pristine beaches, Mykonos offers a perfect mix of relaxation and adventure. Spend the evening exploring the island. Overnight in Mykonos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Mykonos Full-Day Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Set off on a full-day cruise along Mykonos’ southern coast aboard a traditional kaiki boat. Visit Dragonissi Island, snorkel at Frangias Beach, swim at Kalafati Beach, and enjoy lunch by the sea. Later, relax at Paradise Beach and Ornos Beach before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Mykonos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mykonos to Santorini
package_itineraries.description: Take a ferry to Santorini, known for its dramatic cliffs, whitewashed houses, and volcanic history. After check-in, explore at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Santorini Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Santorini’s highlights such as Skaros Rock, ancient Thera, and Akrotiri. Enjoy panoramic views during the Caldera tour and witness the beauty of volcanic landscapes. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Santorini to Athens
package_itineraries.description: Return to Athens via ferry and spend your evening at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Athens
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your departure or onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Athens
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Athens and transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Athens City Tour and Acropolis Museum
package_itineraries.description: Tour the Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Athena Nike, National Library, Hadrian’s Arch, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and more. In the afternoon, visit the Acropolis Museum with treasures like the Caryatids and the Calf-Bearer. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Athens to Santorini
package_itineraries.description: Travel by ferry to Santorini. Explore the island at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Explore Santorini
package_itineraries.description: Visit Akrotiri, Ancient Thera, Santorini Wine Museum, and enjoy views of the Caldera. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Santorini to Heraklion
package_itineraries.description: Take a ferry to Heraklion. Evening free. Overnight in Heraklion.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Discover Heraklion
package_itineraries.description: Explore Knossos Palace with its ancient throne room and frescoes, along with the Archaeological Museum. Learn about Europe’s oldest civilisation. Overnight in Heraklion.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Heraklion
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Athens
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Athens International Airport, you’ll be welcomed and assisted with transfer to your hotel. After check-in, explore nearby markets and attractions at leisure. Overnight stay in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Athens City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin a half-day guided city tour covering Parliament Square, Maximos Mansion, the National Gallery, the Temple of Poseidon, Odeon of Herodes Atticus, National Garden, and Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. Continue to Panathenaic Stadium, Panepistimiou Avenue, the National Library, and the Metropolitan Cathedral. Visit the Temple of Zeus and the Acropolis Museum before returning for dinner and an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Athens Cruise Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and set off for a cruise covering Paros, Hydra, and Aegina. Explore Paros’ charming Cycladic villages, admire Hydra’s elegant villas, and take an optional guided tour of the Temple of Aphaia in Aegina. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Athens Delphi Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head for a full-day Delphi tour, exploring UNESCO-listed sites like the Temple of Apollo, Ancient Stadium, Theatre of Delphi, and Delphi Archaeological Museum. Stop at Livadia and Arachova en route. Return to Athens for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Athens To Kalabaka
package_itineraries.description: Board a train to Kalabaka, located at the foothills of Meteora. Enjoy views of Koziaka Mountains and the Aspropotamos River. On arrival, check into your hotel and spend the evening exploring at leisure. Overnight stay in Kalabaka.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Kalabaka to Athens
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a half-day tour of Meteora’s monasteries and visit Theopetra Cave, dating back to the Middle Palaeolithic period. Later, return to Athens by train for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Athens
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed to Athens International Airport for departure, concluding your Greece vacation package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Athens
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Athens International Airport, where you’ll be greeted and transferred to your hotel. Explore iconic landmarks like the Acropolis, Temple of Zeus, Parthenon, National Archaeological Museum, Odeon of Herodes Atticus, and Roman Forum. In the evening, enjoy a dinner show with authentic Greek cuisine and Bouzouki music. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Athens To Mykonos
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a ferry to Mykonos. On arrival, check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the island’s lively markets, beaches, and nightlife. Overnight stay in Mykonos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Mykonos Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Today’s sightseeing includes the Aegean Maritime Museum, Church of Panagia Paraportiani, iconic windmills, Little Venice, Ornos Beach, Paradise Beach, and the Monastery of Tourliani. Overnight in Mykonos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mykonos To Santorini
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a ferry to Santorini, enjoying spectacular views of the Aegean Sea along the way. Check into your hotel and explore the island’s whitewashed villages and stunning coastline. Overnight stay in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Santorini Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin with a visit to Oia, followed by Akrotiri, Ancient Thera, Santorini Caldera, Red Beach, Three Bells of Fira, and Pyrgos village. Overnight stay in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Santorini To Athens
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, ferry back to Athens and check into your hotel. Spend the evening exploring markets and sampling local delicacies. Overnight stay in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Athens
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast and transfer to Athens International Airport to board your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Athens
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Spend the day at leisure exploring nearby markets and cafés. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Athens City Tour and Acropolis Museum
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit the Temple of Olympian Zeus, Hadrian’s Arch, the Acropolis with its Parthenon, the Temple of Hephaestus, and the Temple of Poseidon. Continue to the Museum of Cycladic Art, followed by the Acropolis Museum, housing treasures from Athens’ most famous monuments. Evening free for shopping. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Athens to Heraklion
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Heraklion, Crete’s largest town. After check-in, explore the town at leisure. Overnight in Heraklion.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Explore Heraklion
package_itineraries.description: Discover the Palace of Knossos with its legendary frescoes and throne room. Visit the Archaeological Museum of Heraklion and admire treasures from the Minoan civilisation. Explore historic churches such as Agios Minas Cathedral and the Basilica of Agios Titos. Overnight in Heraklion.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Heraklion
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Heraklion International Airport for departure or onward travel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Athens
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Athens International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Athens City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Athens’ highlights including the Panathenaic Stadium, Maximos Mansion, Temple of Olympian Zeus, Hadrian’s Arch, Parliament, and Acropolis. Visit the Acropolis Museum before returning to your hotel. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Athens to Paros
package_itineraries.description: Ferry to Paros, a charming island with golden beaches and whitewashed villages. Overnight in Paros.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Explore Paros
package_itineraries.description: Discover Paros’ marble quarries, hidden coves, and sunlit villages. Optional trips include Delos or Antiparos Island. Overnight in Paros.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Paros to Santorini
package_itineraries.description: Ferry to Santorini, known for its caldera views and romantic atmosphere. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Santorini Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring Santorini’s dramatic landscapes, beaches, hot springs, volcano, and Akrotiri ruins. In the evening, enjoy the iconic sunset over the caldera. Overnight in Santorini.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Santorini
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Santorini International Airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Mykonos
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Mykonos International Airport, where you’ll be assisted with hotel transfer. After check-in, enjoy the rest of the day exploring the island’s charming streets. Overnight stay in Mykonos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Mykonos Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off for a guided tour. Visit Agios Ioannis Beach with views of Delos Island, followed by Ano Mera village to explore Panagia Tourliani Monastery. Continue to Kalafatis Beach for refreshments before heading back to town. Wander through cobblestone lanes, explore Little Venice, see the windmills, and take photos with Petros the Pelican. Overnight in Mykonos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Depart Mykonos
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head to Mykonos International Airport to fly back or continue your Greece tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Athens
package_itineraries.description: Meet your representative at Athens International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Evening free to explore nearby attractions. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Athens City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day visiting ancient sites such as the Parthenon, Ancient Agora, Odeon of Herodes Atticus, Temple of Hephaestus, and Hadrian’s Arch. See modern highlights like the Panathenaic Stadium, Presidential Mansion, and National Archaeological Museum. End at the Acropolis Museum. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Athens to Lefkada
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Lefkada, an island known for turquoise waters and lush landscapes. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Lefkada.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Lefkada City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Porto Katsiki, Kathisma, and Egremni beaches. Discover monasteries, villages, and dramatic coastal views. End with a romantic dinner by the sea. Overnight in Lefkada.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Leisure in Lefkada
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy free time on the island. Optional excursions include a dolphin cruise in Amvrakikos Gulf or a visit to Melissani Cave. Overnight in Lefkada.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Lefkada to Athens
package_itineraries.description: Fly back to Athens. Evening free for last-minute shopping. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart Athens
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Athens International Airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 – Arrive In Athens
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Athens International Airport, where you’ll be welcomed by the tour manager. After assistance with check-in at your hotel, you’ll receive an overview of the travel plan. The evening is free to stroll nearby markets or enjoy dinner at a local taverna. Overnight stay in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 – Athens City Tour & Acropolis Museum
package_itineraries.description: After a wholesome breakfast, embark on a guided Athens City Tour. Explore highlights such as the Panathenaic Stadium, Prime Minister’s Residence, Temple of Olympian Zeus, Hadrian’s Arch, the Parliament building, and the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. Continue to the National Library and Temple of Athena Nike. Pause for a Greek lunch with traditional dishes before visiting the world-renowned Acropolis Museum, home to treasures like the Parthenon Gallery, Caryatids, Propylaea, and Hekatompedon. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 – Athens To Mykonos
package_itineraries.description: Post breakfast, travel to Mykonos by ferry, a scenic three-hour journey across the Aegean Sea. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy leisure time exploring the nearby attractions and relaxing by the waterfront. Overnight stay in Mykonos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 – Mykonos Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day experiencing Mykonos’ charm. Wander through the labyrinthine whitewashed alleys, visit the iconic Windmills and the Church of Panagia Paraportiani, and relax on Paradise Beach. Explore bustling street markets filled with souvenirs or take an optional trip to Delos Island. Overnight in Mykonos.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 – Depart Mykonos
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed to Mykonos International Airport to board your flight home or continue your Europe tour.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 – Arrive In Athens
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Athens International Airport and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, spend your day relaxing or shopping nearby. Overnight stay in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 – Athens City Tour & Acropolis Museum
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a city tour covering Panathenaic Stadium, Maximos Mansion, Temple of Olympian Zeus, Hadrian’s Arch, Parliament, and Constitution Square. Visit the Acropolis Museum, where exhibits like the Parthenon sculptures are displayed. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 – Athens – Argolis – Olympia
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive along the Corinth Canal and stop at Epidaurus Theatre and Nafplion. Continue to Mycenae to see its archaeological wonders before proceeding through Tripoli and Megalopolis en route to Olympia. Overnight in Olympia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 – Olympia – Delphi
package_itineraries.description: Explore Olympia’s key monuments, including the Sanctuary of Zeus, Ancient Stadium, and Archaeological Museum. Later, drive via Nafpaktos and Itea to Delphi, stopping at Rion-Antirion Bridge. Overnight in Delphi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 – Delphi – Kalabaka
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore the ruins in Delphi and its museum before heading to Kalabaka. Marvel at Meteora’s towering rock formations and monasteries. Overnight stay in Kalabaka.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 – Kalabaka – Athens
package_itineraries.description: Visit Meteora and Theopetra Cave, learning about ancient hermits and monks. On your return to Athens, stop at the Statue of Leonidas before checking into your hotel. Overnight in Athens.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7 – Depart Athens
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to Athens International Airport for departure or onward travel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Reykjavik
package_itineraries.description: Your Icelandic holiday begins as you land at Reykjavik International Airport. After meeting our representatives, you’ll be escorted to your hotel for check-in. The remainder of the day is free for you to relax or explore the city on your own.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Reykjavik Half-Day City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start the morning with a guided city tour. First, stop at Bessastaðir, the official residence of the President of Iceland, followed by a visit to Hafnarfjörður, a town often linked to myths of elves, dwarves, and hidden beings. From here, you’ll walk through the old fishing harbour before heading to Perlan, where you’ll enjoy sweeping views of Reykjavik. Next, marvel at the striking Hallgrímskirkja church, whose lava-flow-inspired architecture makes it one of Iceland’s most iconic structures. Construction lasted 40 years, and today it stands as a symbol of the nation’s heritage. Conclude the excursion with a stop at Alþingi, the world’s oldest parliament, established back in 930. Return to your hotel in Reykjavik for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Full-Day Excursion from Reykjavik
package_itineraries.description: On this day, enjoy a full-day outing that takes you to some of Iceland’s most treasured landmarks. Begin at Þingvellir National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site situated on tectonic plate boundaries and known as the historic seat of the Alþingi during the Viking era. Continue to Gullfoss, one of the country’s most renowned waterfalls along the Golden Circle. After a lunch break at Gullfoss Café, the journey continues to the Strokkur Geyser, which erupts at regular intervals, creating spectacular scenes. Next, stop at Faxi Waterfall, especially captivating during salmon season, and then proceed to Skalholt Cathedral along with its underground museum. Head back to Reykjavik for an overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Whale Watching Adventure
package_itineraries.description: This morning, set out on a thrilling whale-watching cruise from Reykjavik to Faxaflói Bay. The area is teeming with marine life such as whales, dolphins, puffins, gannets, and seabirds. Later, visit the Whale Exhibition Centre, an educational space housed in a refurbished Capelin fishing ship. Here, you’ll gain fascinating insights into the lives of whales and other arctic creatures. Spend the evening at leisure before retiring to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Reykjavik
package_itineraries.description: Your memorable journey in Iceland comes to an end. After checking out, proceed to the airport for your onward flight or extend your adventure with the next part of your travels.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Dublin
package_itineraries.description: Upon reaching Dublin, our tour manager will arrange your transfer to the hotel and assist with check-in. Get ready for the Hop On Hop Off tour, which offers a flexible way to discover the city. The ticket remains valid for 48 hours, letting you explore at your own pace. Highlights on this tour include Trinity College, Dublin Castle, St. Patrick’s Cathedral, Kilmainham Gaol, the Guinness Storehouse, and the Old Jameson Distillery. Spend your afternoon relishing global delicacies or savoring traditional Irish meals. Use the rest of the evening to relax or enjoy the local vibe. Overnight stay in Dublin at a premium hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Dublin Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin your morning with a hearty Irish breakfast before venturing into the Wicklow Mountains, also known as the Garden of Ireland. Key stops include Powerscourt House and Gardens, the Powerscourt Waterfall, and other heritage landmarks. Travel on to Glendalough, a valley renowned for its monastic ruins, and the pretty town of Enniskerry. Along the way, you’ll also pass through Laragh, Rathdrum, Roundwood, and Avoca. Avoca is home to the centuries-old Avoca Handweavers, one of the oldest surviving mills in Ireland.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Dublin to Belfast
package_itineraries.description: Check out of your Dublin hotel and board a train to Belfast. The journey of about 2.5 hours is filled with scenic views of the countryside. Once you arrive, check into your hotel and begin a guided exploration of the city. A must-see here is Titanic Belfast, a massive six-storey attraction that narrates the story of the legendary ship from its design to its ill-fated voyage. Game of Thrones fans can also opt for a special tour showcasing filming sites of the famous series. Overnight stay in Belfast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Belfast – Giants Causeway – Belfast
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Carrickfergus Castle, one of the finest Norman structures still standing. Continue to the Carrick-a-Rede Rope Bridge before arriving at the Giants Causeway. This natural wonder, filled with myths and geological marvels, offers stunning Atlantic Ocean views. Spend time climbing over the ancient basalt stones or relaxing at the local cafés. After lunch, head to Bushmills Distillery, the oldest licensed whiskey distillery in the world, and browse through souvenir shops or enjoy a tasting session. If time permits, conclude your day with a visit to Dunluce Castle before returning to Belfast for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Belfast
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to Belfast City Airport to either continue your Europe tour package or fly back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Dublin
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Dublin International Airport and transfer to your hotel with assistance from our tour manager. After check-in, spend the day exploring the city at your own leisure. Overnight in Dublin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Dublin Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a Hop On Hop Off tour. With a 48-hour valid ticket, you can explore attractions like Trinity College, Dublin Castle, St. Patrick’s Cathedral, Kilmainham Gaol, the Guinness Storehouse, and the Old Jameson Distillery. Break for lunch to enjoy local dishes or international flavors, then continue exploring the vibrant city streets. Stay overnight in Dublin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Dublin to Galway
package_itineraries.description: Check out and board a train to Galway, a 3-hour journey offering scenic landscapes. Once you arrive, experience the Old Galway City Tour aboard a vintage double-decker bus. Key attractions include Eyre Square, Galway Cathedral, and the City Museum. The town is famous for its cafés, music, and cultural vibrancy. Outside the city, explore Kylemore Abbey, Connemara National Park, Ashford Castle, and the Aran Islands. Spend the night in Galway.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Galway – Cliffs of Moher
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head through the Burren, a limestone wonderland filled with fossils, caves, and prehistoric remains. Continue to the majestic Cliffs of Moher, one of Ireland’s most famous natural sights and a filming location for movies such as Harry Potter and The Princess Bride. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Atlantic and the Aran Islands, and learn about the area at the Visitor Centre. Stay overnight in Galway.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Galway to Dublin
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, return by train to Dublin. Spend time shopping at the city’s many local markets, known for souvenirs, rare books, jewelry, and handmade goods. Overnight in Dublin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart Dublin
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Dublin International Airport to continue your Europe tour package or catch your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 – Arrive in Dublin
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Dublin International Airport, where our tour manager will escort you to your hotel. After check-in, you’ll receive a briefing about the upcoming days. Spend the evening at leisure, wandering through the city’s buzzing markets or enjoying local Irish cuisine in lively pubs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 – Dublin City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a delicious buffet breakfast before boarding your Hop On Hop Off bus tour. This double-decker bus lets you explore the city with ease. Stops include Trinity College, St. Patrick’s Cathedral, Christ Church Cathedral, the Guinness Brewery and Storehouse, Kilmainham Gaol, and Dublin Castle. Make sure to sample freshly poured Guinness at the Storehouse or taste authentic whiskey at the Old Jameson Distillery.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 – Depart Dublin
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport to continue your Europe tour package or board your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Dublin
package_itineraries.description: Known as the “City of a Thousand Welcomes,” Dublin greets you warmly. On arrival at Dublin International Airport, our tour manager will transfer you to the hotel and assist with check-in. After a short orientation, spend the rest of your day relaxing or exploring nearby attractions at your own pace. Overnight in Dublin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Dublin City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying a filling breakfast, set off on a Hop On Hop Off bus tour. The route includes major sites such as Dublin Castle, St. Patrick’s Cathedral, the Guinness Storehouse, Trinity College, Kilmainham Gaol, and the Old James Distillery. Live commentary in different languages enhances the experience. Pause for a traditional lunch at a local eatery before spending the afternoon shopping or relaxing at a classic Irish pub. Stay overnight in Dublin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Dublin to Killarney
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a train journey of about 3 hours to Killarney in County Kerry. This scenic ride showcases rolling hills and lush landscapes. On arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy a horse-drawn cart ride to Killarney National Park. The park features over 26,000 acres of lakes, rivers, and ancient woodlands, offering activities such as hiking, horse riding, canoeing, kayaking, and bird watching.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Killarney – Ring of Kerry
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a traditional Irish breakfast before embarking on the Ring of Kerry circuit. Your route passes through Killorglin, Lough Caragh, Glenbeigh, Cahersiveen, and Ballycarberry Castle. Further along, you’ll explore Waterville, a seaside village, and Sneem, famous for its colorful houses. The journey continues through Moll’s Gap and ends at Ladies View, one of Killarney’s most scenic lookouts. Stay overnight in Killarney.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Killarney to Dublin
package_itineraries.description: Return by train to Dublin after breakfast. Spend the rest of the evening enjoying the city one last time.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart Dublin
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and proceed to Dublin Airport for your onward Europe tour package or your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 – Arrive in Dublin
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Dublin International Airport and transfer to the city centre with the assistance of our tour manager. After check-in, join a briefing session about your itinerary. Start with a Hop On Hop Off tour, which provides live commentary and covers 25 stops including Trinity College, St. Patrick’s Cathedral, Dublin Castle, Kilmainham Gaol, the Guinness Storehouse, and the Old Jameson Distillery. The ticket remains valid for 48 hours, giving you flexibility to explore.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 – Dublin Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, continue your tour with a visit to the world-famous Guinness Storehouse. Learn about Ireland’s iconic brew and visit Gravity Bar for panoramic views of the city. Later, head to Trinity College, Ireland’s oldest university, and see the celebrated Book of Kells, a medieval manuscript admired worldwide. Spend the night in Dublin.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 – Dublin Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: You can either relax in the city or explore the Wicklow Mountains, famously called the Garden of Ireland. The day covers the towns of Enniskerry and Glendalough, along with picturesque villages like Rathdrum, Laragh, Roundwood, and Avoca. The Avoca Handweavers, one of the country’s oldest mills, is a must-see. Return to Dublin for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 – Depart Dublin
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport to continue with your Europe tour package or fly home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Florence
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Florence International Airport, our tour manager will receive you and arrange your transfer to the hotel. After check-in, spend the day exploring vibrant flea markets offering leather handbags, wallets, trinkets, jewelry, and fashionable accessories. It’s also a perfect spot to pick up home décor pieces and affordable kitchenware. Stay overnight in a luxury hotel in Florence.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discover Florence
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, hop on the city’s Hop On Hop Off bus for a full-day tour. This open-top double-decker gives a panoramic view of Florence’s highlights. Key attractions include Piazzale Michelangelo, the Accademia Gallery, the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, Ponte Vecchio, Uffizi Galleries, Basilica of Santa Croce, and Piazza del Duomo. Admire Michelangelo’s David at the Accademia Gallery and the breathtaking city views from Piazzale Michelangelo. Also explore the Boboli Gardens and climb up to San Miniato al Monte. Evening free for boutique shopping before returning to your hotel. Overnight stay in Florence.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out of your hotel and continue your Europe tour package or head to the airport for your return journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Rome
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Leonardo da Vinci–Fiumicino Airport, where our tour manager will welcome you and transfer you to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day walking through nearby attractions and markets selling antiques, carpets, and religious artifacts. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Rome.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Rome Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, join a Hop On Hop Off bus for panoramic sightseeing. See landmarks like the Colosseum, Pantheon, Roman Forum, Trevi Fountain, Sistine Chapel, Vatican Museums, and Spanish Steps. Later, enjoy shopping and dine at Trastevere, a charming neighborhood filled with local restaurants. Overnight stay in Rome.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and continue with your Europe tour package or catch your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Rome
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to Rome, the legendary City of Seven Hills! Considered the heart of Western Civilization and home to the Vatican, Rome will enchant you instantly. At Rome International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and assist with transfers to your hotel. Spend the day wandering the lively markets and avenues nearby. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Rome.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Rome – City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin the Discover Rome experience on a Hop On Hop Off bus. Pass valid for 48 hours lets you board or exit freely. Visit Vatican City, the Colosseum, Trevi Fountain, Tiber Island, and other landmarks. From the open double-decker bus, enjoy 360-degree views while listening to multilingual audio commentary. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel in Rome.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Rome – Florence – Pisa – Florence
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before boarding your train to Florence. The scenic ride lasts about 1.5 hours. After hotel check-in, head out on a half-day excursion through the Tuscan countryside. Highlights include Pisa’s Leaning Tower, Piazza dei Miracoli, Duomo, Camposanto, Battistero di San Giovanni, and Piazza dei Cavalieri. Commentary is available in multiple languages. Don’t miss the ancient Church of San Sisto and admire Pisa’s Romanesque architecture. Return to Florence by evening for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Florence – Venice
package_itineraries.description: Begin with breakfast, then explore Florence on the Hop On Hop Off bus. Admire vineyards, olive groves, art galleries, and Michelangelo’s David. After lunch, transfer to Florence Railway Station and board your train to Venice. Upon arrival, check into your hotel. Spend the night in a luxury hotel in Venice.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Venice City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to St. Mark’s Square for a guided walking tour. Visit St. Mark’s Basilica, Ducale Palace, and cross the Bridge of Sighs to see the historic Venice Jail. Later, enjoy Murano Island’s famous glass factories. The afternoon is free for shopping in Venice’s markets, known for lace, glassware, and papier-mâché. Overnight stay in Venice.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Venice – Milan
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, catch a scenic 2.5-hour train journey along the Adriatic Coast to Milan. Check into your hotel and spend the day exploring markets filled with fashion and handicrafts. Stay at a luxury hotel in Milan.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Explore Milan
package_itineraries.description: Tour Milan on a Hop On Hop Off bus. Visit Duomo, Sforzesco Castle, Santa Maria delle Grazie, Piazza del Duomo, and the Leonardo da Vinci Museum of Science. Other highlights include Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II and Triennale di Milano. Overnight in Milan.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out of your hotel and proceed to the airport for your Europe tour package’s next destination or your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Venice
package_itineraries.description: At Marco Polo International Airport, our tour manager will meet you and assist with hotel transfers. Evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Venice Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Murano Island to watch glass artisans at work. Continue to Burano, known for colorful houses and lace, and Torcello, famous for its cathedral and museums. Stroll Sant’Elena and Venice gardens such as Giardini Papadopoli and Giardini Reali. Relax at Lido Waterfront.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Venice to Florence
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Florence in about 3.5 hours. After check-in, explore attractions like Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, Uffizi Galleries, Piazzale Michelangelo, and Piazza della Signoria. Optionally, visit Pisa to see its Leaning Tower and Piazza del Duomo. Overnight in Florence.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Florence to Rome
package_itineraries.description: Board the train to Rome (1.5 hours). After check-in, enjoy a guided Vatican tour covering St. Peter’s Basilica, Sistine Chapel, Vatican Gardens, St. Peter’s Square, and Castel Sant’Angelo. Overnight stay in Rome.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Roman Highlights
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Colosseum, Trevi Fountain, Pantheon, Roman Forum, Piazza Navona, Spanish Steps, Villa Borghese, Arch of Constantine, and the Jewish Quarter with its synagogue and museum. Stay overnight in Rome.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and head to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Milan
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Milan Malpensa Airport where our tour manager will welcome you and assist with hotel transfer. After check-in, enjoy free time to discover the city’s nearby sights. Stay overnight in a luxury Milan hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Milan
package_itineraries.description: Start with breakfast, then tour Milan on a Hop On Hop Off bus. Tickets remain valid for 48 hours, giving you the freedom to explore at your own pace. Enjoy panoramic city views from the open double-decker. Landmarks include Sforza Castle, Basilica di Sant’Ambrogio, Parco delle Basiliche, and Leonardo’s Navigli canals. Later, explore the Duomo, admire The Madonnina, and visit La Scala Opera House, Fondazione Prada, and the Leonardo da Vinci Museum of Science and Technology. Overnight stay in Milan.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your onward Europe tour package or flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Venice
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Marco Polo International Airport where our tour manager will welcome you and help with hotel transfer. Spend the day strolling through stalls and streets near your hotel. Stay overnight in Venice.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Venice
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, join a guided walking tour starting at St. Mark’s Square. Visit Ducale Palace, Bridge of Sighs, St. Mark’s Basilica, Santa Maria della Salute, Ponte di Rialto, and the Grand Canal. Spend the afternoon exploring charming alleyways and return to St. Mark’s Square via Mercerie Street for shopping. Overnight stay in Venice.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to Venice Airport for your Europe tour package’s continuation or your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Rome
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Rome International Airport, where our tour manager will assist you in catching your high-speed train to Venice (around 3.5 hours). After check-in, explore the surroundings at leisure. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel in Rome.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Venice Island Excursion
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, board the Alilaguna boat at St. Mark’s Square. Visit Murano, famous for glassmaking since the 13th century. Continue to Burano, with its colorful houses and lacemaking traditions, then proceed to Torcello, home to Santa Maria Assunta Cathedral and Torcello Museum. Return to Venice hotel for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Venice – Florence – Pisa
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a 3-hour scenic train ride to Florence. Check in, then proceed to Pisa to explore the Leaning Tower, Piazza dei Miracoli, Duomo, Piazza dei Cavalieri, Scuola Normale, and the historic Battistero. Return to Florence for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Florence – Rome
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, tour Florence’s landmarks, including Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, Uffizi Galleries, Ponte Vecchio, Piazzale Michelangelo, Piazza della Signoria, and Palazzo Pitti. Later, travel to Rome and visit highlights such as Exhibition Palace, Capitoline Museum, Piazza Venezia, and more iconic Roman sites if time allows. Stay overnight in Rome.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Vatican City Visit
package_itineraries.description: Morning free to explore Rome or shop at local flea markets. In the afternoon, visit Vatican City, including St. Peter’s Basilica, Sistine Chapel, Vatican Museums, and Vatican Gardens. Overnight stay in Rome.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and head to Rome International Airport for your onward journey or return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in London
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in London and proceed to your hotel. Spend the remainder of the day discovering the city at your leisure. Top shopping locations include Selfridges, Harrods, and Fortnum & Mason.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: London Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Discover London with a Hop On Hop Off double-decker bus pass. You will see highlights like Buckingham Palace, Trafalgar Square, Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, the Houses of Parliament, the Tower of London, and Piccadilly Circus. The tour also features a 4D cinema and Leicester Square. Stroll along the Thames and explore the lively Southbank with Tate Modern and Shakespeare’s Globe Theatre. You may also opt for a river cruise or a family show at the Kids Club. Visit museums such as the British Museum or Natural History Museum or relax in Hyde Park or Kensington Gardens. Another option is to attend a West End performance. Conclude the day with dinner at a traditional pub or sample global cuisine in one of London’s diverse districts.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: London Eye, Madame Tussauds, and Shopping
package_itineraries.description: Start the morning with a ride on the London Eye for panoramic city views. Continue to Madame Tussauds and view the lifelike wax figures of celebrities and historical icons. Later, shop at Oxford Street, Regent Street, or Covent Garden. End your day with dinner in Soho or Shoreditch, both known for their vibrant food scenes.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: London to Paris
package_itineraries.description: Board the Eurostar train from London to Paris (approx. 2 hours). On arrival, enjoy a guided orientation of Paris. Check in at your hotel, then spend the afternoon walking along the Seine or relaxing at Parisian cafés. At the Louvre, be sure to see the Mona Lisa. Don’t miss shopping at Galeries Lafayette on Boulevard Haussmann. In the evening, attend the Lido show before resting overnight in Paris.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Paris City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Visit landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame Cathedral, Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe, Place de la Concorde, and Tuileries Gardens. Take a Seine river cruise and explore the Latin Quarter. Enjoy free time at Montmartre and visit the Sacré-Cœur Basilica. Savor dinner at a traditional Parisian restaurant. Day 6: Disneyland Paris Spend the day at Disneyland Paris. Explore both Disneyland Park and Walt Disney Studios Park. Enjoy thrilling rides, meet Disney characters, and watch entertaining shows. Don’t miss the evening Disney Illuminations show before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Disneyland Paris
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at Disneyland Paris. Explore both Disneyland Park and Walt Disney Studios Park. Enjoy thrilling rides, meet Disney characters, and watch entertaining shows. Don’t miss the evening Disney Illuminations show before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in London
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Heathrow, transfer to hotel, and check in. Visit Madame Tussauds and enjoy a ride on the London Eye. Overnight stay in London.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: London Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Hop On Hop Off bus through Central London. Sites include Tower of London, Crown Jewels, British Museum, National Gallery, Buckingham Palace, Parliament, Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, Trafalgar Square, Piccadilly Circus, Downing Street, and St. Paul’s Cathedral. In the evening, visit Leicester Square for dining and entertainment.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Around London
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Windsor for Windsor Castle, then to Wiltshire for Stonehenge and the Cotswolds, and finish at Bath with attractions such as St. George’s Chapel, Salisbury Cathedral, Glastonbury Abbey, and Pulteney Bridge.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Around London – Day 2
package_itineraries.description: Visit Oxford, including Christ Church College. Move to Stratford-upon-Avon, Shakespeare’s birthplace, and admire Tudor homes. Tour Warwick Castle with its towers and ramparts. Return to London for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport or continue with your Europe tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Edinburgh
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Scotland’s capital and transfer to your hotel. Take some rest or enjoy a relaxed city walk. Spend the day shopping or visiting nearby attractions.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Edinburgh Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore sights like Edinburgh Castle, Royal Mile, and Holyrood Palace. Journey into the Highlands, stopping at Glencoe, Great Glen, Fort Augustus, Grampian Mountains, and Highland Perthshire, while listening to tales of Jacobites and Loch Ness. Other stops include The National Museum of Scotland, St. Giles’ Cathedral, and the Royal Botanic Garden. Conclude with a Scottish dinner and ceilidh performance. Overnight stay in Edinburgh.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Edinburgh to Inverness
package_itineraries.description: Depart for Inverness, gateway to the Highlands. Pause at Loch Ness to look out for the legendary monster. Check in to your hotel in Inverness and explore at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Inverness Hop On Hop Off Tour
package_itineraries.description: Tour highlights include Inverness Castle and St. Andrews Cathedral. Hop On Hop Off stops include Castle Street, Abertarff House, Highland Archive Centre, Tomnahurich Hill, and the Caledonian Canal. Take a Loch Ness cruise and visit Culloden Battlefield. End with sights like General Wades Road, Bellfield Park, and Holm Mills. Overnight stay in Inverness.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Inverness to Glasgow
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Glasgow, Scotland’s biggest city. See attractions such as Glasgow Cathedral, George Square, and Riverside Museum. Evening free to explore the city’s vibrant nightlife.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Glasgow to Windermere
package_itineraries.description: Drive south into England’s Lake District. Arrive in Windermere and take a cruise on the lake.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Windermere to Cardiff
package_itineraries.description: Head to Wales’ capital, Cardiff. Visit Cardiff Castle and tour Cardiff Bay with the Millennium Centre. Other highlights include Mermaid Quay, Cardiff Barrage, Techniquest, and Alexandra Gardens. Explore Victorian and Edwardian arcades filled with shops and cafés.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Cardiff Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Visit the National Museum Cardiff. Shop at arcades and relax in Bute Park.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Cardiff to London
package_itineraries.description: Return to London. Take a panoramic city tour to see Buckingham Palace, Big Ben, and the Tower of London. In the evening, explore lively areas such as Covent Garden or Soho.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: London Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Take a Hop On Hop Off bus tour. See the British Museum, Tower Bridge, Parliament, Westminster Abbey, Madame Tussauds, and Leicester Square. Ride the London Eye for panoramic views. Shop on Oxford Street or browse Camden and Borough Markets. A Thames cruise offers another perspective of the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Departure from London
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport, ending your Scotland and London journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in London
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Heathrow, transfer to your hotel, and check in. Spend the day at leisure near your hotel. Overnight in London.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: London City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Visit UNESCO sites like the Tower of London, Westminster Palace, Greenwich, and Royal Botanical Gardens. Other stops include Buckingham Palace, London Eye, London Bridge, British Museum, St. Paul’s Cathedral, Big Ben, Hyde Park, Natural History Museum, Trafalgar Square, Kensington Palace, Borough Market, and London Aquarium.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: London to Paris
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Paris on the Eurostar (approx. 2.5 hours). On arrival, transfer to your hotel and explore nearby areas in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Paris City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Discover the Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame, Arc de Triomphe, Luxembourg Gardens, Pantheon, and Palace of Versailles. The guided tour offers audio in multiple languages and includes lunch.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Disneyland Paris
package_itineraries.description: Travel 32 km outside Paris to Disneyland, with rides, shows, and shopping. Return to your hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Paris
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival & Half-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive and check into your hotel. Begin with the British Museum’s fascinating exhibits. Head to Covent Garden for shops, cafés, and street performances. Walk along the South Bank to Tate Modern and Shakespeare’s Globe. Cross Millennium Bridge to St. Paul’s Cathedral. Dinner at a pub, followed by nightlife or a theatre show in the West End.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start with a Hop On Hop Off bus and a Thames cruise. Tour the Tower of London and see the Crown Jewels. Walk across Tower Bridge, and visit HMS Belfast. Lunch at Borough Market before heading to Buckingham Palace for the Guard ceremony. Continue to Green Park and Piccadilly Circus. Visit the National Gallery in Trafalgar Square. Dinner in Covent Garden, or a show in Soho or Camden.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Final Day & Departure
package_itineraries.description: See Big Ben, Parliament, and Westminster Abbey. Take a Thames boat ride past the London Eye, Shard, and Tower Bridge. Shop along Oxford Street or at Harrods and Selfridges. Optional visits include Victoria & Albert Museum or Natural History Museum. Enjoy a farewell dinner before departing.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in London
package_itineraries.description: Arrive and check into your hotel. Evening walk through London with stops at Oxford Street, Knightsbridge, Harrods, and Harvey Nichols.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: London Tour
package_itineraries.description: Use a Hop On Hop Off bus to see major attractions. Visit the Tower of London, Crown Jewels, Houses of Parliament, Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, Piccadilly Circus, Buckingham Palace, and London Eye. Explore museums such as the British Museum. Evening at a West End show or Covent Garden.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: London Eye & Madame Tussauds
package_itineraries.description: Ride the London Eye and explore Madame Tussauds wax museum. Your ticket includes a 4D cinema experience. Evening in Leicester Square.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: London to Paris
package_itineraries.description: Travel by Eurostar to Paris. Visit Montmartre and Sacré-Cœur Basilica. Evening Seine river cruise. Explore Boulevard Haussmann cafés.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Paris Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Tour the Eiffel Tower, Louvre, Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe, Place de la Concorde, Tuileries Gardens, and Latin Quarter. Dinner at a Parisian restaurant.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Disneyland Paris
package_itineraries.description: Full day at Disneyland and Walt Disney Studios Park. Return to Paris for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Paris to Amsterdam
package_itineraries.description: Take the train to Amsterdam. Visit Anne Frank House and enjoy a canal cruise.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Amsterdam Tour
package_itineraries.description: Hop On Hop Off access to Van Gogh Museum, Rijksmuseum, Jordaan, and Anne Frank statue. Take another canal cruise. Evening to explore nightlife or try Dutch cuisine.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy free time before heading to the airport.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Bergen
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Bergen Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and guided to your hotel for check-in. Take some time to relax before setting out on a short orientation walk around the city. Stroll along the famous Bryggen Wharf, a UNESCO World Heritage Site lined with wooden houses, and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of the fish market. In the evening, you may choose to try some fresh seafood or Norwegian delicacies at a local restaurant. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel in Bergen.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Bergen Full-Day Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a hearty breakfast before setting out on a full-day Hop On Hop Off sightseeing tour. You will explore the city’s most treasured landmarks, such as Bryggen, St. Mary’s Church, and the Hanseatic Museum. Stop at Troldhaugen, the former home of composer Edvard Grieg, to immerse yourself in Norway’s musical heritage. Later, visit the famous Voringsfossen Waterfall, one of Norway’s most dramatic natural wonders. For a breathtaking panoramic view of the city, take the Fløibanen funicular up to Mount Fløyen. Spend the night in Bergen, soaking up the city’s magical evening lights.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Depart Bergen
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel. Depending on your travel schedule, you may enjoy some last-minute shopping for souvenirs or take a leisurely stroll along the harbourfront. Continue your Europe tour package with the next destination or head to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Oslo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Oslo International Airport, where you will be met and assisted with your transfer to the hotel. After check-in, spend the afternoon at leisure. You may choose to walk around Karl Johans Gate, the main street of Oslo, lined with shops, cafés, and historic landmarks. In the evening, unwind with a delicious Norwegian dinner and get a glimpse of the vibrant nightlife. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel in Oslo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Oslo – Flam Scenic Journey
package_itineraries.description: Begin your morning with breakfast before embarking on a cultural exploration of Oslo. Visit iconic landmarks such as the Akershus Fortress, Viking Ship Museum, Fram Polar Ship Museum, and the open-air Norwegian Museum of Cultural History. Admire the Oslo Fjord, stretching over 100 km with its serene islands and coastal views. By afternoon, board the train for Flam, a journey renowned for its breathtaking landscapes. The Flam Railway, considered one of the most scenic train rides in the world, passes through mountains, waterfalls, and lush valleys. Stop at Myrdal to capture unforgettable views. Overnight stay in the quaint village of Flam.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Flam – Bergen via Fjords
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a fjord cruise across Aurlandsfjord and Naeroyfjord, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Marvel at the towering peaks rising from the waters and the charming farms clinging to steep hillsides. The drive through Stalheim is equally impressive, with hairpin bends offering stunning views of waterfalls like Stalheimsfossen and Sivlefossen. Continue to the town of Voss, where you will board a train bound for Bergen. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Bergen, surrounded by fjords and mountains.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Bergen
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel. Depending on your schedule, you may enjoy a short walk to admire Bergen’s architecture or shop for souvenirs before continuing your Europe tour package journey or flying back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Oslo
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to Oslo! On arrival at Oslo International Airport, you will be greeted and transferred to your hotel for check-in. Spend the afternoon exploring at your own pace—perhaps take a stroll by the harbour, or relax at one of the many cafés. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel in Oslo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Oslo City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on a full-day Hop On Hop Off sightseeing tour to experience Oslo’s cultural highlights. Learn about the city’s 11th-century origins under Harald Hardrade as you visit attractions like the Norwegian Museum of Cultural History, Viking Ship Museum, Fram Museum, Holmenkollen Ski Museum, and the National Gallery. For a taste of Oslo’s modern side, spend time at Karl Johans Gate with its lively shops and restaurants. In the evening, head to Aker Brygge, a waterfront district known for fine dining and entertainment. Stay overnight in Oslo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Depart Oslo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel. Depending on your flight schedule, you may enjoy a final walk through the city or shop for souvenirs before transferring to the airport. Continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package or board your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Amsterdam
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Schiphol Airport, our representative will assist you with the transfer to your hotel. Take some time to rest after check-in. In the evening, begin your first taste of Amsterdam by visiting the Van Gogh Museum, where the artist’s timeless works are displayed. Later, head to the Heineken Experience to enjoy interactive exhibits and tastings. Conclude your evening with a stroll through the Amsterdam Light Festival, which turns the city into a glowing spectacle. Stay overnight at your Amsterdam hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Amsterdam City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast before exploring some of Amsterdam’s best-loved attractions. Start with Madame Tussauds Museum, featuring lifelike wax figures, and continue to the Amsterdam Dungeon for a thrilling historic experience. Later, visit the iconic windmills that are symbols of Dutch culture—many of these windmills host museums or quirky cafés. In the afternoon, head to Zandvoort Beach, known for its golden sands and vibrant atmosphere, offering water sports and relaxation. Return to your Amsterdam hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Amsterdam Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a Dutch breakfast before heading to the breathtaking Keukenhof Gardens, famously called the “Garden of Europe.” Spread across vast acres, it showcases millions of tulips and seasonal flowers in full bloom. Afterward, visit the Amsterdam Ice Bar for a unique sub-zero experience, followed by a canal cruise that highlights the city’s scenic waterways and charming architecture. Overnight stay in Amsterdam.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Brussels City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart for Belgium’s capital. Known for its rich history and cosmopolitan culture, Brussels will impress with its diversity. Visit the iconic Grand Palace, admire the futuristic Atomium, and explore Mini-Europe, a fascinating miniature park displaying famous European landmarks. In the evening, enjoy Belgian delicacies such as waffles and chocolates before heading back to your hotel. Stay overnight in Brussels.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Amsterdam
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out of the hotel. Continue your onward Europe tour package journey or take your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Amsterdam
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Amsterdam International Airport, you’ll be greeted and transferred to your hotel. After check-in, spend your first evening exploring the nearby attractions at leisure. Whether it’s a quiet stroll by the canals or sampling Dutch street food, the city will immediately charm you. Stay overnight at your Amsterdam hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Amsterdam City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a Hop On Hop Off city tour. The flexible 48-hour ticket allows you to board and exit at various stops, giving you the freedom to explore iconic sites. The tour also includes a scenic canal cruise where you can admire Amsterdam’s narrow houses, bridges, and gabled architecture. Spend the afternoon discovering vibrant markets and lively neighborhoods. Key highlights include Anne Frank House, Van Gogh Museum, Rijksmuseum, and the serene Vondelpark. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel. You may extend your stay for further exploration or continue your Europe tour package journey, or catch your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Rome
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to the Eternal City. Upon arrival in Rome, our tour representative will assist with hotel transfer and check-in. Spend your evening exploring local markets, trattorias, or simply enjoying the Roman atmosphere near your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Rome City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin a Hop On Hop Off bus tour to explore Rome’s highlights, including Vatican City, the Colosseum, Trevi Fountain, and Piazza Venezia. Learn about the city’s ancient heritage and admire its grand monuments. Later, board a train to Florence, check into your hotel, and rest for the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Florence and Pisa
package_itineraries.description: Start with a guided tour of Florence, home to Renaissance art and stunning architecture. Highlights include Michelangelo’s David, Botticelli’s Venus, and the Duomo. Later, venture into the Tuscan countryside to see Pisa’s Leaning Tower and Piazza dei Miracoli. Return to Florence in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Florence to Venice
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and spend the morning shopping or strolling Florence’s quaint streets. Around noon, take a train to Venice. After check-in, spend the evening at leisure. Stay overnight in Venice.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Venice Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Venice’s landmarks, including St. Mark’s Square, Ducal Palace, and the Bridge of Sighs. Later, visit Murano Island, famous for its glass-blowing tradition. In the evening, wander through the canals or markets. Stay overnight in Venice.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Venice to Innsbruck
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a scenic train ride to Innsbruck. Nestled in the Alps, the city offers breathtaking views and a charming old town to explore. Stay overnight in Innsbruck.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Innsbruck to Zurich
package_itineraries.description: Check out and travel to Zurich, enjoying panoramic Swiss views. After check-in, spend your evening strolling through Zurich’s lively streets or lakeside promenades. Stay overnight in Zurich.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Zurich – Mt. Titlis – Lucerne – Zurich
package_itineraries.description: Today, visit Mt. Titlis via cable car for spectacular Alpine views. Highlights include the Ice Grotto and Ice Flyer chairlift. Later, head to Lucerne to admire landmarks like Kapellbrucke and Altstadt. Return to Zurich in the evening. Stay overnight in Zurich.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Zurich to Frankfurt
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Frankfurt, Germany’s bustling financial hub. Explore the city on a Hop On Hop Off tour covering Goethe House, Frankfurt Cathedral, Stadel Museum, and Palmengarten. Stay overnight in Frankfurt.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Frankfurt to Amsterdam
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, board a train to Amsterdam. Upon arrival, enjoy a city tour covering Van Gogh Museum, Anne Frank House, Rembrandt House, and a canal cruise. Stay overnight in Amsterdam.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Amsterdam to Brussels
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Brussels by train. Visit attractions such as the European Parliament, Manneken Pis, Grand Palace, and Atomium. Stay overnight in Brussels.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Brussels to Paris
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with sightseeing in Brussels before boarding your train to Paris. After check-in, explore the neighborhood at leisure. Stay overnight in Paris.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Paris Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a Hop On Hop Off city tour covering the Eiffel Tower, Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe, and the Louvre Museum, home to the world’s most celebrated masterpieces. Stay overnight in Paris.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Departure from Paris
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and continue with your Europe tour package journey or fly back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Lisbon
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Lisbon International Airport, you will be greeted and transferred comfortably to your hotel. After check-in, take some time to relax and settle in. Depending on your arrival time, you can enjoy a leisurely stroll through the cobbled streets around your accommodation or unwind at a nearby café sampling Portugal’s famous pastel de nata. The evening is free for you to discover the peaceful atmosphere of the neighborhood. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Lisbon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Lisbon Sightseeing Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel before boarding the Hop On Hop Off bus, the perfect way to explore Lisbon’s highlights at your own pace. Ride the open-top bus and enjoy panoramic views of the city’s most important landmarks. Stop to admire the majestic Belem Tower and the Jeronimos Monastery, two iconic UNESCO World Heritage sites. Explore the medieval Castelo de Sao Jorge that overlooks the city, and visit the historic Lisbon Cathedral. Each stop offers a chance to dive deeper into the culture and history of Portugal. In the evening, step into Lisbon’s vibrant nightlife. You can dine at traditional restaurants serving authentic Portuguese dishes, sip local wines, or enjoy live Fado music performances before heading to the city’s lively nightclubs. Spend the night in Lisbon.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Lisbon
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel. Depending on your schedule, you may have time for some last-minute shopping or a short walk along the Tagus River promenade. Later, continue with the next leg of your Europe tour package or head to the airport for your return flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Porto
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Porto International Airport, where you will be assisted with your hotel transfer. Once you have checked in, take the evening to relax or wander around your neighbourhood. You may wish to walk along the banks of the Douro River or enjoy a quiet dinner at a local restaurant. Porto’s welcoming atmosphere is best experienced through its authentic dining spots and friendly locals. Overnight stay in Porto.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Porto’s Landmarks
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day sightseeing journey aboard the Hop On Hop Off bus. This flexible tour lets you uncover Porto’s most remarkable highlights. Cross the famous Luis I Bridge, admire the grandeur of Porto Cathedral, and climb the Clerigos Tower for panoramic city views. Visit the neoclassical Bolsa Palace, a masterpiece of 19th-century architecture, and explore the Church of Saint Francis, known for its ornate baroque interior.
