Later, unwind by the scenic Foz do Douro beach, where the Atlantic Ocean meets the river, offering a perfect spot to relax. Spend the night in Porto, soaking in the city’s serene charm.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Porto
package_itineraries.description: On your final day, enjoy breakfast at the hotel before checking out. Depending on your plans, you may continue with your Europe tour package or make your way to the airport for your return journey. Take with you lasting memories of Porto’s cobbled streets, iconic landmarks, and riverside beauty.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive In Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Bucharest International Airport, you’ll be assisted with the transfer to your hotel for check-in. Take the evening at leisure to explore the neighborhood or relax after your journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Bucharest Full Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Your guided tour begins with Old Town landmarks such as the Palace of Parliament, Stavropoleos Monastery, the National Bank, Romanian Athenaeum, and colorful Umbrella Street. After lunch, continue with visits to the Village Museum, the Arch of Triumph, and Revolution Square, wrapping up with University Square and Charles de Gaulle Square.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bucharest Half-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: This morning, discover Piata Obor Market, Cotroceni Palace, the Botanical Gardens, and the Opera House. Later, stop at the Museum of Contemporary Art and Cotroceni National Museum. In the evening, enjoy Bucharest’s nightlife at Caru’ cu Bere, the city’s oldest beer hall.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast and checkout, transfer to Bucharest International Airport to board your flight home or continue onward with your Europe tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Bucharest International Airport, you’ll be welcomed and transferred to your hotel for check-in. Take the evening at leisure by exploring the nearby streets, enjoying charming cafes, and experiencing the relaxed pace of this safe and walkable city. Overnight stay in a luxury hotel in Bucharest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Discovering Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with breakfast, followed by a guided exploration of the city’s major highlights. Wander through the Old Town and see landmarks such as the Palace of Parliament, Stavropoleous Monastery, the National Bank of Romania, and the impressive Romania Athenaeum. Later, explore the Village Museum, Arch of Triumph, Revolution Square, Cotroceni Palace, and the lush Botanical Gardens. Pause for lunch at Piata Obor Market, where you can savor authentic Romanian dishes such as sarmale (stuffed cabbage rolls), meatballs, and sweet baklava. End the evening with a visit to historic bars, including the Art Nouveau-style Caru’ cu Bere, the oldest beer house in Bucharest. Overnight in Bucharest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bucharest to Timisoara
package_itineraries.description: Spend the morning covering attractions you may have missed. Visit artisan markets offering ceramics, handicrafts, and souvenirs. After a hearty Romanian lunch, head to Bucharest train station in the evening to board the overnight train to Timisoara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Timisoara to Belgrade
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Timisoara and continue your journey to Belgrade, Serbia’s vibrant capital. Check into your hotel, then spend the evening strolling through the lively streets filled with cafes and historic sites. Overnight at a luxury hotel in Belgrade.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Exploring Belgrade
package_itineraries.description: Step into one of Europe’s oldest inhabited cities, dating back to 5700 BC. Visit the Belgrade Fortress, Temple of Saint Sava, St. Mark’s Orthodox Church, and the unique Ruzica Church. Stop for a traditional lunch at a cozy Belgrade bistro before exploring art galleries, museums, and lively squares. Overnight in Belgrade.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Leisure in Belgrade
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at your own pace. Shop at bustling markets where you’ll find antiques, handmade cosmetics, books, and gourmet nut butters. Stay overnight in Belgrade.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Belgrade to Zlatibor
package_itineraries.description: Depart for Zlatibor, with a stop at Sirogojno’s open-air museum. Spread over 5 hectares, this fascinating site showcases traditional architecture and lifestyles of the Serbian countryside. Continue to Zlatibor for check-in. Overnight in a luxury hotel in Zlatibor.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Zlatibor to Podgorica
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a hearty Serbian breakfast before driving to Podgorica, Montenegro’s capital. Embark on a walking tour that includes King Nikola’s Palace and the charming Ribnica Bridge. Overnight in Podgorica.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Day Trip to Kotor Bay
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to the Adriatic coast for a guided walking tour of Kotor. Its UNESCO-listed Old Town, medieval walls, and seaside setting make it a spectacular stop. Return to Podgorica in the evening. Overnight in Podgorica.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Departure from Podgorica
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport to continue your Europe tour package adventure or board your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Bucharest – Suceava
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel by train through scenic landscapes to reach Suceava. On arrival, check in and begin a short sightseeing tour, covering the fortified castle, Saint George Church, and Saint John’s Monastery. In the evening, settle in Gura Humorului for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Bucovina Monasteries
package_itineraries.description: Today, visit some of Bucovina’s UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Explore Sucevita Monastery, built in 1581 with fortress-like walls and vivid frescoes. Continue to Voronet Monastery, often called the Sistine Chapel of the East, founded by Stephen the Great in 1488. End at Moldovita Monastery, renowned for biblical frescoes like the Siege of Constantinople. Pause at Marginea village to see local black pottery workshops before returning to Gura Humorului.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and depart Suceava for the return journey to Bucharest, where you can connect with your Europe tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Bucharest International Airport and transfer to your hotel for check-in. Spend the evening exploring the lively surroundings at leisure. Overnight in Bucharest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Bucharest to Sibiu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a short tour of Bucharest to see highlights like the Palace of Parliament, Stavropoleos Monastery, the National Bank, the Romanian Athenaeum, Herastrau Park, the Village Museum, and the Arch of Triumph. Journey onwards to Sibiu, stopping at Poenari Castle, once the residence of Vlad the Impaler, believed to be the inspiration for Count Dracula. Arrive in Sibiu, a medieval town framed by mountain peaks. Visit the Big, Small, and Huet Squares, the Liar’s Bridge, and the Gothic-style Evangelical Church. Overnight in Sibiu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sibiu to Borgo Pass
package_itineraries.description: Follow in Bram Stoker’s footsteps as you head toward Borgo Pass. En route, enjoy lunch at the Bran Castle Restaurant, linked to the Dracula legend. In the evening, stay at the atmospheric Castle Dracula in Pasul Bargaului. Overnight at Castle Dracula.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Borgo Pass to Sighisoara
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart for Sighisoara, birthplace of Vlad the Impaler. Explore its UNESCO-listed citadel, the Clock Tower, The Covered Stairway, Biserica din Deal, and the Catholic Church. Overnight in Sighisoara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Sighisoara to Brasov
package_itineraries.description: Head to Brasov, a charming medieval town. Visit the Black Church, Council Square, and the infamous hill where Vlad the Impaler punished his enemies. Overnight in Brasov.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Brasov to Bucharest via Snagov
package_itineraries.description: On your way back to Bucharest, stop at Snagov Island to visit the monastery where Vlad the Impaler is said to be buried. Overnight in Bucharest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast and transfer to the airport to fly home or continue with your Europe tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive In Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Bucharest International Airport, complete check-in with assistance and take the rest of the day to stroll the city and its vibrant markets. Overnight at a hotel in Bucharest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Bucharest – Sibiu
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore highlights of Bucharest such as Revolution Square, People’s Salvation Cathedral, the Romanian Athenaeum, the Old Royal Palace, and the Village Museum. Later, head towards Transylvania, stopping at Cozia Monastery before reaching Sibiu, a medieval town once named European Capital of Culture. Overnight in Sibiu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: From Taipei to Sun Moon Lake
package_itineraries.description: Spend the morning exploring Sibiu’s landmarks, including Saint Mary’s Evangelical Church, the Bridge of Lies, and the Council Tower. After lunch, drive to Sighisoara, a UNESCO town and birthplace of Vlad the Impaler. Its cobbled streets and fortified citadel make it one of Romania’s most enchanting sites. Overnight in Sighisoara.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Sighisoara – Bucovina
package_itineraries.description: Tour Sighisoara’s Citadel, Clock Tower, and medieval museums. After lunch, cross the Borgo Pass into Bucovina, a region dotted with monasteries and castles. Pause at Dracula’s Castle Hotel before arriving in Gura Humorului for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Explore Bucovina
package_itineraries.description: Today’s tour covers the painted monasteries of Bucovina, Putna Monastery, Suceava Fortress, Bucovina Village Museum, and the famed Voronet Monastery. Later, visit Moldovita Monastery and stop at Marginea to admire black ceramics. Stay overnight in Gura Humorului.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Bucovina – Brasov
package_itineraries.description: Drive through Bicaz Gorge and Hasmas National Park on the way to Brasov, once the capital of Transylvania. Visit Council Square, the Black Church, and the First Romanian School Museum before checking in. Overnight in Brasov.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Brasov – Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Bran Castle, linked to Dracula’s legend, and Peles Castle, a royal summer residence. Later, return to Bucharest for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Depart Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Bucharest International Airport for your flight home or onward Europe tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Henri Coanda International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Enjoy the evening exploring at leisure. Overnight in Bucharest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Bucharest to Sibiu
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Sibiu with stops at cultural landmarks, including Cozia Monastery and the Astra National Museum. Explore Sibiu’s old squares, cobbled streets, and the famous Bridge of Lies. Overnight in Sibiu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sibiu – Alba Lulia – Cluj Napoca
package_itineraries.description: Visit Alba Lulia, the oldest settlement in Romania, and see its Roman and Baroque landmarks such as the Vauban Fortress and Catholic Cathedral. After lunch, continue to Cluj Napoca, Transylvania’s largest city, for a guided walking tour. Overnight in Cluj Napoca.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cluj Napoca – Turda – Targu Mures
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Turda to explore its world-famous salt mines, then continue to Targu Mures, a town rich in medieval history and architecture such as the Apollo Palace and Fortress. Overnight in Targu Mures.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Targu Mures – Sighisoara – Brasov
package_itineraries.description: Depart for Sighisoara, birthplace of Vlad the Impaler, to see medieval treasures like Casa Vlad Dracul and the Covered Stairway. Later, head to Brasov and check in. Overnight in Brasov.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Brasov – Prejmer – Bran
package_itineraries.description: Explore Brasov in the morning before visiting the Prejmer Fortified Church and the legendary Bran Castle, tied to the Dracula myth. Return to Brasov for more sightseeing. Overnight in Brasov.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Brasov – Sinaia – Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Journey back to Bucharest with a stop in Sinaia to explore the fairy-tale Peles Castle. Spend the rest of the day exploring Revolution Square, the Patriarchy Church, and other landmarks. Overnight in Bucharest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure from Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for your onward journey or continue your Europe tour package).

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive In Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Henri Coanda Airport, transfer to your hotel, and enjoy the rest of the day exploring Bucharest’s lively streets. Overnight in Bucharest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Bucharest – Sibiu
package_itineraries.description: Begin the day with a visit to Horezu Monastery, a UNESCO site founded in 1690, then continue via Cozia Monastery before arriving in Sibiu. Check in and overnight in Sibiu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Explore Sibiu
package_itineraries.description: Wander Sibiu’s cobblestone streets, visiting the ASTRA National Museum, the Stairs Passage, fortresses, and the Museum of Glass Painted Icons. Spend the evening soaking in the local charm before staying overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Sibiu – Hunedoara – Sibiu
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore Corvin’s Castle, the largest medieval stronghold in Transylvania, followed by Deva’s fortress. Return to Sibiu for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Sibiu – Alba Lulia – Cluj Napoca – Baia Mare
package_itineraries.description: Travel north, stopping in Alba Lulia to see the Alba-Carolina Citadel and historic churches. Continue via Cluj Napoca to Baia Mare for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Explore Maramures
package_itineraries.description: Tour wooden churches in Surdesti, Leud, and Plopis, along with the Merry Cemetery at Sapanta. Drive through the Iza Valley before returning to Baia Mare for the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Baia Mare – Bucovina
package_itineraries.description: Journey through mountain passes to Gura Humorului, stopping at Barsana’s wooden churches. Overnight in Gura Humorului.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Explore Bucovina
package_itineraries.description: Visit Bucovina’s UNESCO monasteries, including Sucevita, Voronet, and Moldovita, plus ceramic workshops in Marginea. Stay overnight in Gura Humorului.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Bucovina – Sighisoara
package_itineraries.description: Travel through Bicaz Gorge to Sighisoara, Vlad the Impaler’s birthplace. Wander its medieval streets before checking in for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Sighisoara – Brasov
package_itineraries.description: Stop in Prejmer to see the fortified citadel before arriving in Brasov. Explore the Black Church and Council Square, then overnight in Brasov.

package_itineraries.title: Day 11: Explore Brasov
package_itineraries.description: Take a day trip to Bran Castle and Peles Castle, two of Romania’s most iconic landmarks. Return to Brasov for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 12: Brasov – Tulcea
package_itineraries.description: Travel via Galati to Tulcea, gateway to the Danube Delta. Check in and spend the evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 13: Danube Delta
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a full-day excursion into the UNESCO-listed Danube Delta, observing diverse birdlife and the unique Letea Forest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 14: Danube Delta – Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Drive via Constanta, stopping in Histria to see ancient Greek ruins and Roman mosaics, before returning to Bucharest. Overnight in the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 15: Explore Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Discover Bucharest highlights including Revolution Square, the Salvation Cathedral, the Royal Palace, and the Village Museum. Browse flea markets for handicrafts and antiques. Overnight in Bucharest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Bucharest International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening exploring the area. Overnight in Bucharest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Bucharest to Sibiu
package_itineraries.description: Explore Bucharest highlights such as the Palace of the Parliament, Revolution Square, and the Old Town. Visit the Village Museum before departing. Stop at Curtea de Arges, famed for its monastery and tragic legend, then continue via the Oltului Valley and Cozia Monastery to reach Sibiu. Explore the medieval squares and Gothic landmarks of this former Cultural Capital of Europe. Overnight in Sibiu.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sibiu – Sighisoara – Brasov
package_itineraries.description: Head to Sighisoara to visit its UNESCO-listed Clock Tower and medieval churches. Later, travel to Brasov to see the Black Church, Council Square, and the First Romanian School Museum. Overnight in Brasov.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Brasov – Bran – Sinaia – Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Discover Bran Castle, famously tied to the Dracula legend, followed by Peles Castle in Sinaia, a masterpiece of neo-Renaissance design. Continue back to Bucharest. Overnight in Bucharest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Bucharest
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport to catch your return flight or continue your Europe tour package.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Stockholm – Gamla Stan – Vasa Museum – ABBA The Museum
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Stockholm, you’ll be welcomed at the airport and transferred to your hotel. After checking in and freshening up, begin your adventure in Sweden’s beautiful capital. Explore Gamla Stan (Old Town), with its cobbled streets, cozy cafes, boutiques, and art galleries. Next, visit the Vasa Museum, home to the world’s only preserved 17th-century warship. End the day at the interactive ABBA The Museum, where fans of the legendary pop group can relive their music and legacy. Other highlights you can explore include The Royal Palace, Skansen Open Air Museum, and Stockholm City Hall.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Stockholm – Copenhagen – Tivoli Gardens – Christiansborg Palace – National Museum of Denmark
package_itineraries.description: Travel by train to Copenhagen, Denmark’s charming capital. After checking in, explore this city known for colorful buildings, canals, and its historic monarchy. Visit Tivoli Gardens, the world’s second-oldest amusement park, followed by the impressive Christiansborg Palace, home to the Danish Parliament, Supreme Court, and Prime Minister’s office. End the day with a tour of the National Museum of Denmark, the country’s largest cultural history museum.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Copenhagen – Odense – Hans Christian Andersen Museum
package_itineraries.description: Board a train to Odense, Denmark’s third-largest city. Visit the Hans Christian Andersen Museum, which provides fascinating insights into the life and works of the beloved storyteller. Overnight stay in Odense.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Odense – Aarhus – Moesgaard Museum – Marselisborg Castle – Street Food Hall
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Aarhus, Denmark’s second-largest city, often called the “City of Smiles.” Begin with a visit to Moesgaard Museum and Marselisborg Castle, then stroll through the historic Den Gamle By (Old Town). In the evening, enjoy local and international flavors at the Street Food Hall.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Aarhus – Frederikshavn – Gothenburg
package_itineraries.description: Take a train to Frederikshavn and then a ferry to Gothenburg, Sweden’s second-largest city. Visit Liseberg Amusement Park, the floating maritime museum Maritiman, and enjoy a boat cruise to the New Alvsborg Fortress. Overnight in Gothenburg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Gothenburg – Oslo – Vigeland Park – Royal Palace – City Hall
package_itineraries.description: Continue your journey by train to Oslo, the capital of Norway. Discover landmarks such as Vigeland Park, the Royal Palace, City Hall, Parliament Building, and the historic Akershus Fortress. Oslo, surrounded by fjords and rolling hills, offers a perfect blend of nature and history.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Depart from Oslo
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Stockholm
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Stockholm, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day relaxing or exploring the city at leisure. End the evening with a fine dining experience at one of Stockholm’s top restaurants.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Stockholm – Hop On Hop Off Tour
package_itineraries.description: Discover Stockholm aboard a Hop On Hop Off bus tour with audio commentary available in multiple languages. Visit landmarks like Gamla Stan (Old Town), ABBA The Museum, and the Vasa Museum, housing the world’s only preserved 17th-century ship. Other attractions include the Ice Bar, City Hall, Skansen, Royal Palace, Grona Lund, and Fjallgatan for stunning views.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Stockholm – Copenhagen – Bakken
package_itineraries.description: Take a train to Copenhagen, enjoying the scenic view of the Oresund Bridge. On arrival, visit Bakken, the world’s oldest amusement park. Overnight stay in Copenhagen.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Copenhagen – Hop On Hop Off Tour – Cruise to Oslo
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a sightseeing bus tour of Copenhagen, covering highlights like the National Museum of Denmark, Tivoli Gardens, Christiansborg Palace, Amalienborg Palace, Gefion Fountain, Botanical Gardens, and the Royal Library. In the evening, board a luxury cruise to Oslo, with entertainment and dinner onboard.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Oslo – Hop On Hop Off Tour
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Oslo and check in to your hotel. Then, explore the city on a Hop On Hop Off tour, visiting the National Theatre, Vigeland Park, Parliament Building, Aker Brygge, and the Akershus Fortress.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart from Oslo
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy free time in Oslo before heading to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Stockholm – Gamla Stan – Vasa Museum – ABBA The Museum
package_itineraries.description: After checking in at your hotel, explore Gamla Stan (Old Town), then visit the Vasa Museum, which houses a magnificent 17th-century warship. End the day at ABBA The Museum, an engaging stop for music lovers.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Stockholm – Gothenburg – Liseberg – New Alvsborg Fortress – Maritiman
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Gothenburg, Sweden’s lively second city. Visit Liseberg Amusement Park, take a boat ride to the New Alvsborg Fortress, and explore Maritiman, a unique floating maritime museum with ships, submarines, and barges.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Gothenburg – Malmo – Malmohus Castle
package_itineraries.description: Continue by train to Malmo, Sweden’s first fair-trade city. Explore its cultural attractions and visit Malmohus Castle, a Renaissance fortress now housing museums. Overnight in Malmo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Malmo – Ystad – Malmo
package_itineraries.description: Take a day trip to the charming coastal town of Ystad, famous as the setting for the Kurt Wallander detective series. Explore its beaches, medieval streets, and landmarks before returning to Malmo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart from Malmo
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport for your onward flight.v

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Stockholm
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and relax. Enjoy a leisurely evening exploring nearby cafes and scenic waterfronts.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Stockholm – Hop On Hop Off Tour
package_itineraries.description: Set out on a Hop On Hop Off sightseeing bus to visit major attractions. Explore Gamla Stan, visit ABBA The Museum, and step into the Vasa Museum to see the preserved 17th-century ship. Admire modern photography at Fotografiska Museum and marvel at the architecture of Stockholm City Hall. Later, shop at Hamngatan, Stureplan, and Strandvagen, or wander around SoFo, known for its boutiques, pubs, and design shops.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Depart from Stockholm
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your morning at leisure before transferring to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Bern – Rose Garden – Bern Minster
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Bern, you will be welcomed at the airport and transferred to your hotel. After check-in and some relaxation, begin your journey with a visit to the Rose Garden. This peaceful park offers panoramic views of the city and features more than 400 varieties of roses, making it a favorite among locals and tourists alike. Continue to Bern Minster, the tallest cathedral in Switzerland, known for its Gothic architecture and impressive tower that began construction in 1421. Spend the evening exploring the cobbled streets of Bern before retiring to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Clock Tower – Einstein Museum – Historical Museum – Botanical Garden
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning at the Zytglogge Clock Tower, a landmark dating back to the 13th century with an astronomical clock that fascinates visitors daily. Next, head to the Einstein Museum, where over 500 exhibits showcase the life and work of Albert Einstein during his time in Bern. Explore the Historical Museum, the second largest in Switzerland, housing diverse artifacts that highlight the cultural and political past of the region. Conclude the day with a visit to the Botanical Garden of the University of Bern, home to over 5,500 plant species from across the world. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Bern
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your return flight, carrying fond memories of Switzerland’s charming capital.

package_itineraries.title: Arrive in Zurich – Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: On arrival in Zurich, board a train to the beautiful town of Lucerne. After checking in at your hotel, spend the rest of the day exploring at leisure. You may wander through Lucerne’s historic Old Town, stroll along Chapel Bridge, or relax by Lake Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Lucerne – Mt. Titlis
package_itineraries.description: Begin your alpine adventure with a trip to Mt. Titlis . Travel to Engelberg and ascend the peak by the famous Titlis Rotair, the world’s first revolving cable car. Enjoy stunning views of glaciers, valleys, and the Black Forest region as you reach the summit. Spend the evening at your hotel in Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Lucerne – Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and take a scenic train ride to Interlaken. This town, nestled between Lake Thun and Lake Brienz, offers breathtaking alpine panoramas. The Golden Pass route is a highlight, presenting some of the finest Swiss landscapes. After checking in, explore Interlaken at your own pace.

package_itineraries.title: Interlaken – Jungfraujoch
package_itineraries.description: Board the train from Interlaken Ost to Grindelwald, followed by the cogwheel journey to the summit of Jungfraujoch . Standing at 3,454 metres, this is the highest railway station in Europe. Admire the vast Aletsch Glacier, explore the Ice Palace, and enjoy panoramic mountain views before returning to Interlaken for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Zurich – Rhine Falls
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Interlaken back to Zurich. After checking in, embark on an excursion to the Rhine Falls , Europe’s largest waterfall. Later, explore Zurich’s cobbled alleys, browse flea markets, or visit its world-class museums.

package_itineraries.title: Departure from Zurich
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your return journey home.

package_itineraries.title: Farewell Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before transferring to Taoyuan International Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Zurich – Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zurich and travel to Lucerne. Explore the Old Town, Chapel Bridge, and Lion Monument, or enjoy a boat ride on Lake Lucerne. Overnight in Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Lucerne – Mount Titlis
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Engelberg and ride the Rotair cable car to Mount Titlis , where snow awaits year-round. Admire panoramic alpine views before returning to Lucerne.

package_itineraries.title: Lucerne – Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: Board a train to Interlaken. Spend the day exploring or trying adventure activities like paragliding. Evening strolls along Interlaken’s streets are highly recommended.

package_itineraries.title: Jungfraujoch Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Jungfraujoch , the “Top of Europe,” and explore the Ice Palace and Sphinx Observatory. Return to Interlaken in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Interlaken – Bern City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Adventure seekers may try bungee jumping or a helicopter ride. Later, take a train to Bern for a city tour featuring the Rose Garden, Clock Tower, and Bern Cathedral before returning to Interlaken.

package_itineraries.title: Interlaken – Zurich
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Zurich. Visit the Rhine Falls and explore Zurich’s vibrant old streets, markets, and museums.

package_itineraries.title: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Zurich Airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Zurich
package_itineraries.description: On arrival at Zurich Airport, transfer to your hotel. After check-in, enjoy lunch at the hotel’s restaurant and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zurich City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore Zurich’s highlights, starting with the Swiss National Museum , followed by Bahnhofstrasse , one of the world’s most exclusive shopping streets. Walk along Limmatquai in Zurich’s Old Town, admire St. Peter’s Church , and catch a glimpse of the Zurich Opera House . Visit the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology , where Albert Einstein once studied, and ride the Dolderbahn Cogwheel Train to the Zurichberg district. End the day admiring the stained-glass masterpieces at Fraumünster Church .

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Zurich – Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Board a train to Lucerne. After checking in, enjoy the day at your own pace, perhaps exploring the lakeside or wandering the medieval streets.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Mt. Titlis Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Engelberg and take the Titlis Rotair , the world’s first revolving cable car, up to Mt. Titlis at 10,000 feet. Attractions here include the Glacier Cave , Ice Flyer Chairlift , Glacier Park, Adventure Park, souvenir shops, and alpine restaurants offering spectacular views. Return to Lucerne for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Lucerne – Paris
package_itineraries.description: Take a train from Lucerne to Paris. After check-in, begin your Paris sightseeing with a visit to the Louvre Museum , stroll along the Champs-Elysées , shop at Galeries Lafayette , and enjoy an evening cabaret performance at the Lido.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Paris City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore the most iconic landmarks of Paris: Arc de Triomphe , Place de la Concorde , Les Invalides , and the Tuileries Gardens . Ride the elevator to the 2nd level of the Eiffel Tower for panoramic views. In the evening, discover the vibrant Latin Quarter filled with cafés and bookstores.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Disneyland Paris
package_itineraries.description: Spend a magical day at Disneyland Paris . Enjoy thrilling rides, meet Disney characters, and explore the Walt Disney Studios Park with its behind-the-scenes movie secrets.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure from Paris
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival – St. Pierre Cathedral – Conservatory and Botanical Garden – Museum of Art and History
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in Geneva, check in to your hotel before beginning your city exploration. Visit St. Pierre Cathedral , an architectural gem with centuries of history. Continue to the Conservatory and Botanical Garden , spread over 28 hectares with one of the world’s largest herbaria. Later, explore the Museum of Art and History , showcasing over a million exhibits from ancient to modern eras.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Geneva Water Fountain – Flower Clock – Mini Train Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with the iconic Geneva Water Fountain , one of the tallest in the world and a symbol of the city. Next, admire the Flower Clock , a masterpiece of design created from over 6,000 vibrant plants. End your day with a mini-train ride through Geneva’s Old Town, discovering its charming squares and historic landmarks.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and head to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Interlaken and check in to your hotel. Explore Hoheweg, the bustling main street with shops, cafes, and restaurants. End the evening with a lakeside walk and a traditional Swiss dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Full-Day Tour – Jungfraujoch
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a day trip to Jungfraujoch , Europe’s highest railway station. Visit the Ice Palace, Sphinx Observatory, and enjoy panoramic alpine views before returning to Interlaken.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Schynige Platte Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Take the cogwheel train to Schynige Platte for incredible views and the Alpine Garden featuring 600 plant species. Spend the afternoon shopping, visiting the casino, or trying activities like paragliding. Enjoy a farewell Swiss dinner in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zurich – Engelberg
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zurich and travel to Engelberg. After checking in, visit the Benedictine Monastery and enjoy the alpine surroundings. Overnight stay in Engelberg.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Engelberg – Lucerne – Engelberg
package_itineraries.description: Head to Lucerne for a day excursion. Ride the cable car to Mt. Titlis, walk across the iconic Chapel Bridge , see the Water Tower , and explore the charming Old Town. Return to Engelberg for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Engelberg – Basel
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Basel, known for its cultural heritage and thriving art scene. Visit Basel Minster , explore Old Town, and tour museums such as Kunstmuseum Basel or Fondation Beyeler . End the day strolling along the Rhine River. Overnight in Basel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Basel – Zurich – Schaffhausen
package_itineraries.description: Head to Zurich for a city tour including Grossmünster , Fraumünster , and the Swiss National Museum. Continue to Schaffhausen to witness the spectacular Rhine Falls , Europe’s largest waterfall. Return to Zurich for shopping along Bahnhofstrasse and an evening by Lake Zurich.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Zurich
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to Zurich Airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Zurich – Zermatt
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zurich and board the world-famous Glacier Express to Zermatt. The 4-hour ride takes you past gorges, valleys, and snowy peaks. Overnight stay in Zermatt.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Zermatt – Gornergrat – Matterhorn
package_itineraries.description: Take the Gornergrat Railway up to 3,089m, where the panoramic view of the Matterhorn , Switzerland’s iconic mountain, will leave you spellbound. Return to your Zermatt hotel in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Zermatt – St. Moritz
package_itineraries.description: Board the Glacier Express again for a scenic seven-and-a-half-hour journey to St. Moritz, the glamorous alpine resort. Known for its mineral springs and luxurious lifestyle, it is a favorite destination for royals and celebrities. Overnight stay in St. Moritz.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: St. Moritz – Zurich – Rhine Falls
package_itineraries.description: Travel back to Zurich. Spend the day exploring the city’s cultural landmarks before visiting the Rhine Falls , Europe’s largest waterfall. Return to Zurich for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Bahnhofstrasse – Swiss National Museum
package_itineraries.description: Use your Swiss Pass to explore Zurich. Walk along Bahnhofstrasse , one of the world’s premier shopping streets, and later visit the Swiss National Museum , which highlights the nation’s cultural history.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to Zurich Airport, or continue your Swiss journey with the Swiss Pass.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Lucerne – Explore the Old Town
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Lucerne and settle into your hotel. Begin your journey with a visit to the iconic Chapel Bridge (Kapellbrücke) , where flower-decked wooden panels and breathtaking views of the Reuss River set the tone for your trip. Wander through Lucerne’s Old Town (Altstadt) , exploring cobbled alleys, boutique stores, and pastel-colored medieval façades. Admire the Jesuit Church , with its ornate Baroque interiors. Later, enjoy a scenic boat ride on Lake Lucerne , capturing magnificent views of the Swiss Alps. Continue with a visit to the Swiss Museum of Transport , an interactive showcase of Switzerland’s transport and space history. End the evening with a cozy Swiss dinner or a walk along the serene lakeside promenade.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Mount Pilatus Excursion – Lion Monument & Cultural Discovery
package_itineraries.description: Take an unforgettable day trip to Mount Pilatus via cogwheel train, gondola, or cable car. At the summit, soak in panoramic alpine views, explore walking trails, or enjoy traditional Swiss cuisine at mountaintop restaurants. Return to Lucerne and visit the moving Lion Monument (Löwendenkmal) , a powerful sculpture symbolizing Swiss bravery. Explore the Richard Wagner Museum by the lakeside to discover the composer’s legacy. As night falls, immerse yourself in Lucerne’s lively nightlife with music, performances, or relaxed café experiences.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Engelberg & Mount Titlis – Departure from Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Head to Engelberg for an excursion to Mount Titlis , where revolving cable cars, snowy landscapes, and glaciers await. Walk across the Titlis Cliff Walk , Europe’s highest suspension bridge, or enjoy snow sports at Glacier Park. Return to Lucerne and visit the Swiss Museum of Art (Kunstmuseum) , featuring remarkable collections from Swiss masters. Conclude your journey with a traditional Swiss fondue dinner before taking a final stroll through Lucerne’s charming streets, cherishing the city’s magical atmosphere before departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Geneva
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Geneva and check into your luxury hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Geneva City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Tour Geneva’s highlights including the UN headquarters , WHO , and CERN . See the Jet d’Eau Fountain , the Flower Clock , and explore the Old Town on a mini-train and walking tour.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Geneva – Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: Travel by scenic Swiss Rail to Interlaken. Admire views of Lake Geneva and the Alps. After check-in, relax and explore the town at your pace.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Interlaken – Jungfraujoch
package_itineraries.description: Take the cogwheel train to Jungfraujoch , the highest railway station in Europe. Visit the Ice Palace , view the Aletsch Glacier , and admire the Bernese Alps. Overnight in Interlaken.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Interlaken – Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Take the train to Lucerne. After check-in, explore Old Town or shop at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Lucerne – Mt. Titlis
package_itineraries.description: Visit Mt. Titlis via Engelberg and ride the Titlis Rotair . Explore surrounding attractions before returning to Lucerne for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Lucerne – Zurich
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Zurich and explore its highlights including the Swiss National Museum , Lake Zurich , and the Old Town.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Zurich – Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zurich and board a train to Interlaken. After check-in, enjoy leisure time to explore the lakeside promenades and alpine scenery.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Interlaken – Jungfraujoch
package_itineraries.description: Take the cogwheel train to the summit of Jungfraujoch , standing 3,454 meters high. Marvel at the Aletsch Glacier and wander through the Ice Palace before returning to Interlaken.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Interlaken – Mt. Rigi – Zermatt
package_itineraries.description: Begin with an excursion to Mt. Rigi , “Queen of the Mountains.” Ride Europe’s first mountain railway and enjoy views from the summit before descending via cable car. Continue your journey to Zermatt for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Zermatt – Gornergrat – Matterhorn
package_itineraries.description: Board the Gornergrat Railway and ascend to one of Switzerland’s best viewing points. Admire the spectacular Matterhorn and surrounding alpine scenery before heading back to Zermatt.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Zermatt – Rhine Falls – Zurich
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Zermatt to Zurich. After checking in, use your Swiss Pass to visit the majestic Rhine Falls .

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Zurich – Transfer to Interlaken
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Zurich and board a scenic train to Interlaken . After checking into your hotel, take a walk along the Hoheweg promenade , enjoying spectacular mountain views. Shop for authentic Swiss souvenirs, including watches and handcrafted items, before unwinding in your luxury accommodation.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Excursion to Jungfraujoch – Top of Europe
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Interlaken to Jungfraujoch , known as the “Top of Europe.” Ride the Jungfrau Railway to the summit, where panoramic Alpine vistas await. Explore the Ice Palace and enjoy the Alpine Sensation exhibition , immersing yourself in Swiss mountain culture. Return to Interlaken for a relaxed evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Scenic Journey to Zermatt
package_itineraries.description: Board a train through picturesque Swiss countryside to Zermatt , a charming village nestled at the foot of the Matterhorn . Stroll through its car-free streets , visit the Matterhorn Museum , and take in views of the iconic peak. Overnight at a luxury Zermatt hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Panoramic Views from Gornergrat
package_itineraries.description: Take the Gornergrat Bahn cogwheel train to reach one of Switzerland’s most breathtaking viewpoints. From the summit, admire 360° vistas of snow-covered peaks, including the Matterhorn. Spend the afternoon hiking or simply soaking in the alpine atmosphere before returning to Zermatt.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Zermatt to Lucerne
package_itineraries.description: Travel from Zermatt to Lucerne via Brig and Bern . Explore Lucerne’s iconic landmarks such as the Chapel Bridge , Lion Monument , and charming Old Town . End the day with a peaceful Lake Lucerne cruise before retiring to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Adventure at Mount Titlis
package_itineraries.description: From Lucerne, take a day trip to Mount Titlis . Ride the world’s first revolving cable car, the Titlis Rotair , and step into the Ice Palace. Walk across the thrilling Titlis Cliff Walk suspension bridge, or enjoy snow activities like skiing and tubing. Return to Lucerne for a relaxed evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Zurich
package_itineraries.description: Travel back to Zurich and, time permitting, explore highlights like the Bahnhofstrasse shopping district , Lake Zurich , and the charming Old Town before departing from Zurich Airport.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Arrive in Istanbul and check in at your hotel. Spend the afternoon exploring at your own pace. Wander through the lively Grand Bazaar, brimming with colorful stalls and local treasures. In the evening, enjoy a traditional Turkish dinner at a charming restaurant. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel in Turkey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day at the remarkable Basilica Cistern, an underground architectural masterpiece. Discover the Sultanahmet district, home to Istanbul’s most historic sites. Visit the majestic Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, and the grand Topkapi Palace. Continue to the Spice Bazaar, renowned for its fragrant teas, spices, and Turkish sweets. Enjoy a Bosphorus cruise and admire Istanbul’s skyline. End the day with a visit to Dolmabahce Palace, followed by an optional Whirling Dervishes performance.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Explore the vibrant quarter of Beyoglu and the bustling Istiklal Street. Climb Galata Tower for stunning city views. Visit the Istanbul Modern Art Museum to experience contemporary Turkish creativity. Cross Galata Bridge to Karakoy and sample mouthwatering street food. In the evening, immerse yourself in the energetic nightlife of Istanbul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Istanbul – Kusadasi
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and take a domestic flight to Izmir. Upon arrival, continue to the coastal town of Kusadasi. Relax at your hotel or enjoy a walk along the beaches. End the evening with fresh seafood at a local restaurant.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Kusadasi
package_itineraries.description: Take a full-day trip to Ephesus, one of the world’s most impressive Roman archaeological sites. Visit the Library of Celsus, the Great Theater, and the Temple of Artemis. Stop at the House of the Virgin Mary, a spiritual pilgrimage site. Relish an authentic Turkish lunch before returning to Kusadasi for an evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Kusadasi
package_itineraries.description: Spend the morning exploring Kusadasi at your own pace or opt for a guided excursion to Pamukkale. Discover the ruins of Hierapolis including its Necropolis and Basilica. Take a dip in Pamukkale’s famous white travertine pools. Return to Kusadasi for free time in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and travel back to Istanbul for your onward flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Istanbul Ataturk International Airport. Transfer to your hotel and check in. Take some time to relax before strolling through nearby streets and local shops to soak in the atmosphere. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Istanbul City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day guided exploration of Old Istanbul. Highlights include the Blue Mosque (Sultan Ahmed Mosque), Hagia Sophia, and Topkapi Palace. Next, wander through the famous Grand Bazaar—one of the oldest and largest covered markets in the world. Get a glimpse into its hidden alleys and vibrant stalls beyond the tourist hotspots. After lunch, continue to sites such as the Basilica Cistern, Hippodrome, Obelisk of Theodosius, Serpentine Column, Column of Constantine, and the Spice Bazaar. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bosphorus Cruise & Shopping Tour
package_itineraries.description: Start with breakfast before heading out on a Bosphorus Cruise. Glide through the waterway that divides Europe and Asia while admiring landmarks like Dolmabahce Palace, Rumeli Fortress, Ciragan Palace, Yildiz Palace, and Maiden’s Tower. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant and then proceed to Camlica Hill for a sweeping view of the city. In the evening, relax at your hotel or indulge in shopping at Istanbul’s vibrant local markets. Overnight stay at the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Princes’ Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, board a ferry to the Princes’ Islands in the Sea of Marmara. On the way, take in spectacular views of Topkapi Palace, Leander’s Tower, and Uskudar. Explore Büyükada, the largest of the islands, known for its sandy beaches, summer houses, pine forests, and horse-drawn carriages. Spend time cycling through quiet streets, visiting historic mansions, or enjoying water activities. Lunch can be taken at a charming local restaurant. Return to Istanbul by ferry in the late afternoon and enjoy the rest of the evening at leisure. Overnight stay in Istanbul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your final breakfast in Istanbul. Check out from the hotel and, if time permits, do some last-minute sightseeing or shopping. Transfer to Istanbul International Airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Land at Ataturk International Airport and transfer to your hotel. Check in and spend the rest of the day exploring the bustling city independently.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Istanbul Highlights & Bosphorus Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Start the morning with a scenic Bosphorus cruise, taking in magnificent views of Istanbul’s skyline and landmarks. Later, set out on a guided city tour, visiting Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, and the Grand Bazaar. Continue to admire Dolmabahce Palace, Yildiz Palace, and Ciragan Palace before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Princes’ Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, board a ferry to the Princes’ Islands, a collection of nine beautiful isles in the Sea of Marmara. Sail past Uskudar, Leander’s Tower, and Topkapi Palace before stopping at Buyukada Island. Explore by horse-drawn carriage or bicycle, relax on the beaches, and taste fresh seafood. Return to Istanbul in the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Istanbul – Cappadocia
package_itineraries.description: Check out and take a domestic flight to Kayseri. Continue by road to Cappadocia. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy leisure time exploring the surroundings.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Cappadocia Discovery
package_itineraries.description: Start the morning with an optional hot air balloon ride for breathtaking sunrise views. Visit the Goreme Open-Air Museum, famous for its cave churches and frescoes. Explore the valleys of Devrent and Pasabag, known for fairy chimneys and unique rock formations. Discover an underground city such as Kaymakli or Derinkuyu, followed by panoramic views from Uchisar Castle. The day also includes visits to Red Valley, Cavusin Village, Avanos, Pigeons Valley, and other striking sights before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Cappadocia – Istanbul Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast and fly back to Istanbul. Spend any remaining hours shopping or sightseeing before your international departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Istanbul Ataturk Airport and transfer to your hotel. Check in and unwind before exploring the lively neighborhood nearby. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Istanbul City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin a full-day city tour. Visit highlights like the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, and the Grand Bazaar. Optional: Embark on a scenic Bosphorus Cruise for striking views of Istanbul’s skyline. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Free Day in Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at leisure. You may go shopping, explore additional landmarks, or indulge in Istanbul’s renowned food scene. Suggested stops include the Spice Market, Rumeli Fortress, Dolmabahce Palace, and Camlica Hill. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast. Transfer to Istanbul Airport for your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cappadocia
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Kayseri or Nevsehir Airport and transfer to your hotel. Begin with a tour of the Göreme Open-Air Museum, a UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring rock-cut chapels and frescoes. Enjoy stunning viewpoints overlooking Cappadocia’s valleys. In the evening, savor dinner at a local restaurant and experience authentic nightlife with folk dances and belly dancing performances.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Cappadocia Exploration
package_itineraries.description: Optional hot air balloon ride at sunrise for panoramic views (weather permitting). After breakfast, visit Devrent Valley (Imagination Valley) with its animal-shaped formations. Continue to Pasabag to see mushroom-like rocks. Head to Urgup and explore its traditional bazaars and cobbled streets. Discover the vast Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s engineering marvels. Conclude the day with a Turkish dinner and live cultural performances.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Farewell Cappadocia
package_itineraries.description: Take a morning hike through Rose Valley, surrounded by dramatic cliffs and caves. Visit Uchisar Castle, offering panoramic views of the region. Later, explore Ortahisar, known for its historic fortress and authentic atmosphere. In the evening, transfer to the airport for your departure or extend your trip elsewhere in Turkey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Land at Istanbul Ataturk International Airport and transfer to your hotel. After check-in, relax and later take a short walk to nearby markets or attractions. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Istanbul City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off on a guided tour of Old Istanbul. Visit iconic landmarks including the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Topkapi Palace. Explore the world-famous Grand Bazaar, admiring its intricate architecture and discovering its hidden alleys. Post lunch, continue to the Basilica Cistern, Hippodrome, Obelisk of Theodosius, Serpentine Column, Column of Constantine, and the Spice Bazaar. Return to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: More of Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Continue exploring Istanbul with stops at the Spice Market, Rumeli Fortress, Dolmabahce Palace, Camlica Hill, and Bosphorus Bridge. Optional: Take a Bosphorus Cruise for an extraordinary view of the city straddling two continents. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Istanbul to Cappadocia
package_itineraries.description: Check out and fly to Cappadocia. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and settle in. Spend the evening exploring the region, enjoying local cuisine, or attending a cultural performance with folk and belly dancing. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Cappadocia Full-Day Tour
package_itineraries.description: Optional: Begin your morning with a hot air balloon ride for panoramic views. Visit Devrent Valley, Pasabag Valley, Avanos, Goreme Open Air Museum, and the famous fairy chimneys. Explore underground cities like Derinkuyu and stroll through Ihlara Valley. Overnight stay in Cappadocia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before checking out. Transfer to Kayseri or Nevsehir for your return flight to Istanbul International Airport and connect to your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Istanbul Ataturk Airport and transfer to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Istanbul City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Embark on a full-day exploration of Istanbul’s landmarks, including Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, and the Grand Bazaar. Optionally, enjoy a Bosphorus cruise before returning to your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Istanbul Leisure Day
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day exploring on your own. You might visit Dolmabahce Palace, Camlica Hill, Spice Market, or Rumeli Fortress. Sample Turkish cuisine or shop for souvenirs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Flight to Antalya
package_itineraries.description: Fly to Antalya, a jewel on the Mediterranean coast. Transfer to your hotel and relax along the picturesque shoreline.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Antalya Old Town & Perge
package_itineraries.description: Discover Kaleici, Antalya’s charming Old Town with cobblestone streets and historic homes. Visit Perge’s Roman ruins, the Aspendos Theater, and Kursunlu Waterfalls.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Antalya Leisure
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day relaxing on beaches or enjoying water activities. Alternatively, explore sites like Myra Lycian tombs, the Church of St. Nicholas, Kekova Island, and the Sunken City of Simena. Return for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Check out from your hotel and transfer to Istanbul for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Istanbul
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Istanbul Ataturk International Airport. Transfer to your hotel and check in. Spend the remainder of the day exploring Istanbul at your leisure. Overnight stay at a luxury hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Istanbul City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a guided full-day tour of Istanbul’s iconic highlights such as the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Grand Bazaar, Hippodrome, and St. Sophia Museum. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Istanbul Free Day
package_itineraries.description: Continue your Istanbul experience with visits to attractions like the Golden Horn, Rumeli Fortress, Dolmabahce Palace, and Camlica Hill. Take a Bosphorus Cruise to admire the coastline and the historic Bosphorus Bridge. Later, explore at your own pace with visits to the Spice Bazaar, Galata Bridge, or by sampling local delicacies. Overnight stay in Istanbul.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Istanbul to Cappadocia
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to the airport for a domestic flight to Cappadocia. Check into your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day exploring the unique scenery at leisure. Overnight stay in Cappadocia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Cappadocia Highlights
package_itineraries.description: Optional: Begin with a hot air balloon ride for panoramic views (additional cost). Visit the Göreme Open Air Museum, Devrent Valley, and Pasabag Valley. Explore Avanos and see traditional crafts. End the day learning about local culture, including carpet weaving. Overnight stay in Cappadocia.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Cappadocia to Kusadasi
package_itineraries.description: Spend your morning at leisure before transferring to Kayseri Airport for a flight to Izmir. On arrival, travel to Kusadasi and check in to your hotel. Enjoy a relaxing evening by the Aegean coast. Overnight stay in Kusadasi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Kusadasi Tour
package_itineraries.description: Explore the ancient city of Ephesus, visiting the Library of Celsus, Great Theater, and Temple of Artemis. Other highlights include St. Mary’s House, Isabey Mosque, and the Temple of Apollo. Overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Fly back to Istanbul and connect with your onward international flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Antananarivo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Ivato International Airport in Antananarivo, the vibrant capital of Madagascar. Meet your local guide and proceed to your hotel. Spend the remainder of the day relaxing or taking a casual walk to get a feel of the city. Overnight stay in Antananarivo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Antananarivo – Morondava
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Morondava, situated on the island’s western coast. On arrival, check into your hotel and relax for the afternoon. In the evening, head to the legendary Avenue of the Baobabs to enjoy a spectacular sunset and capture the dramatic view of the trees silhouetted against the sky. Explore the local craft market and take a traditional canoe ride to Betania village, where you can witness fishermen at work and admire the mangrove landscapes. Return to Morondava for an overnight stay at a luxury hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Morondava – Kirindy Reserve – Morondava
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set off for a day excursion to the Kirindy Reserve, known for its unique and diverse ecosystem. Admire the majestic baobabs, learn about Sakalava funerary traditions, and discover how the community contributes to protecting biodiversity and preventing deforestation. Go on a guided trek where you may encounter lemurs, fossas, reptiles, colorful bird species, rare freshwater turtles, and a wide variety of endemic plants. Relish a picnic-style lunch at a local restaurant in Kirindy Lodge. In the evening, drive back to Morondava and unwind at your hotel. Overnight stay in Morondava.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Morondava – Antsirabe
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart Morondava for Antsirabe, pausing along the Avenue of the Baobabs to witness the sunrise. The route introduces you to charming villages and gives you a glimpse into local life. Explore Antsirabe, noted for its colonial architecture and history. Check in to your hotel and relax for the evening.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Antsirabe – Antananarivo – Andasibe
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a short city tour of Antsirabe before heading back to Antananarivo for lunch. Continue your drive to Andasibe, a national park renowned for its remarkable biodiversity and lemur species. On arrival, check in to your hotel. Overnight stay in Andasibe.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Andasibe
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out to visit the Analamazaotra Special Reserve, home to the iconic Indri lemurs. Take a guided walk to spot orchids, rare plants, and diverse wildlife, while listening to the distinctive calls of the indri echoing across the forest. Enjoy lunch at Vakona Private Park and spend the rest of the day exploring the surroundings. Overnight stay at a luxury lodge in Andasibe.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Andasibe – Antananarivo
package_itineraries.description: Check out after breakfast and drive back to Antananarivo. On the way, visit the Peryeras Private Reserve, famous for its collection of chameleons, geckos, and reptiles. Depending on your flight schedule, shop for souvenirs at the local markets. Transfer to Ivato International Airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Antananarivo
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Ivato International Airport in Antananarivo, the country’s lively capital. Meet your guide and transfer to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day relaxing and getting familiar with the surroundings.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Antananarivo – Manambato – Ankanin’Ny Nofy
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, drive eastward to Manambato in a private vehicle. Enjoy the scenic journey with views of rice paddies, pine forests, eucalyptus groves, and rural villages belonging to Merina and Bezanozano communities. Stop for lunch at a local restaurant before continuing to Manambato village, located on the Pangalanes Canal. From there, take a boat ride to La Palmarium, an exclusive retreat in Ankanin’Ny Nofy. Check into your hotel for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Ankanin’ Ny Nofy
package_itineraries.description: Ankanin’ Ny Nofy, meaning “Nest of Dreams,” is a haven of unique nature. After breakfast, enjoy a guided walk through its private reserve filled with orchids, palm groves, carnivorous plants, and lemurs roaming freely. Savor a delicious lunch before taking a trip to Andranokoditra to explore the Betsimisaraka village and visit a traditional essential oil factory. Return by boat to your hotel. Later, embark on an evening walk to observe the elusive nocturnal aye-aye lemur. Overnight stay at La Palmarium Hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Ankanin’ Ny Nofy – Manambato – Andasibe
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, return by boat to Manambato and continue by road to Andasibe. Arrive and check into your hotel, followed by lunch at a nearby restaurant. Spend the afternoon at Vakona Private Park, where you can see crocodiles, lemurs, wild ducks, fossas, and other wildlife. In the evening, join a guided night walk to observe nocturnal animals such as lemurs and reptiles. Stay overnight at a luxury hotel in Andasibe.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Andasibe National Park – Antananarivo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head out early to explore Andasibe National Park, home to the indri lemurs. Take a guided trek to discover lemurs, chameleons, and the park’s extraordinary flora. Post lunch, visit Lemur Island, a sanctuary where lemurs live freely. Later, drive back to Antananarivo, stopping at Marozevo Exotic Park to view chameleons, geckos, reptiles, crocodiles, and butterflies. Stay overnight at a hotel in Antananarivo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Antananarivo
package_itineraries.description: On your final day, visit the Pereyras Reptile Reserve, home to a fascinating collection of reptiles, snakes, and chameleons. Transfer to Ivato International Airport for your departure flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Farewell Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before transferring to Taoyuan International Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive in Male
package_itineraries.description: When you arrive in Male, our tour manager will welcome and guide you to the ferry station to catch your speedboat to Hulhumale. If you prefer taking an ocean plane, make sure to inform our tour planners in advance. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day enjoying places around the resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Hulhumale Island Day 1
package_itineraries.description: Hulhumale is a serene island famous for its vistas of the Indian Ocean and amazing marine life. It is also relatively inhabited and has plenty of restaurants serving delectable seafood. After breakfast, you can enjoy some of the water sports activities offered by the resort. These include snorkelling, scuba diving, swimming, and jet skiing. In the evening, you can enjoy a candlelight dinner at the beach. Spend the night in Hulhumale.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Hulhumale Island Day 2
package_itineraries.description: On the second day, you can head out to explore the local markets and restaurants or sign up for one of the many activities offered by the resort. You could enjoy the marine life around the resort, take a private yacht tour, or sign up for a pampering spa session. In the evening, enjoy a pleasant dinner by the beach, as it’s your last night on this island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart Hulhumale
package_itineraries.description: Today, after breakfast, you will check out of the hotel and head to the ferry station to catch your speedboat to Male. While you still have time to catch your flight, we suggest you explore the local attractions in Male, including Sultan Park and Victoria Monument. Catch your flight to return home to India.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive In Male
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to tropical paradise! Upon your arrival at the Male International Airport, you will be welcomed and assisted with a transfer to Addu Atoll. Check in to the South Palm Resort and spend the rest of the morning exploring the resort, its beautiful surroundings, and enjoying the amenities.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Activities
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to Male to explore the city and visit the vibrant local markets. Later in the day, relax at the beach and soak in the spectacular blue waters. You can also take part in various watersport activities available at the resort, with options ranging from complimentary to paid experiences. End the day with a romantic candlelight dinner on the beach.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Exploring the Resort
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy some of the exciting activities offered at the beach. Experience an underwater walk to witness the rich marine life, followed by a boat ride where you can spot dolphins, manta rays, and other exotic sea creatures in their natural environment.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart Male
package_itineraries.description: Today, check out of the hotel and take a ferry back to Male. From there, proceed to the international airport to catch your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Male
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at the Male International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Biyadhoo Island Resort on a speedboat. Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring the beautiful island and its amenities. End the evening with a candlelight dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Male
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, spend the rest of the day exploring Male. You will check out the markets, shop for memorabilia, and visit some of the Maldives’ famous monuments. Later, you will visit the beach and enjoy watersports like diving, snorkelling, and scuba diving.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Exploring the Marine Life
package_itineraries.description: Today, you will have plenty of activities to cover. You could either go on an underwater walk or enjoy a boat ride to view the dolphins. Return to the resort for a sumptuous dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Island Hopping
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day island hopping to enjoy activities offered by the resort. Or, you could lie down by the beach to soak in the views or dip in the pool. Get back to the hotel for a delicious dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Depart Maldives
package_itineraries.description: Today, you will check out of the resort and proceed to Male Airport to catch your flight to return home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive in Maldives
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at the Velana International Airport in Male, our tour manager will guide you to the ferry terminal to catch your speedboat and take you to Maafushi Island. The journey takes around 45 minutes and offers a panoramic view of the beautiful islands along the route. Check into the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring places around the resort. You can also enjoy a candlelight dinner on the beach.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Maafushi Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: Maafushi is Maldives’s most popular island, with plenty of world-class resorts offering a range of adventure activities, including water sports like snorkelling, scuba diving, swimming, dolphin safaris, and catamaran riding. You can also enjoy the local culture, shop at the local market and dine at a local restaurant. Spend the night in Maafushi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Maafushi Island Tour Day 2
package_itineraries.description: Today, you can continue with your adventure activities. You can either sign up for snorkelling with manta rays or go dolphin watching. Or you can rent a private boat to enjoy the tiny islands around Maafushi.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart Maafushi
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to the ferry terminal to return to Male. In the capital city of the Maldives, you can explore the many tourist attractions, including Sultan Park, the Artificial Beach, Rasfannu, and the Victory Monument. Later, catch your return flight to India.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive at Maldives – Snorkelling - Vaadhoo Island
package_itineraries.description: Once you reach Maldives, you will be transferred to your hotel. After you have freshened up, begin your trip with water sports and activities. Lose yourself in the beauty of the underwater world through snorkelling. You can also inform the tour guide if you wish to try other things such as surfing. In the evening, you can head to Vaadhoo Island to witness the Glowing Beach's magic before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Male - Dolphin Watching
package_itineraries.description: The second day of your beachy holiday starts with exploring the capital of Maldives, Male. Travel to famous spots such as the Male Fish Market, the Old Friday Mosque, and the National Museum. You will then be taken to Cinnamon Hakurra later in the day, where you can see some adorable dolphins playing around in their natural habitat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Island Hopping - Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: The island of Maldives is filled with wonderful nature, which is why the third day of your trip is about exploring it in all its beauty. Meet the locals and interact with them to learn about life in the Maldives. Browse the local shops to get jewellery and souvenirs for yourself and your loved ones. In the evening, you will embark on the sunset cruise to enjoy the mesmerizing views and a scrumptious dinner. Get back to your hotel after the cruise and indulge in hours of rest and sleep.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart from Maldives
package_itineraries.description: Get ready to check out from the hotel and head to the airport to catch your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Male
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at the Male International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to the Meeru Island Resort via speedboat. Check in to the hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the surroundings and enjoying the resort's amenities. Spend the evening enjoying a candlelight dinner by the beach.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Activities
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast, head out to enjoy the activities offered at the resort. Some are paid, and others are complimentary. You can go jet skiing, windsurfing, snorkelling, scuba diving, and banana boat riding. You could play beach volleyball or basketball or explore the island on foot. Check out the local markets to buy souvenirs for friends and family.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Explore the Resort
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head out for a breathtaking underwater walk where you can watch the marine animals up close. Later, enjoy a boat ride to watch the dolphins in their natural habitat.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Male
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Male to catch the return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive at Maldives – Island Hopping - Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Once you reach Maldives, you will be transferred to your hotel by our tour representative. After reaching the gorgeous Coco Bodhu Hithi Resort, you will get ample time to freshen up before beginning the first round of sightseeing. Maldives is a stunning island offering a mesmerizing view to tourists from all over the world. You can buy souvenirs or jewelry at the resort's handicraft store. You can also meet the locals and interact with them to learn more about local life. In the evening, get ready to experience the beautiful golden hues on the sunset cruise. You can take in the island's serenity and enjoy a delicious dinner before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Snorkelling - Vaadhoo Island
package_itineraries.description: What's a trip to the Maldives without indulging in thrilling water-based activities? Immerse yourself in the endless beauty of the underwater world through snorkeling. Post this exciting adventure, you can head to Vaadhoo Island, where the magic of the Glowing Beach is sure to win you over.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Male - Dolphin Watching
