package_itineraries.description: The third day of your Maldives trip begins by exploring Male, the capital of Maldives. Spend the morning and afternoon exploring famous sites such as the Male Fish Market, considered the heart of the city, and the oldest mosque in the Maldives, known as the Old Friday Mosque. If you want to learn more about the history of Maldives, pay a visit to the National Museum. Later in the day, you will be taken to Cinnamon Hakurra, where you can see some adorable dolphins being playful, before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart from Maldives
package_itineraries.description: Get ready to check out from the hotel and head to the airport to catch your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive at Maldives - Fishing – Parasailing
package_itineraries.description: Once you reach Maldives, you will be transferred to the hotel. After reaching the stunning Cocoon Maldives hotel, you will get ample time to freshen up before beginning the first day of your beachy holiday. Fishing is a very popular water sport in the Maldives, and it’s how you will initiate your touristy activities. Indulge in some morning fishing where you can spot fishes such as yellowfin tuna, wahoo, marlin, and swordfish. After spending some moments with the colourful fishes, it’s time to ready yourself for the thrill of parasailing. Fly high in the air and get an aerial view of the island.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Whale Shark Sighting – Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: The second day of your tour will begin with a whale shark sighting. You will be taken to the South Ari Atoll Marine Protected Area, the best spot to see whale sharks. During the evening, you will enjoy the Sunset Cruise, wherein you can breathe in the gorgeous views all around you while also relishing a scrumptious dinner before returning to the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Exploring Male
package_itineraries.description: Male is the stunning capital of Maldives, and you can begin your third day by hopping to the heart of the city, the Male Fish Market. Learn about the history of Maldives at the National Museum before going to the oldest mosque in Maldives, the Old Friday Mosque. You can walk around the resort at the nearby beaches during the evening and relish a few relaxing moments.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Island Hopping - Vaadhoo Island
package_itineraries.description: The island of Maldives offers mesmerizing views for its tourists to remember forever. Meet the locals and interact with them. Visit the handicraft stores for souvenirs or jewellery for yourself and your loved ones. In the evening, head to Vaadhoo Island, where the magic of the Glowing Beach will win you over.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Depart from Maldives
package_itineraries.description: Get ready to check out from the hotel and head to the airport to catch your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Activities

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Explore The Resort
package_itineraries.description: After a hearty breakfast buffet, enjoy the resort's amenities. You can start with an underwater walk and later go for a boat ride to watch dolphins and other animals in their natural habitat. Spend the rest of the day with activities – some of which are free and some paid for.

package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival in the Maldives, you will be welcomed by a tour representative and transferred to the beautiful Coco Palm Bodu Hithi Resort by speedboat. After freshening up, begin your Maldivian holiday with fishing, one of the most popular water sports. Early mornings are the perfect time to spot fascinating species such as yellowfin tuna, wahoo, marlin, and swordfish. Once fishing is done, get ready for the thrill of parasailing. No trip to the Maldives is complete without experiencing adventurous water-based activities.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Whale Shark Sighting – Sunset Cruise
package_itineraries.description: The second day starts with a whale shark sighting, a memory that will stay with you forever. You will be taken to the South Ari Atoll Marine Protected Area, considered the best destination to witness whale sharks in their natural habitat. In the evening, enjoy a scenic sunset cruise, soaking in the spectacular views while savoring a delightful dinner before heading back to the resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Exploring Male
package_itineraries.description: On the third day, discover Male, the charming capital of Maldives. Begin your tour at the lively Male Fish Market in the city center. Continue by learning about Maldivian history at the National Museum, followed by a visit to the Old Friday Mosque, the oldest mosque in the country. Later in the evening, you can take a relaxing stroll along the resort beaches and unwind.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart from Maldives
package_itineraries.description: On the final day, check out from the hotel and proceed to the airport for your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Male
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at the Male International Airport, you will be welcomed and assisted in transferring to the Biyadhoo Island Resort via speedboat. Complete check-in formalities and spend the rest of the day exploring the resort's surroundings and amenities. Spend the night in the resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Water Activities
package_itineraries.description: Start your day with a sumptuous breakfast. Later, you can explore the clear blue waters and partake in some watersport activities like jet skiing, banana boat riding, snorkelling, and scuba diving. In the evening, you can enjoy a candlelight dinner by the beach.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Dolphin Watching
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you can enjoy an underwater walk to catch the beautiful fishes and corals or swim with the manta rays and reef sharks. Or, you could lie by the beach enjoying the uninterrupted view of the Indian Ocean. Later, head to Male to explore its local markets, buy souvenirs, or visit the country’s top monuments.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Male
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and proceed to Male Airport to catch your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Bratislava
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at M. R. Štefánik Airport, where you will be transferred to your hotel for check-in. Once settled, you are free to spend the remainder of the day exploring at your own pace or relaxing. Overnight stay in Bratislava.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Explore Bratislava Castle and City Highlights
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided tour of the iconic Bratislava Castle, perched above the Old Town, originally styled in the Renaissance era during the 17th century. Continue to the striking Blue Church with its pastel tones and ornate detailing, followed by visits to the Presidential Palace, UFO Bridge with Observation Deck, and the Slovak National Theatre. Conclude your day with a delightful vineyard experience, tasting traditional Slovak wines infused with ginger and honey. Overnight stay in Bratislava.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Departure from Bratislava
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your breakfast at the hotel before checking out. You will then be assisted with your onward journey, whether flying home or continuing on your Europe tour package adventure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive in Sri Lanka
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at the Colombo International Airport, our tour representative will welcome and guide you to the hotel. After a well-deserved rest, proceed to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can spend time with abandoned elephants. The orphanage was started in 1975 to care for wounded and abandoned elephants. You can work with local volunteers feeding and bathing the elephants. Check into a luxury hotel in Dambulla to spend the night in the city.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Dambulla – Sigiriya
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to explore Sigiriya, one of Sri Lanka’s most iconic monuments, often called the Eight Wonders of the World. Tourists visit the place to explore the Sigiriya Fortress, built by King Kashyapa during the 5th century. The fortress is built on a monolithic rock–visitors must climb 1200 steps to reach the citadel. Besides exploring the fortress and its gardens, tourists also visit the museum to learn more about artefacts and videos related to Sigiriya. The frescoes of life-sized damsels, still preserved at the fort, are equally famous. After exploring Sigiriya, return to Dambulla. Spend the night in Dambulla.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Dambulla – Kandy
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and head to Kandy. On the way, visit the National Spice Gardens in Matale to see the different spices and learn about their culinary and medicinal uses. You can sign up for Ayurvedic treatments, purchase spices, and even join a culinary lesson to learn more about spices and their uses. Some other places you will visit in and around Kandy include Upper Lake Drive, Gem Museum, Market Square, and the most famous of all, the Temple of Tooth Relic. If you’re lucky, you could experience the Kandy Perahara firsthand. This annual 9-day festival culminates in a parade where the tooth relic of Buddha is carried on an elephant in a procession along with cultural dance and song. Spend the night in Kandy.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Kandy
package_itineraries.description: Today, you will explore places in and around Kandy. This includes the Royal Botanical Gardens, the Kandy Lake, the Bahirawakanda Temple, and the Ceylon Tea Museum. The Royal Botanical Garden was established in 1821 and includes over 147 acres of plants, including orchids, spices, medicinal plants, and palm trees. The garden was believed to have been established since 1371 when King Wickramaabahu III.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Kandy – Bentota
package_itineraries.description: Today, after breakfast, head to Bentota. You can either visit directly or stop at Kithulgala, a small town famous for its water sports activities, including whitewater rafting and abseiling. Some of the other attractions in Kithugala include Belilena Caves and Handun Ella. The Belilena Cave is a famous cave believed to have been inhabited over 32,000 years ago, while Handun Ella is famous for its waterfalls. The place gets its name from the Handun or sandalwood trees that grow abundantly around it.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6 : Bentota
package_itineraries.description: Today, you can spend the day leisurely exploring places around the town or opt for a ride on the Madu River in the 915-hectare Madu Ganga Estuary. The wetland covers 64 islands, including Madagaga, the third Ramsar Wetland. Another popular attraction in Madu Ganga is the Kokaduwa Vihariya. The main treasure of Madu Ganga is the mangroves that protect various plant and animal life, including crocodiles, crabs, and various fish. You can also visit the Marine Turtle Conservation in Kosgoda, which houses endangered marine turtle species. There, you can observe the turtles nesting and hatchlings being born. Spend the night in Bentota.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7 : Depart Bentota
package_itineraries.description: Bid adieu to Sri Lanka as you check out of the hotel and head to the Colombo International Airport to catch your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrival in Colombo
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at the Colombo International Airport, our tour manager will welcome and guide you to the hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and spend some time relaxing in the hotel. Later, head to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage to spend quality time with the elephants. The Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage was opened in 1975 to provide shelter to baby elephants abandoned by poaching, hunting, or deforestation. Visitors can learn firsthand how the centre cares for these animals and enjoy watching them bathe in the nearby river. You can also feed the elephants if you visit them during their feeding time, which is from 9.15 a.m. to 9.45 a.m. and from 14.15 p.m. to 14.45 p.m. Later, head to Kandy, which is about two hours from Pinnawala. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the area. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Kandy.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Kandy City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head out to explore Kandy City. This medieval city has several cultural and historical attractions, including the Temple of the Tooth Relic, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Begin your Kandy city tour with a visit to the Sri Dalada Maligawa, or the Temple of the Tooth Relic, which is believed to hold a tooth of the Buddha. Every year, Buddhists celebrate the Kandy Esala Perahara, an annual procession in which the sacred tooth is paraded on a majestic elephant adorned with a majestic golden casket. Other attractions in Kandy include the Royal Botanical Gardens, the Bahirawakanda Temple, Kandy Lake, and the Ceylon Tea Museum. The Royal Botanical Garden was founded in 1371 and was once only allowed to royalty. The garden has thousands of flora and fauna, including orchids, bamboo, weeping figs, and an extensive spice garden. The Botanical Garden is also home to the exclusive coco de mer, the world’s largest seed, popularly called double coconut. Spend the night in Kandy.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Kandy – Colombo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Colombo. The drive takes around 4 hours and is very scenic. Check into your Colombo hotel to spend the rest of the evening at leisure. Some attractions you will visit in the capital city include the Viharamadevi Temple, Kelaniya Raja Maha Vihariya, and the Cathedral of St Lucia. Don’t miss the Pettah market to shop for unique souvenirs, including handcrafted masks, porcelain tableware, Ceylon tea, and the BMICH to see the replica of the Avukana Budda statue. Spend the night at a Colombo hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Colombo Day Two
package_itineraries.description: Today, after breakfast, you will spend the day shopping at the many street markets and malls in Colombo. You can buy gemstones, Ceylon tea, spices, wooden masks, handloom textiles, and even saris in Sri Lanka. Some of the best places for shopping include Pettah Market, Galle Face Green Fair, Liberty Plaza, and the Arcade Independence Square.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Depart Colombo
package_itineraries.description: Bid adieu to Sri Lanka as you check out of the hotel and head to the Colombo International Airport to catch your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Colombo
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at the Colombo International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and help you transfer to the hotel. You will travel by car to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage in Kegalle. The journey takes around 3 hours and is the perfect way to experience rural Sri Lanka. The Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage was established in 1975 by the Sri Lanka Wildlife Department to protect and care for orphaned elephants. The orphanage hosts over 93 elephants, including baby elephants. Tourists can feed and bathe the animals and take pictures with them. Spend the night at a Dambulla luxury resort.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Dambulla – Sigiriya Rock Fortress – Dambulla
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, you will head out to visit the Dambulla cave temples. The Golden Rock Temple in Dambulla is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the largest, well-preserved cave temples in Sri Lanka. You will then visit Sigiriya Rock Fortress, another UNESCO World Heritage Site. The place is famous for its palace ruins, built on a 200-metre rock. An extensive network of gardens, water reservoirs, and other attractions surrounds the fortress. Besides exploring the fortress, you will visit the Sigiriya Museum and the Pidurangala Rock, famous for its reclining Buddha statue. Don’t miss the Minneriya National Park, renowned for the herds of elephants that visit the park for food and water. Spend the night at Dambulla.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Dambulla – Kandy
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Kandy, Sri Lanka’s last royal capital. Kandy is famous for the Temple of the Tooth, which gets its name from the canine tooth believed to be of Gautama Buddha, which is enshrined here. The temple hosts the annual Esala Perahara, a procession to honour the sacred tooth and pay homage to the old gods of Sri Lanka. In addition to the Sri Dalada Maligawa Temple, you will visit Kandy Lake, the Ceylon Tea Museum, Sri Lankathilake Rajamaha Viharaya, and the Udawatta Kele Sanctuary. In the evening, you will be treated to a colourful show, during which you can witness a mind-blowing Sri Lankan cultural extravaganza, including drumbeats and acrobatics. Spend the night in Kandy.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Kandy – Nuwara Eliya
package_itineraries.description: Today, you will explore places around Kandy, beginning with Nuwara Eliya. This is the highest town in Sri Lanka and is called Little England. It was the favourite retreat of the British officers who loved the cool and clean air. The place is now famous for its colonial buildings, tea plantations, and the spectacular Horton Plains National Park. You will also visit the Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya. The garden is famous for its tropical trees and plants, including the cannonball fruit tree, the 40 m-high Burma bamboo, and the Javan fig tree. The garden is also known for its extensive collection of orchids. Other attractions in Nuwara Eliya include the Seetha Amman temple, Horton Plains National Park, and the Nuwara Eliya Central Market. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Nuwara Eliya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Nuwara Eliya – Colombo
package_itineraries.description: Today, check out of your hotel and proceed to Colombo. The journey takes around 5 hours and gives you a glimpse of the beautiful landscape. On the way, you can even stop by to check out other popular attractions like St Mary’s Church and the Dutch Canal. Check into your Colombo hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later, head out for a tour of the city. You will visit some of the city’s commercial areas and tree-lined residential streets like Cinnamon Gardens. Some other tourist attractions include Fort Area, Sea Street in Pettah, the Bazaar Area, and the Dutch Church of Wolfendhal. Don’t miss the replica of the Avukana Buddha Statue kept at the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall and the Independence Square. If you plan to shop, you must visit ODEL, House of Fashion, Arcade Independence Square, Race Course, and Beverly Street. The Pettah Market is a great place to bargain. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Colombo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Depart Colombo
package_itineraries.description: Check out of the hotel and head to the airport, as your Sri Lanka trip package ends.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive In Colombo
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to Ceylon! Upon arriving at the Bandaranaike International Airport, our tour manager will guide you to the hotel and help you with transfer formalities. After a few hours of rest, you can either head to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage or go directly to Kandy. The Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage was established in 1975 to help abandoned elephants. Visitors can spend time with the elephants in the sanctuary, feeding them, helping them bathe, and watching them as they go about their daily lives. Kandy is Sri Lanka’s last capital, which fell into the British Empire. It is home to the Temple of the Tooth, which is believed to house the tooth of Lord Buddha. Sri Lankans celebrate Esala Perahara, an annual festival where the tooth is paraded through the streets on the back of an elephant. It is also home to beautiful tea estates and the Knuckles Mountain Range, which is listed in the UNESCO Natural World Heritage list. Check into a luxury hotel to spend the night in Kandy.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Kandy – Nuwara Eliya
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, proceed to Nuwara Eliya, a lush and green city surrounded by tea estates, waterfalls, and lakes. It is believed that Nuwara Eliya was Ravana's capital and that Sita was kept captive in Sita Eliya. You will visit the Ramboda Falls, Sri Baktha Hanuman Temple, Hakgala Botanical Garden, Devon Falls, and the Horton Plains National Park. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Nuwara Eliya.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Nuwara Eliya - Colombo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and proceed to Colombo. It is Sri Lanka’s cultural and judicial capital. You will visit Lotus Tower, the National Museum of Colombo, the Sri Lanka Planetarium, Viharamahadevi Park, Gangaramaya Temple, and the Pettah Floating Market. Enjoy shopping at the Arcade Independence Square and the Pettah Market in the evening to buy spices, tea, traditional masks, antiques, gems, and batik items. Spend the night at a luxury hotel in Colombo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart Colombo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to the Colombo International Airport to catch your return flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Colombo - Kandy
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at the Colombo International Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Kandy, Sri Lanka’s second-largest city. Kandy was the last capital city of the Sinhalese royal family and is famous for its colonial architecture and ancient temples. Check into the hotel and spend some time exploring places around the neighbourhood.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Kandy City Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to the Temple of the Tooth Relic, a UNESCO World Heritage site famous for hosting the Buddha's canine tooth. The tooth is taken on a procession yearly as part of the Perahara, a 10-day annual festival. Some of the other places you will visit include the Royal Botanical Garden, the Kandy Lake, and the Ceylon Tea Museum. Spend the night in Kandy.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Kandy - Colombo
package_itineraries.description: After a leisurely breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Colombo. You will explore major tourist attractions in Sri Lanka’s capital city, including the Colombo Museum, the Gangaramaya Temple, and the Viharamahadevi Temple. Spend the evening shopping at the local markets before returning to the hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart Colombo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and complete your shopping expedition. Later, drive to the airport to continue with your return journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Sri Lanka – Kandy
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representatives, who will help you transfer to the city of Kandy. After reaching your hotel and completing the check-in formalities, you can freshen up and relax for a while. Once you feel well-rested, head out to explore the beautiful spots in Kandy. Witness the beauty of the Royal Botanic Gardens, which is home to over 4000 species of plants and a wide collection of orchids. Make your way to Sri Dalada Maligawa, also known as Temple of the Tooth, as it houses the relic of the tooth of Lord Buddha. Spend the night at your hotel in Kandy.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kandy - Nuwara Eliya
package_itineraries.description: After enjoying a delicious breakfast, leave Kandy to head towards Nuwara Eliya. Known as the Little England of Sri Lanka, Nuwara Eliya is filled with red bricked buildings and fairy tale cottages, giving the city a magical vibe. Head out for some sightseeing in Nuwara Eliya after the check-in formalities are complete at your hotel. Pay your respects at the Shri Bhakta Hanuman Temple, which was built by the Chinmaya Mission of Sri Lanka. Visit a tea factory before making your way to the Seetha Amman Temple and Horton Plains National Park.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Nuwara Eliya – Colombo
package_itineraries.description: On this day, have a filling breakfast and leave for Colombo from Nuwara Eliya. The capital city of Sri Lanka is brimming with temples and colonial buildings, all of which you will see along with its residential areas. Make sure to visit the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall, a convention centre that hosts a variety of important events.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Sri Lanka
package_itineraries.description: Check out of your hotel after having your breakfast. Make your way to the airport to board your flight back home, carrying a bunch of wonderful memories.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Arrive In Bentota
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at the Bandaranaike International Airport in Colombo, our tour manager will welcome you and guide you to Bentota. Check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day enjoying the places in and around it. Spend the night in Bentota.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Bentota City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Bentota is a resort town famous for its picturesque landscape and cultural attractions. Some of the attractions you will visit in Bentota include the Kande Viharaya Temple, Ventura Beach, and the Polgampola Waterfalls. Later, you will check out of the hotel and head to Colombo. Spend the night in Colombo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Colombo City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Sri Lanka’s capital city, Colombo, has a rich cultural heritage and is a melting pot of different cultures. Some of the attractions you will cover include the Gangaramaya Temple, Viharamahadevi Park, and the Kelaniya Raja Maha Viharaya. Don’t miss shopping at one of the many flea markets where you can buy spices, tea, handicrafts, Ayurveda products, and Batik wear. Spend the night in Colombo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Depart Colombo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to the airport to catch your flight to India.

package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel in Kandy. Complete the check-in formalities and relax for a while after freshening up. Next, go to the Temple of the Tooth Relic, also known as Sri Dalada Maligawa, which has the relic of the tooth of Lord Buddha.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Kandy - Bentota
package_itineraries.description: Relish a scrumptious breakfast in the morning, and then head for Bentota. Upon reaching the hotel and completing the check-in formalities, leave to enjoy a bunch of adventurous activities, such as parasailing, windsurfing, jet skiing, banana boating, and kitesurfing. Spend the night at your hotel in Bentota.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Bentota - Colombo
package_itineraries.description: During the day, leave for Colombo from Bentota. Colombo is the capital of Sri Lanka and also its largest city. On this day, explore the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall (BMICH), which is a convention centre built in honour of Solomon West Ridgeway Dias Bandaranaike.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Depart Sri Lanka
package_itineraries.description: After having a filling breakfast, check out of your hotel and leave for the airport to board your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1 : Colombo - Kandy
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at the Colombo International Airport, our tour manager will welcome and guide you to Kandy, Sri Lanka’s second-largest city. The journey takes around 3.5 hours and is absolutely mesmerising. On the way, you’ll visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can catch orphaned elephants enjoying their time bathing and feeding. Check into the hotel and spend the night in Kandy.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2 : Kandy - Bentota
package_itineraries.description: Kandy is famous for its monasteries, Buddhist temples, and verdant forests. After breakfast, you’ll head out to explore some of Kandy’s top attractions, including the Temple of the Tooth Relic, the Kandy Lake, and the Royal Botanic Gardens. Later in the day, you will proceed to Bentota, a resort town on the southwest coast of Sri Lanka. The journey takes around 4.5 hours and is absolutely scenic. Check into the hotel and spend the night in Bentota.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3 : Bentota Tour
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast buffet amidst the calming ocean waters. Later, explore the city’s top attractions, including the Kande Vihara Temple, Turtle Farm, and the Galle Dutch Fort. You can also sign up for water activities like scuba diving, banana boat riding, and parasailing. Spend the night in Bentota.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4 : Bentota - Colombo
package_itineraries.description: Today, after breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Colombo. You will visit some beautiful places like Waduwwa Beach and the Udawalawe National Park on the way. Check into a hotel and relax before exploring Sri Lanka’s capital city. You will visit the Gangaramaya Temple, Viharamahadevi Temple, Kelaniya Raja Maha Vihara, and the Cathedral of St Lucia. End the day shopping at one of the local markets. Spend the night in Colombo.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5 : Depart Colombo
package_itineraries.description: Begin your day with a hearty breakfast buffet before checking out of the hotel to head for souvenir shopping. Later in the day, you will be driven to the airport to return home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrive in Colombo
package_itineraries.description: Upon your arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Complete the check-in formalities and relax for a while before venturing out to explore Colombo. You will be taken to visit the colonial buildings, temples, and residential areas in the city. Make your way to the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall, a convention centre that hosts several events and conferences.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Colombo City Tour
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast and spend the day at leisure. Head out later in the day to shop at spots like House of Fashion, Majestic City, Odel, and Noritake Factory Store. You can also visit Sea Street and shop for some jewellery. Get back to the hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Depart Colombo
package_itineraries.description: After having a filling breakfast, leave for the airport to board your flight back home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Amman - Your Jordanian Adventure Begins
package_itineraries.description: Welcome to the enchanting land of Jordan! Upon arrival at Amman Airport, you will be warmly greeted by a representative who will assist you with visa formalities and airport procedures. Afterward, you’ll be transferred to your comfortable hotel for check-in. The evening is free for you to relax, refresh, and get accustomed to the local ambiance. Overnight stay at a hotel in Amman.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Amman, Jerash, and the Dead Sea
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast before heading on a journey to Jerash, one of the world’s best-preserved Roman provincial cities. Just an hour’s drive from Amman, this site is a remarkable treasure. Continue your adventure with a trip to the Dead Sea, where you’ll have 2–3 hours to float in its mineral-rich waters—an unmatched experience of relaxation and rejuvenation. Later, return to Amman for your overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Amman to Petra - Exploring Ancient Treasures
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart for Petra, stopping en route at historical landmarks. First, visit Mount Nebo, a revered religious site (note: the church is closed for renovation). Then, head to Madaba to admire the famous Saint George Church with its ancient mosaics. Next, explore Shobak Castle, an impressive medieval fortress. Continue south to Petra and check into your hotel for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Petra - A Day in the Ancient City
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, embark on a tour of Petra, a UNESCO World Heritage site and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World. Walk through the Siq, marvel at the Treasury, and explore the tombs, temples, and colonnaded streets of this rock-hewn city. After your exploration, return to your hotel in Petra for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Exploring Petra, Wadi Rum, and Heading to Amman
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with breakfast and set off toward Wadi Rum, Jordan’s iconic desert landscape. Experience the wonders of this rugged terrain on a thrilling 4x4 ride or take time to admire the scenery on your own. Optionally, spend time at a Bedouin camp for an authentic desert encounter. In the evening, continue to Amman for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Farewell to Amman
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy your final breakfast in Jordan before checking out. You will be transferred to Amman Airport to catch your flight home, bringing your unforgettable journey to an end.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Amman, Jordan
package_itineraries.description: Your journey begins upon arrival at Amman International Airport. A representative will warmly welcome you and provide assistance with visa procedures. You will then be transferred to your hotel, where you can check in and relax after your flight. The rest of the evening is at leisure, giving you time to settle in and prepare for your adventure. Overnight stay at your luxury hotel in Amman.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Visit Petra - The Rose Red City
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart for Petra, one of the world’s greatest archaeological treasures and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Walk through the narrow Siq to witness the iconic Treasury and marvel at the intricate carvings and tombs. Spend the day exploring at your pace before returning via the Desert Highway to Amman. Overnight stay in Amman.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Excursion to Jerash and Return to Amman
package_itineraries.description: Start the morning with breakfast and travel north to Jerash, one of the best-preserved Greco-Roman cities in the world. Explore colonnaded streets, amphitheatres, temples, and plazas that narrate tales from the Roman era. After this immersive journey through history, return to Amman for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Amman City Tour and Dead Sea Experience
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided city tour of Amman. Visit the Citadel, Archaeological Museum, Roman Amphitheatre, and Folklore Museum, learning about Jordan’s heritage and culture. Later, continue to the Dead Sea, the lowest point on Earth. Float in its mineral-rich waters or simply relax along the shoreline. Return to Amman for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Amman
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before checking out. You will then be transferred to Amman Airport for your onward journey, carrying unforgettable memories of your Jordan luxury tour package .

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Welcome to Jordan - Arrival in Amman
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Amman Airport, where you’ll be greeted and assisted with visa procedures. Afterward, transfer to your hotel for check-in. Spend the evening relaxing or exploring Amman at your leisure. Overnight stay in Amman.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Amman, Madaba, and Mount Nebo en route to Petra
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel south towards Petra. En route, visit Mount Nebo, believed to be the resting place of Moses, featuring a Byzantine church that later grew into a large religious site. Then, stop at Madaba to see the Saint George Church with its renowned Mosaic Map of Jerusalem. Continue onward to Petra, where you’ll stay overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Discovering Petra’s Marvels
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore Petra, the Red Rose City carved into sandstone cliffs. Admire the Treasury, Roman-style amphitheatre, colonnaded streets, temples, and the majestic Ad-Deir Monastery, accessible by 800 carved steps. This UNESCO World Heritage site offers a fascinating glimpse into Nabataean history. Return to your hotel in Petra for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: From Petra to the Mystical Wadi Rum
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, journey to Wadi Rum, a stunning desert landscape described by T.E. Lawrence as “vast, echoing, and god-like.” Towering rock formations, ancient drawings, and serene hiking trails await. End the day at a desert camp with dinner under the starry sky, creating unforgettable memories.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: From Wadi Rum to the Tranquil Dead Sea
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to the Dead Sea, the lowest point on Earth at 410 meters below sea level. Experience the buoyancy of its salt-rich waters and the healing qualities of its 21 minerals, 12 of which are unique to the Dead Sea. Stay overnight at a hotel on the Dead Sea coast.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Farewell to the Dead Sea, Hello Amman
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast, then check out and transfer to Amman Airport for your flight home. Your journey ends with wonderful memories of Jordan.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Amman
package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Amman Airport, you will be greeted by your representative who will assist with visa procedures. Transfer to your hotel, check in, and enjoy the evening at leisure. Overnight stay in Amman.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Amman City Tour and Jerash Excursion
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, explore the highlights of Amman, including the Citadel, Museum, Roman Amphitheatre, and Folklore Museum. Later, travel to Jerash, a Roman archaeological masterpiece, where colonnaded streets and temples bring ancient history alive. Return to Amman for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Journey from Amman to Petra via Mount Nebo and Madaba
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel south, stopping at Mount Nebo for panoramic views of the Holy Land. Continue to Madaba to admire the famous mosaics at St. George’s Church. Later, visit Shobak Castle before reaching Petra. Overnight stay in Petra.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Exploring Petra - World Heritage Site
package_itineraries.description: Fuel up with breakfast before exploring Petra, the Nabatean city carved into rose-red cliffs. Walk through the Siq, marvel at the Treasury, temples, and rock-cut tombs. Spend the day at leisure discovering Petra’s marvels. Overnight stay in Petra.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Petra to Wadi Rum and Return to Amman
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, depart for Wadi Rum, also called the Valley of the Moon. Explore its vast desert landscapes, with an option for a jeep tour. Later, return to Amman for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Dead Sea Excursion
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, head to the Dead Sea. Float in its therapeutic waters or relax along its unique shores. Return to Amman in the evening for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure from Amman
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and transfer to Amman Airport for your departure, completing your enriching Amman holiday package journey.

package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Amman Airport, where you’ll be greeted and assisted with visa formalities. Transfer to your hotel for check-in. The evening is free for leisure. Overnight stay in Amman.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Exploring Desert Castles and the Dead Sea
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Jordan’s Desert Castles: Al Kharraneh, Amra (a UNESCO site), and Al Azraq, once home to Lawrence of Arabia. Continue to the Dead Sea, the lowest point on Earth, to float in its salty waters. Return to Amman for the night.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Exploring Amman, Jerash, and Ajloun
package_itineraries.description: Start the day with a panoramic city tour of Amman. Next, explore Jerash, an ancient Roman city filled with theatres, temples, and colonnaded streets. package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Journey from Amman to Petra via Madaba, Mount Nebo, and Little Petra
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Madaba to view its Byzantine mosaics and St. George’s Church. Visit Mount Nebo, where Moses is believed to have seen the Promised Land. Continue to Little Petra, a Nabataean archaeological site with sandstone-carved structures. Stay overnight in Petra.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Exploring Petra - A Visit to the Enchanting Red Rose City
package_itineraries.description: Today, explore Petra’s wonders. Walk through the Siq to reach the Treasury, marvel at rock-cut tombs, temples, and Roman theatres. After a day of exploration, return to your hotel in Petra.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Exploring Petra and Wadi Rum’s Desert Wonders
package_itineraries.description: Following breakfast, travel to Wadi Rum for a jeep safari across its dramatic landscapes. Known as the “Valley of the Moon,” Wadi Rum is filled with breathtaking rock formations. Stay overnight at a hotel in Wadi Rum.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Wadi Rum to Amman - A City Exploration
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, return to Amman. The rest of the day is free for independent sightseeing or shopping. Overnight stay in Amman.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Farewell, Amman!
package_itineraries.description: Have breakfast, then transfer to Amman Airport for your flight home.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Leisure Day in Aqaba

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: More of Aqaba

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Return to Amman

package_itineraries.title: Day 10: Amman City Tour, Jerash, and Ajloun

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sainte Marie – Roland Garros Airport Welcome
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing at Roland Garros Airport, you will be warmly greeted by our representative. They will hand over all essential travel materials, including maps, vouchers, and a detailed guide for your trip. You’ll then be transferred in a private air-conditioned vehicle to your selected hotel. The rest of the day is at leisure to relax and get accustomed to the island’s tropical charm. Spend the night at your hotel in Sainte Marie.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sainte Marie – Salazie – Sainte Marie
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, set out on an excursion filled with vivid cultural and natural experiences. Begin with a visit to brightly coloured Indian temples showcasing unique architectural styles. Next, tour Mr. Rouloff’s vanilla plantations, where you’ll learn about the cultivation of pods and enjoy the intoxicating fragrances of this exotic spice. The journey continues through lush valleys, countless waterfalls, and vibrant tropical flora, before arriving at a village linked to the legendary governor of Hell. Here, explore the traditional Creole houses with sharp ridgepoles and charming historical tales. Return to Sainte Marie in the evening for dinner and an overnight stay at your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sainte Marie to Cilaos Cirque
package_itineraries.description: Today’s highlight is the road to Cilaos Cirque, famous for its “400 bends road.” This historic mountain pass leads you to villages surrounded by towering peaks and colourful gardens filled with jacarandas, roses, and azaleas. Explore the unique heritage of Cilaos, known for its spa culture, exquisite embroidery, fine wine production, and world-famous lentils. Take a short walk or drive to “La Roche Merveilleuse” viewpoint for breathtaking panoramic vistas. Don’t miss the thermal baths, where historic ruins from the 19th century sit alongside modern spa facilities. End your day with a stop at “the whirlpool” in L’Etang-Salé before heading back to your hotel in Cilaos Cirque. Dinner and overnight stay included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Leisure in Cilaos Cirque
package_itineraries.description: This day is reserved for relaxation or optional adventures. Activities such as helicopter tours, diving, or kayaking can be arranged. After a day of leisure, spend the night at your hotel in Cilaos Cirque with all meals provided.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Departure from Cilaos Cirque
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, bid farewell to the breathtaking cirque landscapes. You’ll be transferred to the airport for your return flight or onward travel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sainte Marie – Roland Garros Airport
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Roland Garros Airport where our representative will greet you and provide maps, vouchers, and travel information. You’ll be escorted in a private vehicle to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure before your overnight stay in Sainte Marie.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sainte Marie and Salazie Excursion
package_itineraries.description: Start the morning with a tour of Indian temples in Sainte Marie, with their vivid and striking designs. Continue with a visit to Mr. Rouloff’s vanilla plantation, where you’ll learn about cultivation and preparation. Travel through lush landscapes, cascading waterfalls, and wildflowers on your way to Salazie. End the day at a Creole village renowned for its traditional houses and history. Return to Sainte Marie for dinner and overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sainte Marie to Cilaos Cirque
package_itineraries.description: Journey to Cilaos Cirque along the scenic “400 bends road.” En route, stop at viewpoints overlooking scattered hamlets and valleys. On arrival, explore charming houses, flower-filled gardens, and vibrant mountain scenery. Learn about Cilaos’s embroidery, hydrotherapy centres, lentils, and rare wine production. A visit to “La Roche Merveilleuse” viewpoint reveals stunning panoramas of the cirque. After lunch, visit the thermal baths and explore local heritage. End the day with a stop at “the whirlpool” before reaching your hotel in Cilaos Cirque. Dinner included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Free Day in Cilaos Cirque
package_itineraries.description: Spend the day at leisure or enjoy optional activities like helicopter rides, diving, or kayaking. Overnight at your hotel with breakfast and dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Volcano Explorationv
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel toward St. Peter and the Plains of Cafres. Visit the remarkable Commerson Crater, an amphitheatre-like geological site that fascinates with unique formations. Continue through striking volcanic landscapes before returning to your Cilaos hotel. Dinner and overnight stay included.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Departure from Cilaos Cirque
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a relaxed breakfast before being transferred to the airport for your flight home or onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Farewell Taipei
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before transferring to Taoyuan International Airport for your return flight.

package_itineraries.description: Upon arrival at Roland Garros Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by our representative, who will provide you with maps, vouchers, and a guidebook. A private transfer will take you to your hotel in Sainte Marie. The remainder of the day is free to relax. Overnight stay in Sainte Marie.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Sainte Marie – Salazie – Sainte Marie
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin with a visit to vibrant Indian temples. Continue with a tour of Mr. Rouloff’s vanilla plantation, where you’ll learn about cultivation and preparation. The road to Salazie is lined with waterfalls, lush forests, and wildflowers. Visit a village dedicated to the governor of Hell and admire its Creole architecture. Return to Sainte Marie for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Leisure Day in Sainte Marie
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy the entire day at your own pace. Explore local attractions or relax in the serene setting of Sainte Marie. Dinner included. Overnight stay in your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Amman
package_itineraries.description: Upon landing, you will be greeted by our representatives, who will assist with all necessary arrival formalities. From there, transfer to your hotel for check-in. After a short rest, embark on a scenic drive along the historic King’s Highway, an ancient trade route. This route takes you to Mount Nebo, a revered site offering sweeping views of the Jordan Valley and the Dead Sea. Return to your Amman hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Amman – Nazareth
package_itineraries.description: Start your morning with a hearty breakfast before heading to the Sheik Hussain Bridge. Complete customs and immigration procedures to enter Israel. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant before proceeding to Nazareth, where Archangel Gabriel appeared to Mary to foretell the birth of her son. If time permits, stop by Joseph’s workshop before dinner and an overnight stay in Nazareth.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sea of Galilee – Capernaum – Jordan River – Nazareth – Bethlehem
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, meet your guide and begin with visits to Mount Tabor, Capernaum, the Church of the Beatitudes, and Tabgha. Enjoy a short sail on an authentic Galilean fishing boat. Later, visit St. Peter’s Church, Mensa Christi, and the Church of the Primacy of Peter. Pause for lunch at a local restaurant. End the day at Yardenit, the traditional baptismal site on the Jordan River, before returning for dinner and rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Haifa – Mt. Carmel – Joppa (Tel Aviv) – Jericho – Bethlehem
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast before traveling to Caesarea and onward to Haifa, beautifully located on the slopes of Mount Carmel. Visit the Persian Hanging Gardens and Muhraqa. Pause for lunch, then continue to St. Peter’s Church, the Mediterranean shoreline, the Sycamore Tree, and Mount of Temptation. End your day in Bethlehem for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Old City of Jerusalem – Golgotha – Wailing Wall – Ein Karem – Bethlehem
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin at the Pools of Beit Hasda and walk the Via Dolorosa, tracing the 14 Stations of the Cross until Golgotha. Visit Pilate’s Judgment Hall, the Chapel of the Flagellation, Ecce Homo Arch, The Tomb, and the Convent of the Sisters of Zion. After lunch, head to Ein Karem to see the Church of Visitation and stop by the Dead Sea. Time permitting, explore Lazarus’s Tomb before returning for dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Mount of Olives – Gethsemane – Bethlehem
package_itineraries.description: Start the morning at the Mount of Olives for a panoramic view of Jerusalem. Continue to the Garden of Gethsemane, the Basilica of Agony, the Tomb of St. Mary, the Church of St. Peter of Gallicantu, and Caiaphas. Later, travel to Bethlehem for a visit to Shepherd’s Field. After lunch, explore the Church of the Nativity, Manger Square, the Milk Grotto, and Crusaders’ Cloister before returning to your hotel for dinner.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Taba (Israel) – Sinai (Egypt)
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and head to Taba. After lunch, complete border formalities to cross into Egypt. Travel onward to the Sinai Mountains, then settle into your hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Sinai – St. Catherine Monastery – Cairo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit the renowned St. Catherine Monastery, home to manuscripts dating back 15 centuries. Pause for lunch before continuing to Cairo. Here, enjoy a cruise on the Nile with dinner onboard, followed by hotel check-in for overnight rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 9: Cairo
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out and begin your final sightseeing tour, including the Pyramids, ancient churches, and the Egyptian Museum. Conclude at the airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Jerusalem
package_itineraries.description: On arrival, meet your representative and transfer to your hotel in Jerusalem. Take the evening to relax before an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Jerusalem’s New City
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, begin with a view from the Mount of Olives, followed by visits to the Garden of Gethsemane and the Church of the Agony. Continue to the Israel Museum, home to the Dead Sea Scrolls and the Herodian city model. Visit Yad Vashem, the Holocaust memorial, before traveling to Ein Karem, traditional birthplace of John the Baptist. Return for dinner and rest in Jerusalem.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Jerusalem (Old City) – Bethlehem
package_itineraries.description: Enter the Old City through one of its gates and explore the Jewish Quarter, the Western Wall, and the Temple area. Wander through bazaars, then walk the Via Dolorosa to the Church of the Holy Sepulcher. Later, ascend Mt. Zion to visit King David’s Tomb, the Room of the Last Supper, and Dormitory Abbey. In the afternoon, head to Bethlehem for the Church of the Nativity and Shepherd’s Fields before returning to Jerusalem.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Beit Shean – Nazareth – Galilee
package_itineraries.description: Depart Jerusalem via Jericho and the Jordan Valley to Beit Shean for a tour of Roman ruins. Continue to Nazareth to visit the Church of the Annunciation and Joseph’s workshop. Travel to Safed to explore mystic alleys, synagogues, and the artists’ colony before overnighting in Galilee.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Golan Heights – Sea of Galilee
package_itineraries.description: Travel through Druze villages to the Golan Heights. Visit vineyards and taste wines. Continue to Banias and the Mount of Beatitudes. Explore Capernaum and Tabgha, then reach Tiberias. Optional boat ride on the Sea of Galilee available. Overnight in Galilee.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Acre – Haifa – Caesarea – Tel Aviv
package_itineraries.description: Drive to Acre to explore Crusader fortifications. Continue to Haifa for a panoramic city tour including the Baha’i Shrine and Persian Garden. Next, visit Caesarea’s Roman Theater and Hippodrome. End with a short Tel Aviv–Jaffa tour before checking into your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Leisure Day in Tel Aviv
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy the day at your own pace, with optional excursion to the Dead Sea. Overnight in Tel Aviv.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure
package_itineraries.description: Breakfast at the hotel before transferring to Ben Gurion Airport for departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Tel Aviv
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Tel Aviv Airport, meet your representative, and transfer to your hotel. Evening free at leisure before an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tel Aviv – Jaffa – Caesarea – Megiddo – Sea of Galilee
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit Jaffa for a short walking tour. Continue to Caesarea, built by Herod, and then Megiddo, site of the battle of “Armageddon.” Travel onwards to the Sea of Galilee for an overnight stay in Tiberias.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Sea of Galilee Region
package_itineraries.description: Explore Tiberias, then visit Capernaum, Tabgha, and the Mount of Beatitudes. Continue to Golan Heights for panoramic views. End at the Yardenit Baptismal Site before returning to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Cana – Nazareth – Jordan Valley – Beit Shean – Jerusalem
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Wedding Church at Cana, followed by Nazareth’s Church of Annunciation, Mary’s Well, and Joseph’s Church. Travel via the Jordan Valley to Beit Shean and then continue to Jerusalem for overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Masada – Dead Sea
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, take a cable car to Masada to explore Herod’s fortress. Visit Qumran Caves before heading to the Dead Sea for floating and relaxation. Return to Jerusalem hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Jerusalem’s New City
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Israel Museum, Shrine of the Book, and Herodian model. Explore Ein Karem, birthplace of John the Baptist, and Yad Vashem. Later, head to Bethlehem for the Church of the Nativity and Manger Square. Return to Jerusalem hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Jerusalem’s Old City
package_itineraries.description: Tour the Western Wall, Temple Mount, Via Dolorosa, and Church of the Holy Sepulcher. Continue to Mount Zion for King David’s Tomb and the Room of the Last Supper. Visit Mount of Olives and Garden of Gethsemane. Overnight in Jerusalem.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Tel Aviv Arrival
package_itineraries.description: Arrive at Tel Aviv Airport, where a representative will assist with customs and luggage. Transfer to your hotel and enjoy the evening at leisure. Overnight in Tel Aviv.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: Tel Aviv – Beer Sheba – Masada – Dead Sea – Jerusalem
package_itineraries.description: Drive south via Ashdod and Ashkelon to Beer Sheba. Continue through Arad to Masada, exploring Herod’s palaces and Roman camps. Proceed to the Dead Sea for floating and relaxation. Journey via Ein Gedi and the Judean Desert to Jerusalem. Overnight in Jerusalem.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Jerusalem (New City)
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Israel Museum, Shrine of the Book, and Herodian city model. Continue to Ein Karem, birthplace of John the Baptist, and Yad Vashem. Later, head to Bethlehem to explore the Church of the Nativity and Manger Square. Return to Jerusalem hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Jerusalem (Old City)
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, visit the Western Wall, Temple Mount, and walk the Via Dolorosa to the Church of the Holy Sepulcher. Continue to Mount Zion for King David’s Tomb and the Room of the Last Supper. Admire views from the Mount of Olives and visit the Garden of Gethsemane. Overnight in Jerusalem.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Beit Shean – Nazareth – Safed – Galilee
package_itineraries.description: Drive north through Jericho and the Jordan Valley to Beit Shean for a tour of Roman ruins. Continue to Nazareth for the Church of the Annunciation, then to Safed for its mystical synagogues and artists’ colony. Overnight in Galilee.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Golan Heights – Sea of Galilee – Tiberias
package_itineraries.description: Travel to Golan Heights via Druze villages and Banias. Visit vineyards, then continue to Capernaum, the Mount of Beatitudes, and Tabgha. End at Tiberias for an overnight stay.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Acre – Haifa – Caesarea – Tel Aviv
package_itineraries.description: Visit Acre to explore Crusader fortifications. Continue to Haifa for Mount Carmel views, the Baha’i Shrine, and Persian Gardens. Visit Caesarea’s Roman Theater and fortress. End with a Tel Aviv–Jaffa tour before overnight stay in Tel Aviv.

package_itineraries.title: Day 8: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your departure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 1: Arrival in Mauritius
package_itineraries.description: Land at Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport and meet your tour guide. You’ll be escorted to your hotel for check-in. Take some time to rest and refresh after your journey. Enjoy the facilities and comforts of your hotel. Later, you may explore nearby surroundings or enjoy a peaceful walk along the beach.

package_itineraries.title: Day 2: North Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day guided tour of the North Island. Begin with Port Louis, the lively capital, where you’ll see the Caudan Waterfront, Central Market, and Fort Adelaide. Continue to the famous Pamplemousses Botanical Garden with its impressive collection of native and exotic plants. Conclude with a visit to the L’Aventure du Sucre Museum to discover Mauritius’s fascinating sugar history. Return to your hotel for a relaxed evening at leisure.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: South Island Tour
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, enjoy a day exploring the South Island. See Trou aux Cerfs, a dormant volcanic crater offering panoramic island views. Visit the sacred Grand Bassin, a revered Hindu pilgrimage lake. Discover Black River Gorges National Park with its waterfalls, lush forests, and native wildlife. Take a scenic coastal drive through charming villages and beaches before returning to your hotel for overnight rest.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Ile aux Cerfs (Aux Cerf Island)
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, travel to Trou d’Eau Douce on the east coast. Take a speedboat or catamaran to Ile Aux Cerfs, famous for its crystal-clear lagoons and white sandy beaches. Spend your day swimming, sunbathing, or trying optional activities like snorkeling, parasailing, or kayaking. In the late afternoon, return to the mainland and back to your hotel.

package_itineraries.title: Day 5: Leisure Day or Optional Activities
package_itineraries.description: Spend your day at leisure, relaxing at the hotel or exploring nearby attractions. Alternatively, choose from optional adventures such as snorkeling, diving, water sports, or taking a catamaran cruise across Mauritius’s vibrant coral reefs.

package_itineraries.title: Day 6: Leisure Day or Optional Activities
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy another full day to relax at the hotel and use its facilities. You may explore local markets, book a rejuvenating spa session, or enjoy a scenic seaside walk. Optional excursions include snorkeling at Blue Bay Marine Park or a glass-bottom boat ride to admire the colorful underwater life.

package_itineraries.title: Day 7: Departure
package_itineraries.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel. You’ll be transferred to Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport for your return flight. Leave with unforgettable memories of your Mauritius trip.

package_itineraries.title: Day 3: Trou Aux Cerfs & Grand Basin
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy breakfast and visit Trou Aux Cerfs crater, followed by Grand Basin’s sacred lakes. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight.

package_itineraries.title: Day 4: Pamplemousses Gardens & Grand Baie
package_itineraries.description: Visit the Royal Botanical Gardens and later head to Grand Baie for dining, beaches, and nightlife. Dinner and overnight at hotel.
